This may be expected in multi-location trials given that centres and countries often differ in factors such as clinical practice, patient case-mix and the unit costs of delivering health care. A failure to acknowledge this feature may lead to misleading conclusions in a trial-based economic study. Multilevel modelling (MLM) is an analytical framework that can be used to handle hierarchical cost-effectiveness data. Using data from a recently conducted economic analysis, this paper shows how multilevel modelling can be used to obtain (a) more appropriate estimates of the population average incremental cost-effectiveness and associated standard errors compared to standard stochastic CEA; and (b) location-specific estimates of incremental cost-effectiveness which can be used to explore appropriately the variability between centres/countries of the cost-effectiveness results.

10.1002/hec.914.abstractZh: 在医疗保健领域，成本效益分析（CEA）越来越多地与多中心和跨国随机对照临床试验（RCTs）结合进行。增加随机CEA的使用是为了考虑成本效益数据中患者间的抽样变异性，假设观测值独立分布。然而，如果数据中存在层次结构，即特定地点招募的患者在成本和结果上存在相关性，则可能导致成本效益在不同地点出现差异。在多地点试验中，这种情况是预期之中的，因为各个中心和国家的临床实践、患者病例组合以及提供医疗保健的单位成本等因素往往存在差异。忽视这一特征可能导致基于试验的经济研究得出误导性的结论。多层建模（MLM）是一种可用于处理层次化成本效益数据的分析框架。本文利用最近进行的一项经济分析的数据，展示了如何使用多层建模来获得：（a）与标准随机CEA相比，更精确的人群平均增量成本效益及其标准误差估计；（b）针对特定地点的增量成本效益估计，从而能够恰当地探讨不同中心/国家之间成本效益结果的变异性。

abstract.text: The availability of patient-level data from clinical trials has spurred a lot of interest in developing methods for quantifying and presenting uncertainty in cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA). Although the majority has focused on developing methods for using sample data to estimate a confidence interval for an incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER), a small strand of the literature has emphasized the importance of incorporating risk preferences and the trade-off between the mean and the variance of returns to investment in health and medicine (mean-variance analysis). This paper shows how the exponential utility-moment-generating function approach is a natural extension to this branch of the literature for modelling choices from healthcare interventions with uncertain costs and effects. The paper assumes an exponential utility function, which implies constant absolute risk aversion, and is based on the fact that the expected value of this function results in a convenient expression that depends only on the moment-generating function of the random variables. The mean-variance approach is shown to be a special case of this more general framework. The paper characterizes the solution to the resource allocation problem using standard optimization techniques and derives the summary measure researchers need to estimate for each programme, when the assumption of risk neutrality does not hold, and compares it to the standard incremental cost-effectiveness ratio. The importance of choosing the correct distribution of costs and effects and the issues related to estimation of the parameters of the distribution are also discussed. An empirical example to illustrate the methods and concepts is provided.

10.1002/hec.915.abstractZh: 临床试验中患者级数据的可用性引发了对量化并呈现成本效益分析不确定性方法的极大兴趣。尽管大多数研究集中在利用样本数据来估算增量成本效益比的置信区间，但少数文献强调了结合风险偏好以及健康与医学投资回报的均值与方差之间的权衡的重要性。本文展示了指数效用-矩生成函数方法如何自然地扩展这一领域，用于建模具有不确定成本和效果的医疗干预措施的选择。文章假设使用指数效用函数，这意味着恒定的绝对风险厌恶，并基于该函数期望值能够得到一个仅依赖于随机变量的矩生成函数的便捷表达式这一事实。均值-方差方法被证明是这一更一般框架的一个特例。文章使用标准优化技术描述了资源分配问题的解决方案，并推导出了在风险中性假设不成立时，研究人员需要估算的汇总指标，并将其与标准的增量成本效益比进行了比较。文章还讨论了选择正确的成本和效果分布的重要性，以及与分布参数估计相关的问题。最后，文章提供了一个实证案例来说明这些方法与概念。

abstract.text: Multinational economic evaluations often calculate a single measure of cost-effectiveness using cost data pooled across several countries. To assess the validity of pooling international cost data the reasons for cost variation across countries need to be assessed. Previously, ordinary least-squares (OLS) regression models have been used to identify factors associated with variability in resource use and total costs. However, multilevel models (MLMs), which accommodate the hierarchical structure of the data, may be more appropriate. This paper compares these different techniques using a multinational dataset comprising case-mix, resource use and cost data on 1300 stroke admissions from 13 centres in 11 European countries. OLS and MLMs were used to estimate the effect of patient and centre-level covariates on the total length of hospital stay (LOS) and total cost. MLMs with normal and gamma distributions for the data within centres were compared. The results from the OLS model showed that both patient and centre-level covariates were associated with LOS and total cost. The estimates from the MLMs showed that none of the centre-level characteristics were associated with LOS, and the level of spending on health was the centre-level variable most highly associated with total cost. We conclude that using OLS models for assessing international variation can lead to incorrect inferences, and that MLMs are more appropriate for assessing why resource use and costs vary across centres.

10.1002/hec.916.abstractZh: 跨国经济评估通常通过汇总多个国家的成本数据来计算单一的性价比指标。为了评估汇总国际成本数据的有效性，需要分析各国之间成本差异的原因。以往，通常使用普通最小二乘法回归模型来识别与资源使用和总成本变化相关的因素。然而，考虑到数据的层次结构，多层模型可能更为合适。本文使用包含来自11个欧洲国家13个中心的1300例中风患者的病例组合、资源使用和成本数据的跨国数据集，比较了这两种技术。使用普通最小二乘法和多层模型来估计患者和中心层面的变量对住院总时长和总成本的影响。比较了中心内数据采用正态分布和伽马分布的多层模型。普通最小二乘法模型的结果表明，患者和中心层面的变量都与住院总时长和总成本有关。而多层模型的结果显示，中心层面的特征与住院总时长无关，其中医疗支出水平是与总成本最相关的中心层面变量。我们得出结论，使用普通最小二乘法模型来评估国际差异可能会导致错误的推断，而多层模型更适合用于分析中心之间资源使用和成本差异的原因。

abstract.text: Welfare reform has resulted in a dramatic decline in welfare caseloads and some have claimed that a significant number of low-income women may be without health insurance as a result. The loss of insurance may reduce low-income, pregnant women's health care utilization, and this may adversely affect infant health. Welfare reform also may affect healthcare utilization and health of pregnant women and infants because of welfare-induced changes in family disposable income, time available for health investments, and levels of stress. In this paper we examine the effect of welfare reform on prenatal care utilization and birth weight of low-educated women and their infants. We find that a 50% reduction in the caseload, which is similar to that which occurred in the 1990s, is associated with a zero to seven percent decrease in first trimester prenatal care; a zero to five percent decrease in the number of prenatal care visits; and a zero to 10% increase in low birth weight. Since welfare reform was responsible for only part of the decline in the caseload, welfare reform per se had even smaller effects.

10.1002/hec.921.abstractZh: 福利改革导致福利案件数量显著下降，有人声称因此许多低收入女性可能失去了医疗保险。失去保险可能会减少低收入孕妇的医疗保健利用，这可能对婴儿健康产生不利影响。福利改革还可能因家庭可支配收入、用于健康投资的时间以及压力水平的变化，影响孕妇和婴儿的医疗保健利用及健康状况。本文研究了福利改革对低教育水平女性及其婴儿产前护理利用和出生体重的影响。我们发现，案件数量减少50%，与1990年代的情况类似，会导致孕早期产前护理次数减少0%至7%，产前护理次数减少0%至5%，低出生体重率增加0%至10%。由于福利改革只是案件数量下降的部分原因，因此福利改革本身的影响更为微小。

abstract.text: Canadian per capita drug expenditures increased markedly in recent years and have become center stage in the debate on health care cost containment. To inform public policy, these costs must be compared with the benefits provided by these drugs. This paper measures the statistical relationship between drug spending in Canadian provinces and overall health outcomes. The analysis relies on more homogenous data and includes a more complete set of controls for confounding factors than previous studies. Results show a strong statistical relationship between drug spending and health outcomes, especially for infant mortality and life expectancy at 65. This relationship is almost always stronger for private drug spending than for public drug spending. The analysis further indicates that substantially better health outcomes are observed in provinces where higher drug spending occurs. Simulations show that if all provinces increased per capita drug spending to the levels observed in the two provinces with the highest spending level, an average of 584 fewer infant deaths per year and over 6 months of increased life expectancy at birth would result.

10.1002/hec.922.abstractZh: 近年来，加拿大人均药物支出显著增加，成为医疗成本控制讨论的焦点。为了为公共政策提供信息，必须将这些支出与这些药物带来的益处进行对比。本文研究了加拿大各省药物支出与整体健康结果之间的统计关系。分析采用了更同质化的数据，并包含了比以往研究更全面的混杂因素控制措施。结果显示，药物支出与健康结果之间存在强烈的统计关系，尤其是在婴儿死亡率和65岁时的预期寿命方面。这种关系在私人药物支出中通常比公共药物支出更为显著。分析还表明，在药物支出较高的省份，健康结果明显更好。模拟结果显示，如果所有省份的人均药物支出达到两个最高支出省份的水平，那么每年将减少584例婴儿死亡，并且出生时预期寿命将增加超过6个月。

abstract.text: We investigate the effectiveness of different smoking policies on smokers' expectations to quit smoking using a choice experiment on a sample of smokers identified within the World Health Organization (WHO) MONICA Project. Our results indicate that restricted availability, increased cigarette prices, cessation subsidies and regulations at restaurants, bars and cafes increase the expected probability of smoking cessation. Regulations at work places do not seem to have any effect. The results also show the significant role of limited self-control; smokers who have the intent to quit smoking are more likely to quit smoking if a stricter regulation is implemented. Further, smokers who have received advice from their children to quit smoking or who perceive the health risks as considerable, are more likely to expect to quit smoking.

10.1002/hec.923.abstractZh: 我们研究了不同禁烟政策对吸烟者戒烟期望的影响，通过世界卫生组织（WHO）MONICA项目中的样本吸烟者进行选择实验。研究结果表明，限制香烟的供应、提高香烟价格、提供戒烟补贴以及在餐馆、酒吧和咖啡馆实施相关法规，都能增加吸烟者戒烟的预期概率。而工作场所的法规似乎没有这种效果。研究还显示，自我控制能力对戒烟行为起着重要作用；如果实施更严格的法规，有戒烟意愿的吸烟者更有可能成功戒烟。此外，那些从孩子那里得到戒烟建议或认为健康风险较大的吸烟者，更有可能期望戒烟。

abstract.text: In cost-utility analysis, the numbers of quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) gained are aggregated according to the sum-ranking (or QALY maximisation) rule. This requires that the social value from health improvements is a simple product of gains in quality of life, length of life and the number of persons treated. The results from a systematic review of the literature suggest that QALY maximisation is descriptively flawed. Rather than being linear in quality and length of life, it would seem that social value diminishes in marginal increments of both. And rather than being neutral to the characteristics of people other than their propensity to generate QALYs, the social value of a health improvement seems to be higher if the person has worse lifetime health prospects and higher if that person has dependents. In addition, there is a desire to reduce inequalities in health. However, there are some uncertainties surrounding the results, particularly in relation to what might be affecting the responses, and there is the need for more studies of the general public that attempt to highlight the relative importance of various key factors.

10.1002/hec.924.abstractZh: 在成本-效用分析中，获得的质量调整生命年（QALYs）数量是根据总和排序规则（或QALY最大化规则）进行汇总计算的。这要求健康改善所带来的社会价值是生活质量、寿命以及接受治疗人数增益的简单乘积。对文献的系统性回顾表明，QALY最大化在描述上存在缺陷。实际上，社会价值并非在生活质量与寿命上呈线性增长，而是两者都在边际上有所减少。此外，健康改善的社会价值似乎与个人的其他特征无关，除非该个人有较差的终身健康前景，或者该个人有依赖者。另外，人们还希望减少健康方面的不平等现象。然而，这些结果存在一些不确定性，特别是在影响响应的因素方面。因此，需要更多针对普通人群的研究，以明确各种关键因素的相对重要性。

abstract.text: This paper reports the results of a study to estimate a statistical health state valuation model for a revised version of the Health Utilities Index Mark 2, using Standard Gamble health state preference data. A sample of 51 health states were valued by a sample of the 198 members of the UK general population. Models are estimated for predicting health state valuations for all 8000 states defined by the revised HUI2. The recommended model produces logical and significant coefficients for all levels of all dimensions in the HUI2. These coefficients appear to be robust across model specifications. This model performs well in predicting the observed health state values within the valuation sample and for a separate validation sample of health states. However, there are concerns over large prediction errors for two health states in the valuation sample. These problems must be balanced against concerns over the validity of using the VAS based health state valuation data of the original HUI2 valuation model.

10.1002/hec.925.abstractZh: 本文报告了一项研究的结果，该研究旨在使用标准赌博健康状态偏好数据，为修订版的健康效用指数Mark 2估算一个统计健康状态估值模型。通过对英国普通人群中198名成员的健康状态样本进行估值，共选取了51种健康状态进行估算。模型用于预测修订后的HUI2所定义的8000种健康状态的估值结果。推荐的模型为HUI2中所有维度的所有水平都产生了合理且显著的系数。这些系数在模型规格上表现出稳健性。该模型在预测估值样本中的健康状态值以及另一组验证样本的健康状态时表现良好。然而，在估值样本中有两个健康状态出现了较大的预测误差。这些问题必须与使用基于VAS的健康状态估值数据对原始HUI2估值模型的有效性进行权衡。

abstract.text: The authors consider the association between productive efficiency and clinical quality in institutional long-term care for the elderly. Cross-sectional data were collected from 122 wards in health-centre hospitals and residential homes in Finland in 2001. Productive efficiency was measured in terms of technical efficiency, which was defined as the unit's distance from the (best practice) production frontier. The analysis employed stochastic production frontier estimation, where technical inefficiency in the production function was specified to be a function of ward characteristics and clinical quality of care. Several quality indicators based on the Resident Assessment Instrument, such as prevalence of pressure ulcers and depression with no treatment, were used in the analysis. The results did not reveal systematic association between technical efficiency and clinical quality of care. However, the prevalence of pressure ulcers, indicating poor quality of care was associated with technical efficiency, a fact which highlights the importance of including quality measures in the assessment of efficiency in long-term care.

10.1002/hec.926.abstractZh: 作者研究了生产效率与老年机构长期护理中的临床质量之间的关联。2001年，从芬兰的122家医疗中心医院和养老院收集了横断面数据。生产效率以技术效率来衡量，技术效率定义为单位距离与（最佳实践）生产前沿的距离。分析采用了随机生产前沿估计方法，其中生产函数中的技术效率被假设为病房特征和临床护理质量的函数。分析中还使用了基于居民评估工具的多个质量指标，如压疮的患病率以及未得到治疗的抑郁情况。研究结果并未发现技术效率与临床质量之间存在系统性关联。然而，压疮的患病率，即护理质量不佳的情况，与技术效率之间存在关联，这一事实凸显了在评估长期护理效率时纳入质量指标的重要性。

abstract.text: This study examined the influences of the interaction between a bid and the respondent's characteristics due to insufficient random assignment of bids on the estimation of willingness to pay (WTP) using data from a discrete-choice question. A contingent valuation survey of 152 examinees undergoing X-ray testing for gastric cancer screening was conducted, and the median and mean WTP for the serum pepsinogen test were estimated using a logistic regression model to which the interaction terms between the bid and the respondent's characteristics, which included gender, age, annual income, frequency of prior use of a gastric cancer screening program, and perceived health, were added. There were remarkable differences in the estimated WTP according to whether the interaction term of annual income, to which the bids had failed to be assigned randomly and which had been positively correlated with the bid, was added in the model. It is suggested that it may be necessary to check if the bids were randomly assigned to the respondent's characteristics and, when correlations with the bid are found, to adjust their interaction effects.

10.1002/hec.927.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了由于投标金额分配不随机，导致投标金额与受访者特征之间的相互作用对使用离散选择问题数据估算支付意愿的影响。对152名接受胃癌筛查X光检查的考生进行了条件价值评估调查，并使用逻辑回归模型估算了血清胃蛋白酶原检测的支付意愿中位数和平均值。模型中加入了投标金额与受访者特征之间的交互项，包括性别、年龄、年收入、之前使用胃癌筛查程序的频率以及健康感知等因素。结果显示，当模型中加入了年收入这一交互项时，估算的支付意愿存在显著差异。这表明可能需要检查投标金额是否随机分配给受访者特征，如果发现与投标金额存在相关性，则需要调整这些交互效应。

abstract.text: This paper examines the inter-rater and test-retest reliability of willingness to pay (WTP) for insecticide-treated mosquito nets and net re-treatment using the bidding game (BG), binary with follow-up (BWFU) and a novel structured haggling technique (SH). Inter-rater reliability was evaluated by having two sets of interviewers administer questionnaires to 109 (BG), 110 (BWFU) and 103 (SH) randomly selected household heads. Test-retest reliability was investigated by repeating interviews on 146 (BG), 161 (BWFU) and 139 (SH) household heads one month after an initial survey. Data analysis used testing of means, Spearman's correlation and Pearson's correlation coefficient for test of reliability, while non-parametric analysis was used to determine factors causing a variation in WTP. The study was conducted in Southeast Nigeria. Inter-rater reliability coefficients were estimated for the individual's WTP for own nets, WTP for others and WTP for re-treatment. Using WTP for own nets as the best reliability estimate, the coefficients were high at values of 0.77 (C.I. 0.72-0.86), 0.75 (C.I. 0.64-0.81) and 0.74 (C.I. 0.63-0.82) in the BG, BWFU and SH, respectively. In test-retest reliability coefficients, the coefficients for WTP for own nets were low-to-moderate at values of 0.51 (C.I. 0.40-0.62), 0.41 (C.I. 0.28-0.53) and 0.56 (C.I. 0.41-0.65) for the BG, BWFU and SH groups, respectively. Factors such as gender, change in income, unplanned expenditures, stated WTP in first survey, time-to-think, external information, and subjecting respondents to more than one interview explained the lower test-retest reliability coefficients. We conclude that the CVM was reliable in the study area and the question formats had similar levels of reliability. The lower coefficients in the test-retest reliability were due to the influence of factors affecting demand that had changed in the intervening period. Standard formats for determining reliability within CVM should be developed for easy comparison of results from different studies.

10.1002/hec.928.abstractZh: 本文研究了使用竞价游戏、二元跟进式问卷以及一种新颖的结构化讨价还价技术来评估人们对杀虫剂处理蚊帐的支付意愿以及重新处理蚊帐的支付意愿的评分者间信度和重测信度。通过让两组调查员分别对109名（竞价游戏）、110名（二元跟进式问卷）和103名（结构化讨价还价技术）随机选取的家庭主妇进行问卷调查，来评估评分者间信度。通过在一份初始调查后一个月对146名（竞价游戏）、161名（二元跟进式问卷）和139名（结构化讨价还价技术）家庭主妇进行重复调查，来研究重测信度。数据分析采用了均值检验、Spearman相关性和皮尔逊相关系数来检验信度，同时采用非参数分析来确定导致支付意愿变化的因素。该研究在尼日利亚东南部进行。对个体对自己蚊帐的支付意愿、对他人的支付意愿以及重新处理蚊帐的支付意愿的评分者间信度系数进行了估算。以对自己蚊帐的支付意愿作为最佳信度估计，其系数分别为：竞价游戏组0.77（置信区间0.72-0.86）、二元跟进式问卷组0.75（置信区间0.64-0.81）和结构化讨价还价技术组0.74（置信区间0.63-0.82）。在重测信度系数方面，对自己蚊帐的支付意愿系数较低至中等，分别为：竞价游戏组0.51（置信区间0.40-0.62）、二元跟进式问卷组0.41（置信区间0.28-0.53）和结构化讨价还价技术组0.56（置信区间0.41-0.65）。诸如性别、收入变化、意外支出、首次调查中声明的支付意愿、思考时间、外部信息以及让受访者接受多次调查等因素，解释了较低的重测信度系数。我们得出结论，在研究区域内，CVM具有可靠性，且不同问题形式的信度水平相似。测试-重测信度的较低系数是由于在间隔期间影响需求的因素发生了变化所导致的。为了便于比较不同研究的结果，应该制定用于CVM中确定信度的标准格式。

abstract.text: We analyze the effect of price regulation on delays in launch of new drugs. Because a low price in one market may 'spill-over' to other markets, through parallel trade and external referencing, manufacturers may rationally prefer longer delay or non-launch to accepting a relatively low price. We analyze the launch in 25 major markets, including 14 EU countries, of 85 new chemical entities (NCEs) launched between 1994 and 1998. Each NCE's expected price and market size in a country are estimated using lagged average price and market size of other drugs in the same (or related) therapeutic class. We estimate a Cox proportional hazard model of launch in each country, relative to first global launch. Only 55% of the potential launches occur. The US leads with 73 launches, followed by Germany (66) and the UK (64). Only 13 NCEs are launched in Japan, 26 in Portugal and 28 in New Zealand. The results indicate that countries with lower expected prices or smaller expected market size have fewer launches and longer launch delays, controlling for per capita income and other country and firm characteristics. Controlling for expected price and volume, country effects for the likely parallel export countries are significantly negative.

10.1002/hec.931.abstractZh: 我们分析了价格管制对新药上市延迟的影响。由于一个市场的低价可能会通过平行贸易和外部参考传播到其他市场，制造商可能会理性地选择较长的上市延迟或不予上市，以接受相对较低的定价。我们分析了1994年至1998年间在25个主要市场（包括14个欧盟国家）上市的85种新化学实体。每种新化学实体在某一国家的预期价格和市场规模是通过使用同一（或相关）治疗类别中其他药物的滞后平均价格和市场规模来估算的。我们建立了每个国家的上市时间Cox比例风险模型，以比较首次全球上市的情况。只有55%的潜在上市计划得以实现。美国以73种新药上市数量最多，其次是德国（66种）和英国（64种）。在日本，只有13种新化学实体上市，在葡萄牙为26种，在新西兰为28种。结果表明，在控制人均收入和其他国家和企业特征的情况下，预期价格较低或预期市场规模较小的国家，其上市数量较少且上市延迟时间较长。在控制预期价格和销量后，潜在平行出口国的国家效应显著为负。

abstract.text: Criticism of contingent valuation (CV) stresses warm glow and free-riding as possible causes for biased willingness to pay figures. We present an empirical framework to study the existence of warm glow and free-riding in hypothetical WTP answers based on a CV survey for the measurement of health-related Red Cross services. Both in conventional double-bounded and spike models we do not find indication of warm glow phenomena and free-riding behaviour. The results are very robust and insensitive to the applied payment vehicles. Theoretical objections against CV do not find sufficient empirical support.

10.1002/hec.933.abstractZh: 对条件价值评估方法的批评指出，温暖感和对他人免费使用的态度可能是导致支付意愿数据出现偏差的原因。我们提出了一个实证框架，用于研究基于条件价值评估调查的假设支付意愿回答中是否存在温暖感和对他人免费使用的现象。无论是在传统的双边界模型还是 spike模型中，我们都未能发现温暖感现象和免费使用行为的迹象。研究结果非常稳健，且对所使用的支付方式并不敏感。针对条件价值评估方法的理论反对意见并未得到充分的实证支持。

abstract.text: Recently, commentators have suggested that the distributional form of cost data should be explicitly modelled to gain efficiency in estimating the population mean. We perform a series of simulation experiments to evaluate the usual sample mean and the mean estimator of a lognormal distribution, in the context of both theoretical distributions and three large empirical datasets. The sample mean is always unbiased, but is somewhat less efficient when the population distribution is truly lognormal. However the lognormal estimator can perform appallingly when the true distribution is not lognormal. In practical situations, where the true distribution is unknown, the sample mean generally remains the estimator of choice, especially when limited sample size prohibits detailed modelling of the cost data distribution.

10.1002/hec.941.abstractZh: 最近，评论人士提出，应明确建模成本数据的分布形式，以提高估计总体均值的效率。我们进行了一系列模拟实验，评估了在理论分布和三个大型实证数据集背景下，样本均值与对数正态分布的均值估计方法的效果。样本均值始终具有无偏性，但当总体分布确实为对数正态分布时，其效率会有所降低。然而，当真实分布并非对数正态分布时，对数正态分布的均值估计方法的表现会非常糟糕。在实际情况下，当真实分布未知时，样本均值通常仍然是首选的估计方法，尤其是在样本量有限、无法对成本数据分布进行详细建模的情况下。

abstract.text: Diabetes has been shown to have a detrimental impact on employment and labor market productivity, which results in lost work days and higher mortality/disability. This study utilizes data from the Border Epidemiologic Study on Aging to analyze the endogeneity of diabetes in an employment model. We use family history of diabetes as genetic instrumental variables. We show that assuming that diabetes is an exogenous variable results in an overestimate (underestimate) of the negative impact of diabetes on female (male) employment. Our results are particularly relevant in the case of populations where genetic predisposition has an important role in the etiology of diabetes.

10.1002/hec.942.abstractZh: 研究表明，糖尿病对就业和劳动力市场生产力有负面影响，导致工作天数减少以及死亡率和残疾率上升。本研究利用边境流行病学老龄化研究的数据，分析糖尿病在就业模型中的内生性。我们将糖尿病的家族史作为遗传工具变量。研究结果表明，将糖尿病视为外生变量会导致对糖尿病对女性（男性）就业的负面影响进行高估（或低估）。在那些遗传倾向在糖尿病发病中起着重要作用的人群中，我们的研究结果尤其具有相关性。

abstract.text: In trial-based cost-effectiveness analysis baseline mean utility values are invariably imbalanced between treatment arms. A patient's baseline utility is likely to be highly correlated with their quality-adjusted life-years (QALYs) over the follow-up period, not least because it typically contributes to the QALY calculation. Therefore, imbalance in baseline utility needs to be accounted for in the estimation of mean differential QALYs, and failure to control for this imbalance can result in a misleading incremental cost-effectiveness ratio. This paper discusses the approaches that have been used in the cost-effectiveness literature to estimate absolute and differential mean QALYs alongside randomised trials, and illustrates the implications of baseline mean utility imbalance for QALY calculation. Using data from a recently conducted trial-based cost-effectiveness study and a micro-simulation exercise, the relative performance of alternative estimators is compared, showing that widely used methods to calculate differential QALYs provide incorrect results in the presence of baseline mean utility imbalance regardless of whether these differences are formally statistically significant. It is demonstrated that multiple regression methods can be usefully applied to generate appropriate estimates of differential mean QALYs and an associated measure of sampling variability, while controlling for differences in baseline mean utility between treatment arms in the trial.

10.1002/hec.944.abstractZh: 在基于试验的成本效益分析中，治疗组之间的基线平均效用值总是存在不平衡。患者的基线效用与随访期间的质量调整生命年（QALYs）高度相关，这主要是因为基线效用通常参与QALY的计算。因此，在估算平均差异QALYs时，需要考虑到基线效用不平衡的问题，如果不加以控制，可能会导致误导性的增量成本效益比率。本文讨论了成本效益文献中用于估算绝对和差异平均QALYs的方法，并说明了基线平均效用不平衡对QALY计算的影响。通过最近一项基于试验的成本效益研究的数据和微观模拟实验，比较了不同估算方法的相对表现，结果显示，在存在基线平均效用不平衡的情况下，广泛使用的差异QALYs计算方法会得出错误的结果，无论这些差异是否具有统计学上的显著性。研究表明，多重回归方法可以有效地用于生成差异平均QALYs的适当估算值，以及相关的抽样变异性度量，同时控制试验中各治疗组之间基线平均效用差异的影响。

abstract.text: The aim of this paper is to discuss the use of stochastic league tables approach in cost-effectiveness analysis of diabetes interventions. It addresses the common grounds and differences with other methods of presenting uncertainty to decision-makers. This comparison uses the cost-effectiveness results of medical guidelines for Dutch diabetes type 2 patients in primary and secondary care. Stochastic league tables define the optimum expansion pathway as compared to baseline, starting with the least costly and most cost-effective intervention mix. Multi-intervention cost-effectiveness acceptability curves are used as a way to represent uncertainty information on the cost-effectiveness of single interventions as compared to a single alternative. The stochastic league table for diabetes interventions shows that in case of low budgets treatment of secondary care patients is the most likely optimum choice. Current care options of diabetes complications are shown to be inefficient compared to guidelines treatment. With more resources available one may implement all guidelines and improve efficiency. The stochastic league table approach and multi-intervention cost-effectiveness acceptability curves in uncertainty analysis lead to similar results. In addition, the stochastic league table approach provides policy makers with information on affordability by budget level. It fulfils more adequately the information requirements to choose between interventions, using the efficiency criterion.

10.1002/hec.945.abstractZh: 本文旨在探讨在糖尿病干预的成本效益分析中采用随机联赛表方法的应用。文章分析了该方法与其他不确定性呈现方式在决策者面前的共通点和差异。比较案例采用了荷兰2型糖尿病患者在一级和二级护理中的医疗指南成本效益结果。随机联赛表定义了与基线相比的最佳扩展路径，从成本最低且效益最高的干预组合开始。多干预成本效益可接受曲线被用作一种方式，来表示单个干预措施与单一替代方案在成本效益上的不确定性信息。糖尿病干预的随机联赛表显示，在预算有限的情况下，二级护理患者的治疗是最可能的最佳选择。与指南治疗相比，目前糖尿病并发症的护理方案显得效率低下。如果有更多的资源可用，就可以实施所有指南措施，从而提高效率。随机联赛表方法和多干预成本效益可接受曲线在不确定性分析中的结果相似。此外，随机联赛表方法为政策制定者提供了按预算水平划分的可负担性信息，从而更充分地满足了使用效率标准进行干预选择的信息需求。

abstract.text: We consider an economy where public hospitals are capacity-constrained, and we analyse the willingness of health authorities to reach agreements with private hospitals to have some of their patients treated there. When physicians are dual suppliers, we show that a problem of cream-skimming arises and reduces the incentives of the health authority to undertake such a policy. We argue that the more dispersed are the severities of the patients, the greater the reduction in the incentives will be. We also show that, despite the patient selection problem, when the policy is implemented it is often the case that health authorities decide a more intensive transfer of patients to private practice.

10.1002/hec.946.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个公共医院容量受限的经济体系，并分析卫生当局与私立医院达成协议以让部分患者在其医院接受治疗的意愿。当医生同时担任双重角色时，我们发现会出现“挤占资源”的问题，这会降低卫生当局实施此类政策的积极性。我们指出，患者病情的严重程度越分散，这种积极性降低的程度就越大。此外，尽管存在患者选择问题，但当政策实施时，卫生当局往往更倾向于将患者转交给私立医疗机构。

abstract.text: As part of their practice, policymakers have to make economic evaluations using clinical trial data. Recent interest has been expressed in determining how cost-effectiveness analysis can be undertaken in a regression framework. In this respect, published research basically provides a general method for prognostic factor adjustment in the presence of imbalance, emphasizing sub-group analysis. In this paper, we present an alternative method from a Bayesian approach. We propose the use of covariates in Bayesian health technology assessment in order to reduce uncertainty about the effect of treatments. We show its advantages by comparison with another published method that do not adjust for covariates using simulated data.

10.1002/hec.947.abstractZh: 作为政策制定者的日常工作，他们必须使用临床试验数据来进行经济评估。最近，人们开始关注如何在回归框架下进行成本效益分析。在这方面，已发表的研究基本上提供了一种在存在不平衡情况下进行预后因素调整的一般方法，并强调了子组分析的重要性。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于贝叶斯方法的替代方法。我们建议在贝叶斯健康技术评估中利用协变量，以减少对治疗效果的不确定性。通过与另一种不使用模拟数据且不调整协变量的已发表方法进行比较，我们展示了该方法的优势。

abstract.text: In the economic evaluation of health care programmes, productivity costs are often estimated using patients' wages for the period of absence. However, the use of such methods for short periods of absence is controversial. A previous study found that short-term absence is often compensated for during normal working hours and therefore does not lead to productivity losses. As such, the application of any approach almost certainly overestimates productivity costs. In this study, we examined the productivity costs for five different patient populations and one employee population, using the classical method and by identifying when extra effort was needed. In general, the results showed that productivity costs based on identifying extra effort were 25-30% of the classical estimates. For absences of just one day, productivity costs were relevant in only 17-19% of cases. For absences of two weeks or longer, productivity costs were relevant in 35-39% of cases. Measurement of the compensating mechanisms seemed to be valid, since there is considerable agreement between the opinion of supervisors and their employees about whether compensation covers productivity costs. There was much less agreement between supervisors and their employees on specific compensating mechanisms, however. The measurement of compensating mechanisms also seemed to be valid, because--as expected--different compensating mechanisms were reported for different occupations. In our study populations, compensating mechanisms appeared to differ with occupational characteristics, like part-time work, managerial work and shift work.

10.1002/hec.948.abstractZh: 在医疗项目的经济评估中，生产力成本通常是通过使用患者缺勤期间的工资来估算的。然而，使用这种方法对短期缺勤进行评估存在争议。先前的研究发现，短期缺勤通常在正常工作时间内得到补偿，因此不会造成生产力损失。因此，任何方法的应用几乎肯定会高估生产力成本。在这项研究中，我们针对五种不同的患者群体和一种员工群体，使用传统方法并识别需要额外努力的情况，以评估生产力成本。总体而言，基于识别额外努力得出的生产力成本占传统估算值的25-30%。对于仅一天缺勤的情况，只有17-19%的案例中生产力成本显著。而对于两周或更长时间的缺勤，35-39%的案例中生产力成本显著。补偿机制的测量似乎是有效的，因为主管和员工对补偿是否涵盖生产力成本的意见相当一致。然而，主管和员工在具体的补偿机制方面的一致性则较低。补偿机制的测量也似乎是有效的，因为正如预期的那样，不同职业的补偿机制有所不同。在我们的研究群体中，补偿机制似乎会因职业特征而有所不同，例如兼职工作、管理工作和轮班工作。

abstract.text: In a recent paper in this journal, Andrew Lloyd reviewed some potential threats to the estimation of health care benefits in monetary terms. Particular emphasis was placed on the extent to which the use of non-compensatory heuristics may distort the results. Although it is useful to be reminded of these problems, Lloyd's paper does not do justice to the attention such issues have already received, and continue to receive, within Health Economics. The aim of this paper is twofold. Firstly, it seeks to provide a more balanced and comprehensive view of the evidence by considering some of the methodological work that health economists have conducted in many of the areas pointed out by Lloyd. Secondly, and more importantly, it suggests ways to combine the economic and psychological views of human decision-making, providing a much more positive perspective to all those researchers out there who recognize the necessity of using stated preference methods to inform health policy.

10.1002/hec.949.abstractZh: 在最近发表于本期刊的一篇论文中，Andrew Lloyd回顾了在货币价值衡量医疗保健效益时可能面临的一些威胁。特别强调了使用非补偿性启发式方法可能导致的结果偏差。虽然提醒人们注意这些问题是有用的，但Lloyd的论文并没有充分反映健康经济学领域对这些问题的重视程度，以及它们持续受到的关注。本文的目的有两个方面。首先，它试图通过考虑健康经济学家在Lloyd指出的许多领域所进行的方法论工作，来提供一个更加平衡和全面的视角。其次，更重要的是，它提出了将经济与心理视角结合起来的方法，为那些认识到需要使用陈述偏好方法来为健康政策提供信息的研究人员提供了一个更为积极的视角。

abstract.text: Socio-economic status effects on total and cause-specific mortality are studied using data on all 15.8 million inhabitants of the Netherlands in 1999. Two problems are addressed that often hamper this kind of research: the lack of reliable social status information at the individual level and the intermingling of individual and neighbourhood status effects. The first problem is dealt with by using socio-economic status information of the very close environment of the detailed postcode areas (average 41 inhabitants) in which one is living and the second one by combining this information with such area information at the much larger level of neighbourhoods (1500 inhabitants) or boroughs (6600 inhabitants). Clear and independent effects of socio-economic status at all three levels of aggregation are found on total mortality and for a majority of causes of death. In almost all cases, the effects are to the disadvantage of people living in the lowest status areas. The effects are generally strongest at the detailed postcode level and weakest at the borough level, suggesting greater importance of factors at the nearby or individual level than at the farther away level(s).

10.1002/hec.950.abstractZh: 本研究利用1999年荷兰1580万居民的数据，探讨了社会经济地位对总死亡率和特定死因死亡率的影响。研究面临两个常见的问题：个体层面的可靠社会状态信息缺失，以及个体与社区状态效应的相互交织。对于第一个问题，通过利用居民所在详细邮政编码区域（平均41人）的近邻社会经济状态信息来解决；对于第二个问题，则通过将这些信息与更大范围的社区（1500人）或行政区（6600人）的信息相结合来处理。研究发现，在三个层次上，社会经济地位对总死亡率和大多数死因都有明显且独立的影响。在几乎所有情况下，这些影响对生活在最低地位区域的居民来说都是不利的。这些影响在详细邮政编码层面最为显著，在行政区层面则最为微弱，这表明在更近的层面或个体层面，因素的重要性高于在更远层面。

abstract.text: This study investigated inequalities in physically healthy days in the United States during 1993-1999, by socioeconomic and demographic group. The generalized entropy GE(2) and other indices were computed using data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System survey, 1993-1999. The results indicate that GE(2) for the US population increased by 17% during 1993-1999. Low-to-middle income groups had the highest increases in inequalities during this time (51-66%), whereas the least educated, Asian/Pacific Islanders, American Indians/Alaska Natives, the oldest, the youngest, and the richest had the lowest (-14-10%). In 1999, inequalities ranged from 0.0153 (income>or=$50 000) to 0.112 (income<$10 000). Inequalities have increased during 1993-1999 and vary substantially across groups. The American Indians/Alaska Natives experienced the highest inequalities whereas Asians/Pacific-Islanders exhibited the lowest inequalities. More attention should be given to within-group inequalities.

10.1002/hec.951.abstractZh: 本研究调查了1993-1999年间美国不同社会经济和人口群体在身体健康天数上的不平等现象。通过1993-1999年行为风险因素监测系统的数据，计算了广义熵GE(2)及其他指标。研究结果表明，1993-1999年间美国人口的GE(2)增加了17%。在此期间，低收入至中等收入群体的不平等程度增幅最高，达到了51-66%；而受教育程度最低的人群、亚裔/太平洋岛民、美国印第安人/阿拉斯加原住民、年龄最大或最年轻的人群以及收入最高的人群，其不平等程度最低，分别减少了14-10%。1999年时，不平等程度从0.0153（收入>或=50,000美元）到0.112（收入<10,000美元）不等。1993-1999年间，不平等程度有所上升，且不同群体之间存在显著差异。美国印第安人/阿拉斯加原住民面临的最高不平等程度，而亚裔/太平洋岛民则表现出最低的不平等程度。因此，应更加关注群体内部的不平等现象。

abstract.text: Rural health providers have looked to telemedicine as a technology to reduce costs. However, virtual access to physicians and specialists may alter patients' demand for face-to-face physician access. We develop a model of service demand under managed care, and apply the model to a telemedicine application in rural Alaska. Provider-imposed delays and patient costs were highly significant predictors of patient contingent choices in a survey of ENT clinic patients. The results suggest that telemedicine increased estimated patient benefits by about $40 per visit, and reduced patients' loss from rationing of access to physicians by about 20%.

10.1002/hec.952.abstractZh: 农村卫生服务提供者将远程医疗视为降低成本的技术。然而，通过虚拟方式联系医生和专家可能会改变患者对面对面就诊的需求。我们建立了一个基于管理式医疗的服务需求模型，并将其应用于阿拉斯加农村地区的远程医疗应用。在一项针对耳鼻喉科诊所患者的调查中，医疗服务提供者设定的延迟时间以及患者成本被认为是影响患者选择的重要因素。研究结果表明，远程医疗使每位患者的预期收益增加了约40美元，并减少了患者因医生资源分配不均而造成的损失约20%。

abstract.text: When the health sector variable whose inequality is being investigated is binary, the minimum and maximum possible values of the concentration index are equal to micro-1 and 1-micro, respectively, where micro is the mean of the variable in question. Thus as the mean increases, the range of the possible values of the concentration index shrinks, tending to zero as the mean tends to one and the concentration index tends to zero. Examples are presented on levels of and inequalities in immunization across 41 developing countries, and on changes in coverage and inequalities in selected countries.

10.1002/hec.953.abstractZh: 当被研究的不平等变量为二进制变量时，浓度指数的最小可能值和最大可能值分别等于micro-1和1-micro，其中micro是该变量的值的均值。因此，随着均值的增加，浓度指数可能取值的范围会缩小，当均值趋近于1时，浓度指数趋近于零。文中以41个发展中国家的免疫接种水平的不平等情况为例，并探讨了选定国家中接种覆盖率的变化及不平等现象。

abstract.text: After teenage males, elderly individuals have the highest per capita motor vehicle fatality rate in the United States. Surprisingly, there has been only limited work examining the effect of state motor vehicle laws on older driver fatalities. This paper uses state-level data from the 1985-2000 Fatality Analysis Reporting System to examine the effects of changes in state laws dealing with license renewal, seatbelt use, speed limits, and driving while intoxicated on fatalities among drivers and others aged 65 and over. Negative binomial regressions are estimated using alternatively state and year fixed effects, or age and year fixed effects. In-person license renewal reduced fatalities among the oldest drivers, but vision tests, road tests and the length of the license renewal cycle generally did not. In terms of policies that apply to all drivers, seatbelt laws, particularly with primary enforcement, were generally the only policies that reduced older driver fatalities. These results are noteworthy because a number of policies that have been effective towards increasing younger driver safety are not relevant for older drivers, implying that policymakers must think broadly about using state laws to improve older driver safety.

10.1002/hec.955.abstractZh: 在青少年男性之后，美国老年人拥有最高的人均机动车死亡率。令人惊讶的是，关于州级机动车法律对老年驾驶者死亡影响的研究非常有限。本文利用1985-2000年致命事故分析报告系统中的州级数据，研究了州法律中关于驾照续期、安全带使用、速度限制以及酒后驾车等方面的变化对65岁及以上驾驶者及其他人员死亡的影响。通过负二项回归模型，分别考虑了州和年份的固定效应，以及年龄和年份的固定效应。结果发现，亲自办理驾照续期有助于降低老年驾驶者的死亡风险，而视力测试、道路测试以及驾照续期周期的长度则没有明显效果。就适用于所有驾驶者的政策而言，特别是强制实施的安全带法律，通常是唯一能够降低老年驾驶者死亡风险的政策。这些结果值得注意，因为许多对年轻驾驶者安全有效的政策对老年驾驶者并不适用，这表明政策制定者必须广泛考虑利用州法律来提高老年驾驶者的安全。

abstract.text: We compare the more common physician compensation method of fee-for-service to the less common payment-for-outcomes method. This paper combines an investigation of the theoretical properties of both of these payment regimes with a unique data set from rural Cameroon in which patients can choose between outcome and service based payments. We show that consideration of the role of patient effort in the production of health leads to important differences in the performance of these contracts. Theory and empirical evidence show that when illnesses require (or are responsive to) large amounts of both patient and practitioner effort, outcome based payment schemes are superior to effort based schemes. The traditional healer--a practitioner who offers health services on an outcome-contingent basis--is advanced as an important example of how patient effort can be better understood and tapped in health care.

10.1002/hec.956.abstractZh: 我们将较为常见的医师薪酬制度——按服务收费制，与较为少见的按结果付费制进行了比较。本文结合了对这两种支付制度的理论分析，并使用了来自喀麦隆农村的独特数据集，该数据集让患者在基于结果的付费和基于服务的付费之间做出选择。研究表明，在考虑患者努力对健康产生的影响时，这两种支付制度的绩效存在显著差异。理论和实证证据表明，当疾病需要（或对大量患者和医师的努力有反应）时，基于结果的支付制度优于基于努力的支付制度。传统的医师——那些以结果为基础提供健康服务的从业者——是一个重要的例子，说明如何更好地理解和利用患者的努力在医疗保健中发挥作用。

abstract.text: Background Recent proposals to reform cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA) by weighting health benefits [(Quality-adjusted life-years) QALYs] by recipients' age are based on studies examining age-related preferences in life-saving contexts. We investigated whether the perceived importance of age in resource allocation decisions differs among intervention-types. Methods 160 individuals were recruited from a cafeteria of a university medical centre and asked to choose between hypothetical health care programmes. Scenario A described two programmes treating life-threatening conditions and Scenario B two programmes providing palliative care. Programmes were identical except in average patient age (35 versus 65). Respondents also directly rated the importance of age for allocating resources for six types of interventions. Results Responses for the life-saving scenario favoured younger age groups while those for the palliative care scenario showed no age preference. The difference between scenarios was statistically significant. When directly rating the importance of age in allocating treatment resources, people placed greatest importance on age in treating infertility and life-saving, and least importance in treating depression. Discussion The importance people place on age as a resource allocation criterion depends on the clinical context. As QALYs serve as a common measure of health benefits for all intervention types, age weighting of QALYs is premature.

10.1002/hec.958.abstractZh:
背景  
近期关于改革成本效益分析（CEA）的提案，通过根据接受者的年龄对健康效益的[(质量调整生命年) QALYs]进行加权，这些提案基于研究在救命情境中年龄相关的偏好。我们研究了在不同类型的干预措施中，人们对年龄重要性的感知是否存在差异。  

方法  
我们从一所大学医疗中心的食堂招募了160名参与者，让他们在两种假设的医疗保健方案之间进行选择。方案A描述了两种治疗危及生命的疾病的方法，方案B描述了两种提供姑息治疗的方法。这两种方案的其余方面都是相同的，只是患者的平均年龄不同（35岁与65岁）。参与者还直接评价了年龄在分配资源时对六种类型干预措施的重要性。  

结果  
在救命情境下，人们更倾向于选择年轻年龄组，而在姑息治疗情境下则没有显示出年龄偏好。这种差异在统计上显著。当人们直接评价年龄在分配治疗资源中的重要性时，人们认为年龄在治疗不孕症和救命方面最为重要，而在治疗抑郁症方面则重要性最低。  

讨论  
人们对年龄作为资源分配标准的重要性取决于临床情境。由于QALYs可以作为所有干预措施的健康效益的通用衡量标准，因此现在就进行年龄加权是不合适的。

abstract.text: This study reports on the results of a discrete choice experiment undertaken in Zambia to assess the factors influencing the demand for hospital care in Zambia, in particular the role of (perceived) quality and trade-offs between price and quality. Valuations of quality were evaluated for the treatment of two acute medical conditions, cerebral malaria in adults and acute pneumonia in children. Marginal utilities and willingness-to-pay for attributes of quality of hospital care were estimated, together with the influence of socioeconomic characteristics on these valuations and the extent of non-linearities in valuations of time and money. We find the technical quality of care, as represented by the thoroughness of examination, to be the most important quality attribute, followed by staff attitudes and drug availability. Valuations of examination thoroughness increase with increasing socioeconomic status. The disutility of cost was found to decrease with higher socioeconomic status, as was the value of drug availability. The implications of the findings for Zambian hospital sector reforms are discussed.

10.1002/hec.959.abstractZh: 本研究报告了在赞比亚进行的一项离散选择实验的结果，旨在评估影响赞比亚医院护理需求的因素，特别是（感知到的）质量以及价格与质量之间的权衡。对两种急性医疗状况的治疗质量进行了评估，分别是成人的脑疟疾和儿童的急性肺炎。研究估计了医院护理质量各属性的边际效用和支付意愿，同时探讨了社会经济特征对这些评估的影响，以及时间和金钱评估中的非线性程度。研究发现，作为护理质量重要属性的技术质量，即检查的彻底性，是最重要的因素，其次是员工态度和药品供应情况。检查彻底性的评估随着社会经济地位的提高而增加。成本的不满意度随着社会经济地位的提高而降低，药品供应的价值也呈现下降趋势。研究还讨论了这些发现对赞比亚医院部门改革的意义。

abstract.text: Cost shifting occurs when changes in administered prices of one payer lead to compensating changes in prices charged to other payers. Microeconomic theory suggests that cost shifting can take place under limited conditions and some empirical studies indicate that that hospital cost shifting may have actually occurred at various times. This study designs a model to conceptualize and quantify the potential welfare loss caused by hospital cost shifting under idealized yet fairly plausible conditions. The resulting estimate yields only a small efficiency loss of at most, 0.84% of private hospital expenditures in the US for 1992.

10.1002/hec.961.abstractZh: 成本转移发生在某一支付方管理价格的变化导致其他支付方收费价格相应的变化时。微观经济理论表明，在特定的条件下，成本转移可能发生，一些实证研究也表明，医院成本转移实际上在不同时间都可能发生。本研究构建了一个模型，以概念化和量化在理想化但相当合理的条件下，医院成本转移可能导致的福利损失。研究结果表明，1992年美国私立医院的支出效率损失仅为0.84%。

abstract.text: Incomplete data due to premature withdrawal (dropout) constitute a serious problem in prospective economic evaluations that has received only little attention to date. The aim of this simulation study was to investigate how standard methods for dealing with incomplete data perform when applied to cost data with various distributions and various types of dropout. Selected methods included the product-limit estimator of Lin et al. the expectation maximisation (EM-) algorithm, several types of multiple imputation (MI) and various simple methods like complete case analysis and mean imputation. Almost all methods were unbiased in the case of dropout completely at random (DCAR), but only the product-limit estimator, the EM-algorithm and the MI approaches provided adequate estimates of the standard error (SE). The best estimates of the mean and SE for dropout at random (DAR) were provided by the bootstrap EM-algorithm, MI regression and MI Monte Carlo Markov chain. These methods were able to deal with skewed cost data in combination with DAR and only became biased when costs also included the costs of expensive events. None of the methods were able to deal adequately with informative dropout. In conclusion, the EM-algorithm with bootstrap, MI regression and MI MCMC are robust to the multivariate normal assumption and are the preferred methods for the analysis of incomplete cost data when the assumption of DCAR is not justified.

10.1002/hec.966.abstractZh: 由于数据过早缺失（ dropout），不完整数据在预期经济评估中构成了一个严重问题，但迄今为止对此的关注甚少。本模拟研究的目的是探讨标准处理方法在处理具有不同分布和不同类型dropout的成本数据时的情况。所选方法包括Lin等人的乘积极限估计器、期望最大化（EM）算法、多种多重插补方法以及完全案例分析和均值插补等简单方法。在完全随机dropout的情况下，几乎所有方法都是无偏的，但只有乘积极限估计器、EM算法和多重插补方法能够提供足够的标准误差估计。对于随机dropout，最佳的平均值和标准误差估计分别由自助法EM算法、多重插补回归和多重插补蒙特卡洛马尔可夫链提供。这些方法能够处理偏斜的成本数据，并且只有在成本包含昂贵事件的成本时才会产生偏差。没有任何方法能够充分处理有信息性的dropout。总之，当假设DCAR不成立时，EM算法结合自助法、多重插补回归和多重插补蒙特卡洛马尔可夫链是分析不完整成本数据的首选方法，因为它们对多元正态假设具有鲁棒性。

abstract.text: Hospital acquired infections (HAI) are costly but many are avoidable. Evaluating prevention programmes requires data on their costs and benefits. Estimating the actual costs of HAI (a measure of the cost savings due to prevention) is difficult as HAI changes cost by extending patient length of stay, yet, length of stay is a major risk factor for HAI. This endogeneity bias can confound attempts to measure accurately the cost of HAI. We propose a two-stage instrumental variables estimation strategy that explicitly controls for the endogeneity between risk of HAI and length of stay. We find that a 10% reduction in ex ante risk of HAI results in an expected savings of pound 693 ($ US 984).

10.1002/hec.967.abstractZh: 医院获得性感染（HAI）虽然成本高昂，但许多是可以避免的。评估预防计划的效果需要有关其成本和收益的数据。估算HAI的实际成本（即由于预防而节省的成本）是困难的，因为HAI的成本会因延长患者住院时间而发生变化，而住院时间正是HAI的主要风险因素。这种内生性偏差可能会干扰对HAI成本的准确评估。我们提出了一种两阶段工具变量估计策略，该策略能够明确控制HAI风险与住院时间之间的内生关系。我们发现，将HAI的风险降低10%，预计可节省693英镑（984美元）的成本。

abstract.text: Using a statistical model and a partial equilibrium economic search model, we develop a methodology for appraising the value of consumer information about the quality of health care providers and apply it to information about physicians' predispositions to perform cesarean section deliveries. There are three primary results. First, information's value is roughly proportional to a simple statistical metric of its accuracy; the constant of proportionality can be imputed from knowledge of consumer search methods and consumer preferences. Second, the function governing the production of information from data 'inputs' can have surprising economic properties, such as economies of scale, that usefully inform the efficient production of consumer information. These properties are robust even when the value of information cannot be precisely determined. Third, information's value is enhanced by the way physicians are sorted into hospitals but greatly attenuated by the presence of other dimensions of physician heterogeneity. Under plausible assumptions, the value of information in our empirical application is small enough that it is not surprising that consumers do not utilize it when selecting a physician.

10.1002/hec.968.abstractZh: 通过运用统计模型和部分均衡经济搜索模型，我们开发了一种评估消费者关于医疗服务提供者质量信息价值的方法论，并将其应用于医生选择进行剖宫产分娩倾向的信息评估。研究得出三个主要结果：首先，信息价值大致与其准确性这一简单统计指标成正比；比例常数可以通过了解消费者搜索方法和消费者偏好来估算。其次，从数据“输入”生成信息的功能可能具有令人惊讶的经济特性，例如规模经济，这些特性有助于有效生产消费者信息。即使信息价值无法精确确定，这些特性仍然具有稳健性。第三，医生在医院中的排序方式会增强信息价值，但其他医生异质性因素的存在则会大大削弱这一价值。在合理的假设下，我们实证应用中信息价值较小，因此消费者在选择医生时并不利用这些信息并不令人意外。

abstract.text: The growing number of multinational clinical trials in which patient-level health care resource data are collected have raised the issue of which is the best approach for making inference for individual countries with respect to the between-treatment difference in mean cost. We describe and discuss the relative merits of three approaches. The first uses the random effects pooled estimate from all countries to estimate the difference for any particular country. The second approach estimates the difference using only the data from the specific country in question. Using empirical Bayes estimation a third approach estimates the country-specific difference using a variance-weighted linear sum of the estimates provided by the other two approaches. The approaches are illustrated and compared using the data from the ASSENT-3 trial.

10.1002/hec.969.abstractZh: 随着越来越多的跨国临床试验收集患者层面的医疗资源数据，如何针对各个国家在治疗间平均成本差异进行推断的问题变得愈发重要。我们描述了三种方法的相对优势。第一种方法利用来自所有国家的随机效应汇总估计值来估算特定国家的差异。第二种方法仅使用相关国家的数据来估算差异。第三种方法采用经验贝叶斯估计，利用其他两种方法提供的估计值进行方差加权线性求和，以估算特定国家的差异。这些方法通过ASSENT-3试验的数据进行了说明和比较。

abstract.text: In this paper, we study physician specialty decisions using several unique data sets which include information on almost all Canadian physicians who practised in Canada between 1989 and 1998. Unlike previous studies, we use a truly exogenous measure of potential income across general and specialty medicine to estimate the effect of income on physicians' specialty choices. Furthermore, our estimation procedure allows us to purge the income-effect estimates of non-pecuniary specialty attributes which may be correlated with higher paying specialties. Understanding the effect of potential income (and other variables) on choices is necessary if the desired mix across generalists and specialists as well as across specialties is to be achieved. Our results show that physicians respond to differences in income when making their specialty decisions.

10.1002/hec.970.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了医生专业选择的决策，使用了多个独特的数据集，这些数据集包含了1989年至1998年间在加拿大执业的所有加拿大医生的详细信息。与以往的研究不同，我们采用了一种真正的外生性指标来衡量普通医学与专业医学之间的潜在收入差异，以此来评估收入对医生专业选择的影响。此外，我们的估计方法还允许我们排除那些可能与高薪专业相关的非金钱性专业属性的收入效应估计。如果希望实现普通医生与专业医生之间的合理搭配，以及不同专业之间的合理分配，那么了解潜在收入（及其他变量）对选择的影响是非常必要的。我们的研究结果表明，医生在做出专业选择时确实会考虑收入的差异。

abstract.text: The objective of the present study was to evaluate whether people include the effects of ill-health on income and leisure in quality of life valuation when the measure is silent on both. A convenience sample of 20 health professionals had to rate a health status on a visual analogue scale (VAS) without being explicitly asked to consider the effects of ill-health on income and leisure. A majority of respondents (60%) does not consider income effects and 75% does consider the effects on leisure. Explicitly asking respondents to incorporate these effects lowers the valuation. Our results indicate that whatever separation between costs and effects is preferred, using quality of life measures which are silent on income and leisure, leads to either double-counting or ignoring real costs or effects.

10.1002/hec.971.abstractZh: 本研究的目的是评估人们在评估生活质量时是否考虑到了健康不佳对收入和休闲的影响。我们选取了20名健康专业人士作为样本，让他们在视觉模拟量表上评估健康状况，而没有被明确要求考虑健康不佳对收入和休闲的影响。大多数受访者（60%）认为收入不受影响，而75%的受访者认为健康不佳会影响休闲时间。明确要求受访者考虑这些影响会降低评估的准确性。我们的研究结果表明，无论偏好将成本与影响分开处理，使用那些不涉及收入和休闲的生活质量指标，都会导致重复计算或忽略实际的成本与影响。

abstract.text: The effect of raising cigarette taxes to reduce smoking has been the subject of several studies, which often treat the price of cigarettes as an exogenous factor given to smokers who respond to it by adjusting their smoking behavior. However, cigarette prices vary with brand and quality, and smokers can and do switch to lower-priced brands to reduce the impact of the tax on the cost of cigarettes as they try to consume the same number of cigarettes as they had before a tax hike. Using data from a two-year follow-up interview survey conducted before and after a new cigarette tax scheme was imposed in Taiwan in 2002, this study examines three behavioral changes smokers may make to respond to tax-induced cigarette price increase: brand-switching, amount consumed, and amount spent on smoking. These changes were studied in relation to smoker income, before-tax cigarette price, level of addiction, exposure to advertizing, and consumer loyalty. We found that smokers, depending upon exposure to advertizing, level of consumer loyalty and initial price of cigarettes, switched brands to maintain current smoking habits and control costs. We also found that the initial amount smoked and level of addiction, not price, at least not at the current levels in Taiwan, determined whether a smoker reduced the number of cigarettes he consumed.

10.1002/hec.972.abstractZh: 提高香烟税以减少吸烟的影响一直是多项研究的主题，这些研究通常将香烟价格视为一个外生因素，吸烟者会对此作出反应，调整他们的吸烟行为。然而，香烟价格因品牌和品质而异，吸烟者可以并且确实会转向价格较低的品牌，以减少税收对香烟成本的影响，同时他们试图保持与税收增加前相同的香烟消费量。本研究利用2002年台湾实施新的香烟税方案前后进行的为期两年的跟踪调查数据，探讨了吸烟者为应对税收导致的香烟价格上涨而可能做出的三种行为改变：品牌转换、消费量和吸烟支出。这些改变与吸烟者的收入、税前香烟价格、成瘾程度、广告曝光程度以及消费者忠诚度有关。我们发现，根据广告曝光程度、消费者忠诚度以及香烟的初始价格，吸烟者会转换品牌以维持当前的吸烟习惯并控制成本。此外，我们发现在台湾当前的情况下，决定吸烟者是否减少香烟消费的不是价格，而是初始吸烟量和成瘾程度。

abstract.text: This paper addresses the problem of how to value health care programmes with different ratios of costs to effects, specifically when taking into account that these costs and effects are uncertain. First, the traditional framework of maximising health effects with a given health care budget is extended to a flexible budget using a value function over money and health effects. Second, uncertainty surrounding costs and effects is included in the model using expected utility. Other approaches to uncertainty that do not specify a utility function are discussed and it is argued that these also include implicit notions about risk attitude.

10.1002/hec.973.abstractZh: 本文探讨了如何评估成本与效果比例不同的医疗保健项目的问题，特别是当这些成本与效果具有不确定性时。首先，传统的以给定医疗保健预算最大化健康效果的框架被扩展为使用货币和健康效果的价值函数来构建灵活预算。其次，模型中考虑了成本与效果的不确定性，并采用了期望效用理论。此外，还讨论了那些不指定效用函数的不确定性处理方法，并认为这些方法也隐含了关于风险态度的概念。

abstract.text: How far are income-related inequalities in the health sector due to gaps between poor and less poor areas, rather than due to differences between poor and less poor people within areas? This note sets out a method for answering this question, and illustrates it with two empirical examples. The disproportionate accrual of health subsidies to Vietnam's better-off is found to be largely due to the fact that richer provinces have larger per capita subsidies, while pro-rich inequalities in health insurance coverage in rural China are found to be largely due to the fact that better-off villages have been more successful at preventing the collapse of their insurance schemes.

10.1002/hec.974.abstractZh: 在卫生领域，收入相关的不平等现象在多大程度上是由于贫困地区与较富裕地区之间的差距造成的，而不是由于同一地区内贫困人群与较富裕人群之间的差异造成的？本文提出了一种回答这个问题的方法，并通过两个实证案例进行了说明。研究发现，越南较富裕地区获得的卫生补贴比例较高，主要是因为这些地区的每人补贴金额较大；而在中国农村，对医疗保险覆盖方面的不平等现象，主要是由于较富裕的村庄在防止保险计划崩溃方面更为成功。

abstract.text: This explores the applicability of Sen's capability approach to the economic evaluation of health care programmes. An individual's 'capability set' describes his freedom to choose valuable activities and states of being ('functionings'). Direct estimation and valuation of capability sets is not feasible at present. Standard preference-based methods such as willingness to pay are feasible, but problematic due to the adaptive and constructed nature of individual preferences over time and under uncertainty. An alternative is to re-interpret the QALY as a cardinal and interpersonally comparable index of the value of the individual's capability set. This approach has limitations, since the link between QALYs and capabilities is not straightforward. Nevertheless, the QALY approach is recognisable as an application of the capability approach since it pays close attention to functionings, through the use of survey-based multi-attribute health state valuation instruments, and permits conceptions of value other than the traditional utilitarian ones of choice, desire-fulfilment and happiness. Furthermore, suitably re-interpreted, it can account for (i) non-separability between health and non-health components of value; and suitably modified it can also account for (ii) process attributes of care, which may have a direct effect on non-health functionings such as comfort and dignity, and (iii) sub-group diversity in the value of the same health functionings.

10.1002/hec.975.abstractZh: 本文探讨了Sen的能力论在医疗项目经济评估中的适用性。个人的“能力集”描述了其选择有价值活动和状态的能力。目前直接估计和评估能力集是不可行的。基于偏好的标准方法如支付意愿是可行的，但由于个人偏好随时间变化且存在不确定性，这种方法存在问题。另一种方法是重新解释QALY，将其视为一个与人际相关的、可比较的、衡量个人能力集价值的指标。这种方法存在局限性，因为QALY与能力之间的联系并不简单明了。尽管如此，QALY方法可以被视为能力论的应用，因为它通过基于调查的多属性健康状态评估工具，密切关注功能状态，并允许使用不同于传统功利主义的价值观念，如选择、愿望满足和幸福感。此外，经过适当重新解释后，QALY方法可以解释（i）健康与非健康价值成分之间的不可分离性；经过适当修改后，还可以解释（ii）护理过程的属性，这些属性可能直接影响非健康功能状态，如舒适和尊严；以及（iii）同一健康功能状态在不同群体中的价值差异。

abstract.text: Many public and private healthcare payers use formularies as a tool for controlling drug costs and quality. Although the price per dose is often negotiated as part of the formulary listing, payers may still face unlimited financial risk if demand is much greater than expected at the time of listing. The requirement for drug manufacturers to submit a budget impact analysis as part of the drug approval process suggests that payers are concerned not only with the cost effectiveness of a proposed drug but also with the potential increase in total expenditures that may result from new formulary listings. In this paper we define and analyze a model for financial risk sharing based on the total budget. Our analysis focuses on optimal decision making by manufacturers in the presence of a specific risk sharing agreement. We derive a manufacturer's optimal statement of budget impact and discuss several properties of the optimal solution.

10.1002/hec.976.abstractZh: 许多公共和私人医疗保健支付机构使用处方目录作为控制药品成本和质量的工具。尽管每剂的价格通常会在处方目录中协商确定，但如果需求在目录编制时超出预期，支付机构仍可能面临巨大的财务风险。药品制造商在药品审批过程中需要提交预算影响分析，这表明支付机构不仅关注拟议药品的成本效益，还关注新处方目录可能导致的总支出增加。在本文中，我们定义并分析了一个基于总预算的财务风险分担模型。我们的分析重点在于在特定的风险分担协议存在的情况下，制造商如何做出最优决策。我们推导出了制造商的最优预算影响声明，并讨论了最优解的几个特性。

abstract.text: The aim of this study was to estimate the change in socio-economic differences in life expectancy and in quality-adjusted life years (QALYs), for men and women at different ages, in Sweden 1980 to 1997. We used data from the Swedish Survey of Living Conditions (the ULF survey), which is linked to mortality data, to estimate the life expectancy in different socio-economic groups in 1980 and 1997 (n=100 868). Health state scores were obtained by mapping responses to selected ULF survey interview questions into the generic health-related quality of life measure EQ-5D, using the UK EQ-5D index tariff (n=34 447). For 20-year-old men the difference in life expectancy between the highest (higher non-manual) and the lowest socio-economic group (unskilled manual) was 2.11 years in 1980 and 3.79 years in 1997. The corresponding figures for 20-year-old women were 1.56 in 1980 and 2.15 in 1997. The difference in QALYs between the highest and the lowest socio-economic group increased from 5.76 QALYs in 1980 to 7.06 QALYs in 1997 for 20-year-old men, and from 4.14 QALYs in 1980 to 5.66 QALYs in 1997 for 20-year-old women. The widening socio-economic inequalities over time were more stable for men than for women. We conclude that our results suggest that the socio-economic inequality in health has increased between 1980 and 1997 in Sweden.

10.1002/hec.977.abstractZh: 本研究旨在估算1980年至1997年间瑞典不同年龄组男性与女性在预期寿命及质量调整生命年方面的社会经济差异变化。我们采用了瑞典生活条件调查的数据，该数据与死亡数据相关联，以估算1980年和1997年不同社会经济群体的预期寿命（样本量100,868人）。通过将受访者对选定生活条件调查问题的回答映射到通用健康相关生活质量指标EQ-5D中，得到了健康状态评分，并使用了英国EQ-5D指数标准（样本量34,447人）。对于20岁的男性，1980年最高社会经济群体与最低社会经济群体之间的预期寿命差异为2.11年，而1997年这一差异上升至3.79年。20岁女性的相应数据分别为1980年的1.56年和1997年的2.15年。20岁男性在最高与最低社会经济群体之间的质量调整生命年差异从1980年的5.76 QALYs增加到1997年的7.06 QALYs，而20岁女性则从1980年的4.14 QALYs增加到1997年的5.66 QALYs。随着时间的推移，社会经济不平等的扩大在男性中比女性更为稳定。我们的研究结果表明，1980至1997年间，瑞典的健康领域社会经济不平等有所加剧。

abstract.text: The paper uses new and detailed data from a population sample of individuals with arthritis to examine the impact of objective measures of need for treatment and individual measures of socio-economic position on the distribution of public and private health care. The quality of the data and the range of explanatory factors are more detailed than previously used to study of the allocation of NHS care. The results indicate that broadly the NHS appears to meet its equity goal of equal care for equal medical need, though there is evidence that education increases the amount of resources received. The results also show the importance of the interaction between the public and private sectors in the UK.

10.1002/hec.978.abstractZh: 该论文利用来自关节炎患者样本的新且详细的数据，研究治疗需求的客观衡量指标与个人社会经济地位之间的因素对公共和私人医疗保健分配的影响。数据的质量和解释因素的范围比以往用于研究NHS医疗分配的研究更为详细。研究结果表明，NHS在满足平等医疗需求方面似乎实现了其公平目标，尽管有证据表明教育程度会影响所获得的资源数量。研究结果还显示了英国公共部门与私营部门之间相互作用的重要性。

abstract.text: New guidelines recommend different influenza vaccination timing for different subpopulations due to the limited availability of flu shots (FS). This study's objectives are to develop a theoretical model to demonstrate why some individuals choose to receive an early FS while others choose a late FS and to empirically explore the determinants of vaccination timing. Empirical results generally supported the theoretical results. Individuals vary their FS timing in response to variations in perceived risks, chronic condition levels reflecting their risk of influenza infection, and opportunity costs, measured by the presence of medical care other than an FS.

10.1002/hec.979.abstractZh: 新的指南建议根据不同亚群体的流感疫苗接种时间，因为流感疫苗的供应有限。本研究的目标是开发一个理论模型，以解释为什么有些个体选择提前接种流感疫苗，而另一些则选择延迟接种，并通过实证研究探讨影响疫苗接种时间的因素。实证结果总体上支持了理论预测。个体在接种时间上的选择受到感知风险、反映流感感染风险的慢性健康状况以及机会成本的影响，机会成本体现在除流感疫苗之外的其他医疗服务可用性上。

abstract.text: We provide a new test of the feasibility of using contingent valuation to value informal care. We start with a theoretical model of informal caregiving and derive that willingness to pay depends positively on wealth and negatively on own health, whereas the effect of other's health is sign-ambiguous. These predictions are tested in two new data sets on patients' and caregivers' willingness to pay (WTP) and willingness to accept (WTA) for informal care. The data are generally consistent with the theoretical predictions: wealth generally has a positive impact and own health a negative impact. Other's health has a mixed effect. We find only small differences between WTP and WTA. Our findings suggest that contingent valuation may be a useful technique to value informal care in economic evaluations of health care.

10.1002/hec.980.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的测试方法，用于评估使用条件价值评估来评估非正式护理的可行性。我们从非正式护理的理论模型出发，发现支付意愿与财富呈正相关，与自身健康状况呈负相关，而他人健康状况的影响则具有不确定性。这些预测通过两个关于患者和护理者愿意为非正式护理支付和接受费用的数据集进行了验证。数据总体上支持理论预测：财富通常对支付意愿有积极影响，而自身健康状况则对其有负面影响。他人健康状况的影响则具有混合性。我们发现支付意愿与接受费用之间的差异很小。我们的研究结果表明，条件价值评估可能是评估医疗保健经济评价中非正式护理价值的一种有用方法。

abstract.text: Experimental design is critical to valid inference from the results of discrete choice experiments (DCEs). In health economics, DCEs have placed limited emphasis on experimental design, typically employing relatively small fractional factorial designs, which allow only strictly linear additive utility functions to be estimated. The extensive literature on optimal experimental design outside health economics has proposed potentially desirable design properties, such as orthogonality, utility balance and level balance. However, there are trade-offs between these properties and emphasis on some properties may increase the random variability in responses, potentially biasing parameter estimates.This study investigates empirically the design properties of DCEs, in particular, the optimal method of combining alternatives in the choice set. The study involves a forced choice between two alternatives (treatment and non-treatment for a hypothetical health care condition), each with three, four-level, alternative-specific attributes. Three experimental design approaches are investigated: a standard six-attribute, orthogonal main effects design; a design that combines alternatives to achieve utility balance, ensuring no alternatives are dominated; and a design that combines alternatives randomly. The different experimental designs did not impact on the underlying parameter estimates, but imposing utility balance increases the random variability of responses.

10.1002/hec.981.abstractZh: 实验设计对于从离散选择实验的结果中得出有效推论至关重要。在健康经济学领域，离散选择实验对实验设计的重视程度有限，通常采用相对较小的因子设计，这些设计仅允许估计严格线性的加性效用函数。健康经济学之外的相关文献提出了一些理想的实验设计属性，如正交性、效用平衡和水平平衡。然而，这些属性之间存在权衡，强调某些属性可能会增加响应的随机变异性，从而可能使参数估计产生偏差。本研究通过实证方法探讨了离散选择实验的设计属性，特别是组合选择集中不同选项的最佳方法。研究涉及在两种假设的健康护理条件下进行强制选择，每种条件都有三个或四个级别的特定属性。研究了三种实验设计方法：标准的六属性正交主效应设计；一种结合选项以实现效用平衡的设计，确保没有任何选项被支配；以及一种随机组合选项的设计。不同的实验设计并未对基础参数估计产生影响，但实施效用平衡会增加响应的随机变异性。

abstract.text: This paper discusses the inherent problems associated with applying dummy coding when including a fixed comparator in a discrete choice experiment, and seeks to illustrate the misinterpretations that may arise if the analyst is not aware of the problem. This note provides two examples of possible misinterpretations with dummy coding and how it is solved with the use of effects coding.

10.1002/hec.984.abstractZh: 本文讨论了在离散选择实验中引入固定比较组时，应用虚拟编码所伴随的固有问题，并试图说明如果分析师不了解这些问题，可能会出现的误解。本文提供了两个关于虚拟编码可能产生的误解的例子，以及如何使用效应编码来解决这些问题。

abstract.text: Recently the National Institute for Clinical Excellence (NICE) updated its methods guidance for technology assessment. One aspect of the new guidance is to require the use of probabilistic sensitivity analysis with all cost-effectiveness models submitted to the Institute. The purpose of this paper is to place the NICE guidance on dealing with uncertainty into a broader context of the requirements for decision making; to explain the general approach that was taken in its development; and to address each of the issues which have been raised in the debate about the role of probabilistic sensitivity analysis in general. The most appropriate starting point for developing guidance is to establish what is required for decision making. On the basis of these requirements, the methods and framework of analysis which can best meet these needs can then be identified. It will be argued that the guidance on dealing with uncertainty and, in particular, the requirement for probabilistic sensitivity analysis, is justified by the requirements of the type of decisions that NICE is asked to make. Given this foundation, the main issues and criticisms raised during and after the consultation process are reviewed. Finally, some of the methodological challenges posed by the need fully to characterise decision uncertainty and to inform the research agenda will be identified and discussed.

10.1002/hec.985.abstractZh: 最近，英国国家临床卓越研究所（NICE）更新了其技术评估的方法指南。新指南的一个要求是，所有提交给该研究所的成本效益模型都必须采用概率敏感性分析。本文旨在将NICE关于处理不确定性的指南置于更广泛的决策要求背景之下；解释其制定过程中所采用的一般方法；并探讨关于概率敏感性分析在决策中的作用的各种争议点。制定指南最合适的起点是确定决策所需的条件。基于这些要求，可以识别出最能满足这些需求的分析方法和框架。文章认为，关于处理不确定性的指南，特别是要求使用概率敏感性分析的规定，是出于NICE所面临的决策类型的需求而合理设定的。在这一基础上，回顾了咨询过程中及之后提出的主要问题和批评意见。最后，将探讨由于需要全面描述决策不确定性而带来的方法论挑战，以及这些挑战对研究议程的影响。

abstract.text: Background The assessment of health states considered to be worse than dead is a controversial issue. Objective To investigate how health states are valued when they are close to dead. Differences between adjacent states are compared with the differences between the first positive/first negative state with death. Methods A secondary analysis of the EuroQol EQ-5D data of the measurement of valuation and health (MVH) study was made. Visual analog scale (VAS) and time trade-off (TTO) preferences for 43 health states were obtained. Various subsets of 13 states were valued by 3395 respondents. States were rank ordered by their VAS and TTO values. Differences between adjacent states were calculated for the VAS and the positive and negative TTO values. Results Complete data were obtained in 2997 respondents. The differences between the ordered VAS values were equally large. In contrast, significant gaps around dead were found for the positive as well as the negative TTO values. Discussion These results are interpreted in light of a descriptive QALY model. This model was expanded to include utilities worse than dead. The VAS task does not pick up that bad states become intolerable, i.e. worse than dead, when they last too long, but the TTO task does. The current QALY model seems to lack descriptive validity for states valued worse than dead and for states with a maimal endurable time.

10.1002/hec.986.abstractZh:
背景  
将健康状态评估为“比死亡更糟糕”是一个有争议的问题。  
目的  
研究当健康状态接近死亡时，人们如何评估这些状态。比较相邻状态之间的差异与第一个积极状态/第一个消极状态与死亡之间的差异。  
方法  
对EuroQol EQ-5D数据进行了二次分析，该数据来自测量价值与健康（MVH）的研究。通过视觉模拟量表（VAS）和时间权衡（TTO）偏好调查了43种健康状态。3395名受访者对13种状态的子集进行了评估。根据VAS和TTO值对状态进行了排序。计算了相邻状态在VAS和积极/消极TTO值上的差异。  
结果  
在2997名受访者中获得了完整数据。排序后的VAS值差异同样显著。相比之下，在死亡附近，无论是积极TTO值还是消极TTO值都存在显著差距。  
讨论  
这些结果结合描述性QALY模型进行了解释。该模型被扩展以包括比死亡更糟糕的状态。VAS任务未能捕捉到那些糟糕状态在持续时间过长时变得难以忍受的情况，而TTO任务则能够做到这一点。目前的QALY模型似乎缺乏对比死亡更糟糕的状态以及具有最大可忍受时间状态的描述性有效性。

abstract.text: Health summary measures are commonly used by policy makers to help make decisions on the allocation of societal resources for competing medical treatments. The net monetary benefit is a health summary measure that overcomes the statistical limitations of a popular measure namely, the cost-effectiveness ratio. We introduce a linear model framework to estimate propensity score adjusted net monetary benefit. This method provides less biased estimates in the presence of significant differences in baseline measures and demographic characteristics between treatment groups in quasi-randomized or observational studies. Simulation studies were conducted to better understand the utility of propensity score adjusted estimates of net monetary benefits when important covariates are unobserved. The results indicated that the propensity score adjusted net monetary benefit provides a robust measure of cost-effectiveness in the presence of hidden bias. The methods are illustrated using data from SEER-Medicare for the treatment of bladder cancer.

10.1002/hec.987.abstractZh: 健康综合指标常被政策制定者用来帮助决策，以分配社会资源用于不同的医疗治疗。净货币效益是一种健康综合指标，它能够克服一种常用指标——成本效益比——在统计上的局限性。我们引入了一个线性模型框架来估算经过倾向得分调整的净货币效益。这种方法在基线指标和人口特征在准随机化或观察性研究中存在显著差异的情况下，能够提供更无偏的估计结果。通过模拟研究，我们进一步了解了在重要协变量无法观测时，倾向得分调整后的净货币效益估计值的实用性。研究结果表明，在存在隐藏偏差的情况下，倾向得分调整后的净货币效益仍然能够提供一个稳健的成本效益衡量标准。这些方法以SEER-Medicare中关于膀胱癌治疗的数据为例进行了说明。

abstract.text: While there are a number of studies examining the relationship between nurse staffing and quality, none has examined structural differences in the relationship between nurse staffing and quality contingent upon the level of managed care penetration. We used administrative data, and a dynamic panel data model to examine this relationship in a panel of 422 acute care hospitals from 1990 to 1995. We found that there were significant differences in the relationship between nurse staffing and both mortality and length of stay depending upon the level of HMO penetration in the hospital's market.

10.1002/hec.988.abstractZh: 虽然有许多研究探讨了护士人员配置与医疗质量之间的关系，但没有研究考察在管理式医疗普及程度不同的情况下，护士人员配置与医疗质量之间的关系是否存在结构性差异。我们利用行政数据和一个动态面板数据模型，对1990至1995年间422家急性护理医院的数据进行了分析。研究发现，根据医院所在地区HMO的普及程度，护士人员配置与死亡率和住院时间之间的关系存在显著差异。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effects of AIDS education at school and at home on the sexual behavior of American youth. Multinomial logit equations of the probabilities of abstinence, sexual intercourse with a condom, and intercourse without a condom are estimated using data from the Youth Risk Behavior Supplement of the 1992 National Health Interview Survey. We find no significant effects of AIDS education on the probability of abstinence, but we do find that AIDS education significantly raises the likelihood of condom-protected relative to unprotected intercourse. These results indicate that risk-altering and risk-revealing AIDS education dominate any utility-altering effects favoring intercourse over abstinence. We also find that young women are influenced by AIDS education to a greater extent than young men. Overall, our results suggest that educating young people about AIDS does not promote sex and encourages safer sex, reducing the likelihood of HIV transmission and lowering the subsequent social costs.

10.1002/hec.989.abstractZh: 本文探讨了学校和家庭中的艾滋病教育对美国青少年性行为的影响。利用1992年全国健康访谈调查中的青少年风险行为补充数据，我们建立了多项逻辑回归方程来估计青少年保持禁欲、使用避孕套进行性行为以及不使用避孕套进行性行为的概率。研究发现，艾滋病教育对保持禁欲的概率没有显著影响，但确实显著提高了使用避孕套进行性行为的可能性，相对于不使用避孕套的性行为而言。这些结果表明，改变风险观念和揭示风险信息的艾滋病教育，比改变性行为偏好对促进性行为更有影响力。此外，我们还发现，年轻女性受到艾滋病教育的影响比年轻男性更为显著。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，对年轻人进行艾滋病教育并不能促进性行为，反而能鼓励更安全的性行为，从而降低HIV传播的风险以及随之而来的社会成本。

abstract.text: Real cigarette prices in the US increased from the early 1980s to early 1990s. Holding all else equal, adolescent initiation of regular smoking should have declined during this period. Using national population-based surveys (n = 336 343) conducted in the 1990s, we present trends (early 1960s to mid-1990s) in the initiation of regular smoking among 14-17-year-old adolescents and 18-21-year-old young adults. We also present trends in consumer-price-index-adjusted cigarette price and tobacco-industry expenditures for price-subsidizing promotions. We relate price and price-subsidizing tobacco industry expenditures to trends in initiation in the two age groups, using autoregressive integrated moving average models (ARIMA). From the model results, we conclude that price-subsidizing promotions may provide the tobacco industry with an effective way to segment the market. That is, they effectively offer lower prices to population subgroups that are more price-sensitive (e.g. young smokers not yet addicted), countering the depressing effect of general price increases on smoking. Thus, we find that the relationship of cigarette price to smoking behavior is more complex than previously described.

10.1002/hec.990.abstractZh: 美国实际香烟价格从20世纪80年代初上升到90年代初。在其他条件相同的情况下，青少年开始定期吸烟的比例在这一时期应该有所下降。利用1990年代进行的全国人口调查数据（n=336,343），我们展示了14-17岁青少年和18-21岁年轻成年人定期吸烟的起始趋势（从20世纪60年代初到90年代中期）。我们还展示了消费者价格指数调整后的香烟价格以及烟草行业用于价格补贴促销的支出趋势。我们通过自回归积分移动平均模型（ARIMA）将价格和烟草行业的价格补贴支出与两个年龄组的吸烟起始趋势联系起来。根据模型结果，我们认为价格补贴促销可能为烟草行业提供了一种有效的市场细分方式。也就是说，它们有效地为对价格更敏感的人群（例如尚未上瘾的年轻吸烟者）提供更低的价格，从而抵消了一般价格上涨对吸烟行为的负面影响。因此，我们发现香烟价格与吸烟行为之间的关系比之前描述的更为复杂。

abstract.text: Physicians are key personnel in a sector which is important due to its size as well as the quality of service it provides. We estimate the labor supply of physicians employed at hospitals in Norway, using personnel register data merged with other public records. A dynamic labor supply equation is estimated using a sample of 1303 male physicians observed over the period 1993-1997. The methods of estimation are GMM and system GMM. We reject the static model in favor of a dynamic model and obtain short run wage elasticities around 0.3. This is higher than previously estimated for physicians, in particular for those who are not self-employed.

10.1002/hec.991.abstractZh: 医生是某个行业中的关键人员，该行业因其规模以及所提供的服务质量而具有重要意义。我们利用人员登记数据与其他公共记录相结合，估算了挪威医院中医生的劳动力供给。通过对1993-1997年期间观察到的1303名男性医生的数据进行分析，我们建立了一个动态劳动力供给模型。采用的估算方法是GMM和系统GMM方法。我们拒绝使用静态模型，转而采用动态模型，并得出短期工资弹性约为0.3的结论。这一数值高于之前对医生的估算，尤其是对于那些非自雇医生的工资弹性。

abstract.text: In a recent contribution to this journal, M. Hoel correctly shows that under risk aversion the allocation of health resources should be directed to health conditions for which the expected outcomes are below average. In this letter we show that besides risk aversion, the degree of absolute prudence (to be defined in the text) also matters to obtain an optimal allocation.

10.1002/hec.992.abstractZh: 在最近发表于该期刊的一篇论文中，M. Hoel正确地指出，在风险厌恶的情况下，健康资源的分配应当指向那些预期结果低于平均水平的健康状况。在这封信中，我们表明，除了风险厌恶之外，绝对谨慎程度（具体定义见正文）同样对实现最优资源分配至关重要。

abstract.text: This study examines the impact of Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) coverage on the provision of preventive medicine. We investigate whether any association reflects selection effects on the part of patients and/or physicians or a causal impact of managed care itself. Causal effects may occur on the supply side or the demand side. Using a large national database of Medicare and non-Medicare patients, we investigate these issues for eight common preventive medical procedures. We find that preventive care is substantially higher with HMO coverage than with traditional fee-for-service reimbursement. Our findings also suggest that the impact of HMOs on preventive medicine is a causal one, and does not merely reflect selection effects. Both supply-side (e.g. provider) and demand-side (e.g. patient) factors appear to play a role in the higher incidence of preventive care among HMO enrollees. Patient demand effects are stronger for simple treatments such as physicals, while supply-side effects seem to dominate for relatively complex preventive care procedures such as mammograms.

10.1002/hec.993.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了健康维护组织（HMO）的保险覆盖对预防医学提供的影响。我们调查了这种关联是否反映了患者和/或医生的选择效应，还是管理式医疗本身的因果效应。因果效应可能发生在供应端或需求端。我们利用一个包含Medicare和非Medicare患者的全国性大型数据库，对八种常见的预防医学程序进行了研究。我们发现，在HMO保险覆盖下，预防保健服务的提供量远高于传统的按服务收费模式。我们的研究结果还表明，HMO对预防医学的影响具有因果性，而不仅仅是选择效应。在HMO会员中，供应端（如医疗服务提供者）和需求端（如患者）的因素似乎都对预防保健服务的较高提供率起到了作用。对于简单的治疗项目，如体检，患者的需求效应更为显著；而对于相对复杂的预防保健程序，如乳腺X光检查，供应端的效应似乎更为重要。

abstract.text: Sickness absence tends to be negatively correlated with unemployment rates. In addition to pure health effects, this may be due to moral hazard behavior by workers who are fully insured against income loss during sickness and to physicians who meet demand for medical certificates. Alternatively, it may reflect changes in the composition of the labor force, with more sickness-prone workers entering the labor force in upturns. A panel of Norwegian register data is used to analyze long-term sickness absences. The unemployment rate is shown to be negatively associated with the probability of absence, and with the number of days of sick leave. Restricting the sample to workers who are present in the whole sample period, the negative relationship between absence and unemployment becomes clearer. This indicates that procyclical variations in sickness absence are caused by established workers and not by the composition of the labor force.

10.1002/hec.994.abstractZh: 病假缺席通常与失业率呈负相关。除了纯粹的健康因素外，这可能是由于完全投保的工人因生病而失去收入时的道德风险行为，以及医生为了满足对医疗证明的需求而产生的需求变化。或者，这也可能反映了劳动力构成的变化，即更多容易患病的工人进入劳动力市场。本研究利用挪威的登记数据来分析长期病假缺席情况。结果显示，失业率与缺席概率以及病假天数呈负相关。将样本限制在整个样本期间都在职的工人中，这种缺席与失业之间的负相关关系变得更加明显。这表明，病假缺席的顺周期性变化是由固定工人引起的，而非劳动力构成的变化所致。

abstract.text: In Ireland, approximately 30% of the population receive free GP services (medical card patients) while the remainder (private patients) must pay for each visit. In 1989, the manner in which GPs were reimbursed by the State for their medical card patients was changed from fee-for-service to capitation while private patients continued to pay on a fee-for-service basis. Concerns about supplier-induced demand were in part responsible for this policy change. The purpose of this paper is to examine the extent to which the utilisation of GP services is influenced by the reimbursement system facing GPs, by comparing visiting rates for the two groups before and after this change. Using a difference-in-differences approach on pooled micro-data from 1987, 1995 and 2000, we find that medical card eligibility has a consistently positive and significant effect on the utilisation of GP services. However, the differential in visiting rates between medical card patients and others did not narrow between 1987 and 1995 or 2000, as might have been anticipated if supplier-induced demand played a major role prior to the change in reimbursement system.
