10.1111/0034-6527.00332.abstractZh: 为什么环保组织能够在环境影响政策方面产生强大影响，却不需要进行大量的游说活动呢？本文构建了一个关于“直接”游说政府与“间接”说服公众这两种政治影响力争夺模式的模型，并发现这两种方式实际上是互补的。然而，当公众说服能力的提升或公众环境意识的增强时，这两种方式之间的替代关系就会显现出来。研究结果表明，环保组织缺乏政治影响力这一现象，可能与财务限制无关，而是因为它们在公众说服方面的有效性更高，以及公众环境意识的不断提高所导致的。

abstract.text: Recent efforts to restructure electricity markets have renewed interest in assessing how consumers respond to price changes. This paper develops a model for evaluating the effects of alternative tariff designs on electricity use. The model concurrently addresses several interrelated difficulties posed by nonlinear pricing, heterogeneity in consumer price sensitivity, and consumption aggregation over appliances and time. We estimate the model using extensive data for a representative sample of 1300 California households. The results imply a strikingly skewed distribution of household electricity price elasticities in the population, with a small fraction of households accounting for most aggregate demand response. We then estimate the aggregate and distributional consequences of recent tariff structure changes in California, the consumption effects of which have been the subject of considerable debate.

10.1111/0034-6527.00354.abstractZh: 近期对电力市场进行重组的努力重新引发了人们对消费者如何应对价格变化的关注。本文建立了一个模型，用于评估不同电价设计对电力使用的影响。该模型同时解决了非线性定价、消费者价格敏感性的异质性以及不同电器和时间的消费聚合等相互关联的问题。我们采用大量数据对1300户加州家庭进行了模型估计。结果表明，全人口中家庭电力价格弹性分布呈现出明显的偏斜现象，只有一小部分家庭承担了大部分的总需求响应。随后，我们进一步估计了加州近期电价结构变化的总体和分布后果，这些变化的消费效应曾引发广泛讨论。

abstract.text: This paper presents a theory of the market provision of broadcasting and uses it to address the nature of market failure in the industry. Equilibrium advertising levels may be too low or too high, depending on the nuisance cost to viewers, the substitutability of programmes, and the expected benefits to advertisers from contacting viewers. The equilibrium amount of programming may also be below or above the socially optimal level. Perhaps surprisingly, the ability to price programming may reduce social surplus, while monopoly ownership may increase it.

10.1111/0034-6527.00357.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种关于市场提供广播服务的理论，并利用该理论来分析该行业中的市场失灵问题。广告的均衡水平可能过低或过高，这取决于观众面临的干扰成本、节目的可替代性以及广告商与观众接触所期望获得的收益。节目的均衡数量也可能低于或高于社会最优水平。或许令人惊讶的是，对节目进行定价的能力可能会减少社会剩余，而垄断所有权则可能会增加社会剩余。

abstract.text: We characterize infrequent durables stock adjustment by consumers who also derive utility from non-durable consumption flows in the presence of idiosyncratic income uncertainty. The data we analyse include subjective future income uncertainty measures, which we use as instruments in the estimation of relevant parameters of heterogeneous consumers' dynamic adjustment problems. The data feature two conceptually distinct sources of variation: cross-sectional heterogeneity of the sampled households' dynamic problems, and history-dependent heterogeneity in their situation during the observation period. We note that the latter should affect the likelihood but not the size of stock adjustment decisions, and find broad support for theoretical predictions in formal selection-controlled regressions based on this insight.

10.1111/0034-6527.00358.abstractZh: 我们描述了在独特收入不确定性存在的情况下，消费者如何对不经常使用的耐用品进行库存调整，同时他们也从非耐用品消费中获得效用。我们分析的数据包括主观的未来收入不确定性度量，这些度量被用作估计异质消费者动态调整问题相关参数的工具。数据表现出两个概念上的不同变异来源：样本家庭动态问题的横截面异质性，以及观察期间其状况的历史依赖性异质性。我们注意到，后者应该会影响调整决策的可能性，但不会影响决策的规模。基于这一见解，我们在正式选择控制的回归分析中发现了理论预测的广泛支持。

abstract.text: This paper studies the market for monopolistically supplied sweepstakes. We derive equilibrium demands for fixed-prize and variable-prize sweepstakes and determine the profit-maximizing prize level and pay-out ratio respectively. It can be profitable to offer each type of sweepstake when there is a large enough number of weighted utility consumers who have constant absolute risk attitudes, are strictly averse to small as well as symmetric risks, and display longshot preference behaviour. Moreover, for the variable-prize sweepstake, the supplier will generally find it profitable to combine sweepstakes targeting two smaller populations, and offer a single sweepstake to the combined population. This implication is corroborated by the recent spate of mergers of smaller state lotteries into larger ones.

10.1111/0034-6527.00359.abstractZh: 本文研究了垄断性供应的抽奖市场。我们推导了固定奖金和可变奖金抽奖活动的均衡需求，并分别确定了利润最大化的奖金水平和赔付比例。当有足够数量的加权效用消费者具备恒定绝对风险态度、对微小风险以及对称风险都表现出严格厌恶，并且表现出长尾偏好行为时，提供这两种类型的抽奖活动是有利可图的。此外，对于可变奖金抽奖活动，供应商通常会发现将抽奖活动针对两个较小的群体，并为这两个群体联合举办一次抽奖活动是有利可图的。这一结论得到了最近一些小型州级彩票公司合并为大型公司的现象的支持。

abstract.text: This paper proves that the monotonicity of bidding strategies together with the rationality of bidders implies that the winning bid in a first price auction converges to the competitive equilibrium price as the number of bidders increases (Wilson, 1977). Instead of analysing the symmetric Nash equilibrium, we examine rationalizable strategies (Bernheim (1984), Pearce (1984)) among the set of monotonic bidding strategies to prove that any monotonic rationalizable bidding strategy must be within a small neighbourhood of the “truthful” valuation of the object, conditioned on the signal received by the bidder. We obtain an information aggregation result similar to that of Wilson (1977), while dispensing with almost all symmetric assumptions and using a milder solution concept than the Nash equilibrium. In particular, if every bidder is ex ante identical, then any rationalizable bidding strategy must be within a small neighbourhood of the symmetric Nash equilibrium. In a symmetric first price auction, the symmetry of outcomes is implied rather than assumed.

10.1111/0034-6527.00360.abstractZh: 本文证明了，随着投标者数量的增加，投标策略的单调性与投标者的理性行为共同意味着第一价格拍卖中的中标价格会收敛到竞争均衡价格（Wilson, 1977）。我们并非分析对称纳什均衡，而是考察在单调投标策略集合中的可理性策略（Bernheim (1984), Pearce (1984)），以证明任何单调可理性投标策略必然位于对象“真实”估值的较小邻域内，这一结论基于投标者接收到的信号。我们获得了与Wilson (1977)类似的信息聚合结果，同时几乎不需要对称假设，并采用了比纳什均衡更为温和的解概念。特别地，如果每个投标者在事前都是相同的，那么任何可理性投标策略必然位于对称纳什均衡的较小邻域内。在对称的第一价格拍卖中，结果的对称性是隐含的，而非假设的。

abstract.text: We consider a two-sided, finite-horizon search and matching model with heterogeneous types and complementarity between types. The quality of the pool of potential partners deteriorates as agents who have found mutually agreeable matches exit the market. When search is costless and all agents participate in each matching round, the market performs a sorting function in that high types of agents have multiple chances to match with their peers. However, this sorting function is lost if agents incur an arbitrarily small cost in order to participate in each round. With a sufficiently rich type space, the market unravels as almost all agents rush to participate in the first round and match and exit with anyone they meet.

10.1111/0034-6527.00361.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个具有异质类型以及类型间互补性的双边、有限时间范围的搜索与匹配模型。随着找到双方都满意的匹配对象的代理人退出市场，潜在合作伙伴池的质量会下降。当搜索是免费的且所有代理人都参与每一轮匹配时，市场会起到一种排序功能，即高类型的代理人有更多机会与同类匹配。然而，如果代理人为了参与每一轮匹配而需要承担任意小的成本，这种排序功能就会丧失。在类型空间足够丰富的情况下，市场会崩溃，因为几乎所有代理人都会争先恐后地参与第一轮匹配，并随意与遇到的任何人匹配后退出市场。

abstract.text: To study the detailed location patterns of industries, and particularly the tendency for industries to cluster relative to overall manufacturing, we develop distance-based tests of localization. In contrast to previous studies, our approach allows us to assess the statistical significance of departures from randomness. In addition, we treat space as continuous instead of using an arbitrary collection of geographical units. This avoids problems relating to scale and borders. We apply these tests to an exhaustive U.K. data-set. For four-digit industries, we find that (i) 52% of them are localized at a 5% confidence level, (ii) localization mostly takes place at small scales below 50 km, (iii) the degree of localization is very skewed, and (iv) industries follow broad sectoral patterns with respect to localization. Depending on the industry, smaller establishments can be the main drivers of both localization and dispersion. Three-digit sectors show similar patterns of localization at small scales as well as a tendency to localize at medium scales.

10.1111/0034-6527.00362.abstractZh: 为了研究产业的详细分布模式，特别是产业相对于整体制造业的聚集趋势，我们开发了基于距离的定位测试。与以往的研究不同，我们的方法能够评估偏离随机性的统计显著性。此外，我们将空间视为连续体，而不是使用任意的地理单位集合。这样可以避免与规模和边界相关的问题。我们将这些测试应用于英国的一整套数据。对于四位数产业，我们发现：(i) 52%的产业在5%的置信水平下属于局部化状态；(ii) 局部化主要发生在50公里以下的小规模区域；(iii) 局部化的程度存在很大差异；(iv) 产业在局部化方面呈现出广泛的行业模式。根据产业的不同，小型企业可能是局部化和分散的主要驱动力。三位数产业在小规模上呈现出类似的局部化模式，同时在中等规模上也有局部化的倾向。

abstract.text: In situations where a sequence of forecasts is observed, a common strategy is to examine “rationality” conditional on a given loss function. We examine this from a different perspective—supposing that we have a family of loss functions indexed by unknown shape parameters, then given the forecasts can we back out the loss function parameters consistent with the forecasts being rational even when we do not observe the underlying forecasting model? We establish identification of the parameters of a general class of loss functions that nest popular loss functions as special cases and provide estimation methods and asymptotic distributional results for these parameters. This allows us to construct new tests of forecast rationality that allow for asymmetric loss. The methods are applied in an empirical analysis of IMF and OECD forecasts of budget deficits for the G7 countries. We find that allowing for asymmetric loss can significantly change the outcome of empirical tests of forecast rationality.

10.1111/0034-6527.00363.abstractZh: 在观察到一系列预测的情况下，常见的策略是考虑在给定损失函数条件下的“合理性”。我们从不同的角度来探讨这个问题——假设我们有一系列由未知形状参数索引的损失函数，那么即使我们没有观察到潜在的预测模型，我们能否根据预测结果推断出与预测合理性一致的损失函数参数？我们确定了这类损失函数的参数识别方法，这些损失函数以流行的损失函数为特例，并提供了这些参数的估计方法和渐近分布结果。这使我们能够构建新的预测合理性检验方法，以处理不对称损失的情况。这些方法被应用于对G7国家IMF和OECD对预算赤字的预测进行的实证分析。我们发现，考虑不对称损失可以显著改变对预测合理性的实证检验结果。

abstract.text: This study uses rainfall variation to estimate the impact of income shocks on murder in rural Tanzania. Extreme rainfall (drought or flood) leads to a large increase in the murder of “witches”—typically elderly women killed by relatives—but not other murders. The findings provide novel evidence on the role of income shocks in causing violent crime, and religious violence in particular.

10.1111/0034-6527.00365.abstractZh: 本研究利用降雨变化来估计收入冲击对坦桑尼亚农村谋杀案的影响。极端降雨（干旱或洪水）会导致“女巫”谋杀案大幅增加——这些案件通常是亲属杀害年长女性——但其他类型的谋杀案则不会受到影响。研究结果为理解收入冲击在引发暴力犯罪中的作用提供了新的证据，尤其是宗教暴力问题。

abstract.text: I study a principal-agent model in which the agent collects information and then chooses a verifiable action. I show that the principal can find it desirable to constrain the agent's action set even though there is no disagreement about the ranking of actions ex post. The elimination or penalization of “intermediate” actions, which are optimal when information is poor, improves incentives for information collection. I characterize optimal action sets when the agent is infinitely risk averse with respect to income shocks and optimal incentive schemes when the agent is risk neutral.

10.1111/0034-6527.00366.abstractZh: 我研究了一个委托-代理模型，在该模型中，代理人收集信息后选择一种可验证的行动。我证明了，即使事后对行动的排序没有分歧，委托人仍然可能认为限制代理人的行动集是合适的。消除或惩罚那些在信息不足时是最优的行动，能够提升信息收集的激励。我描述了当代理人对收入冲击具有无限风险厌恶时的最优行动集，以及当代理人风险中性时的最优激励方案。

abstract.text: We measure the degree of overconfidence in judgement (in the form of miscalibration, i.e. the tendency to overestimate the precision of one's information) and self-monitoring (a form of attentiveness to social cues) of 245 participants and also observe their behaviour in an experimental financial market under asymmetric information. Miscalibrated traders, underestimating the conditional uncertainty about the asset value, are expected to be especially vulnerable to the winner's curse. High self-monitors are expected to behave strategically and achieve superior results. Our empirical results show that miscalibration reduces and self-monitoring enhances trading performance. The effect of the psychological variables is strong for men but non-existent for women.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00333.x.abstractZh: 我们对245名参与者进行了判断过度自信程度的测量（表现为误校准，即倾向于高估自身信息的准确性），并观察了他们在信息不对称条件下的实验性金融市场中的行为。预计误校准的交易者，由于低估了资产价值的条件不确定性，会特别容易受到“赢家诅咒”的影响。而高度自我监控的交易者则有望采取战略性的交易方式，并取得更好的交易结果。我们的实证结果显示，误校准会降低交易表现，而自我监控则会提升交易绩效。这些心理变量的影响在男性中较为明显，而在女性中则不存在这种现象。

abstract.text: The observation that the liquidations are concentrated in recessions has long been the subject of controversy. One view holds that liquidations are beneficial in that they result in increased restructuring. Another view holds that liquidations are privately inefficient and essentially wasteful. This paper proposes an alternative perspective. Based on a combination of theory with empirical evidence on gross job flows and on financial and labor market rents, we find that, cumulatively, recessions result in reduced restructuring, and that this is likely to be socially costly once we consider inefficiencies on both the creation and destruction margins. KEY WORDS: Business Cycle, Unemployment, Inefficient Separations, Job Creation and Destruction, Financial Constraints, Depressed Restructuring, Heterogeneity, Liquidation, Sclerosis

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00334.x.abstractZh: 关于清算活动集中在经济衰退时期的观点，长期以来一直存在争议。一种观点认为，清算活动是有益的，因为它们促进了重组的增多。另一种观点则认为，清算活动在私人层面是低效的，并且本质上是浪费资源。本文提出了另一种观点。通过结合理论分析与关于总体就业流动以及金融和劳动力市场租金的实证证据，我们发现，总体而言，经济衰退会导致重组活动的减少，而一旦考虑到在创造和破坏环节上的低效性，这种减少可能会带来社会成本。关键词：经济周期、失业、低效的分离、就业创造与破坏、金融约束、衰退中的重组、异质性、清算、硬化

abstract.text: We study the problem of parameter inference in (possibly non-linear and non-smooth) econometric models when the data are measured with error. We allow for arbitrary correlation between the true variables and the measurement errors. To solve the identification problem, we require the existence of an auxiliary data-set that contains information about the conditional distribution of the true variables given the mismeasured variables. Our main assumption requires that the conditional distribution of the true variables given the mismeasured variables is the same in the primary and auxiliary data. Our methods allow the auxiliary data to be a validation sample, where the primary and validation data are from the same distribution, and more importantly, a stratified sample where the auxiliary data-set is not from the same distribution as the primary data. We also show how to combine the two data-sets to obtain a more efficient estimator of the parameter of interest. We establish the large sample properties of the sieve based estimators under verifiable conditions. In particular, we allow for the mismeasured variables to have unbounded supports without employing the tedious trimming scheme typically used in kernel based methods. We illustrate our methods by estimating a returns to schooling censored quantile regression using the CPS/SSR 1978 exact match files where the dependent variable is measured with error of arbitrary kind.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00335.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了在数据存在测量误差的情况下，对（可能非线性和非光滑的）计量经济模型中的参数进行推断的问题。我们允许真实变量与测量误差之间存在任意相关性。为了解决识别问题，我们需要存在一个辅助数据集，该数据集包含给定测量误差的变量条件下真实变量的条件分布信息。我们的主要假设要求，在测量误差的变量条件下，真实变量的条件分布在主要数据集和辅助数据集中是相同的。我们的方法允许辅助数据集作为验证样本，其中主要数据集和验证数据集来自相同的分布；更重要的是，辅助数据集是分层样本，其分布与主要数据集不同。我们还展示了如何结合这两个数据集，以获得更有效的参数估计量。在可验证的条件下，我们建立了基于筛选法的估计量的大样本性质。特别地，我们允许测量误差的变量具有无界支持，而无需采用通常在基于核的方法中使用的繁琐修剪方案。我们通过使用CPS/SSR 1978精确匹配文件估计教育回报的分位数回归来说明我们的方法，其中因变量存在任意类型的测量误差。

abstract.text: We use a new approach to study questions in political economy that relies on data on the subjective well-being of a large sample of people living in the OECD over the period 1975–1992. Controlling for the personal characteristics of the respondents, year and country fixed effects and country-specific time trends, we find that the data describe social happiness functions for left-wing and right-wing individuals where inflation and unemployment enter negatively. We use these functions to test the root assumption of partisan business cycle models. The evidence is consistent with the hypothesis that left-wing individuals care more about unemployment relative to inflation than right-wingers. Interestingly, we find that individuals declare themselves to be happier when the party they support is in power, even after controlling for macroeconomic variables. The effect of politics is large. Finally, we find that these partisan differences cannot be traced back to income differences. That is, it is misleading to assume—as it is done in the previous literature—that the poor (rich) behave similarly to the left (right). For example, inflation and unemployment do not have differential effects across rich and poor and the happiness levels of these two groups are unaffected by the identity of the party in power. Our findings are hard to explain using median voter models but are to be expected in a partisan world.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00336.x.abstractZh: 我们采用一种新的方法来研究政治经济学中的相关问题，该方法基于1975年至1992年期间OECD地区大量人群的主观幸福感数据。在控制受访者的个人特征、年份和国家固定效应以及国家特定的时间趋势后，我们发现这些数据描述了左翼和右翼个体的社会幸福感函数，其中通货膨胀和失业对幸福感有负面影响。我们利用这些函数来检验党派性商业周期模型的基本假设。研究结果与以下假设一致：左翼个体相比右翼人士更关注失业问题而非通货膨胀。有趣的是，我们发现即使控制了宏观经济变量，当所支持的政党执政时，个体仍会认为自己更幸福。政治因素的影响较大。最后，我们发现这些党派差异并不能追溯到收入差异。也就是说，假设穷人（富人）的行为与左翼人士（右翼人士）相似是误导性的——正如先前文献中所做的那样。例如，通货膨胀和失业对富人和穷人的影响并不相同，这两组人的幸福感不受执政党派的身份影响。我们的发现很难用中位选民模型来解释，但在一个党派化的社会中，这种差异是预期之中的。

abstract.text: This paper estimates a life cycle model of labour supply, retirement, and savings behaviour in which future health status and wages are uncertain. Individuals face a fixed cost of work and cannot borrow against future labour, pension, or Social Security income. The method of simulated moments is used to match the life cycle profiles of labour force participation, hours worked, and assets that are estimated from the data to those that are generated by the model. The model establishes that the tax structure of the Social Security system and pensions are key determinants of the high observed job exit rates at ages 62 and 65. Removing the tax wedge embedded in the Social Security earnings test for individuals aged 65 and older would delay job exit by almost one year. By contrast, Social Security benefit levels, health, and borrowing constraints are less important determinants of job exit at older ages. For example, reducing Social Security benefits by 20% would cause workers to delay exit from the labour force by only three months.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00337.x.abstractZh: 本文估计了一个生命周期模型，该模型涉及劳动力供给、退休和储蓄行为，其中未来的健康状况和工资都是不确定的。个体面临固定的工作成本，且无法借用未来的劳动、养老金或社会保障收入。采用模拟矩方法将数据估计出的劳动力参与率、工作小时数和资产状况与模型生成的状况进行匹配。该模型表明，社会保障制度和养老金的税收结构是决定62岁和65岁人群高离职率的关键因素。如果消除针对65岁及以上个体的社会保障收入测试中的税收负担，则离职时间将延长近一年。相比之下，社会保障福利水平、健康状况和借贷限制对高龄人群的离职影响较小。例如，将社会保障福利减少20%，仅会导致工人从劳动力市场中退出的时间推迟三个月。

abstract.text: We analyse preferences over finite decision problems in order to model decision-makers with “changing tastes”. we provide conditions on these preferences that identify the Strotz model of consistent planning. building on an example given by Peleg and Yaari (1973), we show that for problems with infinitely many choices, Strotz's representation of preferences may not be well defined. For that case, we propose a well-defined approximation which is empirically indistinguishable from the Strotz preference that is being approximated.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00338.x.abstractZh: 我们分析了针对有限决策问题的偏好，以模拟具有“变化口味”的决策者。我们提出了关于这些偏好的条件，这些条件能够确定一致规划中的Strotz模型。基于Peleg和Yaari在1973年给出的一个例子，我们证明了对于具有无限多选择的问题，Strotz对偏好的描述可能并不明确。针对这种情况，我们提出了一种定义明确的近似方法，该方法在实证上无法与正在近似的Strotz偏好区分开来。

abstract.text: The Ellsberg paradox demonstrates that people's beliefs over uncertain events might not be representable by subjective probability. We show that if a risk averse decision maker, who has a well defined Bayesian prior, perceives an Ellsberg type decision problem as possibly composed of a bundle of several positively correlated problems, she will be uncertainty averse. We generalize this argument and derive sufficient conditions for uncertainty aversion.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00339.x.abstractZh: Ellsberg悖论表明，人们对不确定事件的信念可能无法用主观概率来表示。我们指出，如果一个风险厌恶型决策者拥有明确的贝叶斯先验知识，并且认为一个Ellsberg类型的决策问题可能由多个正相关的问题组合而成，那么她将会表现出不确定性厌恶。我们进一步推广了这一论点，并推导出不确定性厌恶的充分条件。

abstract.text: We discuss a class of markets for durable goods where efficiency (or approximate efficiency) is obtained despite the presence of information asymmetries. In the model, the number of times a good has changed hands (the vintage of the good) is an accurate signal of its quality, each consumer self-selects into obtaining the vintage that the social planner would have assigned to her, and consumers' equilibrium trading behaviour in secondary markets is not subject to adverse selection. We show that producers have the incentive to choose contracts that lead to the efficient allocation, and to supply the efficient output. We also provide a contrast between leasing contracts, resale contracts, and different kinds of rental contracts. Resale contracts do not lead to the efficient allocation. A specific kind of rental contract provides the appropriate incentives to consumers.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00340.x.abstractZh: 我们讨论了一类耐用商品市场，在这些市场中，尽管存在信息不对称性，仍能实现效率（或近似效率）。在模型中，商品流转的次数能够准确反映其质量，每个消费者都会选择获得社会规划者会分配给自己的商品版本，而消费者在次级市场中的均衡交易行为不会受到逆向选择的影响。我们表明，生产者有动机选择能够实现有效分配的契约，并提供有效的产出。我们还对比了租赁契约、转售契约以及不同类型的租赁契约。转售契约并不能实现有效分配。一种特定类型的租赁契约能够为消费者提供适当的激励。

abstract.text: Economic theories in time series contexts usually have implications on and only on the conditional mean dynamics of underlying economic variables. We propose a new class of specification tests for time series conditional mean models, where the dimension of the conditioning information set may be infinite. Both linear and nonlinear conditional mean specifications are covered. The tests can detect a wide range of model misspecifications in mean while being robust to conditional heteroscedasticity and higher order time-varying moments of unknown form. They check a large number of lags, but naturally discount higher order lags, which is consistent with the stylized fact that economic behaviours are more affected by the recent past events than by the remote past events. No specific estimation method is required, and the tests have the appealing “nuisance parameter free” property that parameter estimation uncertainty has no impact on the limit distribution of the tests. A simulation study shows that it is important to take into account the impact of conditional heteroscedasticity; failure to do so will cause overrejection of a correct conditional mean model. In a horse race competition on testing linearity in mean, our tests have omnibus and robust power against a variety of alternatives relative to some existing tests. In an application, we find that after removing significant but possibly spurious autocorrelations due to nonsynchronous trading, there still exists significant predictable nonlinearity in mean for S&P 500 and NASDAQ daily returns.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00341.x.abstractZh: 在时间序列背景下，经济理论通常只对基础经济变量的条件均值动态产生影响。我们提出了一种新的时间序列条件均值模型规格检验方法，该方法的条件信息集的维度可能是无限的。该方法适用于线性和非线性的条件均值规格。这些检验能够检测出多种模型误设情况，同时能够稳健地应对条件异方差性和未知形式的高阶时间变化矩。它们可以检验大量的滞后项，但自然会忽略高阶滞后项，这与经济行为更受近期事件而非遥远事件影响的典型事实是一致的。该方法不需要特定的估计方法，并且具有“无干扰参数”的特性，即参数估计的不确定性不会影响检验的极限分布。模拟研究表明，考虑条件异方差性的影响非常重要；如果不这样做，将会过度拒绝正确的条件均值模型。在检验均值线性性的测试中，我们的检验方法对多种替代方案具有全面且稳健的功效，相对于一些现有的检验方法而言。在一个应用中，我们发现，在消除了由于非同步交易而产生的显著但可能是虚假的自相关后，标准普尔500指数和纳斯达克指数日收益率仍然存在显著的、可预测的非线性条件均值。

abstract.text: We characterize the outcomes of games when players may make binding offers of strategy contingent side payments before the game is played. This does not always lead to efficient outcomes, despite complete information and costless contracting. The characterizations are illustrated in a series of examples, including voluntary contribution public good games, Cournot and Bertrand oligopoly, principal-agent problems, and commons games, among others.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00342.x.abstractZh: 我们描述了在游戏开始前，参与者可以做出具有约束力的策略性提议，并附带支付费用的情况下的游戏结果。尽管存在完全的信息和无需成本的契约机制，这种情况并不总是能带来高效的结果。我们通过一系列例子来说明这种特性，包括自愿贡献的公共物品游戏、库尔诺和伯特兰寡头垄断、委托-代理问题以及公共物品游戏等。

abstract.text: We provide an ascending auction that yields an efficient outcome when there are many identical units for sale and bidders have interdependent values and downward-sloping demand. Our ascending auction both extends and generalizes Ausubel's (2004) and yields the same outcome as Perry and Reny's (2002) generalization of Vickrey's (1961) sealed-bid auction. There are two key features of our auction. Bidders are permitted both to express different demands against different bidders, as well as to increase their demands. The equilibrium strategies are closely related to the familiar “drop out when price equals value” strategy of the English auction.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00343.x.abstractZh: 我们提供了一种升价拍卖机制，当存在大量相同的商品可供出售，且竞买者之间存在相互依赖的价值关系，并且需求呈下降趋势时，该机制能够产生高效的结果。我们的升价拍卖机制不仅扩展了Ausubel（2004年）的研究，而且其结果与Perry和Reny（2002年）对Vickrey（1961年）密封拍卖机制的推广结果一致。我们的拍卖机制有两个关键特点：竞买者不仅可以针对不同的竞买者表达不同的需求，还可以增加自己的需求。这种均衡策略与英语拍卖中“当价格等于价值时退出”的策略密切相关。

abstract.text: Contrary to conventional wisdom, a right to silence can reduce wrongful convictions of innocent suspects who tell police the truth, and may reduce the overall conviction rate without affecting the confession rate. We establish these conclusions by modelling interrogation as a game in which suspects are privately informed of their type, but do not know the content of witness reports. Our model has testable implications which distinguish it from competing models. The best data rejects competing models, but does not reject our model.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00344.x.abstractZh: 与普遍观点相反，沉默权可以减少对如实供述的无辜嫌疑人的错误定罪，并且可以在不影响认罪率的情况下降低整体定罪率。我们通过将审讯建模为一个游戏来得出这些结论，在这个游戏中，嫌疑人可以私下了解自己的类型，但不知道证人报告的内容。我们的模型具有可验证的含义，这使其与竞争模型区分开来。最佳数据排除了竞争模型，但并未排除我们的模型。

abstract.text: We study how securities and issuance mechanisms can be designed to mitigate the adverse impact of market imperfections on liquidity. In our model, asset owners seek to obtain liquidity by selling claims contingent on privately observed future cash-flows. Liquidity suppliers can be competitive or strategic. In the optimal trading mechanism associated with an arbitrary given security, issuers with low cash-flows sell their entire holdings of the security, while issuers with high cash-flows are typically excluded from trade. By designing the security optimally, issuers can avoid exclusion altogether. We show that the optimal security is debt. Because of its low informational sensitivity, debt mitigates the adverse selection problem. Furthermore, by pooling all issuers with high cash-flows, debt also reduces the ability of a monopolistic liquidity supplier to exclude them from trade in order to better extract rents from issuers with lower cash-flows.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00345.x.abstractZh: 我们研究如何设计证券和发行机制，以缓解市场缺陷对流动性的不利影响。在我们的模型中，资产所有者通过出售基于私人观察到的未来现金流的债权来获得流动性。流动性提供者可以是竞争性的，也可以是战略性的。在任意给定证券的最优交易机制中，现金流较低的发行者会出售其全部证券持有量，而现金流较高的发行者通常不会被纳入交易范围。通过优化证券设计，发行者可以完全避免被排除在外。我们表明，最优的证券形式是债务。由于债务的信息敏感性较低，它能够缓解逆向选择问题。此外，通过汇集所有现金流较高的发行者，债务还能降低垄断性流动性提供者排除这些发行者进行交易的能力，从而更好地从现金流较低的发行者那里获取收益。

abstract.text: When credit markets to finance investment in human capital are missing, the competitive equilibrium allocation is inefficient. When generations overlap, this failure can be mitigated by properly designed social arrangements. We show that public financing of education and public pensions can be designed to implement an intergenerational transfer scheme supporting the complete market allocation. Neither the public financing of education nor the pension scheme we consider resemble standard ones. In our mechanism, via the public education system, the young borrow from the middle aged to invest in human capital. They pay back the debt via a social security tax, the proceedings of which finance pension payments. When the complete market allocation is achieved, the rate of return implicit in this borrowing-lending scheme should equal the market rate of return.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00346.x.abstractZh: 当缺乏用于资助人力资本投资的信贷市场时，竞争均衡的分配是低效的。当代际重叠时，通过适当设计的社会安排可以缓解这一问题。我们表明，可以通过公共教育融资和公共养老金制度来实施一种代际转移方案，以支持完整的市场分配。我们研究的公共教育融资和养老金制度都不类似于标准模式。在我们的机制中，年轻人通过公共教育系统向中年人借款以投资人力资本，他们通过社会保障税偿还债务，而社会保障税的资金则用于支付养老金。当实现完整的市场分配时，这种借贷机制所隐含的回报率应等于市场回报率。

abstract.text: The paper estimates gross credit flows for the U.S. banking system between 1979 and 1999 and shows that sizable gross flows coexist at any phase of the cycle, even within narrowly defined loan categories, bank size categories, and regional units. To investigate the macroeconomic dimensions of gross credit flows, the paper studies the cyclical behaviour of aggregate credit flows and documents three key cyclical facts. First, excess credit reallocation is countercyclical: for any given rate of change of net credit, gross flows are larger in a recession than in a boom. Second, gross credit flows are highly volatile, with a cyclical volatility which appears more than an order of magnitude larger than GDP volatility. Third, credit contraction is more volatile than credit expansion. Furthermore, the behaviour of gross flows over the 1991 recession suggests that persistent and historically high credit contraction is a key feature of the relatively mild cyclical downturn. The results lend some support to aggregate models that emphasize the asymmetric behaviour of credit expansion and credit contractions.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00347.x.abstractZh: 该论文估算了1979年至1999年间美国银行系统的总信贷流量，并发现即使在狭义定义的贷款类别、银行规模类别和地区单位内部，任何经济周期阶段都存在相当规模的总信贷流量。为了研究总信贷流量的宏观经济特征，论文探讨了总信贷流量的周期性行为，并记录了三个关键的周期性事实。首先，信贷的过度重新分配具有反周期性：对于任何给定的净信贷变化率，经济衰退期间的总信贷流量比经济繁荣时期更大。其次，总信贷流量具有高度波动性，其周期性波动幅度比GDP的波动性大一个数量级以上。第三，信贷收缩的波动性比信贷扩张更大。此外，1991年经济衰退期间总信贷流量的表现表明，持续且历史性的高信贷收缩是相对温和的周期性下滑的一个关键特征。这些结果在一定程度上支持了强调信贷扩张和收缩非对称性行为的综合模型。

abstract.text: Self-regulation is a feature of a number of professions. For example, in the U.S. the government delegates aspects of financial market regulation to self-regulatory organizations (SROs) like the New York Stock Exchange and the National Association of Securities Dealers. We analyse one regulatory task of an SRO, enforcing antifraud rules so agents will not cheat customers. Specifically, we model contracting/enforcement as a two-tier problem. An SRO chooses its enforcement policy: the likelihood that an agent is investigated for fraud and a penalty schedule. Given an enforcement policy, agents compete by offering contracts that maximize customers' expected utility. We assume that the SRO's objective is to maximize the welfare of its members, the agents. We show that the SRO chooses a more lax enforcement policy—meaning less frequent investigations—than what customers would choose. A general conclusion is that control of the enforcement policy governing contracts confers substantial market power to a group of otherwise competitive agents. We also investigate government oversight of the self-regulatory process. The threat of government enforcement leads to more enforcement by the SRO, just enough to pre-empt any government enforcement.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00348.x.abstractZh: 自我监管是许多职业的一个特征。例如，在美国，政府将金融市场监管的某些方面委托给自我监管组织，如纽约证券交易所和国家证券交易商协会。我们分析了一个自我监管组织的监管任务，即执行反欺诈规则，以防止代理人欺骗客户。具体来说，我们将监管/执行问题建模为一个双层问题。自我监管组织选择其执行政策：代理人被调查欺诈的可能性以及处罚等级。在给定执行政策的情况下，代理人通过提供能够最大化客户预期效用的合同来竞争。我们假设自我监管组织的目标是最大化其成员——即代理人的福利。我们发现，自我监管组织选择的执行政策较为宽松——即调查频率较低——这比客户所选择的政策更为宽松。一个普遍的结论是，对监管政策的控制赋予了一群原本具有竞争力的代理人巨大的市场力量。我们还研究了政府对自我监管过程的监管。政府执法的威胁促使自我监管组织更加频繁地执行监管，这种频率刚好足以 preempt 任何政府执法。

abstract.text: We lay out a small open economy version of the Calvo sticky price model, and show how the equilibrium dynamics can be reduced to a simple representation in domestic inflation and the output gap. We use the resulting framework to analyse the macroeconomic implications of three alternative rule-based policy regimes for the small open economy: domestic inflation and CPI-based Taylor rules, and an exchange rate peg. We show that a key difference among these regimes lies in the relative amount of exchange rate volatility that they entail. We also discuss a special case for which domestic inflation targeting constitutes the optimal policy, and where a simple second order approximation to the utility of the representative consumer can be derived and used to evaluate the welfare losses associated with the suboptimal rules.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00349.x.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个小型开放经济版本的Calvo粘性价格模型，并展示了如何将均衡动态简化为国内通货膨胀和产出缺口的简单表示。利用这一框架，我们分析了三种基于规则的宏观经济政策体制对小型开放经济的影响：基于国内通货膨胀和CPI的Taylor规则，以及汇率固定制度。我们发现，这些体制之间的关键区别在于它们所引发的汇率波动程度。我们还讨论了一个特殊情况，即国内通货膨胀目标制是最优政策，在这种情况下，可以推导出代表消费者的效用函数的一个简单二阶近似，并以此来评估与次优政策相关的福利损失。

abstract.text: We propose a procedure for estimating the critical values of the extended Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests of Stochastic Dominance of arbitrary order in the general K-prospect case. We allow for the observations to be serially dependent and, for the first time, we can accommodate general dependence amongst the prospects which are to be ranked. Also, the prospects may be the residuals from certain conditional models, opening the way for conditional ranking. We also propose a test of Prospect Stochastic Dominance. Our method is based on subsampling and we show that the resulting tests are consistent and powerful against some N−1/2 local alternatives. We also propose some heuristic methods for selecting subsample size and demonstrate in simulations that they perform reasonably. We describe an alternative method for obtaining critical values based on recentring the test statistic and using full-sample bootstrap methods. We compare the two methods in theory and in practice.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00350.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种估计一般K-勘探情况下任意阶随机优势扩展Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验临界值的程序。我们允许观测值之间存在序列依赖性，并且首次能够适应待排序的勘探对象之间的一般依赖性。此外，这些勘探对象可能是某些条件模型的残差，这为条件排序提供了可能。我们还提出了一种勘探随机优势检验的方法。我们的方法基于子样本法，并证明所得检验对于某些N−1/2局部替代假设具有一致性和强大性。我们还提出了一些选择子样本大小的启发式方法，并通过模拟验证这些方法的表现相当合理。我们还描述了一种基于使检验统计量最近化并使用全样本自助法来获得临界值的替代方法。我们在理论和实践中比较了这两种方法。

abstract.text: We derive the quantitative implications of growth theory for U.S. corporate equity plus net debt over the period 1960–2001. There were large secular movements in corporate equity values relative to GDP, with dramatic declines in the 1970's and dramatic increases starting in the 1980's and continuing throughout the 1990's. During the same period, there was little change in the capital—output ratio or earnings share of output. We ask specifically whether the theory accounts for these observations. We find that it does, with the critical factor being changes in the U.S. tax and regulatory system. We find that the theory also accounts for the even larger movements in U.K. equity values relative to GDP in this period.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00351.x.abstractZh: 我们推导了增长理论对美国企业股权与净债务在1960至2001年期间的定量影响。企业股权价值相对于GDP出现了显著的长期波动，1970年代出现了大幅下降，而1980年代开始并持续至1990年代的股权价值则出现了显著上升。在同一时期，资本产出比率或产出收益份额的变化很小。我们特别询问该理论是否能够解释这些现象。研究发现，该理论确实能够解释这些现象，其中关键因素是美国税收和监管体系的变化。此外，该理论还能解释英国股权价值相对于GDP的更大波动。

abstract.text: We propose the parametric Dynamic Seemingly Unrelated Regression (DSUR) estimator for simultaneous estimation of multiple cointegrating regressions. DSUR is efficient when the equilibrium errors are correlated across equations and is applicable for panel cointegration estimation in environments where the cross section is small relative to the available time series. We study the asymptotic and small sample properties of the DSUR estimator for both heterogeneous and homogeneous cointegrating vectors. We then apply the method to analyse two long-standing problems in international economics. Our first application revisits the estimation of long-run correlations between national investment and national saving. Our second application revisits the question of whether the forward exchange rate is an unbiased predictor of the future spot rate.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00352.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了参数化的动态看似不相关回归（DSUR）估计方法，用于同时估计多个协整回归。当各方程中的均衡误差存在相关性时，DSUR具有高效性，适用于在横截面数据相对于可用时间序列较小时进行的面板协整估计。我们研究了DSUR估计量在异质性和同质性协整向量情况下的渐近性质和小样本性能。随后，我们将该方法应用于分析国际经济学中的两个长期存在的问题。我们的第一个应用重新探讨了国家投资与国家储蓄之间长期相关性的估计问题。第二个应用则重新审视了远期汇率是否是未来即期汇率的无偏预测指标这一问题。

abstract.text: Monetary policy and the private sector behaviour of the U.S. economy are modelled as a time varying structural vector autoregression, where the sources of time variation are both the coefficients and the variance covariance matrix of the innovations. The paper develops a new, simple modelling strategy for the law of motion of the variance covariance matrix and proposes an efficient Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithm for the model likelihood/posterior numerical evaluation. The main empirical conclusions are: (1) both systematic and non-systematic monetary policy have changed during the last 40 years—in particular, systematic responses of the interest rate to inflation and unemployment exhibit a trend toward a more aggressive behaviour, despite remarkable oscillations; (2) this has had a negligible effect on the rest of the economy. The role played by exogenous non-policy shocks seems more important than interest rate policy in explaining the high inflation and unemployment episodes in recent U.S. economic history.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00353.x.abstractZh: 本文将货币政策与美国经济私营部门的行为建模为时变结构向量自回归模型，其中时间变化的来源既包括系数，也包括创新变量的方差协方差矩阵。文章提出了一种新的、简单的方差协方差矩阵动态建模策略，并提出了一种高效的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛算法，用于模型似然/后验数值计算。主要实证结论包括：(1)在过去40年中，无论是系统性货币政策还是非系统性货币政策都发生了变化——特别是，利率对通货膨胀和失业率的系统性响应呈现出更加激进的趋势，尽管存在显著的波动；(2)这些变化对经济的其他部分影响甚微。在解释美国近代经济史上高通胀和失业现象时，外部非政策冲击的作用似乎比利率政策更为重要。

abstract.text: We model externality abatement as an implementation problem. A social planner would like to ensure efficient behaviour among a group of agents whose actions are sources of externalities. However, the planner has limited information about the agents' preferences, and is unable to distinguish individual agents except through their action choices. We prove that if a concavity condition on aggregate payoffs is satisfied, the planner can guarantee that efficient behaviour is globally stable under a wide range of behaviour adjustment processes by administering a variable pricing scheme. Through a series of applications, we show that the concavity condition is naturally satisfied in settings involving negative externalities. We conclude by contrasting the performance of the pricing mechanism with that of a mechanism based on direct revelation and announcement dependent forcing contracts.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00355.x.abstractZh: 我们将外部性缓解建模为一个实施问题。社会规划者希望确保一组代理人的行为能够产生有效的外部性。然而，规划者对代理人的偏好信息有限，除了通过他们的行为选择外，无法区分个别代理人。我们证明，如果满足总收益的凹性条件，规划者可以通过实施可变定价方案，在广泛的调整过程中保证有效行为的全局稳定性。通过一系列应用案例，我们表明在涉及负外部性的情况下，凹性条件自然得到满足。最后，我们通过比较定价机制与基于直接揭示和基于公告依赖的强制合同的机制的性能，得出了结论。

abstract.text: Standard equilibrium models are unable to replicate the average return on equity and the risk-free rate during 1889–1978, the well-known asset returns puzzle. The present paper, motivated by the excess of outliers in the data, proposes a normal-scale mixture stochastic process for output that is compatible with leptokurtosis. Using formal likelihood-based methods, it is shown that observed asset returns are compatible with posterior distributions implied by the model.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2005.00356.x.abstractZh: 标准均衡模型无法解释1889年至1978年间众所周知的资产回报之谜，即平均股本回报与无风险利率之间的关系。本文基于数据中异常值的过多现象，提出了一种与尖峰厚尾特性兼容的常态混合随机过程模型。通过正式的基于似然的方法，证明了观察到的资产回报与模型所暗示的后验分布是相容的。

abstract.text: This paper is an attempt to describe andevaluate current methods for assessing the quality of medicalcare and to suggest some directions for further study. It is con-cerned with methods rather than findings, and with an evaluation of methodology in general, rather than a detailed critique of methods in specific studies. This is not an exhaustive review of the pertinent literature. Certain key studies, of course, have been included. Other papers have been selected only as illustrative examples. Those omitted are not, for that reason, less worthy of note. This paper deals almost exclusively with the evaluation of the medi-cal care process at the level of physician-patient interaction. It excludes, therefore, processes primarily related to the effective delivery of medi-cal care at the community level. Moreover, this paper is not concerned with the administrative aspects of quality control. Many of the studies reviewed here have arisen out of the urgent need to evaluate and control the quality of care in organized programs of medical care. Nevertheless, these studies will be discussed only in terms of their contribution to methods of assessment and not in terms of their broader social goals. The author has remained, by and large, in the familiar territory of care provided by physicians and has avoided incursions into other types of

10.1111/j.1468-0009.2005.00397.x.abstractZh: 本文试图描述并评估当前用于评估医疗质量的方法，并提出一些进一步研究的方向。本文关注的是方法本身，而非具体的研究结果；同时，本文侧重于方法论的评估，而非对特定研究方法的详细批判。本文并非对相关文献的详尽综述，但确实包含了一些关键研究。其他论文仅作为示例被选用，被遗漏的论文同样具有值得关注的价值。本文主要关注的是在医患互动层面对医疗过程进行评估，因此不包括与社区层面有效医疗服务提供相关的流程。此外，本文不涉及质量控制的行政方面。这里所回顾的许多研究都是出于对医疗质量进行评估和控制的迫切需求而产生的。尽管如此，这些研究仅从其对评估方法的贡献角度进行讨论，而非从更广泛的社会目标角度进行探讨。作者总体上仍停留在医生提供的医疗服务这一领域，避免涉及其他类型的医疗评估。

abstract.text: We extend the standard model of general equilibrium with incomplete markets to allow for default and punishment by thinking of assets as pools. The equilibrating variables include expected delivery rates, along with the usual prices of assets and commodities. By reinterpreting the variables, our model encompasses a broad range of adverse selection and signalling phenomena in a perfectly competitive, general equilibrium framework. Perfect competition eliminates the need for lenders to compute how the size of their loan or the price they quote might affect default rates. It also makes for a simple equilibrium refinement, which we propose in order to rule out irrational pessimism about deliveries of untraded assets. We show that refined equilibrium always exists in our model, and that default, in conjunction with refinement, opens the door to a theory of endogenous assets. The market chooses the promises, default penalties, and quantity constraints of actively traded assets.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00563.x.abstractZh: 我们将一般均衡模型扩展到不完全市场的情形，通过将资产视为资源池，从而允许违约和惩罚机制的存在。均衡变量包括预期交付率，以及资产与商品的常规价格。通过重新解释这些变量，我们的模型能够在完全竞争的一般均衡框架中涵盖广泛的逆向选择和信号传递现象。完全竞争消除了贷款人需要计算贷款规模或报价对违约率影响的必要性。同时，这种模型也便于进行简单的均衡调整，我们提出这种调整是为了排除对未交易资产交付结果的非理性悲观态度。我们证明，在我们的模型中，经过调整的均衡总是存在的，而违约与均衡调整相结合，为内生资产理论的发展打开了大门。市场决定了活跃交易资产所承诺的支付、违约惩罚以及数量限制。

abstract.text: We analyze a game of strategic experimentation with two-armed bandits whose risky arm might yield payoffs after exponentially distributed random times. Free-riding causes an inefficiently low level of experimentation in any equilibrium where the players use stationary Markovian strategies with beliefs as the state variable. We construct the unique symmetric Markovian equilibrium of the game, followed by various asymmetric ones. There is no equilibrium where all players use simple cut-off strategies. Equilibria where players switch finitely often between experimenting and free-riding all yield a similar pattern of information acquisition, greater efficiency being achieved when the players share the burden of experimentation more equitably. When players switch roles infinitely often, they can acquire an approximately efficient amount of information, but still at an inefficient rate. In terms of aggregate payoffs, all these asymmetric equilibria dominate the symmetric one wherever the latter prescribes simultaneous use of both arms.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00564.x.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个具有双臂老虎机的策略实验游戏，其中风险臂可能在指数分布的随机时间后产生收益。免费搭便车会导致在任何均衡状态下实验效率显著降低，此时玩家使用静态马尔可夫策略，信念作为状态变量。我们构建了该游戏的唯一对称马尔可夫均衡，以及各种非对称均衡。不存在所有玩家都使用简单截止策略的均衡。当玩家在实验和免费搭便车之间频繁切换时，信息获取的模式相似，当玩家更公平地分担实验负担时，效率会更高。当玩家无限次地切换角色时，他们可以获得近似有效的信息量，但效率仍然较低。从总体收益来看，所有这些非对称均衡在对称均衡占优的情况下，后者要求同时使用两个臂的情况除外。

abstract.text: We study a one-sided offers bargaining game in which the buyer has private information about the value of the object and the seller has private information about his beliefs about the buyer's valuation. We show that this uncertainty about uncertainties dramatically changes the set of outcomes. In particular, second order beliefs can lead to a delay in reaching agreement even when the seller makes frequent offers. We show that not all types of second order beliefs lead to a delay. When the buyer assigns positive probability to the seller knowing the buyer's value, then delay not only can occur, but it must occur for a class of equilibria. However, in all other cases delay will never occur.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00565.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个单边报价讨价还价游戏，其中买方拥有关于物品价值的私人信息，而卖方则拥有关于他对买方估值信念的私人信息。我们指出，这种不确定性极大地改变了结果集。特别是，即使卖方频繁报价，第二层次的信念也可能导致达成协议的延迟。我们表明，并非所有类型的第二层次信念都会导致延迟。当买方认为卖方了解买方的估值时，延迟不仅可能发生，而且对于某些均衡类型来说必须是如此。然而，在所有其他情况下，延迟永远不会发生。

abstract.text: We show existence of equilibria in distributional strategies for a wide class of private value auctions, including the first general existence result for double auctions. The set of equilibria is invariant to the tie-breaking rule. The model incorporates multiple unit demands, all standard pricing rules, reserve prices, entry costs, and stochastic demand and supply. Valuations can be correlated and asymmetrically distributed. For double auctions, we show further that at least one equilibrium involves a positive volume of trade. The existence proof establishes new connections among existence techniques for discontinuous Bayesian games.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00566.x.abstractZh: 我们证明了在多种私人价值拍卖中，存在分布策略的均衡，其中包括对双重拍卖首次的一般性存在性结果。这些均衡集合对于平局裁决规则是不变的。该模型包含多个单位需求、所有标准定价规则、保留价格、进入成本以及随机需求和供应。价值可以相关且不对称分布。对于双重拍卖，我们进一步证明至少有一个均衡涉及正数量的交易。这一存在性证明建立了不连续贝叶斯博弈存在性技术之间的新联系。

abstract.text: Fix finite pure strategy sets S1 , … , Sn , and let S= S1 ×⋯× Sn . In our model of a random game the agents' payoffs are statistically independent, with each agent's payoff uniformly distributed on the unit sphere in R -super-S. For given nonempty T1 ⊂ S1 , … , Tn ⊂ Sn we give a computationally implementable formula for the mean number of Nash equilibria in which each agent i's mixed strategy has support T i . The formula is the product of two expressions. The first is the expected number of totally mixed equilibria for the truncated game obtained by eliminating pure strategies outside the sets T i . The second may be construed as the "probability" that such an equilibrium remains an equilibrium when the strategies in the sets Si ∖ Ti become available.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00567.x.abstractZh: 固定有限的纯策略集合S1，…，Sn，令S= S1×⋯×Sn。在我们这个随机博弈模型中，各代理人的收益是统计独立的，且每个代理人的收益在单位球R -super-S上均匀分布。对于给定的非空集合T1⊂S1，…，Tn⊂Sn，我们给出了一个可计算实现的公式，用于计算每个代理人混合策略有支持集合Ti的纳什均衡的平均数量。该公式由两个表达式的乘积构成。第一个表达式表示通过消除集合Ti之外的纯策略而得到的截断博弈中完全混合均衡的预期数量。第二个表达式可以视为当集合Si∖Ti中的策略变得可用时，这样的均衡仍然保持为均衡的“概率”。

abstract.text: We compare three market structures for monetary economies: bargaining (search equilibrium); price taking (competitive equilibrium); and price posting (competitive search equilibrium). We also extend work on the microfoundations of money by allowing a general matching technology and entry. We study how equilibrium and the effects of policy depend on market structure. Under bargaining, trade and entry are both inefficient, and inflation implies first-order welfare losses. Under price taking, the Friedman rule solves the first inefficiency but not the second, and inflation may actually improve welfare. Under posting, the Friedman rule yields the first best, and inflation implies second-order welfare losses.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00568.x.abstractZh: 我们比较了三种货币经济的市场结构：讨价还价（搜索均衡）、价格垄断（竞争均衡）和价格公告（竞争搜索均衡）。我们还通过引入通用的匹配技术和市场进入机制，对货币微观基础的研究进行了扩展。我们研究了均衡状态以及政策效果如何依赖于市场结构。在讨价还价模式下，贸易和进入都是低效的，通货膨胀会导致一阶福利损失。在价格垄断模式下，弗里德曼法则解决了第一种低效问题，但第二种低效问题仍未解决，通货膨胀实际上可能改善福利。在价格公告模式下，弗里德曼法则达到了最优状态，而通货膨胀则会导致二阶福利损失。

abstract.text: This paper considers a general equilibrium model in which the distinction between uncertainty and risk is formalized by assuming agents have incomplete preferences over state-contingent consumption bundles, as in Bewley (1986). Without completeness, individual decision making depends on a set of probability distributions over the state space. A bundle is preferred to another if and only if it has larger expected utility for all probabilities in this set. When preferences are complete this set is a singleton, and the model reduces to standard expected utility. In this setting, we characterize Pareto optima and equilibria, and show that the presence of uncertainty generates robust indeterminacies in equilibrium prices and allocations for any specification of initial endowments. We derive comparative statics results linking the degree of uncertainty with changes in equilibria. Despite the presence of robust indeterminacies, we show that equilibrium prices and allocations vary continuously with underlying fundamentals. Equilibria in a standard risk economy are thus robust to adding small degrees of uncertainty. Finally, we give conditions under which some assets are not traded due to uncertainty aversion.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00569.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了一个一般均衡模型，其中通过假设代理人对状态相关的消费组合有不完全偏好，来明确不确定性与风险之间的区别，类似于Bewley（1986）的研究。在没有完全偏好的情况下，个体的决策依赖于状态空间上的概率分布集合。一个消费组合比另一个更受青睐，当且仅当它在该集合中的所有概率下都具有更高的期望效用。当偏好是完备的时，这个集合就只有一个元素，模型就简化为标准的期望效用理论。在这种设定下，我们描述了帕累托最优解和均衡状态，并表明不确定性的存在会在均衡价格和分配中产生稳健的不确定因素，无论初始禀赋如何。我们推导出了将不确定性程度与均衡变化联系起来的比较静态结果。尽管存在稳健的不确定因素，我们仍然发现均衡价格和分配会随着基础因素的变化而连续变化。因此，在标准风险经济中的均衡对增加一定程度的不确定性是稳健的。最后，我们给出了一些由于不确定性厌恶而导致某些资产不被交易的情形。

abstract.text: The ability of quantile regression models to characterize the heterogeneous impact of variables on different points of an outcome distribution makes them appealing in many economic applications. However, in observational studies, the variables of interest (e.g., education, prices) are often endogenous, making conventional quantile regression inconsistent and hence inappropriate for recovering the causal effects of these variables on the quantiles of economic outcomes. In order to address this problem, we develop a model of quantile treatment effects (QTE) in the presence of endogeneity and obtain conditions for identification of the QTE without functional form assumptions. The principal feature of the model is the imposition of conditions that restrict the evolution of ranks across treatment states. This feature allows us to overcome the endogeneity problem and recover the true QTE through the use of instrumental variables. The proposed model can also be equivalently viewed as a structural simultaneous equation model with nonadditive errors, where QTE can be interpreted as the structural quantile effects (SQE).

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00570.x.abstractZh: 分位数回归模型能够描述变量对结果分布不同点上的异质影响，这使得它们在许多经济应用中具有吸引力。然而，在观察性研究中，感兴趣的变量（如教育、价格）往往是内生的，这使得传统分位数回归方法不再适用，无法准确捕捉这些变量对经济结果分位数的影响。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一个在存在内生性情况下的分位数处理效应模型，并找到了无需功能形式假设即可识别分位数处理效应的条件。该模型的主要特点是施加了限制处理状态下排名变化的约束条件，这一特点使我们能够克服内生性问题，并通过使用工具变量来恢复真实的分位数处理效应。所提出的模型也可以等效地视为一个具有非加性误差的结构性联立方程模型，其中分位数处理效应可以被解释为结构性分位数效应。

abstract.text: We study the monotonicity of the equilibrium bid with respect to the number of bidders n in affiliated private-value models of first-price sealed-bid auctions and prove the existence of a large class of such models in which the equilibrium bid function is not increasing in n. We moreover decompose the effect of a change in n on the bid level into a competition effect and an affiliation effect. The latter suggests to the winner of the auction that competition is less intense than she had thought before the auction. Since the affiliation effect can occur in both private- and common-value models, a negative relationship between the bid level and n does not allow one to distinguish between the two models and is also not necessarily (only) due to bidders taking account of the winner's curse.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00571.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了在关联私有价值模型中的第一价格密封拍卖中，均衡出价对竞标者数量n的单调性，并证明了存在大量这样的模型，其中均衡出价函数并不随n的增加而上升。此外，我们将竞标者数量变化对出价水平的影响分解为竞争效应和关联效应。后者会让拍卖的胜者认为竞争程度比他们之前想象的要低。由于关联效应既可能出现在私有价值模型中，也可能出现在共同价值模型中，因此出价水平与竞标者数量之间的负相关关系无法区分这两种模型，也不一定（仅）是由于竞标者考虑到了胜者诅咒所致。

abstract.text: We develop general model-free adjustment procedures for the calculation of unbiased volatility loss functions based on practically feasible realized volatility benchmarks. The procedures, which exploit recent nonparametric asymptotic distributional results, are both easy-to-implement and highly accurate in empirically realistic situations. We also illustrate that properly accounting for the measurement errors in the volatility forecast evaluations reported in the existing literature can result in markedly higher estimates for the true degree of return volatility predictability.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00572.x.abstractZh: 我们开发了基于实际可行的实现波动率基准的无模型调整程序，用于计算无偏的波动率损失函数。这些程序利用了最新的非参数渐近分布结果，既易于实施，又在现实情况下具有高度准确性。我们还指出，正确考虑现有文献中波动率预测评估中的测量误差，可以显著提高对真实回报波动率可预测性的估计。

abstract.text: The paper studies the optimal tax-subsidy schedules in an economy where the only decision of the agents is to work, or not, with an application to the case of France. Given an income guarantee provided by the welfare state, the tax schedule that maximizes government revenue provides a benchmark, the Laffer bound, above which it is inefficient to tax. In fact, under mild conditions, a feasible allocation is second best optimal if and only if the associated taxes are lower than the Laffer bound. The only restriction that efficiency puts on the shape of the tax scheme is this upper Laffer bound. The Laffer tax scheme itself can be computed from the joint distribution of the agents' productivities and work opportunity costs. Depending on the economy, it can take widely different forms, and exhibit, for instance, negative marginal tax rates. After estimating the joint distribution of productivities and work opportunity costs on French data, I compute the Laffer bound for two subpopulations, single women and married women with two children or more. Quite surprisingly, the actual incentives to work appear to be very close to the bound.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00582.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个经济体内的最优税收补贴方案，该经济体内代理人的唯一决策是工作与否，并以法国为例进行了分析。在福利国家提供的收入保障下，能够最大化政府收入的税收方案提供了一个基准，即拉弗界限，超过该界限征税是低效的。实际上，在温和条件下，一个可行的分配方案是次优最优的，当且仅当相关的税收低于拉弗界限时。效率对税收方案形状的唯一限制就是这个上限的拉弗界限。拉弗税收方案本身可以通过代理人生产力和工作机会成本的联合分布来计算。根据经济情况的不同，它可能会呈现出不同的形式，例如，可能会出现负的边际税率。在基于法国数据估算出生产力和工作机会成本的联合分布后，我计算了两个子群体的拉弗界限：单身女性以及有两个或更多孩子的已婚女性。令人惊讶的是，实际的工作激励似乎与这个界限非常接近。

abstract.text: We introduce a class of strategies that generalizes examples constructed in two-player games under imperfect private monitoring. A sequential equilibrium is belief-free if, after every private history, each player's continuation strategy is optimal independently of his belief about his opponents' private histories. We provide a simple and sharp characterization of equilibrium payoffs using those strategies. While such strategies support a large set of payoffs, they are not rich enough to generate a folk theorem in most games besides the prisoner's dilemma, even when noise vanishes.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00583.x.abstractZh: 我们引入了一类策略，这些策略可以推广到在不完全私人监控下的两人游戏中构建的例子。如果每次私人历史之后，每个玩家的继续策略都是最优的，而不依赖于他对对手私人历史的信念，那么这种策略就满足信念自由的条件。我们使用这些策略对均衡收益进行了简单而精确的描述。虽然这样的策略能够支持大量的收益，但它们并不足以在大多数游戏中产生一个普遍适用的定理，除了囚徒困境之外，即使在没有噪声的情况下也是如此。

abstract.text: This paper disentangles the impact of schools and teachers in influencing achievement with special attention given to the potential problems of omitted or mismeasured variables and of student and school selection. Unique matched panel data from the UTD Texas Schools Project permit the identification of teacher quality based on student performance along with the impact of specific, measured components of teachers and schools. Semiparametric lower bound estimates of the variance in teacher quality based entirely on within-school heterogeneity indicate that teachers have powerful effects on reading and mathematics achievement, though little of the variation in teacher quality is explained by observable characteristics such as education or experience. The results suggest that the effects of a costly ten student reduction in class size are smaller than the benefit of moving one standard deviation up the teacher quality distribution, highlighting the importance of teacher effectiveness in the determination of school quality.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00584.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了学校与教师对学业成绩的影响，特别关注了变量遗漏或测量不当以及学生与学校选择所带来的潜在问题。来自UTD Texas Schools项目的独特匹配面板数据使得我们能够根据学生表现来识别教师质量，并分析教师和学校具体特征对学业成绩的影响。基于校内异质性得出的教师质量方差的半参数下限估计表明，教师在阅读和数学成绩方面具有显著的影响，尽管教师质量的差异很少可以通过教育或经验等可观测特征来解释。研究结果表明，减少十个学生人数的成本高于提升一个标准差的教师质量所带来的收益，这凸显了教师效能在决定学校质量中的重要性。

abstract.text: Consider a two-player discounted infinitely repeated game. A player's belief is a probability distribution over the opponent's repeated game strategies. This paper shows that, for a large class of repeated games, there are no beliefs that satisfy three properties: learnability, a diversity of belief condition called CSP, and consistency. Loosely, if players learn to forecast the path of play whenever each plays a strategy that the other anticipates (in the sense of being in the support of that player's belief) and if the sets of anticipated strategies are sufficiently rich, then neither anticipates any of his opponent's best responses. This generalizes results in Nachbar (1997).

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00585.x.abstractZh: 考虑一个双玩家、具有无限重复期的博弈。玩家的信念是对对手重复博弈策略的概率分布。本文表明，对于一大类重复博弈，不存在满足以下三个性质的信念：可学习性、称为CSP的信念多样性以及一致性。广义上讲，如果玩家学会在对手预期采取某种策略时预测对手的博弈路径（即该策略属于玩家信念的支撑范围），并且预期策略的集合足够丰富，那么玩家就无法预测对手的最佳反应。这一结论推广了Nachbar在1997年得出的结果。

abstract.text: This paper brings together the microeconomic-labor and the macroeconomic-equilibrium views of matching in labor markets. We nest a job matching model à la Jovanovic (1984) into a Mortensen and Pissarides (1994)-type equilibrium search environment. The resulting framework preserves the implications of job matching theory for worker turnover and wage dynamics, and it also allows for aggregation and general equilibrium analysis. We obtain two new equilibrium implications of job matching and search frictions for wage inequality. First, learning about match quality and worker turnover map Gaussian output noise into an ergodic wage distribution of empirically accurate shape: unimodal, skewed, with a Paretian right tail. Second, high idiosyncratic productivity risk hinders learning and sorting, and reduces wage inequality. The equilibrium solutions for the wage distribution and for the aggregate worker flows—quits to unemployment and to other jobs, displacements, hires—provide the likelihood function of the model in closed form.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00586.x.abstractZh: 本文将微观经济层面的劳动匹配理论与宏观经济层面的均衡匹配理论相结合。我们将Jovanovic（1984）提出的劳动匹配模型嵌入到Mortensen和Pissarides（1994）提出的均衡搜索环境中。这一框架既保留了劳动匹配理论对工人流动率和工资动态的影响，又支持聚合分析和一般均衡分析。我们得出了劳动匹配与搜索摩擦对工资不平等的两个新均衡影响：首先，了解匹配质量和工人流动率的信息可以将高斯输出噪声转化为具有精确形状的遍历工资分布：单峰、偏斜，并带有帕累特式的右尾分布。其次，高异质性的生产率风险会阻碍学习和排序过程，从而降低工资不平等。工资分布的均衡解以及工人流动的总体情况——包括离职、失业、转岗、招聘等——为模型提供了封闭形式的似然函数。

abstract.text: In many trading environments, any incentive compatible and individually rational market mechanism will be either inefficient or will run a deficit. We prove that as the market size m gets large, for any fixed surplus (or deficit) x, m times the minimal absolute inefficiency converges to c(x) where c(⋅) is essentially a quadratic function of textitx. We introduce a new mechanism, the double auction with a fixed transaction fee. By choosing the size of the fee appropriately, any level of deficit or surplus can be implemented and the resulting mechanisms achieve the above bound. Corollaries include: an asymptotic version of the Myerson–Satterthwaite Impossibility Theorem; a description of the minimal subsidy required to implement the efficient trading rule; a characterization of the minimal inefficiency obtainable with budget-balanced market mechanisms; recommendations on the optimal organization of trade; and insights on the effects of taxation.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00587.x.abstractZh: 在许多交易环境中，任何符合激励相容原则且个体理性的市场机制要么效率低下，要么会导致赤字。我们证明，随着市场规模m的增加，对于任何固定的盈余（或赤字）x，m倍的最小绝对效率低下会收敛到c(x)，其中c(x)本质上是x的二次函数。我们引入了一种新的机制——带有固定交易费的两倍拍卖。通过适当选择交易费的大小，可以实现任何水平的赤字或盈余，而由此产生的机制也能达到上述界限。相关结论包括：Myerson–Satterthwaite不可能性定理的渐近版本；实施有效交易规则所需的最小补贴的描述；预算平衡市场机制所能达到的最小效率低下的表征；关于贸易最优组织方式的建议；以及关于税收影响的见解。

abstract.text: We investigate the effect of employer-provided health insurance on job mobility rates and economic welfare using a search, matching, and bargaining framework. In our model, health insurance coverage decisions are made in a cooperative manner that recognizes the productivity effects of health insurance as well as its nonpecuniary value to the employee. The resulting equilibrium is one in which not all employment matches are covered by health insurance, wages at jobs providing health insurance are larger (in a stochastic sense) than those at jobs without health insurance, and workers at jobs with health insurance are less likely to leave those jobs, even after conditioning on the wage rate. We estimate the model using the 1996 panel of the Survey of Income and Program Participation, and find that the employer-provided health insurance system does not lead to any serious inefficiencies in mobility decisions.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00588.x.abstractZh: 我们采用搜索、匹配和谈判框架，研究雇主提供的健康保险对就业流动性率和经济福利的影响。在我们的模型中，健康保险覆盖决策是以一种合作的方式进行的，这种合作既考虑到健康保险的生产力效应，也考虑到其对员工的非金钱价值。由此产生的均衡状态是：并非所有就业都受到健康保险覆盖，提供健康保险的工作岗位的工资（在随机意义上）高于没有健康保险的工作岗位的工资，而且拥有健康保险的工作岗位的工人更不容易离开这些岗位，即使是在考虑了工资率之后也是如此。我们使用1996年《收入与计划参与调查》的面板数据对模型进行了估计，发现雇主提供的健康保险制度并不会导致就业流动性决策出现严重的效率低下。

abstract.text: Repeated games with unknown payoff distributions are analogous to a single decision maker's “multi-armed bandit” problem. Each state of the world corresponds to a different payoff matrix of a stage game. When monitoring is perfect, information about the state is public, and players are sufficiently patient, the following result holds: For any function that maps each state to a payoff vector that is feasible and individually rational in that state, there is a sequential equilibrium in which players experiment to learn the realized state and achieve a payoff close to the one specified for that state.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00589.x.abstractZh: 具有未知收益分布的重复博弈类似于单个决策者的“多臂老虎机”问题。每个世界状态对应一个阶段博弈的不同收益矩阵。当监控是完美的，关于状态的信息是公开的，且玩家具有足够的耐心时，以下结论成立：对于任何将每个状态映射到在该状态下是可行且个体理性的收益向量的函数，都存在一个序贯均衡，玩家通过实验来学习实际状态，并获得接近该状态所指定的收益。

abstract.text: We consider an exchange economy in which there are infinitely many consumers and some commodities are bads, that is, cause disutility to consumers. We give an example of such an economy for which there is no competitive equilibrium or its variants (quasi- or pseudo-equilibrium), and an example of the failure of the so-called uniform integrability condition of equilibrium allocations of increasingly populous finite economies.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00590.x.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个交换经济体系，其中存在无限多的消费者，某些商品是“坏商品”，即会导致消费者的效用降低。我们给出了一个这样的经济体系的例子，该体系不存在竞争均衡或其变体（准均衡或伪均衡）。同时，我们还举例说明了所谓的“均匀可积性条件”在人口不断增加的有限经济体系中无法满足的情况。

abstract.text: This paper uses the marginal treatment effect (MTE) to unify the nonparametric literature on treatment effects with the econometric literature on structural estimation using a nonparametric analog of a policy invariant parameter; to generate a variety of treatment effects from a common semiparametric functional form; to organize the literature on alternative estimators; and to explore what policy questions commonly used estimators in the treatment effect literature answer. A fundamental asymmetry intrinsic to the method of instrumental variables (IV) is noted. Recent advances in IV estimation allow for heterogeneity in responses but not in choices, and the method breaks down when both choice and response equations are heterogeneous in a general way.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00594.x.abstractZh: 本文采用边际处理效应（MTE）这一方法，将非参数处理效应研究与经济计量学中的结构估计研究相结合，利用一种非参数的政策不变参数来统一这些研究。通过一种共同的半参数函数形式，可以生成多种处理效应。同时，本文对替代估计器的相关文献进行了整理，并探讨了处理效应研究中所使用的常用估计器通常能够回答哪些政策问题。文中指出，工具变量方法存在一种根本性的不对称性。最近在工具变量估计方面的进展允许在响应变量中存在异质性，但在选择变量上则不允许，而当选择变量和响应变量都普遍存在异质性时，该方法就会失效。

abstract.text: Extensive-form market games typically have a large number of noncompetitive equilibria. In this paper, we argue that the complexity of noncompetitive behavior provides a justification for competitive equilibrium in the sense that if rational agents have an aversion to complexity (at the margin), then maximizing behavior will result in simple behavioral rules and hence in a competitive outcome. For this purpose, we use a class of extensive-form dynamic matching and bargaining games with a finite number of agents. In particular, we consider markets with heterogeneous buyers and sellers and deterministic, exogenous, sequential matching rules, although the results can be extended to other matching processes. If the complexity costs of implementing strategies enter players’ preferences lexicographically with the standard payoff, then every equilibrium strategy profile induces a competitive outcome.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00595.x.abstractZh: 广泛形式的市场博弈通常包含大量非竞争均衡。在本文中，我们认为非竞争行为的复杂性为竞争均衡的存在提供了依据，因为如果理性主体厌恶复杂性（在边际上），那么最大化行为将导致简单的行为规则，从而产生竞争性的结果。为此，我们研究了一类具有有限数量参与者的广泛形式动态匹配与讨价还价博弈。特别地，我们考虑了具有异质买方和卖方以及确定性、外生性、顺序匹配规则的市场，尽管这些结果可以扩展到其他匹配过程。如果实施策略的复杂性成本以标准收益的形式被玩家 lexicographically 考虑在内，那么每一个均衡策略组合都会引导出竞争性的结果。

abstract.text: We investigate a class of semiparametric ARCH(∞) models that includes as a special case the partially nonparametric (PNP) model introduced by Engle and Ng (1993) and which allows for both flexible dynamics and flexible function form with regard to the “news impact” function. We show that the functional part of the model satisfies a type II linear integral equation and give simple conditions under which there is a unique solution. We propose an estimation method that is based on kernel smoothing and profiled likelihood. We establish the distribution theory of the parametric components and the pointwise distribution of the nonparametric component of the model. We also discuss efficiency of both the parametric part and the nonparametric part. We investigate the performance of our procedures on simulated data and on a sample of S&P500 index returns. We find evidence of asymmetric news impact functions, consistent with the parametric analysis.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00596.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了一类半参数ARCH(∞)模型，其中包含了Engle和Ng在1993年提出的部分非参数模型作为特例。这类模型允许在“新闻影响”函数的方面同时具有灵活的动态特性和灵活的函数形式。我们证明了模型的函数部分满足一种II型线性积分方程，并给出了存在唯一解的简单条件。我们提出了一种基于核平滑和剖面似然的估计方法。我们建立了参数分量的分布理论以及模型非参数分量的点分布。我们还讨论了参数部分和非参数部分的效率。我们在模拟数据和S&P500指数回报样本上检验了我们的方法的性能。我们发现存在与参数分析一致的不对称新闻影响函数。

abstract.text: Entropy is a classical statistical concept with appealing properties. Establishing asymptotic distribution theory for smoothed nonparametric entropy measures of dependence has so far proved challenging. In this paper, we develop an asymptotic theory for a class of kernel-based smoothed nonparametric entropy measures of serial dependence in a time-series context. We use this theory to derive the limiting distribution of Granger and Lin's (1994) normalized entropy measure of serial dependence, which was previously not available in the literature. We also apply our theory to construct a new entropy-based test for serial dependence, providing an alternative to Robinson's (1991) approach. To obtain accurate inferences, we propose and justify a consistent smoothed bootstrap procedure. The naive bootstrap is not consistent for our test. Our test is useful in, for example, testing the random walk hypothesis, evaluating density forecasts, and identifying important lags of a time series. It is asymptotically locally more powerful than Robinson's (1991) test, as is confirmed in our simulation. An application to the daily S&P 500 stock price index illustrates our approach.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00597.x.abstractZh: 熵是一个具有吸引力的经典统计概念。为平滑的非参数依赖熵度量建立渐近分布理论至今仍是一个挑战。在本文中，我们为时间序列背景下的一类基于核的平滑非参数依赖熵度量发展了一个渐近理论。我们利用这一理论推导出了Granger和Lin（1994）提出的归一化依赖熵度量的极限分布，这一分布在现有文献中尚未得到报道。我们还应用这一理论构建了一种新的基于熵的依赖性检验方法，为Robinson（1991）的方法提供了替代方案。为了获得准确的推断结果，我们提出并证明了一种一致的平滑自助法程序。单纯的自助法并不适用于我们的检验。我们的检验在例如检验随机游走假设、评估密度预测以及识别时间序列的重要滞后项等方面具有实用性。与Robinson（1991）的检验相比，我们的检验在渐近局部上更为强大，这一点在我们的模拟实验中得到了验证。我们将这一方法应用于每日的S&P 500股票价格指数，以说明我们的方法的有效性。

abstract.text: In a number of semiparametric models, smoothing seems necessary in order to obtain estimates of the parametric component which are asymptotically normal and converge at parametric rate. However, smoothing can inflate the error in the normal approximation, so that refined approximations are of interest, especially in sample sizes that are not enormous. We show that a bootstrap distribution achieves a valid Edgeworth correction in the case of density-weighted averaged derivative estimates of semiparametric index models. Approaches to bias reduction are discussed. We also develop a higher-order expansion to show that the bootstrap achieves a further reduction in size distortion in the case of two-sided testing. The finite-sample performance of the methods is investigated by means of Monte Carlo simulations from a Tobit model.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00598.x.abstractZh: 在许多半参数模型中，为了获得渐近正态且以参数速率收敛的参数分量估计值，平滑处理似乎是必要的。然而，平滑处理可能会增大正态近似的误差，因此，特别是在样本量不是很大的情况下，更精细的近似方法变得很有意义。我们证明了在半参数指数模型的密度加权平均导数估计情况下，自举分布能够实现有效的Edgeworth校正。我们还讨论了减少偏差的方法。此外，我们发展了一种高阶展开方法，以证明在双侧检验的情况下，自举方法能够进一步减少尺寸失真。通过来自Tobit模型的蒙特卡洛模拟，我们研究了这些方法的有限样本性能。

abstract.text: Previous work on the denomination structure of currency treats as exogenous the distribution of transactions and the denominations held by people. Here, by way of a matching model, both are endogenous. In the model, trades in pairwise meetings alternate in time with the opportunity to freely choose a portfolio of denominations and there is a trade-off between the benefits of small-denomination money for transacting and the costliness of carrying a large quantity of small-denomination money. For a given denomination structure, a monetary steady state is shown to exist. The model implies that too small denominations are abandoned.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00599.x.abstractZh: 以往关于货币面额结构的研究将交易分布和人们持有的面额视为外生变量。而本文通过匹配模型表明，这两者都是内生变量。模型中，成对交易在时间上交替进行，人们可以自由选择面额组合。在小型面额货币的交易便利性与携带大量小型面额货币的成本之间存在着权衡。对于给定的面额结构，可以证明存在一个货币稳态。该模型表明，过小面额的货币会被放弃。

abstract.text: We present a new method for solving asset pricing models, which yields an analytic price-dividend function of one state variable. To illustrate our method we give a detailed analysis of Abel's asset pricing model. A function is analytic in an open interval if it can be represented as a convergent power series near every point of that interval. In addition to allowing us to solve for the exact equilibrium price-dividend function, the analyticity property also lets us assess the accuracy of any numerical solution procedure used in the asset pricing literature.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00600.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种解决资产定价模型的新方法，该方法能够得到一个仅涉及一个状态变量的解析价格-股息函数。为了说明我们的方法，我们对Abel的资产定价模型进行了详细分析。如果一个函数在某个开区间内能够在该区间的每一点附近表示为收敛的幂级数，那么该函数在该区间内是解析的。除了能够帮助我们确定精确的均衡价格-股息函数外，解析性属性还使我们能够评估资产定价文献中使用的任何数值解方法的准确性。

abstract.text: For stationary time series models with serial correlation, we consider generalized method of moments (GMM) estimators that use heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation consistent (HAC) positive definite weight matrices and generalized empirical likelihood (GEL) estimators based on smoothed moment conditions. Following the analysis of Newey and Smith (2004) for independent observations, we derive second order asymptotic biases of these estimators. The inspection of bias expressions reveals that the use of smoothed GEL, in contrast to GMM, removes the bias component associated with the correlation between the moment function and its derivative, while the bias component associated with third moments depends on the employed kernel function. We also analyze the case of no serial correlation, and find that the seemingly unnecessary smoothing and HAC estimation can reduce the bias for some of the estimators.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00601.x.abstractZh: 对于具有序列相关性的平稳时间序列模型，我们考虑了广义矩估计（GMM）方法，该方法使用异方差性和自相关性一致的正定权重矩阵，以及基于平滑矩条件的广义经验似然估计量。基于Newey和Smith（2004）对独立观测值的研究，我们推导了这些估计量的二阶渐近偏差。对偏差表达式的检验表明，与GMM相比，使用平滑的GEL可以消除与矩函数及其导数之间的相关性相关的偏差成分，而与第三矩相关的偏差成分则取决于所使用的核函数。我们还分析了无序列相关性的情况，发现看似不必要的平滑处理和HAC估计可以减小某些估计量的偏差。

abstract.text: We propose two new methods for estimating models with nonseparable errors and endogenous regressors. The first method estimates a local average response. One estimates the response of the conditional mean of the dependent variable to a change in the explanatory variable while conditioning on an external variable and then undoes the conditioning. The second method estimates the nonseparable function and the joint distribution of the observable and unobservable explanatory variables. An external variable is used to impose an equality restriction, at two points of support, on the conditional distribution of the unobservable random term given the regressor and the external variable. Our methods apply to cross sections, but our lead examples involve panel data cases in which the choice of the external variable is guided by the assumption that the distribution of the unobservable variables is exchangeable in the values of the endogenous variable for members of a group.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00609.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了两种新的方法，用于估计具有不可分离误差和内生回归量的模型。第一种方法估计局部平均响应。该方法通过条件化一个外部变量，估计因变量条件均值对解释变量变化的响应，然后取消条件化。第二种方法估计不可分离函数以及可观测和不可观测解释变量的联合分布。使用一个外部变量在两个支持点上对给定回归量和外部变量的不可观测随机项的条件分布施加等式约束。我们的方法适用于横截面数据，但我们的主要例子涉及面板数据案例，在这种情况下，选择外部变量的依据假设不可观测变量的分布在组内内生变量的取值上是可交换的。

abstract.text: We propose a generalized method of moments (GMM) Lagrange multiplier statistic, i.e., the K statistic, that uses a Jacobian estimator based on the continuous updating estimator that is asymptotically uncorrelated with the sample average of the moments. Its asymptotic χ-super-2 distribution therefore holds under a wider set of circumstances, like weak instruments, than the standard full rank case for the expected Jacobian under which the asymptotic χ-super-2 distributions of the traditional statistics are valid. The behavior of the K statistic can be spurious around inflection points and maxima of the objective function. This inadequacy is overcome by combining the K statistic with a statistic that tests the validity of the moment equations and by an extension of Moreira's (2003) conditional likelihood ratio statistic toward GMM. We conduct a power comparison to test for the risk aversion parameter in a stochastic discount factor model and construct its confidence set for observed consumption growth and asset return series.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00610.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种广义矩估计（GMM）拉格朗日乘数统计量，即K统计量，该统计量采用基于连续更新估计器的雅可比估计器，该估计器与矩的样本平均值渐近不相关。因此，在更宽的情况下，如弱工具变量条件下，其渐近χ-super-2分布仍然成立，而传统统计量的渐近χ-super-2分布在标准满秩情况下才成立。K统计量的行为在目标函数的拐点或最大值处可能会出现虚假值。通过结合一个检验矩方程有效性的统计量，以及扩展Moreira（2003）的条件似然比统计量以适应GMM方法，可以克服这一不足。我们进行了功效比较，以检验随机折现因子模型中的风险厌恶参数，并构建了观测到的消费增长和资产回报序列的置信区间。

abstract.text: Exploiting a rich panel data set on anti-ulcer drug prescriptions, we measure the effects of uncertainty and learning in the demand for pharmaceutical drugs. We estimate a dynamic matching model of demand under uncertainty in which patients learn from prescription experience about the effectiveness of alternative drugs. Unlike previous models, we allow drugs to have distinct symptomatic and curative effects, and endogenize treatment length by allowing drug choices to affect patients' underlying probability of recovery. We find that drugs' rankings along these dimensions differ, with high symptomatic effects for drugs with the highest market shares and high curative effects for drugs with the greatest medical efficacy. Our results also indicate that while there is substantial heterogeneity in drug efficacy across patients, learning enables patients and their doctors to dramatically reduce the costs of uncertainty in pharmaceutical markets.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00612.x.abstractZh: 通过利用关于抗溃疡药物处方的丰富面板数据集，我们研究了不确定性及学习对药品需求的影响。我们构建了一个在不确定性条件下的动态匹配模型，患者可以通过处方经验了解不同药物的有效性。与以往模型不同，我们允许药物具有不同的症状和疗效，并通过让药物选择影响患者的康复概率来内生化治疗时长。研究发现，这些药物在这些维度上的排名有所不同：市场占比最高的药物具有更强的症状缓解效果，而医疗效果最好的药物则具有更强的疗效。我们的结果还表明，尽管不同患者之间的药物疗效存在显著差异，但学习使得患者及其医生能够显著降低药品市场中的不确定性成本。

abstract.text: This paper shows that the bootstrap does not consistently estimate the asymptotic distribution of the maximum score estimator. The theory developed also applies to other estimators within a cube-root convergence class. For some single-parameter estimators in this class, the results suggest a simple method for inference based upon the bootstrap.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00613.x.abstractZh: 本文表明，自助法无法一致地估计最大得分估计量的渐近分布。所发展的理论同样适用于其他属于立方根收敛类的估计量。对于这类单参数估计量，研究结果提出了一种基于自助法的简单推断方法。

abstract.text: This paper develops theoretical foundations for an error analysis of approximate equilibria in dynamic stochastic general equilibrium models with heterogeneous agents and incomplete financial markets. While there are several algorithms that compute prices and allocations for which agents' first-order conditions are approximately satisfied (“approximate equilibria”), there are few results on how to interpret the errors in these candidate solutions and how to relate the computed allocations and prices to exact equilibrium allocations and prices. We give a simple example to illustrate that approximate equilibria might be very far from exact equilibria. We then interpret approximate equilibria as equilibria for close-by economies; that is, for economies with close-by individual endowments and preferences. We present an error analysis for two models that are commonly used in applications, an overlapping generations (OLG) model with stochastic production and an asset pricing model with infinitely lived agents. We provide sufficient conditions that ensure that approximate equilibria are close to exact equilibria of close-by economies. Numerical examples illustrate the analysis.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00614.x.abstractZh: 本文为动态随机一般均衡模型中具有异质性代理人与不完全金融市场条件下的近似均衡误差分析提供了理论基础。虽然存在一些算法能够计算出近似满足代理人一阶条件的价格和分配结果（“近似均衡”），但关于如何解释这些候选解中的误差，以及如何将计算出的分配和价格与精确均衡的分配和价格进行关联，目前的研究成果相对较少。我们通过一个简单的例子说明，近似均衡可能与精确均衡相差甚远。随后，我们将近似均衡解释为与邻近经济体相对应的均衡，即那些在个体禀赋和偏好方面相近的经济体。我们对两种常用模型进行了误差分析：一种是具有随机生产的重叠世代模型，另一种是具有无限寿命代理人的资产定价模型。我们提出了充分条件，以确保近似均衡与邻近经济体的精确均衡接近。数值例子进一步验证了分析结果的准确性。

abstract.text: In econometric applications, often several hypothesis tests are carried out at once. The problem then becomes how to decide which hypotheses to reject, accounting for the multitude of tests. This paper suggests a stepwise multiple testing procedure that asymptotically controls the familywise error rate. Compared to related single-step methods, the procedure is more powerful and often will reject more false hypotheses. In addition, we advocate the use of studentization when feasible. Unlike some stepwise methods, the method implicitly captures the joint dependence structure of the test statistics, which results in increased ability to detect false hypotheses. The methodology is presented in the context of comparing several strategies to a common benchmark. However, our ideas can easily be extended to other contexts where multiple tests occur. Some simulation studies show the improvements of our methods over previous proposals. We also provide an application to a set of real data.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00615.x.abstractZh: 在计量经济学应用中，通常会同时进行多项假设检验。问题在于如何决定拒绝哪些假设，同时考虑到众多检验的存在。本文提出了一种逐步多重检验程序，该程序能够渐近地控制家族错误率。与相关的单步法相比，该程序更为有效，通常能拒绝更多的错误假设。此外，我们建议在可行的情况下使用学生化方法。与某些逐步方法不同，该方法隐含地捕捉了检验统计量的联合依赖结构，从而提高了检测错误假设的能力。该方法是在比较多种策略与共同基准的背景下提出的。然而，我们的思想可以轻松扩展到其他存在多项检验的情境。一些模拟研究表明，我们的方法比以往提出的方案有更好的效果。我们还提供了一组真实数据的应用案例。

abstract.text: We consider semiparametric estimation of the memory parameter in a model that includes as special cases both long-memory stochastic volatility and fractionally integrated exponential GARCH (FIEGARCH) models. Under our general model the logarithms of the squared returns can be decomposed into the sum of a long-memory signal and a white noise. We consider periodogram-based estimators using a local Whittle criterion function. We allow the optional inclusion of an additional term to account for possible correlation between the signal and noise processes, as would occur in the FIEGARCH model.
