We also allow for potential nonstationarity in volatility by allowing the signal process to have a memory parameter d*1/2. We show that the local Whittle estimator is consistent for d*∈(0,1). We also show that the local Whittle estimator is asymptotically normal for d*∈(0,3/4) and essentially recovers the optimal semiparametric rate of convergence for this problem. In particular, if the spectral density of the short-memory component of the signal is sufficiently smooth, a convergence rate of n2/5−δ for d*∈(0,3/4) can be attained, where n is the sample size and δ>0 is arbitrarily small. This represents a strong improvement over the performance of existing semiparametric estimators of persistence in volatility. We also prove that the standard Gaussian semiparametric estimator is asymptotically normal if d*=0. This yields a test for long memory in volatility.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00616.x.abstractZh: 我们考虑在包含长记忆随机波动性和分数积分指数GARCH（FIEGARCH）模型在内的模型中，对记忆参数进行半参数估计。在我们的通用模型下，平方回报的对数可以分解为一个长记忆信号和一个白噪声之和。我们考虑使用基于周期图的估计器，并采用局部Whittle准则函数。我们允许引入额外的项来考虑信号和噪声过程之间可能存在的相关性，正如FIEGARCH模型中所做的那样。我们还允许信号过程具有记忆参数d*1/2，从而考虑波动性的潜在非平稳性。我们证明局部Whittle估计器对于d*∈(0,1)是一致的。我们还证明，对于d*∈(0,3/4)，局部Whittle估计器是渐近正态的，并且基本上恢复了该问题的最优半参数收敛速率。特别地，如果信号的短记忆分量的谱密度足够平滑，那么对于d*∈(0,3/4)，可以达到n2/5−δ的收敛速率，其中n是样本大小，δ>0是任意小的数值。这比现有的半参数估计器在波动性持续性估计方面的性能有了显著改进。我们还证明了，如果d*=0，标准高斯半参数估计器是渐近正态的。这提供了一种检测波动性长记忆性的方法。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a model for multilateral contracting, where contracts are written and renegotiated over time, and where contracts may impose externalities on other agents. The paper derives several properties of the Markov perfect equilibria of the infinite state-space contracting model. Equilibria always exist and the equilibrium value function is linear and monotonic on the contracts. If the grand coalition is not efficient we show that bargaining delays arise in positive-externality games. Otherwise, if the grand coalition is efficient, there are no bargaining delays and convergence to the grand coalition occurs in a finite number of contracting rounds. Thus, if bargaining frictions are insignificant, the outcome is Pareto efficient. However, if bargaining frictions are not small, we show that inefficiencies arise in negative-externality games because contracting takes place in multiple steps, while in positive-externality games contracting occurs in one step and is Pareto efficient.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00617.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个多边契约模型，其中契约会随着时间的推移被撰写和重新协商，并且契约可能会对其他主体产生外部性影响。文章推导了无限状态空间契约模型的马尔可夫完美均衡的若干性质。均衡总是存在的，且均衡价值函数在契约上是线性且单调的。如果大联盟并不高效，我们表明在正外部性博弈中会出现讨价还价延迟。反之，如果大联盟是高效的，则不会出现讨价还价延迟，并且通过有限次数的契约协商就能达成大联盟的共识。因此，如果讨价还价摩擦不显著，结果将是帕累托有效的。然而，如果讨价还价摩擦较大，我们表明在负外部性博弈中会出现效率低下现象，因为契约协商需要多个步骤，而在正外部性博弈中，契约协商只需一步，且是帕累托有效的。

abstract.text: It is well known that standard asymptotic theory is not applicable or is very unreliable in models with identification problems or weak instruments. One possible way out consists of using a variant of the Anderson–Rubin ((1949), AR) procedure. The latter allows one to build exact tests and confidence sets only for the full vector of the coefficients of the endogenous explanatory variables in a structural equation, but not for individual coefficients. This problem may in principle be overcome by using projection methods (Dufour (1997), Dufour and Jasiak (2001)). At first sight, however, this technique requires the application of costly numerical algorithms. In this paper, we give a general necessary and sufficient condition that allows one to check whether an AR-type confidence set is bounded. Furthermore, we provide an analytic solution to the problem of building projection-based confidence sets from AR-type confidence sets. The latter involves the geometric properties of “quadrics” and can be viewed as an extension of usual confidence intervals and ellipsoids. Only least squares techniques are needed to build the confidence intervals.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00618.x.abstractZh: 众所周知，标准渐近理论在存在识别问题或工具变量不足的情况下并不适用，或者非常不可靠。一种可能的解决办法是使用Anderson–Rubin ((1949), AR) 程序的变体。后者允许仅针对结构方程中内生解释变量的全部系数向量构建精确检验和置信区间，而不针对单个系数。原则上，可以通过使用投影方法来克服这个问题（Dufour (1997), Dufour和Jasiak (2001)）。然而，乍看之下，这种技术需要应用昂贵的数值算法。在本文中，我们给出了一个通用的必要和充分条件，用于判断AR型置信区间是否是有界的。此外，我们还提供了从AR型置信区间构建基于投影的置信区间的解析解。后者涉及“二次曲面”的几何性质，可以视为常规置信区间和椭球的扩展。构建置信区间只需要最小二乘法即可。

abstract.text: We apply recent econometric advances to study the distribution of commuters' preferences for speedy and reliable highway travel. Our analysis applies mixed logit to combined revealed and stated preference data on commuter choices of whether to pay a toll for congestion-free express travel. We find that motorists exhibit high values of travel time and reliability, and substantial heterogeneity in those values. We suggest that road pricing policies designed to cater to such varying preferences can improve efficiency and reduce the disparity of welfare impacts compared with recent pricing experiments.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00619.x.abstractZh: 我们运用最新的计量经济学方法，研究通勤者对快速且可靠的公路交通的偏好分布。我们的分析采用了混合逻辑模型，结合显式偏好和隐式偏好数据，来研究通勤者是否愿意支付通行费以获得无拥堵的快速交通。研究发现，驾驶者对行驶时间和可靠性的重视程度较高，且这些偏好存在显著的异质性。我们认为，针对这种不同偏好设计的道路定价政策，能够比最近的定价实验更有效地提高交通效率，并减少福利差异。

abstract.text: We exhibit a large class of simple rules of behavior, which we call adaptive heuristics, and show that they generate rational behavior in the long run. These adaptive heuristics are based on natural regret measures, and may be viewed as a bridge between rational and behavioral viewpoints. Taken together, the results presented here establish a solid connection between the dynamic approach of adaptive heuristics and the static approach of correlated equilibria.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00625.x.abstractZh: 我们展示了一类简单的行为规则，称之为适应性启发式规则，并证明它们在长期内能够产生理性行为。这些适应性启发式规则基于自然的遗憾度量机制，可以被视为理性视角与行为视角的桥梁。综上所述，这里所呈现的结果建立了适应性启发式动态方法与相关均衡静态方法之间的紧密联系。

abstract.text: How much discretion should the monetary authority have in setting its policy? This question is analyzed in an economy with an agreed-upon social welfare function that depends on the economy's randomly fluctuating state. The monetary authority has private information about that state. Well designed rules trade off society's desire to give the monetary authority discretion to react to its private information against society's need to prevent that authority from giving in to the temptation to stimulate the economy with unexpected inflation, the time inconsistency problem. Although this dynamic mechanism design problem seems complex, its solution is simple: legislate an inflation cap. The optimal degree of monetary policy discretion turns out to shrink as the severity of the time inconsistency problem increases relative to the importance of private information. In an economy with a severe time inconsistency problem and unimportant private information, the optimal degree of discretion is none.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00626.x.abstractZh: 货币当局在制定政策时应该拥有多大的自由裁量权？这个问题在一个具有约定好的社会福利函数的经济体系中得到了分析，该社会福利函数取决于经济的随机波动状态。货币当局拥有关于该状态的私人信息。设计良好的规则需要在社会希望赋予货币当局自由裁量权以利用私人信息，以及社会需要防止该当局因诱惑而通过意外通胀刺激经济之间做出权衡，这就是时间不一致性问题。尽管这种动态机制设计问题看起来很复杂，但其解决方案却很简单：制定一个通胀上限。随着时间不一致性问题的严重性相对于私人信息的重要性而增加，货币政策自由裁量权的最佳程度实际上会减小。在一个存在严重时间不一致性问题且私人信息不重要的经济体系中，最优的自由裁量权程度为零。

abstract.text: This paper addresses how changing the admission and financial aid rules at colleges affects future earnings. I estimate a structural model of the following decisions by individuals: where to submit applications, which school to attend, and what field to study. The model also includes decisions by schools as to which students to accept and how much financial aid to offer. Simulating how black educational choices would change were they to face the white admission and aid rules shows that race-based advantages had little effect on earnings. However, removing race-based advantages does affect black educational outcomes. In particular, removing advantages in admissions substantially decreases the number of black students at top-tier schools, while removing advantages in financial aid causes a decrease in the number of blacks who attend college.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00627.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了大学招生和财政援助规则的变化如何影响未来的收入。我构建了一个结构模型，用于分析个人在申请地点、选择学校以及专业选择方面的决策。该模型还涵盖了学校在录取学生及提供财政援助方面的决策。模拟了如果遵循白人学生的招生和财政援助规则，黑人教育选择会发生怎样的变化，结果显示，基于种族的竞争优势对收入几乎没有影响。然而，去除基于种族的竞争优势确实会影响黑人的教育成果。具体而言，去除招生方面的优势会显著减少黑人学生在顶尖学校的数量，而去除财政援助方面的优势则会导致黑人学生上大学的人数减少。

abstract.text: This paper provides weak conditions under which there is nonparametric interval identification of local features of a structural function that depends on a discrete endogenous variable and is nonseparable in latent variates. The function delivers values of a discrete or continuous outcome and instruments may be discrete valued. Application of the analog principle leads to quantile regression based interval estimators of values and partial differences of structural functions. The results are used to investigate the nonparametric identifying power of the quarter-of-birth instruments used in Angrist and Krueger's 1991 study of the returns to schooling.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00628.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种弱条件，在此条件下，可以对依赖于离散内生变量且在潜在变量中不可分离的结构函数的局部特征进行非参数区间识别。该结构函数能够输出离散或连续结果的值，而工具变量可以是离散值的。通过应用类比原理，可以得到基于分位数回归的区间估计量，用于估计结构函数的数值和差分值。这些结果被用于研究Angrist和Krueger在1991年关于教育回报的研究中使用的出生季度工具变量的非参数识别能力。

abstract.text: This paper considers regression models for cross-section data that exhibit cross-section dependence due to common shocks, such as macroeconomic shocks. The paper analyzes the properties of least squares (LS) estimators in this context. The results of the paper allow for any form of cross-section dependence and heterogeneity across population units. The probability limits of the LS estimators are determined, and necessary and sufficient conditions are given for consistency. The asymptotic distributions of the estimators are found to be mixed normal after recentering and scaling. The t, Wald, and F statistics are found to have asymptotic standard normal, χ2, and scaled χ2 distributions, respectively, under the null hypothesis when the conditions required for consistency of the parameter under test hold. However, the absolute values of t, Wald, and F statistics are found to diverge to infinity under the null hypothesis when these conditions fail. Confidence intervals exhibit similarly dichotomous behavior. Hence, common shocks are found to be innocuous in some circumstances, but quite problematic in others. Models with factor structures for errors and regressors are considered. Using the general results, conditions are determined under which consistency of the LS estimators holds and fails in models with factor structures. The results are extended to cover heterogeneous and functional factor structures in which common factors have different impacts on different population units.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00629.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了由于共同冲击（如宏观经济冲击）导致的截面数据中的回归模型。文章分析了在这种情况下最小二乘估计量的性质。研究结果适用于任何形式的截面依赖性和不同人口单位之间的异质性。确定了最小二乘估计量的概率极限，并给出了一致性的必要充分条件。估计量的渐近分布在重新中心和缩放后变为混合正态分布。在零假设下，当满足参数一致性的条件时，t统计量、Wald统计量和F统计量分别具有渐近标准正态、卡方分布和缩放后的卡方分布。然而，在这些条件不满足的情况下，t统计量、Wald统计量和F统计量的绝对值会发散到无穷大。置信区间也表现出类似的二分行为。因此，共同冲击在某些情况下是无害的，但在其他情况下则相当问题重重。文章还考虑了具有误差和回归变量因子结构的模型。利用一般结果，确定了在具有因子结构的模型中最小二乘估计量一致性的条件及不满足这些条件的情况。研究结果还扩展到了异质性和功能性因子结构的情况，即共同因子对不同人口单位产生不同的影响。

abstract.text: In this paper, I consider a dynamic economy in which a government needs to finance a stochastic process of purchases. The agents in the economy are privately informed about their skills, which evolve stochastically over time in an arbitrary fashion. I construct an optimal tax system that is restricted to be linear in an agent’s wealth but can be arbitrarily nonlinear in his current and past labor incomes. I find that wealth taxes in a given period depend on the individual’s labor income in that period and previous ones. However, in any period, the expectation of an agent’s wealth tax rate rate in the following period is zero. As well, the government never collects any net revenue from wealth taxes. ∗This version fixes some typos in the December 2003 version. The material in this paper previously circulated as

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00630.x.abstractZh: 在本文中，我考虑了一个动态经济体系，其中政府需要为随机的购买行为提供资金。经济中的个体都对其技能有私人信息了解，这些技能会随时间以任意方式随机变化。我构建了一个最优税收体系，该体系在个体财富上呈线性，但在其当前和过去的劳动收入上可以任意非线性。我发现，某一时期的财富税取决于该时期及之前各时期的劳动收入。然而，在任何时期，个体在下一时期的财富税率期望值为零。此外，政府从财富税中从未获得任何净收入。*此版本修正了2003年12月版本中的一些拼写错误。本文的原文曾以其他形式流传。

abstract.text: There is evidence that people do not fully take into account how other people's actions depend on these other people's information. This paper defines and applies a new equilibrium concept in games with private information, cursed equilibrium, which assumes that each player correctly predicts the distribution of other players' actions, but underestimates the degree to which these actions are correlated with other players' information. We apply the concept to common-values auctions, where cursed equilibrium captures the widely observed phenomenon of the winner's curse, and to bilateral trade, where cursedness predicts trade in adverse-selections settings for which conventional analysis predicts no trade. We also apply cursed equilibrium to voting and signalling models. We test a single-parameter variant of our model that embeds Bayesian Nash equilibrium as a special case and find that parameter values that correspond to cursedness fit a broad range of experimental datasets better than the parameter value that corresponds to Bayesian Nash equilibrium.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00631.x.abstractZh: 有证据表明，人们并未充分考虑到他人的行为是如何依赖于这些人的信息的。本文定义了一个新的均衡概念，用于私人信息博弈中，即“诅咒均衡”。该概念假设每个参与者都能正确预测其他参与者的行为分布，但低估了这些行为与其他参与者信息之间的相关性程度。我们将这一概念应用于共同价值拍卖，其中诅咒均衡能够解释普遍存在的“赢者诅咒”现象；同时，它也适用于双边贸易，其中诅咒均衡能够预测在常规分析认为不会发生贸易的逆向选择情况下仍会发生贸易的情况。我们还将诅咒均衡应用于投票和信号传递模型。我们测试了模型的单参数变体，该模型将贝叶斯纳什均衡作为特例纳入其中，发现与诅咒均衡相对应的参数值能够比与贝叶斯纳什均衡相对应的参数值更好地拟合一系列实验数据集。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the conditions under which consistent estimation can be achieved in instrumental variables (IV) regression when the available instruments are weak and the number of instruments, Kn, goes to infinity with the sample size. We show that consistent estimation depends importantly on the strength of the instruments as measured by rn, the rate of growth of the so-called concentration parameter, and also on Kn. In particular, when Kn→∞, the concentration parameter can grow, even if each individual instrument is only weakly correlated with the endogenous explanatory variables, and consistency of certain estimators can be established under weaker conditions than have previously been assumed in the literature. Hence, the use of many weak instruments may actually improve the performance of certain point estimators. More specifically, we find that the limited information maximum likelihood (LIML) estimator and the bias-corrected two-stage least squares (B2SLS) estimator are consistent when , while the two-stage least squares (2SLS) estimator is consistent only if Kn/rn→0 as n→∞. These consistency results suggest that LIML and B2SLS are more robust to instrument weakness than 2SLS.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00632.x.abstractZh: 本文分析了在可用工具变量较弱且工具变量的数量Kn随样本量增加而趋于无限大的情况下，如何实现一致估计的条件。研究表明，一致估计的达成程度主要取决于工具变量的强度，这一强度通过所谓浓度参数的增长率rn来衡量，同时也与Kn有关。特别是当Kn→∞时，即使每个工具变量与内生解释变量之间的相关性较弱，浓度参数仍有可能增长，此时某些估计量的一致性可以在比文献中先前假设的条件更宽松的情况下得到保证。因此，使用大量弱工具变量实际上可能会提升某些点估计量的性能。更具体地说，我们发现有限信息最大似然估计量（LIML）和偏差校正两阶段最小二乘法估计量在满足条件的情况下是一致的，而两阶段最小二乘法估计量只有在Kn/rn→0且n→∞时才一致。这些一致性结果表明，LIML和B2SLS对工具变量的弱性更为鲁棒。

abstract.text: Each agent in a finite set requests an integer quantity of an idiosyncratic good; the resulting total cost must be shared among the participating agents. The Aumann–Shapley prices are given by the Shapley value of the game where each unit of each good is regarded as a distinct player. The Aumann–Shapley cost-sharing method charges to an agent the sum of the prices attached to the units she consumes. We show that this method is characterized by the two standard axioms of Additivity and Dummy, and the property of No Merging or Splitting: agents never find it profitable to split or to merge their consumptions. We offer a variant of this result using the No Reshuffling condition: the total cost share paid by a group of agents who consume perfectly substitutable goods depends only on their aggregate consumption. We extend this characterization to the case where agents are allowed to consume bundles of goods.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00633.x.abstractZh: 在一个有限集合中，每个代理人都请求一定数量的一种特色商品；由此产生的总成本必须由参与代理的各方共同承担。Aumann–Shapley定价方法基于游戏的Shapley值来确定成本，其中每种商品的单位被视为不同的参与者。Aumann–Shapley成本分摊方法将每种商品单位的价格总和分摊给每个代理人。我们证明，该方法满足加性公理和虚拟公理这两个标准公理，并且具有“不合并或拆分”的特性：代理人永远不会认为拆分或合并他们的消费是划算的。我们还提出了一种使用“不重排”条件的变体结果：一组消费完全可替代商品的代理人所支付的总成本仅取决于他们的总消费量。我们将这一特性扩展到代理人可以消费多种商品组合的情况。

abstract.text: In the Self Sufficiency Project (SSP) welfare demonstration, members of a randomly assigned treatment group could receive a subsidy for full-time work. The subsidy was available for 3 years, but only to people who began working full time within 12 months of random assignment. A simple optimizing model suggests that the eligibility rules created an “establishment” incentive to find a job and leave welfare within a year of random assignment, and an “entitlement” incentive to choose work over welfare once eligibility was established. Building on this insight, we develop an econometric model of welfare participation that allows us to separate the two effects and estimate the impact of the earnings subsidy on welfare entry and exit rates among those who achieved eligibility. The combination of the two incentives explains the time profile of the experimental impacts, which peaked 15 months after random assignment and faded relatively quickly. Our findings suggest that about half of the peak impact of SSP was attributable to the establishment incentive. Despite the extra work effort generated by SSP, the program had no lasting impact on wages and little or no long-run effect on welfare participation.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00637.x.abstractZh: 在自给自足项目（SSP）的福利示范中，随机分配的治疗组成员可以获得全职工作的补贴。该补贴有效期为3年，但仅适用于在随机分配后的12个月内开始全职工作的人。一个简单的优化模型表明，资格规则创造了一种“建立”激励，促使人们在随机分配后一年内找到工作并退出福利救济；同时，一旦获得资格，又产生了一种“权利”激励，使人们更倾向于选择工作而非依赖福利救济。基于这一洞察，我们开发了一个计量经济模型，用于分析福利参与情况，该模型能够区分这两种激励效应，并估算收入补贴对达到资格者进入和退出福利救济的比率的影响。这两种激励效应的结合解释了实验效果的时间变化轨迹：在随机分配后15个月达到峰值，随后迅速减弱。我们的研究发现表明，SSP的峰值效应中约有一半归因于“建立”激励。尽管SSP带来了额外的工作负担，但该计划对工资水平没有持久影响，对福利参与的长期影响也微乎其微。

abstract.text: We study how intermediation and asset prices in over-the-counter markets are affected by illiquidity associated with search and bargaining. We compute explicitly the prices at which investors trade with each other as well as marketmakers' bid and ask prices in a dynamic model with strategic agents. Bid-ask spreads are lower if investors can more easily find other investors, or have easier access to multiple marketmakers. With a monopolistic marketmaker, bid-ask spreads are higher if investors have easier access to the marketmaker. We characterize endogenous search and welfare, and discuss empirical implications.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00639.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了场外市场中中介行为以及资产价格如何受到流动性不足的影响，这种流动性不足源于搜索和谈判过程的困难。我们在一个包含战略代理人的动态模型中，明确计算了投资者之间的交易价格以及做市商的出价和要价。如果投资者能够更容易地找到其他投资者，或者更容易接触到多个做市商，那么买卖价差就会更低。在垄断性做市商的情况下，如果投资者能够更轻松地接触到做市商，买卖价差就会更高。我们分析了内生性搜索行为对福利的影响，并讨论了其实证意义。

abstract.text: We propose and axiomatize a model of preferences over acts such that the decision maker evaluates acts according to the expectation (over a set of probability measures) of an increasing transformation of an act's expected utility. This expectation is calculated using a subjective probability over the set of probability measures that the decision maker thinks are relevant given her subjective information. A key feature of our model is that it achieves a separation between ambiguity, identified as a characteristic of the decision maker's subjective information, and ambiguity attitude, a characteristic of the decision maker's tastes. We show that attitudes towards risk are characterized by the shape of the von Neumann-Morgenstern utility function, as usual, while attitudes towards ambiguity are characterized by the shape of the increasing transformation applied to expected utilities. We show that the negative exponential form of this transformation is the special case of constant ambiguity aversion. Ambiguity itself is defined behaviorally and is shown to be characterized by properties of the subjective set of measures. This characterization of ambiguity is formally related to the definitions of subjective ambiguity advanced by Epstein-Zhang (2001) and Ghirardato-Marinacci (2002). One advantage of this model is that the well-developed machinery for dealing with risk attitudes can be applied as well to ambiguity attitudes. The model is also distinct from many in the literature on ambiguity in that it allows smooth, rather than kinked, indifference curves. This leads to different behavior and improved tractability, while still sharing the main features (e.g., Ellsberg's Paradox, etc.). The Maxmin EU model (e.g., Gilboa and Schmeidler (1989)) with a given set of measures may be seen as an extreme case of our model with infinite ambiguity aversion. Two illustrative applications to portfolio choice are offered.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00640.x.abstractZh: 我们提出并公理化了一个关于行为的偏好模型，使得决策者能够根据行为预期效用的递增变换的期望值（在一系列概率度量上）来评估行为。该期望值是通过使用决策者认为与其主观信息相关的概率度量集合来计算的。我们模型的一个关键特点是，它将模糊性（作为决策者主观信息的一个特征）与模糊态度（作为决策者偏好特征）区分开来。我们表明，对风险的态度由冯·诺伊曼-莫根施特恩效用函数的形状决定，而对待模糊性的态度则由应用于预期效用的递增变换的形状决定。我们证明，这种变换的负指数形式是常数模糊厌恶的特殊情况。模糊性本身是通过行为来定义的，并且被证明具有主观度量集合的属性。这种对模糊性的描述与Epstein-Zhang（2001）和Ghirardato-Marinacci（2002）提出的主观模糊性定义有形式上的关联。该模型的一个优势是，处理风险态度的成熟机制也可以应用于模糊态度。该模型与许多关于模糊性的文献不同，因为它允许平滑的 indifference曲线，而不是尖峭的曲线。这导致了不同的行为模式和更易于处理的问题，同时仍然保留了主要特征（例如，Ellsberg悖论等）。Maxmin EU模型（例如，Gilboa和Schmeidler在1989年的研究）在给定一套衡量指标的情况下，可以被视为我们模型中无限模糊厌恶的极端情况。文中还提供了两个关于投资组合选择的示例应用。

abstract.text: Alternating-offer and demand bargaining models of legislative bargaining make very different predictions in terms of both ex-ante and ex-post distribution of payoffs, as well as the role of the order of play. The experiment shows that actual bargaining behavior is not as sensitive to the different bargaining rules as the theoretical point predictions, while the comparative statics are in line with both models. We compare our results to studies attempting to distinguish between these two approaches using field data, finding strong similarities

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00641.x.abstractZh: 立法谈判的轮流报价与需求谈判模型在预期和事后收益分配以及谈判顺序的作用方面做出了截然不同的预测。实验表明，实际谈判行为对不同的谈判规则的敏感度并不如理论预测那么高，而比较静态分析则两种模型的结果一致。我们将我们的结果与那些试图使用实地数据来区分这两种方法的研究进行了比较，发现两者之间存在很强的相似性。

abstract.text: This paper is concerned with accuracy properties of simulations of approximate solutions for stochastic dynamic models. Our analysis rests upon a continuity property of invariant distributions and a generalized law of large numbers. We then show that the statistics generated by any sufficiently good numerical approximation are arbitrarily close to the set of expected values of the model's invariant distributions. Also, under a contractivity condition on the dynamics, we establish error bounds. These results are of further interest for the comparative study of stationary solutions and the estimation of structural dynamic models.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00642.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了随机动态模型近似解的模拟精度问题。我们的分析基于不变分布的一致性和大数定律。我们证明了，任何足够精确的数值近似所生成的统计数据，都可以任意接近模型不变分布的期望值集合。此外，在动态系统的收敛性条件下，我们还建立了误差界限。这些结果对于静态解的对比研究以及结构动态模型的估计具有进一步的研究价值。

abstract.text: We derive a lower bound for the volatility of the permanent component of investors' marginal utility of wealth or, more generally, asset pricing kernels. The bound is based on return properties of long-term zero-coupon bonds, risk-free bonds, and other risky securities. We find the permanent component of the pricing kernel to be very volatile; its volatility is about at least as large as the volatility of the stochastic discount factor. A related measure for the transitory component suggest it to be considerably less important. We also show that, for many cases where the pricing kernel is a function of consumption, innovations to consumption need to have permanent effects.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00643.x.abstractZh: 我们推导出了投资者财富边际效用的永久成分的波动性下限，或者更一般地，资产定价核的波动性下限。该下限基于长期零息债券、无风险债券以及其他风险证券的回报特性。我们发现，定价核的永久成分具有非常高的波动性；其波动性至少与随机贴现因子的波动性相当。对于过渡成分的相关度量表明，其重要性要小得多。我们还表明，在许多情况下，当定价核是消费的函数时，对消费的创新需要具有永久性的影响。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the driving forces behind informal sanctions in cooperation games and the extent to which theories of fairness and reciprocity capture these forces. We find that cooperators' punishment is almost exclusively targeted towards the defectors but the latter also impose a considerable amount of spiteful punishment on the cooperators. However, spiteful punishment vanishes if the punishers can no longer affect the payoff differences between themselves and the punished individual, whereas the cooperators even increase the resources devoted to punishment in this case. Our data also discriminate between different fairness principles. Fairness theories that are based on the assumption that players compare their own payoff to the group's average or the group's total payoff cannot explain the fact that cooperators target their punishment at the defectors. Fairness theories assuming that players aim to minimize payoff inequalities cannot explain the fact that cooperators punish defectors even if payoff inequalities cannot be reduced. Therefore, retaliation, i.e., the desire to harm those who committed unfair acts, seems to be the most important motive behind fairness-driven informal sanctions.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2005.00644.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了合作游戏中非正式制裁背后的驱动力，以及公平和互惠理论在解释这些驱动力方面的有效性。我们发现，合作者施加的惩罚几乎完全针对违约者，而违约者也会对合作者施加相当数量的恶意惩罚。然而，如果惩罚者无法再影响自己与被惩罚者之间的收益差异，那么恶意惩罚就会消失，而合作者在这种情况下甚至会增加用于惩罚的资源。我们的数据还揭示了不同公平原则之间的差异。那些基于玩家将自己的收益与群体平均水平或群体总收益进行比较的公平理论无法解释合作者为何会将惩罚目标指向违约者。而那些假设玩家旨在最小化收益不平等的公平理论也无法解释即使收益不平等无法减少，合作者为何仍会惩罚违约者。因此，报复行为，即想要伤害那些做出不公平行为的人，似乎才是推动公平驱动型非正式制裁的最重要动机。

abstract.text: Structural vector autoregressions (VARs) are widely used to trace out the effect of monetary policy innovations on the economy. However, the sparse information sets typically used in these empirical models lead to at least two potential problems with the results. First, to the extent that central banks and the private sector have information not reflected in the VAR, the measurement of policy innovations is likely to be contaminated. A second problem is that impulse responses can be observed only for the included variables, which generally constitute only a small subset of the variables that the researcher and policymaker care about. In this paper we investigate one potential solution to this limited information problem, which combines the standard structural VAR analysis with recent developments in factor analysis for large data sets. We find that the information that our factor-augmented VAR (FAVAR) methodology exploits is indeed important to properly identify the monetary transmission mechanism. Overall, our results provide a comprehensive and coherent picture of the effect of monetary policy on the economy.

10.1162/0033553053327452.abstractZh: 结构向量自回归模型被广泛用于追踪货币政策创新对经济的影响。然而，这些实证模型通常使用的稀疏信息集至少会导致两个潜在问题。首先，由于中央银行和私营部门拥有的信息并未反映在自回归模型中，货币政策创新的测量可能会受到污染。第二个问题是，脉冲响应只能针对包含在内的变量观察到，而这些变量通常只是研究人员和政策制定者所关心的少数变量之一。在本文中，我们探讨了解决这一信息有限问题的一种潜在方案，该方案将标准的结构向量自回归分析与大型数据集的因子分析技术相结合。我们发现，我们的因子增强自回归模型所利用的信息对于正确识别货币传导机制确实非常重要。总体而言，我们的研究结果提供了关于货币政策对经济影响的全面且一致的认识。

abstract.text: We explore the effectiveness of matching grants when lower levels of government can expropriate some of the funds for other uses. Using data on the Medicaid Disproportionate Share program, we identify states that were most able to expropriate funds. Payments to public hospitals in these states were systematically diverted and had no significant impact on patient mortality. Payments that were not expropriated were associated with significant declines in patient mortality. Overall, subsidies were an effective mechanism for improving outcomes for the poor, but the impact was limited by the ability of state and local governments to divert the targeted funds.

10.1162/0033553053327461.abstractZh: 我们探讨了在地方政府可能将部分资金用于其他用途时，匹配补助的有效性。通过Medicaid Disproportionate Share项目的数据，我们识别出那些能够更有效地转移资金的状态。在这些州，对公立医院的支付被系统性地转移，但并未对患者的死亡率产生显著影响。而那些未被转移的资金则与患者死亡率的显著下降相关。总体而言，补贴是改善贫困人群状况的有效机制，但其效果受到州和地方政府转移目标资金能力的限制。

abstract.text: We show the importance of a dynamic aggregation bias in accounting for the PPP puzzle. We prove that established time series and panel methods substantially exaggerate the persistence of real exchange rates because of heterogeneity in the dynamics of disaggregated relative prices. When heterogeneity is properly taken into account, estimates of the real exchange rate half-life fall dramatically, to little more than one year, or significantly below Rogoff's consensus view' of three to five years. We show corrected estimates are consistent with plausible nominal rigidities, thus, arguably, solving the puzzle. We also explain why traded goods prices account for the bulk of the persistence and volatility of the real exchange rate. The reason is that traded goods prices display dynamics that are more heterogeneous than non-traded ones.

10.1162/0033553053327524.abstractZh: 我们强调了动态聚合偏差在解释购买力平价难题中的重要性。我们证明，现有的时间序列和面板分析方法由于未正确考虑分解后的相对价格动态差异，从而严重夸大了实际汇率的持久性。当正确考虑这种差异时，实际汇率的半衰期显著缩短，几乎缩短到一年左右，或者远低于罗格夫所认为的三到五年。我们表明，经过修正后的估计结果与合理的名义刚性相符，因此可以说，这一研究解决了该难题。我们还解释了为什么交易商品的价格在实际汇率的持久性和波动性中占主导地位。原因是，交易商品的价格动态比非交易商品更为异质。

abstract.text: Public provision of education is usually viewed as a form of redistribution in kind. However, does it arise when income redistribution is feasible as well? I analyze a two-dimensional model of political decision-making with endogenous political parties. Society chooses both the tax rate and the allocation of the revenues between income redistribution and public education. Agents differ in their income and in their age, where young agents prefer public education and the old prefer income redistribution. I find that when the cohort size of the young is not too large then public education arises as a political compromise between the rich and the young segment of the poor. They collude in order to reduce the size of government (which benefits the rich) and target some of its resources to education (which benefits the young poor). When the cohort size of the young is too large, however, income redistribution crowds out public provision of education in the political equilibrium.

10.1162/003355305775097489.abstractZh: 公共教育供给通常被视为一种实物再分配的形式。然而，当收入再分配也是可行的时，是否也会出现公共教育供给呢？我分析了一个具有内生性政党的二维政治决策模型。社会在税收率和收入在收入再分配与公共教育之间的分配上做出选择。不同代理人之间存在收入差异和年龄差异，年轻代理人更倾向于公共教育，而老年人则更倾向于收入再分配。我发现，当年轻人的群体规模不是太大时，公共教育会成为富人与贫困的年轻人之间的政治妥协。他们通过合作来减少政府规模（这对富人有利），并将部分资源用于教育（这对贫困的年轻人有利）。然而，当年轻人的群体规模过大时，收入再分配会在政治均衡中排斥公共教育的供给。

abstract.text: We develop a novel model of campaigns, elections, and policy-making in which the ex ante objectives of national party leaders differ from the ex post objectives of elected legislators. This generates a distinction between “policy rhetoric” and “policy reality” and introduces an important role for “party discipline” in the policy-making process. We identify a protectionist bias in majoritarian politics. When trade policy is chosen by the majority delegation and legislators in the minority have limited means to influence choices, the parties announce trade policies that favor specific factors, and the expected tariff or export subsidy is positive. Positions and expected outcomes monotonically approach free trade as party discipline strengthens.

10.1162/003355305775097498.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个关于竞选活动、选举和政策制定的新模型，在该模型中，国家政党领导人的事前目标与当选立法者的事后目标存在差异。这一差异使得“政策言论”与“政策现实”之间产生了区分，并使得“政党纪律”在政策制定过程中发挥了重要作用。我们发现，在多数派政治中存在着保护主义倾向。当贸易政策由多数派代表团决定，而少数派立法者缺乏影响决策的能力时，政党会宣布有利于特定因素的贸易政策，此时预期的关税或出口补贴会呈现正值。随着政党纪律的加强，相关立场和预期结果会趋向于自由贸易。

abstract.text: This paper studies large private banks in 21 major emerging markets in the 1990s. It first demonstrates that bank failures are very common in these coun-tries: about 25 percent of these banks failed during the seven-year sample period. The paper also shows that political concerns play a significant role in delaying government interventions to failing banks. Failing banks are much less likely to be taken over by the government or to lose their licenses before elections than after. This result is robust to controlling for macroeconomic and bank-specific factors, a new party in power, early elections, outstanding loans from the IMF, as well as country-specific, time-independent factors. This finding implies that much of the within-country clustering in emerging market bank failures is directly due to political concerns. I.

10.1162/003355305775097506.abstractZh: 本文研究了1990年代21个主要新兴市场的大型私人银行。首先，本文指出在这些国家中，银行倒闭非常普遍：在七年的样本期间，约25%的银行发生了倒闭。研究还表明，政治因素在延迟政府对倒闭银行的干预方面起着重要作用。与选举之后相比，选举之前，倒闭的银行更不容易被政府接管，也不太可能失去经营许可。这一结果在控制宏观经济因素和银行特定因素、新政党上台、提前选举、国际货币基金组织的未偿还贷款以及国家特定的、与时间无关的因素后仍然成立。这一发现意味着，新兴市场银行倒闭的国内聚集现象在很大程度上是由政治因素造成的。

abstract.text: Among 188 countries, 72 had no state religion in 2000,1970, and 1900; 58 had a state religion throughout; and 58 had 1 or 2 transitions. We use a Hotelling spatial competition model to analyze the likelihood that the religion market would be monopolized. Similar forces influence a government's decision to establish a state religion. Consistent with the model, the probability of state religion in 1970 and 2000 is increasing with the adherence rate to the main religion, has a nonlinear relation with population, and has little relation with per capita GDP. The probability of state religion decreases sharply under Communism, but lagged Communism has only a weak effect. With costly adjustment for institutions, the probability of state religion in 1970 or 2000 depends substantially on the status in 1900. This persistence is much stronger for countries with no major regime change than for countries with such a change.

10.1162/003355305775097515.abstractZh: 在188个国家中，2000年、1970年和1900年时，有72个国家没有国教；58个国家一直存在国教；还有58个国家经历了一次或两次国教变更。我们使用霍特林空间竞争模型来分析宗教市场被垄断的可能性。类似的势力也会影响政府决定建立国教的决定。与模型预测一致，1970年和2000年国教存在的概率随着主要宗教的信仰率的增加而增加，与人口数量存在非线性关系，与人均GDP关系不大。在共产主义时期，国教存在的概率显著下降，但共产主义之后的影响则较为微弱。由于制度调整的代价较高，1970年或2000年国教存在的概率在很大程度上取决于1900年的制度状况。这种持续性在那些没有发生过重大政权变更的国家中更为明显。

abstract.text: Corruption by the politically connected is often blamed for economic ills, particularly in less developed economies. Using a loan-level data set of more than 90,000 firms that represents the universe of corporate lending in Pakistan between 1996 and 2002, we investigate rents to politically connected firms in banking. Classifying a firm as “political” if its director participates in an election, we examine the extent, nature, and economic costs of political rent provision. We find that political firms borrow 45 percent more and have 50 percent higher default rates. Such preferential treatment occurs exclusively in government banks—private banks provide no political favors. Using firm fixed effects and exploiting variation for the same firm across lenders or over time allows for cleaner identification of the political preference result. We also find that political rents increase with the strength of the firm's politician and whether he or his party is in power, and fall with the degree of electoral participation in his constituency. We provide direct evidence against alternative explanations such as socially motivated lending by government banks to politicians. The economy-wide costs of the rents identified are estimated to be 0.3 to 1.9 percent of GDP every year.

10.1162/003355305775097524.abstractZh: 政治关系网中的腐败行为常被指责为经济问题的根源，尤其是在欠发达经济体中。本研究利用1996至2002年间巴基斯坦超过9万家企业的贷款数据，调查了银行中对政治关系网企业提供的租金现象。如果企业的董事参与选举，我们将该企业归类为“政治型企业”。研究发现，政治型企业借款成本高出45%，违约率也高出50%。这种优惠待遇仅出现在政府银行中，私人银行则不会提供此类政治支持。通过企业固定效应分析，并考虑同一企业在不同贷款机构或不同时间的变化情况，我们能够更清晰地识别政治偏好带来的后果。此外，我们还发现，政治型企业提供的租金随着企业政治人物的影响力以及他或他的政党在执政地位上的变化而增加；而随着其在选区中的选举参与程度降低，这种租金也会减少。这些发现直接反驳了政府银行向政治家提供贷款的社会动机等替代解释。这些租金对整个经济造成的年度成本估计为GDP的0.3%至1.9%。

abstract.text: Party platforms differ sharply from one another, especially on issues with religious content, such as abortion or gay marriage. Given the high return to attracting the median voter, why do vote-maximizing politicians take extreme positions? In this paper we find that strategic extremism depends on an intensive margin where politicians want to induce their core constituents to vote (or make donations) and the ability to target political messages toward those core constituents. Our model predicts that the political relevance of religious issues is highest when around one-half of the voting population attends church regularly. Using data from across the world and within the United States, we indeed find a nonmonotonic relationship between religious extremism and religious attendance.

10.1162/003355305775097533.abstractZh: 各政党在其纲领上存在显著差异，尤其是在涉及宗教内容的问题上，如堕胎或同性婚姻。鉴于吸引中间选民所带来的高回报，为何那些追求最大化选票的政客会采取极端立场呢？我们的研究发现，策略性极端主义取决于一个“密集边际”——即政客希望诱导其核心选民进行投票（或捐款）的临界点，以及向这些核心选民传递政治信息的能力。我们的模型预测，当大约一半的选民定期参加宗教活动时，宗教问题的政治相关性最高。通过全球及美国国内的数据验证，我们确实发现宗教极端主义与宗教参与率之间存在非单调关系。

abstract.text: We measure media bias by estimating ideological scores for several major media outlets. To compute this, we count the times that a particular media outlet cites various think tanks and policy groups, then compare this with the times that members of Congress cite the same groups. Our results show a strong liberal bias: all of the news outlets we examine, except Fox News ’ Special Report and the Washington Times, received scores to the left of the average member of Congress. Consistent with claims made by conservative critics, CBS Evening News and the New York Times received scores far to the left of center. The most centrist media outlets were PBS NewsHour, CNN’s Newsnight, and ABC’s Good Morning America; among print outlets, USAToday was closest to the center. All of our findings refer strictly to news content; that is, we exclude editorials, letters, and the like.

10.1162/003355305775097542.abstractZh: 我们通过估算多家主要媒体的意识形态得分来衡量媒体偏见。为此，我们统计了某家媒体引用各种智库和政策团体的次数，然后将其与国会议员引用相同团体的次数进行比较。我们的结果显示，所有被考察的媒体都表现出强烈的自由派偏见：除了福克斯新闻的《特别报道》和《华盛顿时报》外，其他所有媒体得分都低于普通国会议员的得分。与保守派批评者的说法一致，《哥伦比亚广播公司晚间新闻》和《纽约时报》的得分则明显偏左。最中立的媒体包括PBS新闻时间、CNN的《新闻之夜》以及ABC的《早安美国》；在印刷媒体中，《今日美国》的得分最接近中间水平。我们的所有研究结果仅涉及新闻内容，即排除了社论、信件等形式的报道。

abstract.text: A club's majority rule defines the number of members that must approve a policy proposed to replace the status quo. Since the majority rule thus dictates the extent to which winners must compensate losers, it also determines the incentives to invest in order to become a winner of anticipated projects. If the required majority is large, members invest too little because of a holdup problem; if it is small, members invest too much in order to become a member of the majority coalition. To balance these opposing forces, the majority rule should increase in the project's value and the club's enforcement capacity but decrease in the heterogeneity in preferences. Externalities can be internalized by adjusting the rule. With heterogeneity in size or initial conditions, votes should be appropriately weighted or double majorities required.

10.1162/003355305775097551.abstractZh: 一个俱乐部的多数规则决定了必须获得多少成员同意才能实施一项旨在取代现状的政策。由于多数规则规定了赢家必须补偿输家的程度，它也决定了人们为了成为预期项目的赢家而投资的动机。如果所需的多数人数过多，成员可能会因为阻碍问题而投资不足；如果多数人数过少，成员可能会为了成为多数联盟的成员而过度投资。为了平衡这些对立的力量，多数规则应该随着项目价值的增加和俱乐部的执行能力增强而加强，同时减少偏好差异的影响。外部性可以通过调整规则来内部化。如果成员规模或初始条件存在差异，则应该对投票进行适当加权，或者要求双重多数同意。

abstract.text: This paper studies the political viabihty of free trade agreements (FTAs). The key element of the analysis is the “rent destruction” that these arrangements induce: by eliminating intrabloc trade barriers, an FT A lowers the incentives of import-competing industries to lobby for higher external tariffs, thereby inducing a reduction of the rents created in the lobbying process. Using a conventional competitive model, I show that the prospect of rent destruction can critically undermine (and in some cases rule out entirely) the political viability of welfare-reducing FTAs. This result contrasts sharply with findings from the earlier regionalism literature.

10.1162/003355305775097560.abstractZh: 本文研究了自由贸易协定在政治上的可行性。分析的核心要素是这些协定引发的“租金破坏”：通过消除集团内部的贸易壁垒，自由贸易协定降低了进口竞争行业游说要求更高外部关税的动机，从而减少了游说过程中产生的租金。利用传统的竞争模型，我表明租金破坏的可能性会严重削弱（在某些情况下甚至完全排除）降低福利的自由贸易协定的政治可行性。这一结果与早期关于区域主义研究的发现形成了鲜明对比。

abstract.text: We present a model in which setting up and running a regulatory institution takes a fixed cost. As a consequence, the supply of regulation is limited by the extent of the market. We test three implications of this model. First, jurisdictions with larger populations affected by a given regulation are more likely to have it. Second, jurisdictions with lower incremental fixed costs of introducing and administering new regulations should regulate more. This implies that regulation spreads from higher to lower population jurisdictions, and that jurisdictions that build up transferable regulatory capabilities should regulate more intensely. Consistent with the model, we find that higher population U. S. states have more pages of legislation and adopt particular laws earlier in their history than do smaller states. We also find that the regulation of entry, the regulation of labor, and the military draft are more extensive in countries with larger populations, as well as in civil law countries, where we argue that the incremental fixed costs are lower.

10.1162/003355305775097579.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，在该模型中，设立和运行一个监管机构需要固定的成本。因此，监管供给受到市场规模的限制。我们测试了该模型的三个推论。首先，受特定监管影响的居民人口较多的司法管辖区更有可能实施该监管。其次，引入和实施新法规的增量固定成本较低的司法管辖区应该实施更多的监管。这意味着监管会从人口较多的司法管辖区向人口较少的司法管辖区扩散，而那些具备可转移监管能力的司法管辖区应该实施更严格的监管。与模型一致，我们发现人口较多的美国州拥有更多的立法条款，并且比人口较小的州更早地采纳特定法律。我们还发现，在人口较多的国家以及民法国家，对进入市场的监管、对劳动力的监管以及军事征兵的监管更为严格，我们认为这些国家的增量固定成本较低。

abstract.text: When it is hard to assess service quality, firms will suboptimally hire low ability workers. We show that organizing as a profit-sharing partnership can alleviate these problems. Our theory explains the relative scarcity of partnerships outside of professional service industries such as law, accounting, medicine, investment banking, architecture, advertising, and consulting. It also sheds light on features of partnerships such as up-or-out promotion systems, the use of noncompete clauses, and recent trends in professional service industries.

10.1162/qjec.2005.120.1.131.abstractZh: 在难以评估服务质量的情况下，企业往往会雇佣能力较低的员工，这并非最优选择。我们的研究表明，将企业组织成利润分享型合作伙伴关系可以缓解这些问题。我们的理论解释了为什么在诸如法律、会计、医学、投资银行、建筑、广告和咨询等专业服务行业之外，合作伙伴关系相对稀缺。此外，该理论还揭示了合作伙伴关系的一些特点，如晋升制度、非竞争条款的使用，以及专业服务行业中的最新趋势。

abstract.text: We introduce imperfect creditor protection in a multicountry Schumpeterian growth model. The theory predicts that any country with more than some critical level of financial development will converge to the growth rate of the world technology frontier, and that all other countries will have a strictly lower long-run growth rate. We present evidence supporting these and other implications, in the form of a cross-country growth regression with a significant and sizable negative coefficient on initial per-capita GDP (relative to the United States) interacted with financial intermediation. In addition, we find that other variables representing schooling, geography, health, policy, politics, and institutions do not affect the significance of the interaction between financial intermediation and initial per capita GDP, and do not show any independent effect on convergence in the regressions. Our findings are robust to removal of outliers and to alternative conditioning sets, estimation procedures, and measures of financial development.

10.1162/qjec.2005.120.1.173.abstractZh: 我们在一个多国的熊彼特式增长模型中引入了不完善的债权人保护机制。该理论预测，任何金融发展程度超过某个临界水平的国家都将趋向于世界技术前沿的增长率，而所有其他国家的长期增长率则会明显低于这一水平。我们提供了支持这些预测及其他结论的证据，这些证据表现为一个跨国增长回归模型，其中初始人均GDP（相对于美国）与金融中介之间存在显著的负系数关系。此外，我们发现，代表教育水平、地理条件、健康状况、政策、政治和制度等因素的变量，并不会影响金融中介与初始人均GDP之间交互作用的重要性，也不会在回归分析中显示出任何独立的收敛效应。我们的研究结果在去除异常值、采用不同的条件集、不同的估计方法以及不同的金融发展衡量标准后仍然保持稳定。

abstract.text: Analyzing 210 developing country private equity investments, we find that transactions vary with nations' legal enforcement, whether measured directly or through legal origin. Investments in high enforcement and common law nations often use convertible preferred stock with covenants. In low enforcement and civil law nations, private equity groups tend to use common stock and debt, and rely on equity and board control. Transactions in high enforcement countries have higher valuations and returns. While relying on ownership rather than contractual provisions may help to alleviate legal enforcement problems, these results suggest that private solutions are only a partial remedy.

10.1162/qjec.2005.120.1.223.abstractZh: 通过对210个发展中国家的私募股权投资进行分析，我们发现交易情况因国家的法律执行力度而异，这种差异可以通过直接衡量或法律渊源来体现。在法律执行力度较强且以普通法为基础的国家，私募股权投资通常会采用带有约束条件的可转换优先股。而在法律执行力度较弱且以民法为基础的国家，私募股权集团则倾向于使用普通股和债务融资，并依赖股权和董事会控制。在法律执行力度较强的国家，交易项目的估值和回报通常更高。虽然依赖所有权而非合同条款可能有助于缓解法律执行问题，但这些结果表明，私人解决方案只是部分有效的解决办法。

abstract.text: The majority of asset-management intermediaries (e.g., mutual funds, hedge funds) are structured on an open-end basis, even though it appears that the open-end form can be a serious impediment to arbitrage. I argue that when funds compete to attract investors' dollars, the equilibrium degree of open-ending in an economy can be excessive from the point of view of these investors. One implication of the analysis is that, even absent short-sales constraints or other frictions, economically large mispricings can coexist with rational, competitive arbitrageurs who earn small excess returns.

10.1162/qjec.2005.120.1.247.abstractZh: 大多数资产管理中介机构（如共同基金、对冲基金）采用开放式结构，尽管这种形式似乎会成为套利的严重障碍。我认为，当这些基金竞相吸引投资者资金时，从投资者的角度来看，开放式结构的均衡程度可能会过高。分析的一个结果是，即使没有短期销售限制或其他摩擦因素，经济上的大幅价格偏差仍可能与理性、竞争性的套利者共存，这些套利者能够获得较小的超额回报。

abstract.text: This paper examines the interactions between household formation, inequality, and per capita income. We develop a model in which agents decide to become skilled or unskilled and form households. We show that the equilibrium sorting of spouses by skill type (their correlation in skills) is an increasing function of the skill premium. In the absence of perfect capital markets, the economy can converge to different steady states, depending upon initial conditions. The degree of marital sorting and wage inequality is positively correlated across steady states and negatively correlated with per capita income. We use household surveys from 34 countries to construct several measures of the skill premium and of the degree of correlation of spouses' education (marital sorting). For all our measures, we find a positive and significant relationship between the two variables. We also find that sorting and per capita GDP are negatively correlated and that greater discrimination against women leads to more sorting, in line with the predictions of our model.

10.1162/qjec.2005.120.1.273.abstractZh: 本文探讨了家庭形成、不平等与人均收入之间的相互作用。我们建立了一个模型，其中个体决定成为技能型或非技能型家庭成员。研究表明，配偶的技能类型排序（即他们的技能相关性）是技能溢价的一个增函数。在缺乏完美资本市场的情况下，经济可能会根据初始条件收敛到不同的稳定状态。配偶的排序程度与工资不平等在多个稳定状态下呈正相关，但与人均收入呈负相关。我们利用34个国家的家庭调查数据，构建了多种衡量技能溢价以及配偶教育相关性程度的指标。对于所有这些指标，我们都发现了这两个变量之间的正向且显著的关系。此外，我们还发现，配偶的排序程度与人均GDP呈负相关，而对女性的歧视程度越高，配偶的排序程度也越高，这与我们模型的预测一致。

abstract.text: This paper develops a model of the interaction between the supply of hate-creating stories from politicians and the willingness of voters to listen to hatred. Hatred is fostered with stories of an out-group's crimes, but the impact of these stories comes from repetition not truth. Hate-creating stories are supplied by politicians when such actions help to discredit opponents whose policies benefit an out-group. Egalitarians foment hatred against rich minorities; opponents of re-distribution build hatred against poor minorities. Hatred relies on people accepting, rather than investigating, hate-creating stories. Hatred declines when there is private incentive to learn the truth. Increased economic interactions with a minority group may provide that incentive. This framework is used to illuminate the evolution of anti-Black hatred in the United States South, episodes of anti-Semitism in Europe, and the recent surge of anti-Americanism in the Arab world.

10.1162/qjec.2005.120.1.45.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个模型，用于研究政治家发布的仇恨言论与选民愿意接受这些言论之间的互动关系。仇恨言论往往源于对外部群体罪行的描述，但这些言论的影响并非来自事实本身，而是来自重复传播。当政治行为有助于贬低那些其政策有利于外部群体的对手时，政治家就会发布这类仇恨言论。平等主义者会煽动对富裕少数群体的仇恨；反对重新分配财富的人则会煽动对贫困少数群体的仇恨。仇恨的传播依赖于人们接受而非调查这些仇恨言论。当存在了解真相的私人动机时，仇恨就会减少。与少数群体增加的经济互动可能会提供这种动机。这一框架被用来解释美国南部对黑人的仇恨情绪、欧洲的反犹太主义事件，以及阿拉伯世界近期出现的反美情绪。

abstract.text: The Moving to Opportunity (MTO) demonstration assigned housing vouchers via random lottery to public housing residents in five cities. We use the exogenous variation in residential locations generated by MTO to estimate neighborhood effects on youth crime and delinquency. The offer to relocate to lower-poverty areas reduces arrests among female youth for violent and property crimes, relative to a control group. For males the offer to relocate reduces arrests for violent crime, at least in the short run, but increases problem behaviors and property crime arrests. The gender difference in treatment effects seems to reflect differences in how male and female youths from disadvantaged backgrounds adapt and respond to similar new neighborhood environments.

10.1162/qjec.2005.120.1.87.abstractZh: “机会转移”示范项目通过随机抽签方式向五座城市的公共住房居民发放住房券。我们利用“机会转移”项目导致的居住地点变化来估计社区环境对青少年犯罪和违法行为的影响。与对照组相比，被提议迁移到贫困程度较低地区的青少年，在暴力犯罪和财产犯罪方面的被捕次数有所减少。对于男性青少年来说，迁移到贫困程度较低地区的提议至少在短期内减少了暴力犯罪的被捕次数，但增加了问题行为及财产犯罪被捕的次数。这种性别差异在治疗效果上的体现，似乎反映了来自弱势背景的男女青少年在适应和应对相似新社区环境时的不同方式。

abstract.text: Current macroeconomic models provide appealing, succinct descriptions of business cycle dynamics in the United States and other countries, but less is known about the extent to which these models accurately replicate the economy’s long-run characteristics. In part, this reflects that economists have far fewer observations about long-run behavior, given the limited sample sizes available. But while less is known about the long-run characteristics of the economy, many macroeconomic models impose very strong assumptions about this behavior— that the long-run levels of inflation and the real interest rate are constant over time and perfectly known by all economic agents. This paper empirically

10.1257/0002828053828446.abstractZh: 当前的宏观经济模型能够简洁地描述美国及其他国家的商业周期动态，但对于这些模型在多大程度上准确再现经济的长期特征，我们知之甚少。部分原因在于，由于可用样本规模有限，经济学家对长期行为的观察数据极为匮乏。然而，尽管我们对经济的长期特征了解不足，许多宏观经济模型却对这些行为的描述过于绝对——即长期的通胀水平和实际利率是恒定的，并且所有经济主体都能完全知晓这些数值。本文通过实证分析探讨了这一问题。

abstract.text: Our main goal is to quantify the returns to a career in the United States Congress. We specify a dynamic model of career decisions of a member of Congress andestimate this model using a newly collected dataset. Given estimates of the structural model, we assess reelection probabilities, estimate the effect of congressional experience on private and public sector wages, and quantify the value of a congressional seat. Moreover, we assess how an increase in the congressional wage or the imposition of term limits would affect the career decisions of politicians and the returns from a career in Congress.

10.1257/0002828053828464.abstractZh: 我们的主要目标是量化在美国国会任职的回报。我们构建了一个关于国会议员职业决策的动态模型，并使用新收集的数据集对该模型进行估算。在得到该模型的结构化估计后，我们评估了议员连任的概率，估算了国会工作经验对私营和公共部门工资的影響，并量化了担任国会议员的收益。此外，我们还评估了提高国会工资或实施任期限制会对政治人物的职业决策以及国会任职的回报产生什么影响。

abstract.text: Prevalent thinking about liquidity traps suggests that the perfect substitutability of money and bonds at a zero short-term nominal interest rate renders open-market operations ineffective for achieving macroeconomic stabilization goals. We show that even were this the case, there remains a powerful argument for large-scale open market operations as a fiscal policy tool. As we also demonstrate, however, this same reasoning implies that open-market operations will be beneficial for stabilization as well, even when the economy is expected to remain mired in a liquidity trap for some time. Thus, the microeconomic fiscal benefits of open-market operations in a liquidity trap go hand in hand with standard macroeconomic objectives. Motivated by Japan’s recent economic experience, we use a dynamic general-equilibrium model to assess the welfare impact of open-market operations for an economy in Japan’s predicament. We argue Japan can achieve a substantial welfare improvement through large open-market purchases of domestic government debt.

10.1257/0002828053828473.abstractZh: 关于流动性陷阱的常见观点认为，在零短期名义利率下，货币与债券可以完美替代，这使得公开市场操作无法有效实现宏观经济稳定目标。然而，我们指出，即便如此，大规模公开市场操作作为财政政策工具仍然具有强大的合理性。不过，同样的推理也表明，即使预期经济将在流动性陷阱中持续一段时间，公开市场操作仍然有助于稳定经济。因此，在流动性陷阱中，公开市场操作的微观经济福利效益与标准的宏观经济目标是一致的。基于日本近期经济经验，我们运用动态一般均衡模型来评估公开市场操作对日本经济的福利影响。我们认为，日本可以通过大规模购买国内政府债务来实现显著的福利改善。

abstract.text: Following a recession, the aggregate labor market is slack–employment remains below normal and recruiting efforts of employers, as measured by help-wanted advertising and vacancies, are low. A model of matching friction explains the qualitative responses of the labor market to adverse shocks, but requires implausibly large shocks to account for the magnitude of observed fluctuations. The incorporation of wage stickiness vastly increases the sensitivity of the model to driving forces. I develop a new model of the way that wage stickiness affects unemployment. The stickiness arises in an economic equilibrium and satisfies the condition that no worker-employer pair has an unexploited opportunity for mutual improvement. Sticky wages neither interfere with the efficient formation of employment matches nor cause inefficient job loss. Thus the model provides an answer to the fundamental criticism previously directed at sticky-wage models of fluctuations.

10.1257/0002828053828482.abstractZh: 在经济衰退之后，整体劳动力市场处于疲软状态——就业水平低于正常水平，雇主通过招聘广告和职位空缺来吸引人才的努力也相当有限。匹配摩擦模型能够解释劳动力市场对不利冲击的定性反应，但需要极其严重的冲击才能解释观察到的波动幅度。工资粘性的引入显著提高了模型对驱动因素的敏感性。我提出了一种新的模型，用以说明工资粘性如何影响失业率。工资粘性存在于经济均衡中，并满足没有工人-雇主组合存在未被利用的相互改进机会的条件。粘性的工资既不会干扰就业匹配的有效形成，也不会导致无效的工作流失。因此，该模型为之前针对粘性工资模型提出的批评提供了答案。

abstract.text: We provide an empirical assessment of the comparative advantage gains from trade argument. We use Japan’s nineteenth-century opening up to world commerce as a natural experiment to answer the following counterfactual: “By how much would real income have had to increase in Japan during its final autarky years of 1851–1853 to afford the consumption bundle the economy could have obtained if it were engaged in international trade during that period?” Using detailed historical data on trade flows, autarky prices, and Japan’s real GDP, we obtain upper bounds on the gains from trade of about 8 to 9 percent of Japan’s GDP.

10.1257/0002828053828491.abstractZh: 我们对该贸易带来的比较优势进行了实证评估。以日本19世纪向世界开放为自然实验，来探讨这样一个反事实问题：“在1851至1853年的自给自足末期，日本的实际收入需要增加多少，才能满足当时如果进行国际贸易所能获得的消费水平？”通过详细的历史数据，包括贸易流量、自给自足时期的物价以及日本的实际GDP，我们得出了贸易带来的收益约为日本GDP的8%至9%。

abstract.text: I report new evidence for localized knowledge spillovers identified by within-patent variations in the geographic matching rates of citations added by inventors and cita-tions added by examiners. Evaluated at the mean citation lag, inventor citations are 20 percent more likely than examiner citations to match the country of origin of their citing patent, while US inventor citations are 25 percent more likely to match the state or metropolitan area of their citing patent. The localization of intranational knowledge spillovers declines with the passage of time, but international borders present a persistent barrier to spillovers. (JEL O310, O340)

10.1257/0002828053828509.abstractZh: 我报告了关于局部知识溢出效应的新证据，这些证据通过专利内部引用匹配率的差异得以体现。研究发现，在平均引用滞后时间上，发明人的引用更有可能与引用专利的起源国相匹配，其概率比审查人的引用高出20%；而美国发明人的引用则更有可能与引用专利的州或大都市区相匹配，其概率高出25%。尽管国内知识溢出的局部性随时间逐渐减弱，但国际边界仍然对知识溢出构成了持续的障碍。（JEL O310, O340）

abstract.text: This paper introduces methods to compute impulse responses without specification and estimation of the underlying multivariate dynamic system. The central idea consists in estimating local projections at each period of interest rather than extrapolating into increasingly distant horizons from a given model, as it is done with vector autoregressions (VAR). The advantages of local projections are numerous: (1) they can be estimated by simple regression techniques with standard regression packages; (2) they are more robust to misspecification; (3) joint or point-wise analytic inference is simple; and (4) they easily accommodate experimentation with highly nonlinear and flexible specifications that may be impractical in a multivariate context. Therefore, these methods are a natural alternative to estimating impulse responses from VARs. Monte Carlo evidence and an application to a simple, closed-economy, new-Keynesian model clarify these numerous advantages.

10.1257/0002828053828518.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一种无需指定和估计底层多变量动态系统即可计算脉冲响应的方法。其核心思想是在每个感兴趣的时期进行局部预测，而不是像向量自回归模型那样从给定模型外推到越来越遥远的时期。局部预测方法的优势包括：(1)可以通过标准回归软件进行简单回归估计；(2)对误设的容忍度更高；(3)联合或点状分析推断较为简单；(4)能够轻松适应高度非线性和灵活性的模型设定，这在多变量背景下可能不切实际。因此，这些方法自然成为从向量自回归模型估计脉冲响应的替代方案。蒙特卡洛模拟结果以及一个简单封闭经济下的新凯恩斯模型的应用，进一步证明了这些方法的诸多优势。

abstract.text: This paper studies how to protect future generations from expropriation and to induce optimal investment in intergenerational public goods (IPGs), by introducing constitutional restrictions on the tax base. The type of tax-base restrictions that we consider places limits on the tax instruments that the government can use to raise revenue, but not on the level of expenditures or debt. We show that the introduction of a constitutional amendment requiring that IPGs and debt be financed with land taxes makes intergenerational expropriation impossible and, for many cases of interest, induces optimal investment in IPGs. We also show that a weaker constitutional amendment requiring that IPGs be financed with land taxes, but imposing no restrictions on how to finance the debt, has a positive impact on IPGs, but not on expropriation. The paper also studies the political feasibility of these reforms. We show that the first reform is not politically feasible since it hurts current generations, but the weaker reform can induce a Pareto improvement.

10.1257/0002828053828527.abstractZh: 本文研究了如何通过引入宪法对税基的限制，来保护后代免受剥夺，并促使对代际公共物品进行最优投资。我们考虑的税基限制类型，虽然对政府可用于筹集收入的税收工具有所限制，但并未对支出或债务水平产生影响。研究表明，通过宪法修正案要求用土地税来资助代际公共物品和债务，可以使得代际剥夺行为变得不可能，并且在许多情况下，还能促使对代际公共物品进行最优投资。我们还发现，一个较为宽松的宪法修正案，仅要求用土地税来资助代际公共物品，而不对债务融资方式施加限制，虽然对代际公共物品有积极影响，但并不会减少剥夺行为。本文还探讨了这些改革在政治上的可行性。研究表明，第一种改革在政治上不可行，因为它会损害当前代际的利益，而较为宽松的改革则有可能带来帕累托改进。

abstract.text: We welcome Dan Levin’s comment as a nice example of the manner in which we believe science should ideally proceed. The story begins with a real-world observation: the existence of multi-unit uniform-price auctions. It continues with a theory: Engelbrecht-Wiggans and Kahn’s (1998) theory of demand reduction in uniform-price auctions.1 Next came an experiment: List and Lucking-Reiley’s (2000) field experiment at a sportscard show, which tests the predictions of that particular theory. The experiment confirmed some of the theory’s predictions, but contradicted one prediction in particular. Now comes a new theory that proposes to explain the anomaly discovered in the experiment. Even more appealing, the theory makes new testable predictions not contained in the previous theory or experiments. We wish to highlight this important point because we feel that examples of this sort of scientific progress are all too rare in economics. We encourage other economists to follow Levin’s example in responding to anomalous empirical findings with new theories that contain new testable implications. Levin proposes an explanation for the behavior observed by List and Lucking-Reiley (2000) in two-bidder, two-unit auctions. While Engelbrecht-Wiggans and Kahn (1998,

10.1257/0002828053828536.abstractZh: 我们欢迎Dan Levin的评论，这很好地体现了我们认为科学理想发展方式的一个范例。这个故事始于一个现实世界的观察：多单位统一价格拍卖的存在。接着是一个理论：Engelbrecht-Wiggans和Kahn在1998年提出的关于统一价格拍卖中需求减少的理论。1 接下来是一个实验：List和Lucking-Reiley在2000年进行的一项实地实验，该实验旨在验证这一特定理论的预测。实验证实了一些理论的预测，但与其中一个预测相矛盾。现在，有一个新的理论试图解释实验中发现的异常现象。更令人兴奋的是，这一理论提出了新的可验证的预测，而这些预测并未包含在之前的理论或实验中。我们希望强调这一点，因为我们认为这种科学进步的例子在经济学中极为罕见。我们鼓励其他经济学家效仿Levin的做法，用包含新的可验证含义的新理论来应对异常的实证发现。Levin提出了一种解释，用于解释List和Lucking-Reiley在2000年进行的两竞标、两单位拍卖中观察到的行为。而Engelbrecht-Wiggans和Kahn在1998年的理论……

abstract.text: economics. 1 Social insurance programs have become the most important, the most expensive, and often the most controversial aspect of government domestic policy, not only in the United States but also in many other countries, including developing and industrialized nations. In the United States, these programs include Social Security retirement, disability, and survivor insurance, unemployment insurance, and Medicare insurance for those age 65 and older. Together these programs accounted for 37 percent of federal government spending and more than 7 percent of GDP in 2003. These ratios have increased rapidly in the past and are projected to increase even faster in the future because of the more rapid aging of the population. I will discuss how the major forms of social

10.1257/0002828053828545.abstractZh: 社会保障计划已成为政府国内政策中最重要的、最昂贵的，且往往最具争议的方面，这不仅在美国如此，在许多其他国家，包括发展中国家和工业化国家也是如此。在美国，这些计划包括社会保障退休金、残疾保险、遗属保险、失业保险，以及针对65岁及以上人群的医疗保险。2003年，这些计划占联邦政府支出的37%，占GDP的7%以上。由于人口老龄化的加速，这些比例在过去迅速上升，并且预计在未来会进一步增加。我将讨论社会保障的主要形式如何……

abstract.text: Relative purchasing power parity (PPP) holds for pure price inflations, which affect prices of all goods and services by the same proportion, while leaving relative prices unchanged. Pure price inflations also affect nominal returns of all traded financial assets by exactly the same amount. Recognizing that relative PPP may not hold for the official inflation data constructed from commodity price indices because of relative price changes and other frictions that cause prices to be “sticky,” we provide a novel method for extracting a proxy for realized pure price inflation from stock returns. We find strong support for relative PPP in the short run using the extracted inflation measures.

10.1257/0002828053828554.abstractZh: 相对购买力平价（PPP）适用于纯粹的价格通胀，这种通胀以相同的比例影响所有商品和服务的价格，而相对价格则保持不变。纯粹的价格通胀同样以相同的幅度影响所有交易金融资产的名义回报。由于相对价格变化以及其他导致价格“粘性”的摩擦因素，官方根据商品价格指数计算的通胀数据可能无法满足相对购买力平价的假设。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，从股票回报中提取反映实际纯粹价格通胀的指标。通过运用所提取的通胀指标，我们在短期内发现了相对购买力平价的强烈支持。

abstract.text: GDP per capita is usually used to proxy for the quality of life of individuals living in different countries. Welfare is also affected by quantity of life, however, as represented by longevity. This paper incorporates longevity into an overall assessment of the evolution of cross-country inequality and shows that it is quantitatively important. The absence of reduction in cross-country inequality up to the 1990s documented in previous work is in stark contrast to the reduction in inequality after incorporating gains in longevity. Throughout the post–World War II period, health contributed to reduce significantly welfare inequality across countries. This paper derives valuation formulas for infra-marginal changes in longevity and computes a "full" growth rate that incorporates the gains in health experienced by 96 countries for the period between 1960 and 2000. Incorporating longevity gains changes traditional results; countries starting with lower income tended to grow faster than countries starting with higher income. We estimate an average yearly growth in "full income" of 4.1 percent for the poorest 50 percent of countries in 1960, of which 1.7 percentage points are due to health, as opposed to a growth of 2.6 percent for the richest 50 percent of countries, of which only 0.4 percentage points are due to health. Additionally, we decompose changes in life expectancy into changes attributable to 13 broad groups of causes of death and three age groups. We show that mortality from infectious, respiratory, and digestive diseases, congenital, perinatal, and “ill-defined” conditions, mostly concentrated before age 20 and between ages 20 and 50, is responsible for most of the reduction in life expectancy inequality. At the same time, the recent effect of AIDS, together with reductions in mortality after age 50--due to nervous system, senses organs, heart and circulatory diseases--contributed to increase health inequality across countries.

10.1257/0002828053828563.abstractZh: 人均GDP通常被用来衡量不同国家中个体生活质量的指标。然而，福利也受到寿命长度的影响。本文将寿命长度纳入对跨国不平等演变的整体评估中，并表明其具有重要的定量意义。先前的研究记录显示，直到20世纪90年代，跨国不平等并未出现减少，而纳入寿命长度因素后，不平等程度却有所降低。在二战后的时期，健康水平的提高显著减少了国家间的福利不平等。本文推导了寿命长度微小变化的估值公式，并计算了1960年至2000年间96个国家因健康改善而获得的“全面”增长率。纳入寿命长度因素后，传统的结果发生了变化：起点收入较低的国家往往比起点收入较高的国家增长更快。我们估计，1960年时，最贫困的50%国家的“全面收入”年均增长率为4.1%，其中1.7个百分点是由于健康因素造成的，而最富有的50%国家的年均增长率为2.6%，其中只有0.4个百分点是由于健康因素造成的。此外，我们将预期寿命的变化分解为由13大类死因和三个年龄组引起的变化。研究表明，20岁之前和20至50岁之间，由传染病、呼吸系统疾病、消化系统疾病、先天性疾病以及“不明原因”疾病引起的死亡，是导致预期寿命不平等减少的主要原因。同时，艾滋病的最新影响，以及50岁以后因神经系统、感官器官、心脏和循环系统疾病导致的死亡率下降，加剧了各国之间的健康不平等。

abstract.text: This paper argues that the textbook search and matching model cannot generate the observed business-cycle-frequency fluctuations in unemployment and job vacancies in response to shocks of a plausible magnitude. In the United States, the standard deviation of the vacancy-unemployment ratio is almost 20 times as large as the standard deviation of average labor productivity, while the search model predicts that the two variables should have nearly the same volatility. A shock that changes average labor productivity primarily alters the present value of wages, generating only a small movement along a downward-sloping Beveridge curve (unemploymentvacancy locus). A shock to the separation rate generates a counterfactually positive correlation between unemployment and vacancies. In both cases, the model exhibits virtually no propagation.

10.1257/0002828053828572.abstractZh: 本文认为，教科书中的搜索与匹配模型无法解释在合理规模的冲击下，失业率与职位空缺数量出现的周期性波动。在美国，职位空缺与失业率比率的标准差几乎是平均劳动生产率标准差的20倍，而搜索模型预测这两个变量应该具有相近的波动性。改变平均劳动生产率的冲击主要改变了工资的现值，仅导致沿着向下倾斜的贝弗里奇曲线（失业与职位空缺的关系曲线）发生微小的移动。而对分离率的冲击则会导致失业率与职位空缺之间存在反向的正相关关系。在这两种情况下，该模型几乎没有任何传播效应。

abstract.text: We study time variation in expected excess bond returns. We run regressions of one-year excess returns on initial forward rates. We find that a single factor, a single tent-shaped linear combination of forward rates, predicts excess returns on one-to five-year maturity bonds with R 2 up to 0.44. The return-forecasting factor is countercyclical and forecasts stock returns. An important component of the return-forecasting factor is unrelated to the level, slope, and curvature movements described by most term structure models. We document that measurement errors do not affect our central results.

10.1257/0002828053828581.abstractZh: 我们研究了预期超额债券回报的时间变化。我们将一年超额回报与初始远期利率进行回归分析。研究发现，一个单一的因子，即远期利率的线性组合，能够预测一到五年到期债券的超额回报，其R²值高达0.44。该回报预测因子具有反周期性，并且能够预测股票回报。该预测因子的一个重要组成部分与大多数期限结构模型所描述的水平、斜率和曲率变化无关。我们的研究还表明，测量误差并未影响我们的核心结果。

abstract.text: Transport time increases with distance traveled, and time is valuable. We show the implications of these facts for global specialization and trade: products where timely delivery is important will be produced near the source of final demand, where wages will be higher as a result. In the model, timely delivery is important because it allows retailers to respond to final demand fluctuations without holding costly inventories, and timely delivery is possible only from nearby locations. Using a unique dataset that allows us to measure the retail demand for timely delivery, we show that the sources of U.S. apparel imports have shifted in the way predicted by the model, with products for which timeliness matters increasingly imported from nearby countries.

10.1257/0002828053828590.abstractZh: 运输时间随着行驶距离的增加而延长，而时间是非常宝贵的。我们探讨了这些事实对全球专业化与贸易的影响：那些需要及时交付的产品将会在最终需求源头的附近生产，因为那里的工资水平更高。在模型中，及时交付之所以重要，是因为它使得零售商能够在不持有昂贵库存的情况下应对最终需求的波动，而及时交付只能从附近的地方实现。通过使用一个独特的数据集，我们能够衡量对及时交付的零售需求，结果显示，美国服装进口的来源地已经按照模型预测的方式发生了变化，那些需要及时交付的产品越来越多地从邻近国家进口。

abstract.text: Researchers perpetually complain about long decision lags. Glenn Ellison (2002a,b) confirms that delays are being longer. He suggests an evolving social norm as a possible explanation, with more demands made on authors for their work to be published. Time delays have the additional effect, however, of limiting the flow of submissions. In the absence of time delays and other significant submission costs, the best strategy is to start at the most prestigious journal and work down until the article is accepted. Better journals are unlikely to welcome this. The major submission cost is the long and unpredictable length of time spent waiting for a decision. Ellison notes that time lags are longer for the top five economics journals, at around six to eleven months longer than the rest. Despite the increasing prestige of top journals, the number of submissions remains fairly static.

10.1257/0002828053828608.abstractZh: 研究人员经常抱怨决策过程耗时过长。Glenn Ellison（2002a,b）证实，这种延迟确实在延长。他提出，一种不断演变的社会规范可能是解释这一现象的原因，即作者需要承担更多的责任来确保自己的作品能够被发表。然而，时间延迟还会进一步限制投稿的流动。如果没有时间延迟和其他显著的投稿成本，最佳策略是从最权威的期刊开始投稿，逐步向下寻找合适的期刊，直到文章被接受。但更好的期刊不太可能接受这种策略。主要的投稿成本在于等待决策结果的漫长且不可预测的时间。Ellison指出，在排名前五的经济学期刊中，决策时间比其他期刊要长六到十一个月左右。尽管顶级期刊的声望日益提高，但投稿数量却仍然相当稳定。

abstract.text: This paper shows that a country’s wealth can be an important determinant of comparative advantage when access to credit differs across sectors of the economy. Wealthier nations exhibit a comparative advantage toward goods produced in sectors facing more severe financial imperfections. These sectors are typically populated by small firms. Empirically this paper documents that these sectors are also labor intensive. Consequently, this theory partially offsets traditional sources of comparative advantage and offers an explanation for Trefler’s missing trade mystery and the Leontief paradox. Furthermore, the theory makes the relation between trade and income distribution endogenous.

10.1257/0002828053828626.abstractZh: 本文指出，当不同经济部门获得信贷的机会存在差异时，一个国家的财富可以成为决定比较优势的重要因素。富裕国家在那些面临更严重金融缺陷的部门所生产的商品上具有比较优势。这些部门通常由小型企业构成。实证研究表明，这些部门也具有较高的劳动力投入强度。因此，这一理论部分弥补了传统比较优势理论的不足，并为Trefler的“缺失贸易之谜”和Leontief悖论提供了解释。此外，该理论还将贸易与收入分配之间的关系视为内生变量。

abstract.text: Parents with higher education levels have children with higher education levels. However, is this because parental education actually changes the outcomes of children, suggesting an important spillover of education policies, or is it merely that more able individuals who have higher education also have more able children? This paper proposes to answer this question by using a unique dataset from Norway. Using the reform of the education system that was implemented in different municipalities at different times in the 1960s as an instrument for parental education, we find little evidence of a causal relationship between parents' education and children's education, despite significant OLS relationships. We find 2SLS estimates that are consistently lower than the OLS estimates with the only statistically significant effect being a positive relationship between mother's education and son's education. These findings suggest that the high correlations between parents'and children's education are due primarily to family characteristics and inherited ability and not education spillovers.

10.1257/0002828053828635.abstractZh: 受教育程度较高的父母通常会培养出受教育程度较高的孩子。然而，这是否意味着父母的教育水平确实能够影响孩子的教育水平，从而体现出教育政策的重要溢出效应？还是仅仅因为受过高等教育的父母往往拥有更优秀的孩子？本文利用挪威的独特数据集来探讨这个问题。通过以1960年代不同城市实施的教育改革作为衡量父母教育水平的指标，我们发现父母教育水平与孩子教育水平之间几乎没有因果关系，尽管存在显著的OLS分析结果。我们的2SLS估计结果显示，父母教育水平与孩子教育水平之间的关系低于OLS估计结果，唯一具有统计学意义的效应是母亲教育水平与儿子教育水平之间的正相关关系。这些发现表明，父母与子女教育水平之间的高相关性主要源于家庭特征和遗传能力，而非教育政策的溢出效应。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes optimal monetary policy in a sticky price model with Calvo-type staggered price-setting. In the paper, the optimal monetary policy maximizes the expected utility of a representative household without having to rely on a set of linearly approximated equilibrium conditions, given the distortions associated with the staggered price-setting. It shows that the complete stabilization of the price level is optimal in the absence of initial price dispersion, while optimal inflation targets respond to changes in the level of relative price distortion in the presence of initial price dispersion.

10.1257/0002828053828653.abstractZh: 本文分析了在具有Calvo型分阶段价格设定的粘性价格模型下的最优货币政策。文中指出，最优货币政策旨在最大化代表性家庭的预期效用，而无需依赖一系列线性近似的均衡条件，因为分阶段价格设定会带来一定的扭曲。研究表明，在初始价格分布不明显的条件下，完全稳定价格水平是最优的；而在初始价格分布存在的情况下，最优通胀目标会响应相对价格扭曲程度的变化。

abstract.text: This paper studies the role of consequences in a person’s decision to lie. Based on findings from an experiment with a deception game, as well as from questionnaires, I propose a simple formulation of preferences to describe deception behavior. The decision maker uses the “truth telling ” outcome as a reference level when evaluating the benefits of lying. The monetary consequences of the lie are compared to this reference level. In the formulation used in this paper the decision maker’s utility depends on her own intentions. She is selfish in the sense of maximizing her own payoffs, but sensitive to the cost her lie imposes on the other side. Sensitivity diminishes with the size of payoffs. Moreover, since perception of the counterpart’s cost is subjective. When there are differences in wealth as in employee-employer relations or a consumer-insurer interactions, the decision maker is more likely to lie the wealthier the counterpart.

10.1257/0002828053828662.abstractZh: 本文研究了后果在个人说谎决策中的作用。基于一项欺骗游戏的实验结果以及问卷调查的结果，我提出了一种简单的偏好模型来描述欺骗行为。决策者在评估说谎的收益时，会以“说实话”的结果作为参考水平。谎言带来的金钱后果会与这一参考水平进行比较。本文所使用的偏好模型中，决策者的效用取决于其自身意图。从自私的角度来看，决策者会最大化自己的收益，但也会考虑到自己的谎言对对方造成的成本。这种敏感性随着收益大小的增加而降低。此外，由于对方的成本感知是主观的，在财富差异较大的情况下，例如员工与雇主或消费者与保险公司的关系中，决策者更有可能选择说谎，尤其是当对方更富有时。

abstract.text: In this paper we evaluate the impact of a major school reform, that took place in the 1950s in Sweden, on educational attainment and earnings. The reform, which has many common elements with reforms in other European countries including the UK, consisted of increasing compulsor schooling, imposing a national curriculum and abolishing selectionby ability into Academic and non-academic streams at the age of 12 (comprehensive school reform). Our data combines survey data with administrative sources. We find that the reform increased both the educational attainment and the earnings of children whose fathers had just complusory education. However the earnings of those with educated parents declined - possibly because of a dilution of quality at the top end of the education levels. The overall effect of the reform was however positive.
