The reform, which has many common elements with reforms in other European countries including the UK, consisted of increasing compulsor schooling, imposing a national curriculum and abolishing selectionby ability into Academic and non-academic streams at the age of 12 (comprehensive school reform). Our data combines survey data with administrative sources. We find that the reform increased both the educational attainment and the earnings of children whose fathers had just complusory education. However the earnings of those with educated parents declined - possibly because of a dilution of quality at the top end of the education levels. The overall effect of the reform was however positive.

10.1257/0002828053828671.abstractZh: 本文评估了20世纪50年代在瑞典实施的一项重大教育改革对教育成就和收入的影响。这项改革与包括英国在内的其他欧洲国家的改革有许多共同之处，包括增加义务教育年限、实施国家课程，以及取消12岁时按能力划分学术与非学术领域的选拔制度（全面教育改革）。我们的数据结合了调查数据和行政数据。研究发现，这项改革提高了那些父亲仅接受完小教育孩子的教育成就和收入。然而，那些父母受过良好教育的孩子的收入却有所下降——可能是由于教育水平较高端的质量有所降低。不过，总体而言，这项改革的影响是积极的。

abstract.text: What caused the baby boom? And can it be explained within the context of the secular decline in fertility that has occurred over the last 200 years? The hypothesis is that: (a) The secular decline in fertility is due to the relentless rise in real wages that increased the opportunity cost of having children; (b) The baby boom is explained by an atypical burst of technological progress in the household sector that occurred in the middle of the last century. This lowered the cost of having children. A model is developed in an attempt to account, quantitatively, for both the baby boom and bust.

10.1257/0002828053828680.abstractZh: 是什么导致了婴儿潮？在过去200年中生育率持续下降的背景下，这一现象能否得到解释？假设如下：(a) 生育率持续下降是由于实际工资的不断上升，这增加了生育孩子的机会成本；(b) 婴儿潮的出现可以归因于上个世纪中叶家庭领域出现了非典型的科技进步，这降低了生育孩子的成本。本文提出了一个模型，试图从数量上解释婴儿潮的出现及其终结。

abstract.text: What accounts for the worldwide advance of financial reforms in the last quarter century? Using a new index of financial liberalization, we find that influential events shook the policy status quo. Balance-of-payments crises spurred reforms, but banking crises set liberalization back. Falling global interest rates strengthened reformers, while new governments went both ways. The overall trend toward liberalization, however, reflected pressures and incentives generated by initial reforms that raised the likelihood of additional reforms, stimulated further by the need to catch up with regional reform leaders. In contrast, ideology and country structure had limited influence.

10.1257/0002828053828699.abstractZh: 过去四十年间，全球金融改革为何能够取得进展？通过一个新的金融自由化指数分析，我们发现一些具有影响力的事件动摇了政策现状。国际收支危机推动了改革，但银行危机则使自由化进程受到阻碍。全球利率的下降为改革者提供了支持，而新政府的政策走向则呈现出双向性。然而，整体向自由化的趋势反映了初始改革所引发的压力和激励，这些压力和激励进一步促进了后续改革的发生，同时由于需要赶上地区性改革领先国家的步伐，这种趋势也得到了加强。相比之下，意识形态和国家结构对金融改革的推动作用较为有限。

abstract.text: We consider a model of policy choice in which appropriate policies depend on a country's own circumstances, but the presence of a successful leader generates an informational externality and results in too little "policy experimentation." Corrupt governments are reined in while honest governments are disciplined inefficiently. Our model yields distinct predictions about the patterns of policy imitation, corruption, and economic performance as a function of a country's location vis-a-vis successful leaders. In particular, it predicts a U-shaped pattern in economic performance as we move away from the leader in the relevant space of characteristics: Close neighbors should do very well, distant countries moderately well on average with considerable variance, and intermediate countries worst of all. An empirical test with the experience of post-socialist countries provides supportive results.

10.1257/0002828053828707.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一个政策选择模型，其中合适的政策取决于一个国家自身的状况，但成功领导人的存在会产生信息外部性，导致“政策实验”不足。腐败政府受到约束，而诚实政府则难以得到有效管理。我们的模型对政策模仿、腐败和经济绩效的模式做出了预测，这些预测取决于一个国家在相关特征空间中的位置以及领导人的表现。具体而言，模型预测经济绩效呈现出U形变化：在靠近领导者的邻近国家，经济表现应该非常好；在距离较远的国家，平均表现适中但存在较大差异；而在中间国家，经济表现最差。通过对后社会主义国家经验的实证测试，得到了支持这一模型的实验结果。

abstract.text: Lack of access to finance is often cited as a key reason why poor people remain poor. This paper uses data on the Indian rural branch expansion program to provide empirial evidence on this issue. Between 1977 and 1990, the Indian Central Bank mandated that a commercial bank can open a branch in a location with one or more bank branches only if it opens four in locations with no bank branches. We show that between 1977 and 1990 this rule caused banks to open relatively more rural branches in Indian states with lower initial financial development. The reverse is true outside this period. We exploit this fact to identify the impact of opening a rural bank on poverty and output. Our estimates suggest that the Indian rural branch expansion program significantly lowered rural poverty, and increased non-agricultural output.

10.1257/0002828054201242.abstractZh: 缺乏融资渠道常被认为是贫困人群持续贫困的关键原因。本文利用印度农村分支机构扩展计划的数据，为这一问题提供了实证证据。在1977年至1990年间，印度中央银行规定，商业银行只有在没有银行分支的地方开设四个分支机构时，才允许在该地点开设分支机构。我们发现，在这段时间内，这一规则导致银行在初始金融发展较低的印度邦开设了更多的农村分支机构。而在这一时期之外，情况则相反。我们利用这一事实来研究开设农村银行对贫困和产出的影响。我们的估计表明，印度农村分支机构扩展计划显著降低了农村贫困率，并增加了非农业产出。

abstract.text: This paper shows that price rigidity evolves in an economy populated by imperfectly rational agents who experiment with alternative rules of thumb. In the model, firms must set their prices in face of aggregate demand shocks. Their payoff depends on the level of aggregate demand, as well as on their own price and their “neighbor's” price. The latter assumption captures local interactions. Despite the fact that the rational expectations equilibrium (REE) is characterized by a simple pricing rule that firms can easily adopt, the economy does not converge to the REE for all parameter values. When the volatility of monetary innovations is low and interactions among firms are high, the aggregate price level exhibits rigidity, in that it does not fully react to contemporaneous aggregate demand shocks. We discuss the role of the nature of experimentation, and of path dependence driven by interactions, in explaining these results.

10.1257/0002828054201251.abstractZh: 本文指出，在由不完美理性代理人构成的经济体中，价格刚性会发生变化，这些代理人会尝试不同的定价规则。在模型中，企业必须在总需求冲击面前设定价格。企业的收益取决于总需求水平，以及他们自己的价格和“邻近企业”的价格。后一个假设反映了局部互动的影响。尽管理性预期均衡具有简单的定价规则，企业可以轻松采用这种规则，但经济并不会在所有参数值下都收敛到理性预期均衡。当货币创新的波动性较低且企业之间的互动较强时，整体价格水平会表现出刚性，即不会完全对同时发生的总需求冲击作出反应。我们讨论了实验性质以及由互动驱动的路径依赖性在解释这些结果中的作用。

abstract.text: We provide a formal analysis of the notion that conglomerates are more ‘entrenched’ as they have ‘deeper pockets’. Using the financial contracting model of Bolton and Scharfstein (1990), we can isolate two effects that confirm this conjecture: the pooling of cash flows, which allows to smooth out repayments, and the ability to obtain better credit terms. For less profitable business segments, the internal capital market operated in a conglomerate may, however, work in the opposite direction, increasing the sensitivity of operations to own cash flows and increasing the likelihood of exit.

10.1257/0002828054201260.abstractZh: 我们对“企业集团因拥有更深的资金储备而更加稳固”这一观点进行了正式分析。利用Bolton和Scharfstein（1990）提出的金融契约模型，我们发现了两个支持这一假设的现象：现金流的集中管理有助于平滑还款，同时还能获得更优惠的信贷条件。然而，对于利润较低的业务板块，企业集团内部的资本市场可能会产生相反的效果，即增加业务对自有现金流的依赖性，并增加退出业务的可能性。

abstract.text: We model an international union as a group of countries deciding to centralize the provision of public goods, or policies, that generate externalities across union members. The trade-off between the benefits of coordination and the loss of independent policymaking endogenously determines size, composition, and scope of the union. Policy uniformity reduces the size of the union, may block the entry of new members, and induces excessive centralization. We study flexible rules with nonuniform policies that reduce these inefficiencies, focusing particularly on arrangements that are relevant to the ongoing debate on the institutional structure of the European Union.

10.1257/0002828054201279.abstractZh: 我们将国际联盟建模为一组国家，这些国家决定集中提供产生外部性的公共物品或政策，这些外部性会惠及联盟成员。协调带来的好处与独立政策制定能力的丧失之间的权衡，内生地决定了联盟的规模、组成和范围。政策的一致性会缩小联盟的规模，可能会阻碍新成员的加入，并导致过度集中。我们研究了具有非均匀政策的灵活规则，这些规则能够减少这些低效现象，特别关注那些与当前关于欧盟制度结构讨论相关的安排。

abstract.text: Heterogeneous time preference has a profound impact on the wealth distribution and therefore on equilibrium asset prices. I identify two distinct effects on interest rates: an averaging effect due to Jensen’s inequality and a general equilibrium consumption timing effect. The averaging effect decreases and the timing effect increases real interest rates, and both effects induce an inverse term structure. More fundamentally, the model shows that asset prices need to be interpreted with caution. Evidence apparently pointing to non-standard preferences may simply be the result of heterogeneity. (JEL: D91, E43, G12.)

10.1257/0002828054201288.abstractZh: 异质的时间偏好对财富分配产生深远影响，进而影响均衡资产价格。我发现了两种对利率的不同影响：一种是由于詹森不等式导致的平均效应，另一种则是一般均衡消费时机效应。平均效应会降低实际利率，而时机效应则会提高实际利率，这两种效应共同导致了逆周期的期限结构。更根本地说，该模型表明需要谨慎解读资产价格。那些看似表明非标准偏好的证据，可能仅仅是异质性的结果而已。（JEL: D91, E43, G12.）

abstract.text: In a model of career concerns for experts, when is a principal hurt from observing more information about her agent? This paper introduces a distinction between information on the consequence of the agent's action and information directly on the agent's action. When the latter kind of information is available, the agent faces an incentive to disregard useful private signals and act according to how an able agent is expected to act a priori. This conformist behavior hurts the principal in two ways: the decision made by the agent is less likely to be the right one (discipline) and ex post it is more difficult to evaluate the agent's ability (sorting). The paper identifies a necessary and sufficient condition on the agent signal structure under which the principal bene.ts from committing not to observe the agent's action. The paper also shows the existence of strategic complementarities between information on action and information on consequence. The results on the distinction between action and consequence are then used to interpret existing disclosure policies in delegated portfolio management. In particular, they are consistent with hitherto puzzling evidence that mutual funds systematically overperform pension funds.

10.1257/0002828054201297.abstractZh: 在专家职业决策模型中，当委托人观察到关于其代理人的更多信息时，何时会受到伤害？本文区分了关于代理人行为后果的信息与直接关于代理人行为的信息。当后者信息可用时，代理人会倾向于忽略有用的私人信号，而按照预期中优秀代理人的行为方式行事。这种从众行为以两种方式损害委托人的利益：代理人做出的决策不太可能是正确的（纪律性问题），并且事后评估代理人的能力变得更加困难（排序问题）。本文确定了代理人信号结构的一个必要且充分条件，使得委托人从不观察代理人的行为中获益。此外，本文还揭示了关于行为后果的信息与关于行为本身的信息之间的战略互补性。随后，基于关于行为后果与行为本身的信息之间的区别，本文对现有委托投资管理的披露政策进行了解释。具体而言，这些发现与目前令人困惑的证据一致，即共同基金系统性地优于养老基金的表现。

abstract.text: The rise of Western Europe after 1500 is due largely to growth in countries with access to the Atlantic Ocean and with substantial trade with the New World, Africa, and Asia via the Atlantic. This trade and the associated colonialism affected Europe not only directly, but also indirectly by inducing institutional change. Where “initial” political institutions (those established before 1500) placed significant checks on the monarchy, the growth of Atlantic trade strengthened merchant groups by constraining the power of the monarchy, and helped merchants obtain changes in institutions to protect property rights. These changes were central to subsequent economic growth.

10.1257/0002828054201305.abstractZh: 1500年后西欧的崛起，主要得益于那些能够进入大西洋并通过与新世界、非洲和亚洲的贸易而获得显著发展的国家。这种贸易以及相关的殖民活动不仅直接影响了欧洲，还通过引发制度变革间接对其产生了影响。在“最初”的政治制度下，君主权力受到严格的制约；而大西洋贸易的发展则增强了商人群体的力量，限制了君主的权力，并帮助商人获得了保护财产权的制度变革。这些变革是随后经济增长的核心因素。

abstract.text: Competition among countries—or regions within them—to attract mobile capital is often thought to discipline their governments, motivating them to invest more in infrastructure, reduce waste and corruption, and spend less on non-productive public goods. The result should be convergence on business-friendly policies. We argue that this requires an assumption—units start out very similar—that is often unrealistic. If units are heterogeneous (in natural resources, geographical location, inherited human capital or infrastructure), capital mobility often weakens discipline on the poorly-endowed units. This may help explain disappointing results of liberalizing capital flows

10.1257/0002828054201314.abstractZh: 国家之间或国家内部的不同地区之间为了吸引流动资本而进行的竞争，通常被认为能够促使政府更加重视基础设施投资、减少浪费和腐败，并减少在非生产性公共产品上的支出。这样的竞争应该会促使各方采取有利于商业发展的政策。然而，我们认为这一假设往往是不现实的——各经济体在初始阶段往往存在很大的差异。如果各经济体在自然资源、地理位置、继承的人力资本或基础设施等方面存在差异，那么资本流动往往会削弱那些资源匮乏的地区的政策执行力度。这或许可以解释为什么资本流动自由化所带来的结果并不理想。

abstract.text: We study good-by-good deviations from the Law-of-One-Price (LOP) for over 1,800 retail goods and services between all European Union (EU) countries for the years 1975, 1980, 1985, and 1990. We find that for each of these years, after we control for differences in income and value-added tax (VAT) rates, there are roughly as many overpriced goods as there are underpriced goods between any two EU countries. We also find that good-by-good measures of cross-sectional price dispersion are negatively related to the tradeability of the good, and positively related to the share of non-traded inputs required to produce the good. We argue that these observations are consistent with a model in which retail goods are produced by combining a traded input with a non-traded input.

10.1257/0002828054201332.abstractZh: 我们研究了1975年、1980年、1985年和1990年间，所有欧盟国家之间超过1,800种零售商品和服务偏离单一价格法则的情况。研究发现，在控制收入差异和增值税税率后，这些年份中，任意两个欧盟国家之间，高价商品的数量大致与低价商品的数量相当。我们还发现，横向价格分散度的度量与商品的贸易性呈负相关，与生产该商品所需的非贸易性投入的比例呈正相关。我们认为，这些观察结果与一种模型相符，即零售商品是通过将贸易性投入与非贸易性投入结合来生产的。

abstract.text: We show that extrinsic or nonfundamental uncertainty influences markets in a controlled environment. This work provides the first direct evidence of sunspot equilibria. These equilibria require a common understanding of the semantics of the sunspot variable, and they appear to be sensitive to the flow of information. Sunspots always occur in a closed-book call market, but they happen only occasionally in a double auction, where inframarginal bids and offers are observable.

10.1257/0002828054201350.abstractZh: 我们表明，在受控环境中，外部或非基本的不确定性会影响市场。这项工作首次直接证明了太阳黑子均衡的存在。这些均衡需要人们对太阳黑子变量的语义有共同的理解，并且它们似乎对信息流动非常敏感。太阳黑子总是出现在一种闭门会议式的市场中，但在双拍卖中，只有偶尔会出现太阳黑子，此时可以观察到次边际的出价和报价。

abstract.text: To study how a firm can capitalize on a long-term customer relationship, we characterize the optimal contract between a monopolist and a consumer whose preferences follow a Markov process. The optimal contract is nonstationary and has infinite memory, but is described by a simple state variable. Under general conditions, supply converges to the efficient level for any degree of persistence of the types and along any history, though convergence is history-dependent. In contrast, as with constant types, the optimal contract can be renegotiation-proof, even with highly persistent types. These properties provide insights into the optimal ownership structure of the production technology.

10.1257/0002828054201369.abstractZh: 为了研究企业如何利用长期客户关系，我们描述了垄断者与消费者的最优契约关系，其中消费者的偏好遵循马尔可夫过程。最优契约是非平稳的，并具有无限记忆性，但可以用一个简单的状态变量来描述。在一般条件下，无论类型持续性的程度如何，以及无论历史如何，供给都会收敛到有效水平，不过收敛过程取决于历史背景。相比之下，在类型持续性的情况下，即使存在高度持续性的类型，最优契约仍然可以免于重新谈判。这些特性为我们理解生产技术的最优所有权结构提供了启示。

abstract.text: We conduct experiments to explore the possibility that subject misconceptions, as opposed to a particular theory of preferences referred to as the “endowment effect,” account for reported gaps between willingness to pay (“WTP”) and willingness to accept (“WTA”). The literature reveals two important facts. First, there is no consensus regarding the nature or robustness of WTP-WTA gaps. Second, while experimenters are careful to control for subject misconceptions, there is no consensus about the fundamental properties of misconceptions or how to avoid them. Instead, by implementing different types of experimental controls, experimenters have revealed notions of how misconceptions arise. Experimenters have applied these controls separately or in different combinations. Such controls include ensuring subject anonymity, using incentive-compatible elicitation mechanisms, and providing subjects with practice and training on the elicitation mechanism before employing it to measure valuations. The pattern of results reported in the literature suggests that the widely differing reports of WTP-WTA gaps could be due to an incomplete science regarding subject misconceptions. We implement a “revealed theory” methodology to compensate for the lack of a theory of misconceptions. Theories implicit in experimental procedures found in the literature are at the heart of our experimental design. Thus, our approach to addressing subject misconceptions reflects an attempt to control simultaneously for all dimensions of concern over possible subject misconceptions found in the literature. To this end, our procedures modify the Becker-DeGroot-Marschak mechanism used in previous studies to elicit values. In addition, our procedures supplement commonly used procedures by providing extensive training on the elicitation mechanism before subjects provide WTP and WTA responses. Experiments were conducted using both lotteries and mugs, goods frequently used in endowment effect experiments. Using the modified procedures, we observe no gap between WTA and WTP. Therefore, our results call into question the interpretation of observed gaps as evidence of loss aversion or prospect theory. Further evidence is required before convincing interpretations of observed gaps can be advanced.

10.1257/0002828054201387.abstractZh: 我们开展实验，以探讨主体误解的可能性，而非所谓的“禀赋效应”对支付意愿与接受意愿之间差距的影响。相关文献揭示了两个重要事实：首先，对于支付意愿与接受意愿之间差距的本质或稳定性，目前尚无共识；其次，尽管实验者努力控制主体误解的影响，但对于误解的基本特性以及如何避免误解，也缺乏一致性的认识。通过实施不同类型的实验控制，实验者揭示了误解产生的机制。实验者分别或组合使用这些控制手段，包括确保主体匿名性、使用激励相容的评估机制，以及在评估机制使用前为受试者提供相关练习和培训。文献中报告的结果表明，关于支付意愿与接受意愿之间差距的不同报道，可能是由于对主体误解的研究还不够深入。我们采用了“揭示性理论”的方法论，以弥补缺乏关于误解理论的问题。文献中实验程序中隐含的理论正是我们实验设计的核心。因此，我们处理主体误解的方法，实际上是在尝试同时控制文献中提及的所有与主体误解相关的因素。为此，我们的程序对之前研究中使用的Becker-DeGroot-Marschak机制进行了修改，以更准确地评估价值。此外，我们的程序通过提供关于引出机制的广泛培训，补充了常用程序，从而在受试者提供支付意愿和接受意愿反应之前进行了训练。实验使用了常用于禀赋效应实验的抽奖和马克杯这两种物品。采用修改后的程序后，我们观察到支付意愿和接受意愿之间没有差距。因此，我们的结果对将观察到的差距解释为损失厌恶或前景理论的证据提出了质疑。在能够提出令人信服的解释之前，还需要更多的证据。

abstract.text: Large economies export more in absolute terms than do small economies. We use data on shipments by 126 exporting countries to 59 importing countries in 5,000 product categories to answer the question: How? Do big economies export larger quantities of each good (the intensive margin), a wider set of goods (the extensive margin), or higher-quality goods? We find that the extensive margin accounts for around 60 percent of the greater exports of larger economies. Within categories, richer countries export higher quantities at modestly higher prices. We compare these findings to some workhorse trade models. Models with Armington national product differentiation have no extensive margin, and incorrectly predict lower prices for the exports of larger economies. Models with Krugman firm-level product differentiation do feature a prominent extensive margin, but overpredict the rate at which variety responds to exporter size. Models with quality differentiation, meanwhile, can match the price facts. Finally, models with fixed costs of exporting to a given market might explain the tendency of larger economies to export a given product to more countries.

10.1257/0002828054201396.abstractZh: 大型经济体在绝对数量上的出口量通常大于小型经济体。我们通过分析126个出口国向59个进口国出口的5,000种产品类别的数据，来探讨这一现象背后的原因：大型经济体为何能够出口更多的商品？是每种商品的出口量更大（即密集型边际）、商品种类更多（即广延性边际），还是出口商品的质量更高？研究发现，广延性边际在大型经济体更大的出口量中占比约为60%。在具体的产品类别中，富裕国家的出口量更大，但价格也略高一些。我们将这些发现与一些主流贸易模型进行了比较。具有阿明顿国家产品差异性的模型没有广延性边际，并且错误地预测了大型经济体出口商品的价格会更低。具有克鲁格曼企业级产品差异性的模型则表现出显著的广延性边际，但高估了产品多样性对出口企业规模的反应程度。而具有质量差异性的模型则能够解释价格现象。最后，针对特定市场的出口固定成本模型或许可以解释为什么大型经济体会向更多国家出口某种产品。

abstract.text: A unifying theme in the literature on organizations such as public bureaucracies and private nonprofits is the importance of mission, as opposed to profit, as an organizational goal. Such mission-oriented organizations are frequently staffed by motivated agents who subscribe to the mission. This paper studies incentives in such contexts and emphasizes the role of matching the mission preferences of principals and agents in increasing organizational efficiency. Matching economizes on the need for high-powered incentives. It can also, however, entrench bureaucratic conservatism and resistance to innovations. The framework developed in this paper is applied to school competition, incentives in the public sector and in private nonprofits, and the interdependence of incentives and productivity between the private for-profit sector and the mission-oriented sector through occupational choice.

10.1257/0002828054201413.abstractZh: 在关于公共官僚机构与私人非营利组织等组织的文献中，一个统一的主题是使命的重要性，而非利润作为组织的目标。这类以使命为导向的组织通常由具有积极性的成员组成，这些成员认同组织的使命。本文研究了此类情境下的激励机制，并强调了匹配管理者与成员对使命的偏好对于提高组织效率的作用。匹配机制可以节省高强度的激励成本，但也可能加剧官僚主义的保守性以及对新创新的抵制。本文提出的框架被应用于学校竞争、公共部门及私人非营利组织的激励问题，以及私人营利部门与使命导向部门之间激励与生产力之间的相互依赖关系。

abstract.text: We integrate a widely accepted version of the separation of ownership and control—Michael Jensen's (1986) free cash flow theory—into a dynamic equilibrium model, and study the effect of imperfect corporate control on asset prices and investment. Aggregate free cash flow of the corporate sector is an important state variable in explaining asset prices, investment, and the cyclical behavior of interest rates and the yield curve. The financial friction causes cash-flow shocks to affect investment, and causes otherwise i.i.d. shocks to be transmitted from period to period. The shocks propagate through large firms and during booms.

10.1257/0002828054201422.abstractZh: 我们将一种被广泛接受的产权与控制分离理论——迈克尔·詹森（1986年）的自由现金流理论——纳入一个动态均衡模型中，研究不完美企业控制对资产价格和投资的影响。企业部门的综合自由现金流是解释资产价格、投资以及利率和收益率曲线周期性行为的重要状态变量。金融摩擦会导致现金流冲击影响投资，并使原本独立同分布的冲击在时期之间传递。这些冲击在大型企业中传播，并在经济繁荣时期尤为明显。

abstract.text: We compare individuals with two-person teams in signaling game experiments. Teams consistently play more strategically than individuals and generate positive synergies in more difficult games, beating a demanding “truth-wins” norm. The superior performance of teams is most striking following changes in payoffs that change the equilibrium outcome. Individuals play less strategically following the change in payoffs than inexperienced subjects playing the same game. In contrast, the teams exhibit positive learning transfer, playing more strategically following the change than inexperienced subjects. Dialogues between teammates are used to identify factors promoting strategic play.

10.1257/0002828054201431.abstractZh: 我们在信号博弈实验中比较了个体与两人团队的表现。团队在博弈中始终表现出更强的策略性，并在更困难的游戏中产生积极的协同效应，超越了要求严格的“真相获胜”准则。当收益发生变化导致均衡结果改变时，团队的卓越表现尤为显著。与未参与相同游戏的受试者相比，个体在收益变化后策略性表现下降。相比之下，团队在收益变化后表现出积极的学习迁移能力，其策略性表现优于未参与相同游戏的受试者。通过团队间的对话，我们试图找出促进策略性博弈的因素。

abstract.text: Holt and Laury (2002) used a menu of ordered lottery choices to make inferences about risk aversion under various payment conditions. The main results of that paper were: 1) subjects are risk averse, even for relatively small payments of less than $5, 2) risk aversion increases sharply with large increases in the scale of cash payoffs, and 3) there is no significant effect from increasing the scale of hypothetical payment. With a few exceptions noted in the paper, all treatments began with a low-payment choice, followed by a choice with hypothetical payments that had been scaled up (by 20x, 50x, or 90x), followed by a real-cash decision with the same high payment scale (20x 50x, or 90x), followed by a single final low (1x) real payment choice. Those in the 90x treatment could earn amounts ranging from $9.00 to $346.50 in this task. As Harrison et al. (2004) correctly note this design confounds order and treatment effects since the high real payment choice was always completed after the low real and high hypothetical payment tasks. In a new experiment reported below, we first seek to replicate Harrison et al.’s finding that the order effect (participating in a low-payment choice before making a highpayment choice) magnifies the scale effect. In a second treatment, each subject completes the menu of lottery choices under just one payment condition (1x or 20x, real or hypothetical), thereby eliminating any order effects. I. New Data The new experiment was conducted in 2004 using 216 subjects recruited from undergraduate economics classes at the University of Virginia. 1 As in our previous

10.1257/0002828054201459.abstractZh: Holt和Laury在2002年使用了一系列有序的彩票选择来推断在不同支付条件下的风险厌恶程度。该论文的主要结果包括：1) 即使对于小于5美元的较小支付，受试者也表现出风险厌恶；2) 现金回报规模的大幅增加会显著增强风险厌恶；3) 增加假设支付规模并没有显著效果。除了文中提到的少数例外情况，所有实验都从低支付选择开始，随后进行假设支付规模扩大（20倍、50倍或90倍）的选择，最后以相同的高支付规模（20倍、50倍或90倍）做出实际现金决策，最后以1倍的实际支付选择作为结束。在90倍规模的处理中，受试者可以在这个任务中赚取9.00美元到346.50美元不等的金额。正如Harrison等人（2004年）所指出的，这种设计混淆了顺序效应和处理效应，因为高实际支付选择总是在低实际支付和假设支付任务之后完成的。在下面报告的新实验中，我们首先试图复制Harrison等人的发现，即顺序效应（在做出高支付选择之前先完成低支付选择）会放大规模效应。在第二种处理中，每个受试者只在一个支付条件下完成一系列彩票选择（1倍或20倍，实际或假设），从而消除了任何顺序效应。I. 新数据该新实验于2004年进行，使用了来自弗吉尼亚大学经济学本科课程的216名受试者。1 与我们之前的实验一样。

abstract.text: The increasing incidence of ethnic conflicts, and the much-publicized consequences of these conflicts, have attracted the interest of many researchers in the social sciences. Many studies have addressed directly the issue of ethnic di-versity and its effects on social conflicts and civil wars. Political scientists have stressed the importance of institutions in the attenuation or intensification of social conflict in ethnically divided societies. Recently economists have connected ethnic diversity with important eco-nomic phenomena like investment, growth, or the quality of government (William Easterly and

10.1257/0002828054201468.abstractZh: 种族冲突的日益频繁，以及这些冲突所引发的广泛影响，吸引了众多社会科学研究者的兴趣。许多研究直接探讨了种族多样性问题及其对社会冲突和内战的影响。政治学家强调了制度在缓解或加剧种族分裂社会中的社会冲突方面的重要性。最近，经济学家将种族多样性与诸如投资、经济增长或政府质量等重要经济现象联系起来（威廉·伊斯特利和）

abstract.text: I develop and estimate a monetary business cycle model with nominal loans and collateral constraints tied to housing values. Demand shocks move housing and nominal prices in the same direction, and are amplified and propagated over time. The financial accelerator is not uniform: nominal debt dampens supply shocks, stabilizing the economy under interest rate control. Structural estimation supports two key model features: collateral effects dramatically improve the response of aggregate demand to housing price shocks; and nominal debt improves the sluggish response of output to inflation surprises. Finally, policy evaluation considers the role of house prices and debt indexation in affecting monetary policy trade-offs.

10.1257/0002828054201477.abstractZh: 我开发并估计了一个货币商业周期模型，该模型考虑了名义贷款和与住房价值相关的抵押品约束。需求冲击会使住房价格和名义价格朝同一方向变动，并且这种影响会随着时间的推移而放大和传播。金融加速器并非均匀：名义债务能够抑制供应冲击，从而在利率控制下稳定经济。结构估计支持了该模型的两个关键特征：抵押品效应显著提升了总需求对住房价格冲击的响应；而名义债务则改善了产出对通胀意外情况的迟缓反应。最后，政策评估考虑了房价和债务指数化在影响货币政策权衡中的作用。

abstract.text: This paper develops a model where reductions in mortality are the main force behind economic development. The model generates a pattern of changes similar to the demographic transition, where gains in life expectancy at birth are followed by reductions in fertility and increases in the rate of human capital accumulation. The onset of the transition is characterized by a critical level of life expectancy at birth, which marks the movement of the economy from a Malthusian equilibrium to an equilibrium with investments in human capital and the possibility of long-run growth.

10.1257/0002828054201486.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个模型，其中死亡率的降低是经济发展的主要驱动力。该模型呈现出一种与人口转变相似的变化模式：出生时预期寿命的增加伴随着生育率的下降以及人力资本积累率的上升。这一转变的起始点以出生时预期寿命的临界水平为标志，这标志着经济从马尔萨斯均衡转向以人力资本投资为基础的均衡状态，并有可能实现长期增长。

abstract.text: Farley W. Grubb's recent papers on the early U.S. monetary system would be important contributions to the common currency area literature were not most of their historical assertions questionable and their key assumption—that the medium of exchange can be inferred from the unit of account—dubious. We contend that after 1781 most Americans eschewed government paper money in favor of fullbodied coins and convertible bank liabilities and that, contrary to Grubb's claim, bankers did not foist the constitutional clause banning state emissions onto an unsuspecting public.

10.1257/0002828054201495.abstractZh: Farley W. Grubb关于美国早期货币体系的近期论文，如果其历史论断不具争议性，且关键假设——即交换媒介可以从记账单位中推断出来——也不存在疑问，那么它们将对共同货币体系的相关文献做出重要贡献。我们认为，1781年之后，大多数美国人更倾向于使用实体硬币和可兑换的银行负债，而非政府发行的纸币。与Grubb的主张相反，银行家们并没有将宪法中禁止州发行货币的规定强加给毫无戒心的公众。

abstract.text: We develop a model of matching with contracts which incorporates, as special cases, the college admissions problem, the Kelso-Crawford labor market matching model, and ascending package auctions. We introduce a new “law of aggregate demand” for the case of discrete heterogeneous workers and show that, when workers are substitutes, this law is satisfied by profit-maximizing firms. When workers are substitutes and the law is satisfied, truthful reporting is a dominant strategy for workers in a worker-offering auction/matching algorithm. We also parameterize a large class of preferences satisfying the two conditions.

10.1257/0002828054825466.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个包含合同匹配模型的框架，该模型将大学录取问题、Kelso-Crawford劳动力市场匹配模型以及升序打包拍卖作为特例纳入其中。我们为离散异质工人的情况引入了一个新的“总需求法则”，并证明当工人是替代品时，这一法则会被追求利润最大化的企业所满足。当工人是替代品且这一法则得到满足时，在工人提供拍卖/匹配算法中，诚实报告成为工人的主导策略。我们还对满足这两个条件的大量偏好类型进行了参数化处理。

abstract.text: We study security-bid auctions in which bidders compete for an asset by bidding with securities whose payments are contingent on the asset's realized value. In formal security-bid auctions, the seller restricts the security design to an ordered set and uses a standard auction format (e.g., first- or second-price). In informal settings, bidders offer arbitrary securities and the seller chooses the most attractive bid, based on his beliefs, ex post. We characterize equilibrium and show that steeper securities yield higher revenues, that auction formats can be ranked based on the security design, and that informal auctions lead to the lowest possible revenues.

10.1257/0002828054825475.abstractZh: 我们研究了安全 Bid 拍卖，在这种拍卖中，竞拍者通过竞标具有取决于资产实际价值的证券来争夺资产。在正式的安全 Bid 拍卖中，卖方将证券设计限制在一个有序集合中，并使用标准的拍卖格式（例如，第一价格或第二价格拍卖）。在非正式环境中，竞拍者提供任意的证券，卖方根据他的判断，事后选择最具吸引力的竞标。我们描述了均衡状态，并表明更陡峭的证券会带来更高的收入，拍卖格式可以根据证券设计进行排序，而非正式拍卖则会导致最低可能的收入。

abstract.text: Two issues dominate the school choice de-bate: whether competition would make schools more productive, and whether choice would re-sult in sorting or stratification. In trying to an-swer these questions, economists have generally focused on the consequences of voucher sys-tems, yet inter-district or Tiebout choice is, and is likely to remain, the main form of school choice in the United States. Surprisingly, we know comparatively little about its effects. This paper focuses on whether inter-district choice leads to sorting, an issue on which there is no consensus. In recent work, for instance, Charles T. Clotfelter (1999) argues that district availability does influence chil-

10.1257/0002828054825484.abstractZh: 学校选择讨论中有两个主要问题：竞争是否会提高学校的效率，以及选择制度是否会导致学校之间的排序或分层。在试图回答这些问题时，经济学家通常关注 vouchers 制度的后果，然而，跨学区选择或 Tiebout 选择制度仍然是美国学校选择的主要形式，并且很可能会持续如此。令人惊讶的是，我们对这种选择制度的影响知之甚少。本文重点探讨跨学区选择是否会导致学校之间的排序问题，而这一问题目前尚未达成一致意见。例如，Charles T. Clotfelter 在 1999 年的研究中指出，学区 availability 确实会影响儿童的选择。

abstract.text: Forward-looking agents care about expected future utility flows, and hence have higher current felicity if they are optimistic. This paper studies utility-based biases in beliefs by supposing that beliefs maximize average felicity, optimally balancing this benefit of optimism against the costs of worse decision making. A small optimistic bias in beliefs typically leads to first-order gains in anticipatory utility and only second-order costs in realized outcomes. In a portfolio choice example, investors overestimate their return and exhibit a preference for skewness; in general equilibrium, investors' prior beliefs are endogenously heterogeneous. In a consumption-saving example, consumers are both overconfident and overoptimistic.

10.1257/0002828054825493.abstractZh: 具有前瞻性意识的个体更关注预期的未来效用流，因此如果他们持乐观态度，当前的幸福感会更高。本文通过假设信念能够最大化平均幸福感，来研究基于效用的信念偏差现象，从而在乐观主义的收益与较差决策成本的权衡之间找到最优平衡。在信念中表现出轻微的乐观偏差通常会导致预期效用的第一阶收益，而在实际结果中只会产生第二阶成本。在一个投资组合选择的例子中，投资者高估了自己的收益，并表现出对偏态的偏好；在一般均衡条件下，投资者的先验信念是内生地异质的。在消费-储蓄的例子中，消费者既过于自信，又过于乐观。

abstract.text: Studies of innovation have focused on the effects of patent laws on the number of innovations, but have ignored effects on the direction of technological change. This paper introduces a new dataset of close to fifteen thousand innovations at the Crystal Palace World's Fair in 1851 and at the Centennial Exhibition in 1876 to examine the effects of patent laws on the direction of innovation. The paper tests the following argument: if innovative activity is motivated by expected profits, and if the effectiveness of patent protection varies across industries, then innovation in countries without patent laws should focus on industries where alternative mechanisms to protect intellectual property are effective. Analyses of exhibition data for 12 countries in 1851 and 10 countries in 1876 indicate that inventors in countries without patent laws focused on a small set of industries where patents were less important, while innovation in countries with patent laws appears to be much more diversified. These findings suggest that patents help to determine the direction of technical change and that the adoption of patent laws in countries without such laws may alter existing patterns of comparative advantage across countries.

10.1257/0002828054825501.abstractZh: 关于创新的研究主要集中在专利法对创新数量的影响上，而忽略了其对技术变革方向的影响。本文引入了一个新的数据集，包含大约一万五千项在1851年水晶宫世界博览会和1876年百年博览会上发生的创新，以研究专利法对创新方向的影响。本文提出以下论点：如果创新活动是由预期利润驱动的，且专利保护的有效性因行业而异，那么没有专利法的国家应该将创新重点放在那些替代机制能够有效保护知识产权的行业。对1851年12个国家和1876年10个国家的展览数据进行分析后发现，没有专利法的国家的发明家主要专注于一些专利重要性较低的行业，而拥有专利法的国家的创新则显得更加多样化。这些发现表明，专利有助于确定技术变革的方向，而在没有专利法的国家，采用专利法可能会改变各国之间的比较优势模式。

abstract.text: This paper develops an analytical framework for assessing the second-best optimal level of gasoline taxation taking into account unpriced pollution, congestion, and accident externalities, and interactions with the broader fiscal system. We provide calculations of the optimal taxes for the US and the UK under a wide variety of parameter scenarios, with the gasoline tax substituting for a distorting tax on labor income. Under our central parameter values, the second-best optimal gasoline tax is $1.01/gal for the US and $1.34/gal for the UK. These values are moderately sensitive to alternative parameter assumptions. The congestion externality is the largest component in both nations, and the higher optimal tax for the UK is due mainly to a higher assumed value for marginal congestion cost. Revenue-raising needs, incorporated in a "Ramsey" component, also play a significant role, as do accident externalities and local air pollution. The current gasoline tax in the UK ($2.80/gal) is more than twice this estimated optimal level. Potential welfare gains from reducing it are estimated at nearly one-fourth the production cost of gasoline used in the UK. Even larger gains in the UK can be achieved by switching to a tax on vehicle miles with equal revenue yield. For the US, the welfare gains from optimizing the gasoline tax are smaller, but those from switching to an optimal tax on vehicle miles are very large.

10.1257/0002828054825510.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个分析框架，用于评估在考虑未定价污染、交通拥堵、事故外部性以及与更广泛财政体系相互作用的情况下，第二优的汽油税收水平。我们针对美国和英国的各种参数情景进行了税收计算，其中汽油税替代了对劳动收入的扭曲性税收。在核心参数取值下，美国第二优的汽油税为每加仑1.01美元，英国为每加仑1.34美元。这些数值对不同的参数假设有中等程度的敏感性。在两国中，交通拥堵外部性是最大的影响因素，而英国较高的最优税收主要是由于假设中的边际拥堵成本较高所致。纳入“Ramsey”组件的税收增加需求也起着重要作用，事故外部性和局部空气污染同样重要。目前英国的车用汽油税为每加仑2.80美元，是估计最优水平的两倍多。减少汽油税可能带来的福利增益约为英国汽油生产成本的四分之一。在英国，通过转向对车辆行驶里程征税可以获得更大的福利增益，其税收收益相当。对于美国而言，优化汽油税带来的福利增益较小，但转向对车辆行驶里程征税则能带来巨大的福利增益。

abstract.text: Many programs reward or penalize schools based on students' average performance. Mean reversion is a potentially serious hindrance to the evaluation of such interventions. Chile's 900 Schools Program (P-900) allocated resources based on cutoffs in schools' mean test scores. This paper shows that transitory noise in average scores and mean reversion lead conventional estimation approaches to overstate the impacts of such programs. It further shows how a regressiondiscontinuity design can be used to control for reversion biases. It concludes that P-900 had significant effects on test score gains, albeit much smaller than is widely believed

10.1257/0002828054825529.abstractZh: 许多项目根据学生的平均表现来奖励或惩罚学校。均值回归可能会严重阻碍此类干预措施的评估。智利的900学校计划（P-900）根据学校的平均测试成绩来分配资源。本文表明，平均成绩的短暂波动以及均值回归会导致传统的估计方法高估此类项目的效果。此外，本文还展示了如何使用回归不连续设计来控制回归偏差。最后得出结论，P-900对测试成绩的提升产生了显著影响，尽管其影响程度远小于人们的普遍认知。

abstract.text: Organizations often distribute resources through weighted voting. We analyze this setting using a noncooperative bargaining game based on the Baron-Ferejohn (1989) model. Unlike analyses derived from cooperative game theory, we find that each voter's expected payoff is proportional to her voting weight. An exception occurs when many high-weight voters exist, as low-weight voters may expect disproportionately high payoffs due to proposal power. The model also predicts that, ex post, the coalition formateur (the party chosen to form a coalition) will receive a disproportionately high payoff. Using data from coalition governments from 1946 to 2001, we find strong evidence of such formateur effects.

10.1257/0002828054825538.abstractZh: 组织通常通过加权投票来分配资源。我们基于Baron-Ferejohn（1989年）模型，使用非合作讨价还价博弈来分析这一情境。与从合作博弈理论得出的分析结果不同，我们发现每个选民的预期收益与其投票权重成正比。当存在许多权重较高的选民时，低权重选民可能会因提案权而获得不成比例的较高收益。该模型还预测，从事后来看，组建联盟的政党将获得不成比例的较高收益。通过1946年至2001年联盟政府的数据分析，我们发现了这种“组建者效应”的强烈证据。

abstract.text: We develop a model of race discrimination in labor markets in which offered wage rates are posted along with job openings. If an employer with a job vacancy and a posted wage receives a pool of applicants, she chooses the most qualified and, if the best applicants are equally qualified, she is free to make an arbitrary, or perhaps a discriminatory, choice. We develop a game in which firms post wages, workers choose where to apply, and firms decide which workers to hire. The key result is that labor-market frictions can greatly amplify perceived racial disparities, so that mild discriminatory tastes or small productivity differences can produce large wage differentials between the races. Compared with the nondiscriminatory equilibrium, the discriminatory equilibrium features lower net output, lower wages for both white and black workers and greater profits for firms. We argue that this result generalizes to a number of different cases, including some in which blacks and whites are equally productive on average. Although based entirely on individualistic maximizing behavior without collusion or cooperation, the model has a flavor that is reminiscent of certain Economic theory suggests that wage discrimination against groups of workers is unlikely to persist in a competitive economy, because in the presence of such discrimination profits can be had

10.1257/0002828054825547.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个关于劳动力市场种族歧视的模型，其中雇主会公布提供的工资水平以及职位空缺信息。如果一家有职位空缺且公布了工资标准的雇主收到一批求职者，她会选择最合格的求职者；如果最优秀的求职者资质相当，她则有权做出任意或带有歧视性的选择。我们构建了一个博弈模型，其中企业公布工资水平，工人选择申请哪个职位，企业则决定雇佣哪些工人。关键结论是，劳动力市场中的摩擦会大大加剧种族差异的感知，因此轻微的歧视性偏好或微小的生产率差异就能导致种族间的工资差距显著扩大。与非歧视均衡相比，歧视均衡会导致总产出降低，白人和黑人工人的工资都下降，而企业的利润则增加。我们认为这一结论可以推广到多种情况，包括黑人和白人在平均生产率上相当的情况。尽管该模型完全基于个体主义最大化行为，没有勾结或合作，但其特点让人联想到某些经济理论的观点，即在一个竞争性的经济环境中，对特定群体的工资歧视不太可能持续存在，因为在这种歧视下，企业仍然可以获得利润。

abstract.text: This paper uses the consumption Euler equation to derive a decomposition of consumption growth into four sources. These four sources are new information, and three sources of predictable consumption growth: intertemporal substitution, changes in the preferences for consumption, and incomplete markets for consumption insurance. Using household-level data, we implement this decomposition for the average growth rate of consumption expenditures on nondurable goods in the United States from 1982 to 1997. The economic importance of precautionary saving rivals that of the real interest rate, but the relative importance of each source of movement in the volatility of consumption is not precisely measured.

10.1257/0002828054825556.abstractZh: 本文运用消费欧拉方程，将消费增长分解为四个来源。这四个来源分别是新信息、可预测的三种消费增长因素：跨期替代、消费偏好变化以及消费保险市场的不完善性。通过家庭层面的数据，我们对1982年至1997年间美国非耐用品消费支出的平均增长率进行了分析。预防性储蓄的经济重要性与实际利率相当，但各来源在消费波动中的相对重要性尚未得到精确衡量。

abstract.text: Using a new international dataset of trade-weighed exchange rates, this paper highlights a neglected adjustment mechanism in the classical gold standard literature. Since gold-pegged countries traded extensively with economies operating more flexible monetary regimes and where parity change was a common adjustment device to systemic shocks, we show that such parity adjustments induced worldwide swings in nominal effective exchange rates. These translated into real exchange rate variations to which trade balances responded with an average elasticity of unity and in the direction of restoring external disequilibria. We conclude that some nominal exchange rate flexibility thus present in the pre-1914 system was instrumental to international payments adjustment.

10.1257/0002828054825565.abstractZh: 本文利用一个新的国际贸易加权汇率数据集，重点探讨了经典金本位文献中一个被忽视的调整机制。由于金本位国家与实行更灵活货币制度的经济体进行广泛贸易，而平价调整是应对系统性冲击的常见手段，我们发现这种平价调整引发了全球名义有效汇率的波动。这些波动转化为实际汇率的变化，贸易收支对此的反应平均弹性为1，且方向是恢复外部失衡状态。我们得出结论，1914年之前体系中存在的某些名义汇率灵活性对国际支付调整起到了重要作用。

abstract.text: We analyze the colonial land revenue institutions set up by the British in India, and show that differences in historical property rights institutions lead to sustained differences in economic outcomes. Areas in which proprietary rights in land were historically given to landlords have significantly lower agricultural investments and productivity in the post-independence period than areas in which these rights were given to the cultivators. These areas also have significantly lower investments in health and education. These differences are not driven by omitted variables or endogeneity problems; they probably arise because differences in historical institutions lead to very different policy choices.

10.1257/0002828054825574.abstractZh: 我们分析了英国在印度建立的殖民土地税收制度，发现历史上的财产权利制度差异导致了经济结果的持续差异。在那些历史上土地所有权属于地主的地区，独立后的农业投资和生产力明显低于那些所有权属于耕作者的地区。这些地区的卫生和教育投资也明显较低。这些差异并非由遗漏变量或内生性问题所驱动；它们可能是由于历史制度差异导致政策选择截然不同的结果。

Each player i has a favorite policy xi. The outcome of an action profile a is a compromise m(a) among the favorite policies of the players j for whom aj is "participate. One of our main results (Proposition 2) is that if the function v is concave and symmetric, then there are functions z and E (which we define

10.1257/0002828054825592.abstractZh: 2000年的一项研究探讨了这样一种战略博弈：其中，一组玩家各自选择是否参与决策过程以制定政策，这一过程被建模为Re中的一个点。每个玩家i都有一个偏好的政策xi。一个行动方案a的结果，实际上是参与决策的玩家j的偏好政策之间的妥协m(a)。如果玩家i参与决策，她的收益为v(xi-m(a))-c；如果不参与，收益为v(xi-m(a))。其中，v(ad)对于a>0来说是递减的。如果v(z)仅依赖于|IzjI，我们称v为对称的，并且用v(llzll)来表示其值。我们的主要结果之一（命题2）是：如果函数v是凹且对称的，那么存在函数z和E（我们对其进行定义）。

abstract.text: I present a model in which the incomplete nature of contracts governing international transactions limits the extent to which the production process can be fragmented across borders. Because of contractual frictions, goods are initially manufactured in the same country where product development takes place. Only when the good becomes sufficiently standardized is the manufacturing stage of production shifted to a low-wage foreign location. Solving for the optimal organizational structure, I develop a new version of the product cycle hypothesis in which manufacturing is shifted abroad first within firm boundaries, and only at a later stage to independent foreign firms.

10.1257/0002828054825600.abstractZh: 我提出了一个模型，其中制约国际交易合同的非完整性限制了生产过程在跨国界进行分割的程度。由于合同上的摩擦，商品最初是在产品开发所在的国家进行制造的。只有当商品达到足够的标准化程度时，制造阶段才会转移到低工资的外国地区。通过求解最优组织结构问题，我提出了产品周期假设的新版本，即制造首先在企业内部转移到国外，只有在后期才会转移到独立的外国企业。

abstract.text: We investigate the market for news under two assumptions: that readers hold beliefs which they like to see confirmed, and that newspapers can slant stories toward these beliefs. We show that, on the topics where readers share common beliefs, one should not expect accuracy even from competitive media: competition results in lower prices, but common slanting toward reader biases. On topics where reader beliefs diverge (such as politically divisive issues), however, newspapers segment the market and slant toward extreme positions. Yet in the aggregate, a reader with access to all news sources could get an unbiased perspective. Generally speaking, reader heterogeneity is more important for accuracy in media than competition per se.

10.1257/0002828054825619.abstractZh: 我们基于两个假设来研究新闻市场：读者持有他们希望得到证实的信念，而报纸可以将新闻偏向这些信念。我们发现，在读者持有共同信念的主题上，即使从竞争性的媒体中也无法期待准确性：竞争导致价格下降，但报纸普遍偏向读者的偏见。然而，在读者信念存在分歧的主题上（如政治分歧问题），报纸会分割市场并偏向极端立场。不过，总体而言，能够获取所有新闻来源的读者可以获得无偏见的视角。总的来说，读者之间的异质性对于媒体的准确性而言，比单纯的竞争更为重要。

abstract.text: In a recent paper Osborne, Rosenthal and Turner (2000) investigate a model of meetings with costly participation. Their main result is that the equilibrium number of participants is small and their positions are extreme. In particular, when the policy space is one-dimensional and the policy outcome is the median of participants' positions, they conclude that the number of attendees is even. The proof is flawed. We construct an example with an odd number of attendees. Oddness of the number of participants has a dramatic consequence on how equilibria look like.

10.1257/0002828054825628.abstractZh: 在最近的一篇论文中，Osborne、Rosenthal和Turner（2000）研究了一个具有高昂参与成本的会议模型。他们的主要结论是，参与者的均衡数量很少，且他们的位置非常极端。特别是当政策空间是一维的，且政策结果为参与者位置的中位数时，他们得出结论，参与者的数量甚至是偶数。然而，这一结论存在缺陷。我们构造了一个参与者数量为奇数的例子，结果表明，参与者数量的奇偶性对均衡状态有着显著的影响。

abstract.text: We propose an evolutionary explanation for the pattern of intertemporal preference reversals often ascribed to "hyperbolic discounting." We take the view that preferences—manifested, for example, in urges, cravings, and inclinations— are the outcome of evolutionary forces, and so will induce animals or humans to make survival-maximizing choices in "typical" decision problems. We show that if the typical problem involves payoffs whose realization times are uncertain, then optimal preferences give rise to relatively patient behavior when the time horizon is long but induce a switch to impatience when the horizon grows short. Such reversals do not entail dynamic inconsistency in typical decision problems; behavior there is optimal. However, if a decision-maker is confronted with a choice for which the realization-time uncertainty falls outside the evolutionary norm, her preferences may well prompt her to behave inconsistently. We argue that, if such a choice problem recurs, her evolutionarily endowed aability to learn will lead her to make self-commitments against these urges.

10.1257/0002828054825637.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种进化解释，用于说明那些常被归因于“ hyperbolic discounting”的跨时偏好逆转现象。我们认为，偏好——例如表现为冲动、渴望和倾向——是进化力量的结果，因此会促使动物或人类在“典型”决策问题中做出最大化生存选择的行为。我们指出，如果典型问题中的收益实现时间不确定，那么最优偏好会促使行为者在时间跨度较长时表现出耐心，而当时间跨度变短时，则会引发急躁行为。这种逆转并不导致典型决策问题中的动态不一致性；在这种情况下，行为是最优的。然而，如果决策者面临一个实现时间不确定性超出进化常态的选择，其偏好可能会促使其行为出现不一致性。我们认为，如果这样的选择问题反复出现，其进化赋予的学习能力将促使他们克服这些冲动，做出自我承诺。

abstract.text: We analyze the political determinants of investor and employment protection. Our model predicts that proportional electoral systems are conducive to weaker investor protection and stronger employment protection than majoritarian systems. This prediction is consistent with international panel data evidence. The proportionality of the voting system is significantly and negatively correlated with shareholder protection in a panel of 45 countries, and positively correlated with employment protection in a panel of 21 OECD countries. Other political variables also affect regulatory outcomes, especially for the labor market. The origin of the legal system has some additional explanatory power only for employment protection.

10.1257/0002828054825646.abstractZh: 我们分析了投资者保护和就业保护的政治决定因素。我们的模型预测，与多数制选举制度相比，比例制选举制度更有利于保护投资者和促进就业。这一预测与国际面板数据的结果一致。在45个国家的面板数据中，投票制度的比例性与股东保护呈显著负相关，而与就业保护呈正相关。其他政治变量也会影响监管结果，尤其是对劳动力市场的影響。法律体系的起源对就业保护还有一定的额外解释力。

abstract.text: Different beliefs about the fairness of social competition and what determines income inequality influence the redistributive policy chosen in a society. But the composition of income in equilibrium depends on tax policies. We show how the interaction between social beliefs and welfare policies may lead to multiple equilibria or multiple steady states. If a society believes that individual effort determines income, and that all have a right to enjoy the fruits of their effort, it will choose low redistribution and low taxes. In equilibrium, effort will be high and the role of luck will be limited, in which case market outcomes will be relatively fair and social beliefs will be self-fulfilled. If, instead, a society believes that luck, birth, connections, and/or corruption determine wealth, it will levy high taxes, thus distorting allocations and making these beliefs self-sustained as well. These insights may help explain the cross-country variation in perceptions about income inequality and choices of redistributive policies.

10.1257/0002828054825655.abstractZh: 关于社会竞争公平性的不同信念以及决定收入不平等的因素，会影响一个社会所选择的再分配政策。但收入在均衡状态下的构成取决于税收政策。我们展示了社会信念与福利政策之间的相互作用如何可能导致多种均衡或多种稳定状态。如果一个社会认为个人努力决定了收入，并且所有人都有权享受自己的努力成果，那么这个社会会选择低水平的再分配和低税收。在均衡状态下，努力程度会很高，运气的作用会被限制，此时市场结果将相对公平，社会信念也会得到实现。相反，如果一个社会认为财富是由运气、出身、人际关系和/或腐败因素决定的，那么这个社会会征收高税收，从而扭曲分配结果，使得这些信念也得以维持。这些见解可能有助于解释各国在收入不平等认知和再分配政策选择上的差异。

abstract.text: We provide a model showing that the use of confidential settlement as a strategy for a firm facing tort litigation leads to lower average safety of products sold than would occur if the firm were committed to openness. A rational risk-neutral consumer's response in a market, wherein a firm engages in confidential settlements, may be to reduce demand. A firm committed to openness incurs higher liability and R&D costs, though product demand is not diminished. We identify conditions such that, if the cost of credible auditing (to verify openness) is low enough, a firm prefers to eschew confidentiality.

10.1257/0002828054825673.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，表明对于面临侵权诉讼的企业而言，采用保密和解策略会导致销售产品的平均安全性低于企业坚持公开透明时的水平。在采用保密和解策略的市场中，理性风险中性消费者的反应可能是减少需求。而坚持公开透明的企业则会承担更高的责任和研发成本，尽管产品需求并未减少。我们确定了某些条件，即如果可信审计（用于验证公开透明性）的成本足够低，企业更倾向于放弃保密策略。

abstract.text: We show that individuals with identical preferences and abilities can self-organize into communities with starkly different civic environments. Specifically, we consider a multi-community city where community quality depends upon residents' efforts to prevent crime, improve local governance, etc. Homeownership raises incentives for such civic efforts, but is beyond the reach of the poor. Within-community externalities lead to segregated cities: the rich reside in healthy homeowner communities, while the poor live in dysfunctional renter communities. Tenure segregation in the United States accords well with our prediction. We study alternative tax-subsidy policies to expand homeownership and to promote integration of homeowners and renters.

10.1257/0002828054825682.abstractZh: 我们表明，具有相同偏好和能力的个体可以自组织成具有截然不同公民环境的社区。具体来说，我们考虑一个多社区城市，其中社区质量取决于居民预防犯罪、改善地方治理等行为的努力。拥有住房可以提高公民的积极性，但这对于穷人来说是不可及的。社区内部的外部性导致城市出现分化：富人居住在环境良好的住房社区，而穷人则生活在功能失调的租赁社区。美国的住房持有者隔离现象与我们的预测相符。我们研究了其他税收补贴政策，以扩大住房持有者数量，并促进房主和租户之间的融合。

abstract.text: We examine the misallocation of credit in Japan associated with the perverse incentives faced by banks to provide additional credit to the weakest firms. Firms are more likely to receive additional bank credit if they are in poor financial condition, because troubled Japanese banks have an incentive to allocate credit to severely impaired borrowers in order to avoid the realization of losses on their own balance sheets. This “evergreening” behavior is more prevalent among banks that have reported capital ratios close to the required minimum, and is compounded by the incentives arising from extensive corporate affiliations.

10.1257/0002828054825691.abstractZh: 我们研究了日本信贷分配不当的问题，这源于银行在面对逆向激励时倾向于向最弱小的企业提供额外信贷。如果企业财务状况不佳，它们更有可能获得额外的银行贷款，因为陷入困境的日本银行有动机将信贷分配给严重受损的借款人，以避免自身资产负债表出现亏损。这种“持续提供信贷”的行为在那些资本比率接近最低要求的银行中更为普遍，并且由于广泛的企业关联关系而产生的激励作用，使得这种现象更加严重。

Bergstrom, 2001 p. 183).Increased concentration provides one possible explanation for why prices of for-profit journals are so high.To take one example, measured by revenue, in 2001 Elsevier Science had a 22.9percent share of the Science, Technology, and Medicine (STM) industry, with Kluwer at 11.7 percent, and Thomson at 10.7 percent. 1 But concentration offers at best only a partial answer.Bundling offers another, potentially more significant explanation, particularly for recent increases.The prices of for-profit journals could not be high and increasing without significant structural barriers to entry.Recently, however, a new

10.1257/000282805774669565.abstractZh: 过去二十年里，学术期刊的出版方式发生了迅速的变化。价格、所有权集中度、期刊数量以及发行方式都发生了显著的变化。价格的大幅上涨已成为常态。在此期间，平均价格上升了数倍，其中营利性期刊的价格上涨幅度最大，现在是非营利性期刊的500%左右（Gail Yokote, 2003）。营利性与非营利性学术期刊之间的价格差异尤为明显，尽管这两类期刊在格式和编辑流程上通常相似，而且营利性期刊似乎并不具有更高的质量（Theodore C. Bergstrom, 2001, 第183页）。价格的高昂可能有一个解释，即期刊的集中度较高。例如，根据收入来衡量，2001年Elsevier Science在科学、技术和医学领域的市场份额达到了22.9%，Kluwer为11.7%，Thomson为10.7%。但集中度最多只能提供部分解释。捆绑销售可能是一个更重要的解释，尤其是在最近价格上升的情况下。营利性期刊的价格不可能如此之高，并且持续上涨，除非存在重大的进入壁垒。然而，最近出现了新的情况……

abstract.text: The increasing availability of high-frequency asset return data has had a fundamental impact on empirical financial economics, focusing attention on asset return volatility and correlation dynamics, with key applications in portfolio and risk management. So-called "realized" volatilities and correlations have featured prominently in the recent literature, and numerous studies have provided direct characterizations of the unconditional and conditional distributions of realized volatilities and correlations across different assets, asset classes, countries, and sample periods. For overviews see Andersen et al. (2005a, b). In this paper we selectively survey, unify and extend that literature. Rather than focusing exclusively on characterization of the properties of realized volatility, we progress by examining economically interesting functions of realized volatility, namely, realized betas for equity portfolios, relating them both to their underlying realized variance and covariance parts and to underlying macroeconomic fundamentals.

10.1257/000282805774669574.abstractZh: 高频资产回报数据的日益丰富对实证金融经济学产生了深远影响，使得人们开始关注资产回报的波动性和相关性动态，这一研究在投资组合和风险管理领域得到了广泛应用。所谓的“实现性”波动性和相关性在近期文献中占据了重要地位，许多研究直接描述了不同资产、资产类别、国家和样本期间实现性波动性和相关性的无条件分布和条件分布。有关综述，请参阅Andersen等人（2005a，b）。在本文中，我们选择性地回顾、统一并扩展了这些研究。我们不仅关注实现性波动性的特性描述，还进一步探讨了实现性波动性的经济意义函数，即股票投资组合的实现性贝塔值，并将其与基础实现性方差和协方差部分以及基础宏观经济基本面联系起来。

abstract.text: This paper uses an estimated demand system that accounts for heterogeneity to calculate and compare the lost consumer surplus from a higher tax on gasoline, a tax on distance, or a subsidy for buying a newer car. We introduce a view of cost-effectiveness that compares policies instead of technologies. Each tax might induce some consumers to drive less, some to switch from two vehicles to one, and some to buy a car instead of an SUV. Our model captures these behaviors. For each rate of tax, we simulate the changes in all such choices and how the new choices affect emissions. We also calculate the equivalent variation and subtract tax revenue to get deadweight loss. Finally, we take the added deadweight loss over the additional abatement as the social marginal cost of abatement, and we plot this curve for several different tax policies.

10.1257/000282805774669583.abstractZh: 本文采用一种考虑异质性的估计需求系统来计算并比较对汽油征收更高税、对距离征税或提供购买更新汽车补贴所带来的消费者剩余损失。我们提出了一种成本效益评估方法，该方法比较的是政策而非技术。每种税收可能会促使一些消费者减少驾驶，一些消费者从拥有两辆车改为拥有一辆车，还有一些消费者选择购买汽车而非SUV。我们的模型能够捕捉到这些行为变化。对于每一种税率，我们模拟了所有这些选择的变化以及新选择对排放的影响。我们还计算了等效变化量，并减去税收收入以得到无谓损失。最后，我们将额外的无谓损失与额外的减排量相比，作为减排的社会边际成本，并绘制了几种不同税收政策的这一曲线。

abstract.text: U.S. research universities are increasingly populated by postdoctoral fellows. Two dimensions of the postdoctoral training have led to this increase. One is the increasing number of new Ph.D. s taking a first postdoc position, and the other involves a lengthening of the duration of an individual’s postdoc experience. In this paper, we examine factors contributing to both of these trends. We find that the increased propensity to take a postdoctoral position can be attributed to the increased proportion of Ph.D.s being awarded in the life sciences and the increased proportion of temporary and permanent residents in the graduate population. The increased propensity to take a postdoc position also relates to adverse job market conditions experienced by Ph.D. s during the period. Our postdoc duration results suggest that increased duration can be explained in part by the increasing proportion of Ph.D. s awarded to temporary residents and the increased number of degrees being awarded in the life sciences. Adverse job market conditions also appear to play a role. We also find the duration of the postdoc experience to be positively related to the provision of fringe benefits. We would like to thank Grant Black of the Andrew Young School for his assistance. We also thank Science Resources Statistics, National Science Foundation for providing U.S. access to the Survey of Doctorate Recipients and the Survey of Earned Doctorates. We have benefited from the comments of Robert Clark, Richard Freeman, Bill Amis, Michael Rothchild and participants at the November 2004 NBER Education meeting. Stephan would like to acknowledge the financial support provided by the TIAA-CREF Institute for this project and from the Andrew W. Mellon Foundation for support of work with the Survey of Earned Doctorates.

10.1257/000282805774669619.abstractZh: 美国的科研大学中，博士后研究员的数量正在不断增加。这一趋势的出现源于两个因素：一是越来越多的博士毕业生选择从事博士后研究，二是博士后经历的持续时间有所延长。本文探讨了导致这两种趋势的因素。我们发现，博士毕业生选择从事博士后工作的倾向增加，可能与生命科学领域授予博士学位的比例增加有关，也与研究生群体中临时和正式居民的比例增加有关。博士毕业生在求职市场面临的不利条件也影响了他们选择从事博士后工作的倾向。我们的博士后经历持续时间研究结果表明，博士后经历的延长部分可以归因于授予博士学位的临时居民比例增加，以及生命科学领域授予学位的数量增加。不利的市场条件似乎也起到了一定作用。我们还发现，博士后经历的持续时间与提供额外福利之间存在正相关关系。我们感谢Andrew Young学院的Grant Black提供的帮助，同时也感谢国家科学基金会提供的美国版《博士毕业生调查》和《 earned博士学位调查》数据。我们的研究还得到了Robert Clark、Richard Freeman、Bill Amis、Michael Rothchild以及2004年11月NBER教育会议参与者的意见反馈。Stephan感谢TIAA-CREF研究所和Andrew W. Mellon基金会为该项目提供的资金支持，同时也感谢他们在《 earned博士学位调查》方面的支持。

abstract.text: After the publication of “School Choice: A Mechanism Design Approach” by Abdulkadiroglu and Sonmez (2003), a Boston Globe reporter contacted us about the Boston Public Schools (BPS) system for assigning students to schools. The Globe article highlighted the difficulties that Boston’s system may give parents in strategizing about applying to schools. Briefly, Boston tries to give students their firstchoice school. But a student who fails to get her first choice may find her later choices filled by students who chose them first. So there is a risk in ranking a school first if there is a chance of not being admitted; other schools that would have been possible had they been listed first may also be filled. Valerie Edwards, then Strategic Planning Manager at BPS, and her colleague Carleton Jones invited us to a meeting in October 2003. BPS agreed to a study of their assignment system and provided us with micro-level data sets on choices and characteristics of students in the grades at which school choices are made (K, 1, 6, and 9), and school characteristics. Based on the pending results of this study, the Superintendent has asked for our advice on the design of a new assignment mechanism. This paper describes some of the difficulties with the current mechanism and some elements of the design and evaluation of possible replacement mechanisms. School choice in Boston has been partly shaped by desegregation. In 1974, Judge W. Arthur Garrity ordered busing for racial balance. In 1987, the U.S. Court of Appeals freed BPS to adopt a new, choice-based assignment plan. In 1999 BPS eliminated racial preferences in assignment and adopted the current mechanism.

10.1257/000282805774669637.abstractZh: 在Abdulkadiroglu和Sonmez于2003年发表《学校选择：一种机制设计方法》之后，一位《波士顿环球报》的记者联系了我们，询问关于波士顿公立学校系统对学生分配学校的情况。该报道强调了波士顿的系统可能会给家长在申请学校时带来困难。简而言之，波士顿试图为学生分配首选学校。但是，如果学生未能获得首选学校，他们后续的学校选择可能会由那些先选择这些学校的学生占据。因此，如果某个学校存在未被录取的风险，将其列为首选是有风险的；而那些如果先被列出可能会被选择的学校也可能被这些学生占据。当时担任波士顿公立学校战略规划经理的Valerie Edwards和她的同事Carleton Jones在2003年10月邀请我们参加了一次会议。波士顿公立学校同意对我们的分配系统进行研究，并提供了关于学生选择年级及其特征的数据集，以及学校的相关信息。根据这项研究的初步结果，校长要求我们就新的分配机制设计提供建议。本文描述了当前机制的一些不足之处，以及可能替代机制的设计和评估要素。波士顿的学校选择在一定程度上受到了种族融合的影响。1974年，W. Arthur Garrity法官下令实施校车接送以平衡种族比例。1987年，美国上诉法院允许波士顿公立学校采用新的基于选择的分配计划。1999年，波士顿公立学校取消了种族偏好，并采用了当前的分配机制。

abstract.text: and Ethan Cohen-Cole provided helpful comments on an earlier draft. Racial Profiling: Efficiency, Equity, and Ambiguity This paper considers racial profiling in traffic stops as a public policy problem. Efficiency and equity considerations are characterized. I argue that while there is a strong argument that racial profiling produces a violation of fairness, specifically in the treatment of innocent black motorists, the efficiency effects of profiling are not known. One cannot assign probabilities to the possible magnitudes of either deterrent effects or the harms of profiling to individuals. This makes the assessment of profiling an example of decisionmaking under ambiguity. I defend a notion of a “Fairness Presumption ” that requires a policymaker to be able to make an affirmative case if a policy is to be implemented that induces unfairness. On this basis, I reject racial profiling as a policy.

10.1257/000282805774669646.abstractZh: Ethan Cohen-Cole对早期草稿提出了有益的评论。这篇论文将交通拦截中的种族定性视为一个公共政策问题。文章探讨了效率和公平方面的考量。我认为，虽然有充分的理由认为种族定性会导致不公正，尤其是在对待无辜的黑人司机时，但定性所带来的效率影响尚不明确。我们无法为定性可能带来的威慑效果或危害对个人进行概率分配。因此，对定性的评估属于在不确定性下进行决策的例子。我提出了“公平假设”的概念，要求政策制定者能够提出肯定的理由，以实施可能导致不公正的政策。基于这一基础，我拒绝将种族定性作为一种政策。

abstract.text: In the mid-1990s, a pickup in measured productivity growth for the semiconductor industry coincided with an economy-wide acceleration in labor productivity growth. The pickup in semiconductor markets reflected an increase in the growth of real output that was generated by what Dale Jorgenson (2001) called an “inflection point” in the price indexes for the semiconductor industry. Jorgenson hypothesized that the inflection point reflected increases in the rate of product innovation made possible by an increase in Moore’s Law, a stylized description of technology that currently states that the number of electrical components on a chip will double every eighteen months. Within semiconductors, microprocessors (MPUs) produced by Intel—the world’s largest producer of the chips that serve as a computer’s central processing unit—were the primary contributor to the inflection point in the semiconductor index. The inflection point in the price index coincided with two changes in the price contours for Intel’s chips. First, price contours for Intel’s chips became steeper around 1995. Because most price index formulae boil down to functions of weighted averages of price change, steeper price contours translate directly into more rapidly declining price indexes. At the same time, the product lifecycle for MPUs—the length of time chips are sold in the market—shortened and Intel began to introduce chips more frequently. What caused these changes in pricing and product cycles? This paper provides a simple framework to help gain some intuition on these issues. The model provides a set of conditions under which an increase in Moore’s Law is consistent with both of these stylized facts. In the model, an increase in Moore’s Law raises the quality of future chips relative to today’s chips. If consumers view these chips as substitutes, then increases in the quality of tomorrow’s chips push down the prices for today’s chips and can, under certain conditions, generate an inflection point in the price index. However, the framework also suggests that changes in the attributes of contemporaneous substitutes can have the same effects. Thus, the model suggests that increases in the quality of competitor’s chips can generate an inflection point through the same channel. This is an important possibility to consider because Intel faced increasing competition from AMD beginning in the mid-1990s, about when the inflection point occurred.

10.1257/000282805774669655.abstractZh: 在20世纪90年代中期，半导体行业的生产率增长有所加快，与此同时，整个经济领域的劳动生产率也出现了加速增长。半导体市场的增长反映了实际产出的增加，这一增长是由Dale Jorgenson在2001年提出的半导体行业价格指数“拐点”所推动的。Jorgenson假设，这一拐点是由于摩尔定律的加速而使得产品创新速度加快所导致的。摩尔定律是一种对技术的描述，它指出芯片上的电子元件数量每18个月就会翻一番。在半导体领域，由英特尔生产的微处理器是半导体指数拐点的主要贡献者。价格指数的拐点与英特尔芯片价格曲线的两个变化相吻合。首先，大约在1995年左右，英特尔芯片的价格曲线变得更加陡峭。由于大多数价格指数公式都是价格变化加权平均的函数，因此更陡峭的价格曲线直接意味着价格指数下降得更快。同时，微处理器的产品生命周期缩短，英特尔开始更频繁地推出新芯片。是什么导致了这些价格和产品周期的变化呢？本文提供了一个简单的框架，以帮助理解这些问题。该模型提供了一组条件，在这些条件下，摩尔定律的加速与这两个特征是一致的。在模型中，摩尔定律的加速提高了未来芯片相对于当前芯片的质量。如果消费者将这些芯片视为替代品，那么未来芯片质量的提升会压低当前芯片的价格，并在某些条件下导致价格指数出现拐点。然而，该模型也表明，同时存在的替代品的属性变化也可能产生相同的效果。因此，该模型表明，竞争对手芯片质量的提升也可以通过同样的途径导致价格指数的拐点。这是一个值得考虑的重要可能性，因为英特尔从20世纪90年代中期开始面临来自AMD的日益激烈的竞争，而价格指数的拐点也恰好出现在那个时期。

abstract.text: High nominal gas prices, new awareness of threats to national security, and growing concern about global warming have reignited discussion of ways to reduce gasoline consumption in the United States. Debate centers on changing two policies already in place: the federal gas tax and Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE) standards. Two influential recent reports find that increasing the gas tax would attain a given reduction in gas consumption at lower cost than would tightening CAFE standards (National Research Council, 2002; Congressional Budget Office, 2003). The gas tax has this advantage because it encourages not just increases in fuel efficiency, but also reductions in miles driven. In contrast, CAFE standards actually encourage more driving, because increases in fuel efficiency reduce the cost of gas per mile driven. We also compare the costs of the gas tax and CAFE standard but take into account interactions with preexisting tax distortions. Many papers examine the effects of these tax interactions in other contexts, but to our knowledge none of them considers the CAFE standard (see e.g., Lars Bovenberg and Ruud de Mooij, 1994; Ian Parry, 1995; Lawrence Goulder, 1995; Bovenberg and Goulder, 1996; Parry et al., 1999; Don Fullerton and Gilbert Metcalf, 2001). These interactions reduce the cost of the gas tax but increase the cost of CAFE, thus expanding the cost advantage enjoyed by the gas tax. This difference does not arise because the gas tax raises revenue, while the CAFE standard does not. Rather, this result is similar to that in West and Williams (2004a), which showed that, since gasoline and leisure are relative complements, raising the gas tax will increase labor supply, generating additional efficiency gains. In this paper, we estimate a consumer demand system using data from the Consumer Expenditure Survey and the California Air Resources Board and find that miles driven and leisure are relative complements. Thus, the gas tax encourages labor supply by raising the cost per mile driven, producing an additional efficiency gain. Conversely, because CAFE reduces the cost per mile, it discourages labor supply and yields an additional efficiency loss. While the induced changes in labor supply are tiny relative to the labor market, they are still substantial relative to the gas market and thus have a dramatic effect on the relative costs of the two policies. Our point estimates imply that they reduce the social marginal cost of the gas tax (starting from the status quo gas tax rate and ignoring the benefits of reduced gas consumption) by almost 30 percent, while increasing the marginal cost of CAFE by nearly 60 percent. This result implies that the case for raising the gas tax rather than tightening the CAFE standard is far stronger than previous studies suggest. Indeed, it strongly suggests that any tightening at all of the CAFE standard would lower welfare unless the benefits of reduced gas consumption have been seriously underestimated.

10.1257/000282805774669673.abstractZh: 高额的天然气价格、对国家安全的威胁有了新的认识，以及对全球变暖的日益关注，重新引发了关于减少美国汽油消费方式的讨论。争论的焦点在于改变两项已经实施的政策：联邦汽油税和企业平均燃油经济性标准。两项有影响力的近期报告发现，提高汽油税可以在较低的成本下实现相同的汽油消费减少效果，而加强CAFE标准则不然（国家研究委员会，2002年；国会预算办公室，2003年）。汽油税的优势在于它不仅促进了燃油效率的提高，还减少了驾驶里程。相比之下，CAFE标准实际上鼓励了更多的驾驶行为，因为燃油效率的提高降低了每英里驾驶的汽油成本。我们还比较了汽油税和CAFE标准的成本，并考虑了与现有税收扭曲之间的相互作用。许多论文研究了这些税收相互作用在其他情境下的影响，但据我们所知，没有一篇论文考虑过CAFE标准的影响（例如，Lars Bovenberg和Ruud de Mooij，1994年；Ian Parry，1995年；Lawrence Goulder，1995年；Bovenberg和Goulder，1996年；Parry等人，1999年；Don Fullerton和Gilbert Metcalf，2001年）。这些相互作用降低了汽油税的成本，但增加了CAFE标准的成本，从而扩大了汽油税所享有的成本优势。这种差异并非因为汽油税增加了收入，而CAFE标准则不会。这一结果类似于West和Williams（2004a）的研究，他们指出，由于汽油和休闲活动是相对互补的，提高汽油税将增加劳动力供应，从而带来额外的效率提升。在本文中，我们基于《消费者支出调查》和加州空气资源委员会的数据，估算了消费者需求系统。研究发现，行驶里程和休闲活动是相对互补的。因此，汽油税通过提高每英里行驶的成本来鼓励劳动力供应，从而带来额外的效率提升。相反，由于CAFE标准的实施降低了每英里的成本，反而抑制了劳动力供应，导致额外的效率损失。虽然劳动力供应的变化相对于劳动力市场来说很小，但相对于汽油市场而言，这些变化仍然相当显著，因此对两种政策的相对成本产生了巨大影响。我们的点估计表明，在现行汽油税税率不变且忽略减少汽油消费带来的好处的情况下，汽油税的社会边际成本降低了近30%，而CAFE标准的边际成本则增加了近60%。这一结果意味着，提高汽油税而不是收紧CAFE标准的观点比以往的研究更为有力。事实上，任何对CAFE标准的收紧都会降低福利水平，除非减少汽油消费带来的好处被严重低估了。

abstract.text: We are helping a task force of the American Gastroenterology Association to evaluate the current state of the (decentralized) market for gastroenterology fellows, and to assess the prospects of reorganizing it via a suitably designed centralized clearinghouse, a "match." This market used a match from 1986 until the late 1990s. Starting in 1996, participation in the match declined precipitously, and it was formally abandoned after 1999. Consequently, the experience of this market when the match was in place, in comparison to the periods before and since, allows an assessment of the effects of the match. An analysis of how the match failed in the 1990s yields insights into the prospects for success of a new match. These events offer economists a rare window on how decentralized labor markets clear, and on how market clearinghouses succeed and fail.

10.1257/000282805774669691.abstractZh: 我们正在协助美国胃肠病学协会的一个工作组，评估当前胃肠病学领域分散式市场的状况，并探讨通过设计合适的集中式清算所来重新组织该市场的可能性。这一市场自1986年起一直使用这种清算方式，直到1990年代末才被正式放弃。因此，可以对比这种清算方式实施前后的市场状况，以评估其影响。对1990年代这种清算方式失败的分析，为评估新的清算方式的成功前景提供了启示。这些事件为经济学家提供了难得的机会，让他们了解分散式市场是如何实现清算的，以及市场清算所是如何成功或失败的。

abstract.text: Trust is an essential component of transactions that occur over time. The amount of trust accorded to others is typically conditioned on multiple factors, including knowledge of the other party, the history of interactions, and the context of exchange. Determining who to trust and who to distrust is especially important in modern societies with largely impersonal exchange (Vernon L. Smith, 2003). In fact, trust is among the strongest predictors of whether a country will successfully develop: poor countries are by-and-large low-trust countries. This occurs because low trust inhibits investment and thereby the creation of wealth (Zak and Stephen Knack, 2001). Unfortunately, subjects in laboratory settings are unable to articulate clearly why they decide to trust or distrust a trading partner. In order to discover why human beings trust or distrust others, economists have begun obtaining physiologic measurements during trust experiments (Zak, 2005). This new transdisciplinary field is called neuroeconomics (Kevin McCabe et al.,

10.1257/000282805774669709.abstractZh: 信任是随时间发生的交易中的关键要素。人们对他人的信任程度通常取决于多个因素，包括对方的信息、互动的历史以及交换的情境。在现代社会，由于交换大多是非个人化的，因此确定谁值得信任、谁值得不信任尤为重要（Vernon L. Smith, 2003）。事实上，信任是判断一个国家能否成功发展的关键因素之一：贫穷国家通常缺乏信任。这是因为低信任水平会抑制投资，从而影响财富的创造（Zak和Stephen Knack, 2001）。不幸的是，实验室中的实验对象无法清晰地说明他们为何选择信任或不信任某个交易伙伴。为了了解人类为何信任或不信任他人，经济学家开始在信任实验中进行生理测量（Zak, 2005）。这一新的跨学科领域被称为神经经济学（Kevin McCabe等人）。

abstract.text: This paper examines the influence on estimates of the value of statistical life (VSL) of the worker's relative position in the wage distribution and relative position in the life cycle. Whereas past work on relative position effects in the labor market have been based on illustrative hypothetical examples, this paper develops empirical tests using actual market behavior. To test for the effect of relative wage position, we use two different measures: the individual's wage rank in the state and the wage rank by gender in the state. Using the CPS coupled with constructed BLS fatality risk measures by industry and occupation group, we show that inclusion of relative position variables in a canonical wage equation reduces VSL estimates by 25-33%. This effect is the opposite of what the relative position theorists have hypothesized. In contrast, recognition of the worker's relative position within the life cycle raises VSL estimates by up to 20%, especially for older workers.

10.1257/000282805774669718.abstractZh: 本文探讨了统计生命价值（VSL）估计值受劳动者在工资分布中的相对位置以及生命周期中的相对位置的影响。过去关于劳动力市场中的相对位置效应的研究通常基于示例性的假设性案例，而本文则通过实际市场行为进行了实证检验。为了测试相对工资位置的影响，我们使用了两种不同的衡量指标：个体在所在州内的工资排名，以及按性别划分的工资排名。结合CPS数据以及按行业和职业组划分的BLS死亡风险指标，我们发现将相对位置变量纳入标准工资方程后，VSL估计值会下降25-33%。这种效应与相对位置理论家们的假设相反。相比之下，认识到劳动者在生命周期中的相对位置则会使VSL估计值增加20%，尤其是对于年龄较大的劳动者而言。

abstract.text: This paper discusses recent neuroeconomic evidence related to other-regarding behaviors and the decision to trust in other people's other-regarding behavior. This evidence supports the view that people derive nonpecuniary utility (i) from mutual cooperation in social dilemma (SD) games and (ii) from punishing unfair behavior. Thus, mutual cooperation and the punishment of free riders in SD games is not irrational, but better understood as rational behavior of people with corresponding social preferences. We also report the results of a recent study that examines the impact of the neuropeptide Oxytocin (OT) on trusting and trustworthy behavior in a sequential SD. Animal studies have identified Oxytocin as a hormone that induces prosocial approach behavior, suggesting that it may also affect prosocial behavior in humans. Indeed, the study shows that subjects given Oxytocin exhibit much more trusting behavior, suggesting that OT has a direct impact on certain aspects of subjects' social preferences. Interestingly, however, although Oxytocin affects trusting behavior, it has no effect on subjects' trustworthiness.

10.1257/000282805774669736.abstractZh: 本文讨论了与利他行为以及信任他人行为相关的神经经济学最新研究证据。这些研究支持这样一种观点：人们从社会困境游戏中相互合作以及惩罚不公平行为中获得非金钱性的效用。因此，在社交困境游戏中，相互合作以及惩罚搭便车的行为并非不合理，而是符合人们相应社会偏好的理性行为。我们还报告了一项最新研究的结果，该研究探讨了神经肽催产素对信任和值得信任行为的影响。动物研究已经证实催产素是一种能够诱发亲社会行为的激素，这表明它也可能影响人类的亲社会行为。事实上，研究结果显示，接受催产素的实验对象表现出更多的信任行为，这表明催产素对实验对象的某些社会偏好有直接影响。不过，有趣的是，尽管催产素会影响信任行为，但它对实验对象的可信度没有影响。

abstract.text: During the last four decades the average total fertility rate in OECD countries witnessed a dramatic fall: from 2.9 in 1960 to 2.0 in 1975 and then to 1.6 in the late 1990s (reaching 1.25 in Southern Europe). With the exception of the United States, all advanced countries now have fertility rates well below the replacement rate of 2.1. In the absence of either sharp changes in fertility behavior or large inflows of immi-grants, their populations are set to shrink, par-ticularly in Europe. Still, within this generalized fall, cross-national differences in fertility be-havior have remained significant. 10.1257/000282805774669763.abstractZh: 在过去的四十年里，经合组织国家的平均总生育率出现了显著下降：从1960年的2.9下降到1975年的2.0，然后在1990年代末降至1.6（南欧地区甚至达到了1.25）。除了美国外，所有发达国家的总生育率都远低于2.1的替代率。在没有生育行为发生剧烈变化或大量移民涌入的情况下，这些国家的人口预计将会减少，尤其是在欧洲。尽管如此，在这一普遍下降的趋势中，各国之间的生育行为差异仍然相当明显。到2000年，各国的生育率范围从美国的2.1，到法国和挪威的超过1.8，再到更低的水平。

abstract.text: This paper discusses the reasons for the recent decline in Economics PhDs given out to American citizens and posits that the trend could be curbed if faculty were encouraged to utilize undergraduates more frequently in research projects and papers within not only the classroom, but within their respective departments at large.

10.1257/000282805774669772.abstractZh: 本文探讨了近期美国公民获得的经济学博士学位数量下降的原因，并认为如果鼓励教师更频繁地在课堂内以及各自系部内部利用本科生参与研究项目和论文，这一趋势可以得到遏制。

abstract.text: An extensive literature in education shows little relationship between teaching and research. Authors advance the notion that research enhances teaching, but typically ignore the prospect of teaching enhancing research. We report the results of a survey of active researchers in economics who were asked if they could cite a specific instance in which their research was substantively influenced by their teaching. About 50% reported such an experience, with a further 35% indicating, without prompting, that their teaching had a very positive effect on their research in general. Their comments identify a variety of channels through which teaching influences research.

10.1257/000282805774669790.abstractZh: 在教育领域的广泛文献中，教学与研究之间似乎缺乏关联。一些学者认为研究能够提升教学水平，但往往忽略了教学对研究可能产生的积极影响。我们针对经济学领域的活跃研究人员进行了一项调查，询问他们是否能举出一个具体例子，说明他们的研究受到了教学的实质性影响。大约50%的研究人员表示有过这样的经历，另有35%的研究人员在未被特别提示的情况下表示，他们的教学总体上对研究产生了非常积极的影响。他们的评论指出了教学影响研究的多种途径。

abstract.text: We examine whether unregulated, private insurance markets efficiently provide insurance against reclassification risk (the risk of becoming a bad risk and facing higher premiums). To do so, we examine the ex-post risk type of individuals who drop their long-term care insurance contracts relative to those who are continually insured. Consistent with dynamic inefficiencies, we find that individuals who drop coverage are of lower risk ex-post than individuals who were otherwise-equivalent at the time of purchase but who do not drop out of their contracts. These findings suggest that dynamic market failures in private insurance markets can preclude the efficient provision of insurance against reclassification risk.

10.1257/000282805774669808.abstractZh: 我们研究未受监管的私人保险市场是否能够有效提供针对重新分类风险的保险（即成为高风险客户并面临更高保费的风险）。为此，我们对比了放弃长期护理保险合同的个体与持续投保的个体的事后风险状况。与动态效率低下的情况一致，我们发现放弃保险覆盖的个体的事后风险低于那些在购买时具有同等风险但并未放弃合同的个体。这些发现表明，私人保险市场中的动态市场失灵可能导致无法有效提供针对重新分类风险的保险。

abstract.text: I examine here an aspect of law enforcement that has recently been the subject of debate. This is the choice of a profiling policy wherein decisions to search for evidence of crime may vary with observable covariates of the persons at risk of being searched. Policies that make search rates vary with personal attributes are variously defended as essential to effective law enforcement and denounced as unfair to classes of persons subjected to relatively high search rates. Variation of search rates by race has been particularly controversial; see, for example, Knowles, Persico, and Todd (2001), Persico (2002), and Dominitz (2003). Whereas recent research on profiling has sought to define and detect racial discrimination, my concern is to understand how a social planner might choose a profiling policy. This paper studies optimal profiling in a simple, illustrative setting. In related work (Manski, 2004), I consider how a planner might reasonably behave when he does not possess all of the information needed to determine an optimal policy. Section I poses a utilitarian planning problem whose objective is to minimize the social cost of crime and search. Search is costly per se, and search that reveals a crime entails costs for punishment of offenders. Search is beneficial to the extent that it deters or prevents crime.

10.1257/000282805774669817.abstractZh: 本文探讨了近期备受争议的执法领域的一个方面，即选择一种犯罪画像政策。这种政策决定了在寻找犯罪证据时，是否会根据被搜查人员的相关特征进行调整。那些使搜查频率随个人属性变化的政策，被一些人视为有效执法的必要条件，而另一些人则认为这种政策对某些群体不公平，导致这些群体的搜查频率较高。不同种族之间的搜查频率差异尤其具有争议性；例如，可以参考Knowles、Persico和Todd（2001年）、Persico（2002年）以及Dominitz（2003年）的研究。虽然最近关于犯罪画像的研究试图定义和识别种族歧视，但本文关注的是，社会规划者如何选择这种画像政策。本文在一个简单且具有说明性的情境下研究了最优犯罪画像政策。在相关的研究（Manski，2004年）中，我探讨了当规划者无法获得所有必要信息时，其合理的决策方式。第一部分提出了一个功利主义规划问题，其目标是最小化犯罪和搜查的社会成本。搜查本身是有成本的，而揭露犯罪行为的搜查还会带来对犯罪者的惩罚成本。搜查之所以有益，是因为它能够阻止或预防犯罪的发生。
