abstract.text: Recent years have witnessed a remarkable increase in the way firms organize production on a global scale. A variety of terms have been used to refer to this phenomenon: the “slicing of the value chain,” “international outsourcing,” “fragmentation of the production process,” “vertical specialization,” “global production sharing,” and many more. In developing their global sourcing strategies, firms not only decide on where to locate the different stages of the value chain, but also on the extent of control they want to exert over these processes. abstract.text: The economics of governance is an effort to implement the “study of good order and workable arrangements,” where good order includes both spontaneous order in the market, which is a venerated tradition in economics (Adam Smith, 1776; Friedrich Hayek, 1945; Kenneth A. Arrow and Gerard Debreu, 1954), and intentional order, of a “conscious, deliberate, purposeful” kind (Chester Irving Barnard, 1938 p. 9). Also, I interpret workable arrangements to mean feasible modes of organization, all of which are flawed in comparison with a hypothetical ideal (Avinash Dixit, 1996 pp. 4–9). The object is to work out the efficiency logic for managing transactions by alternative modes of governance—principally spot markets, various long-term contracts (hybrids), and hierarchies. Interest among social scientists, economists included, in the study and practice of good order and workable arrangements has been steadily growing. In contrast with the orthodox lens of choice (prices and output, supply and demand), the economics of governance is a lens of contract construction, broadly in the spirit of James Buchanan’s (2001 p. 29) observation that “mutuality of advantage from voluntary exchange ... is the most fundamental of all understandings in economics.” The economics of governance, as herein described, is principally an exercise in bilateral private ordering, by which I mean that the immediate parties to an exchange are actively involved in the provision of good order and workable arrangements. To be sure, the need for private ordering varies with the rules of the game as provided by the state. Distinctions between lawlessness where the state provides limited or unreliable protection for property and contract (Dixit, 2004) and lawfulness, where the state undertakes to protect property and enforce contracts in a principled way, are pertinent. The first of these applies mainly to primitive and transition economies. The second is commonly associated with Western democracies. Recourse to private ordering under conditions of lawlessness is altogether understandable: given the absence of state support, the * Walter A. Haas School of Business, University of California, Berkeley, CA 94720-1900. The paper has benefited from workshop presentations at the University of California–Berkeley, the University of Valencia, INSEAD (Fountainebleau), and the 2004 annual conference of the International Society for New Institutional Economics. An abbreviated version was also given as the Horst Claus Recktenwald Lecture at Nuremburg on 4 November 2004. Combining these four categories, articles using the word governance increased from 48 to 275 over this 20-year interval. Dixit (2004 pp. 149–50) reports that the number of web pages that turn up under the search for “governance” is huge.

10.1257/000282805774669880.abstractZh: 治理经济学旨在实施“对良好秩序和可行安排的研究”，其中良好的秩序包括市场中的自发秩序，这是经济学中备受推崇的传统（亚当·斯密，1776年；弗里德里希·哈耶克，1945年；肯尼思·A·阿罗和杰拉德·德布鲁，1954年），以及“有意识、有目的”的故意秩序（切斯特·欧文·巴纳德，1938年，第9页）。此外，我将“可行安排”理解为可行的组织模式，但所有这些模式与假设的理想状态相比都存在缺陷（阿维纳什·迪克西特，1996年，第4-9页）。研究的目的是为通过不同的治理模式来管理交易制定效率逻辑——主要是现货市场、各种长期合同（混合形式）以及层级结构。包括经济学家在内的社会科学家对良好秩序和可行安排的研究与实践兴趣日益浓厚。与传统的选择视角（价格和产量、供给与需求）不同，治理经济学是一种契约构建的视角，大致符合詹姆斯·布坎南（2001年，第29页）的观点，即“从自愿交换中获得的互惠利益……是经济学中最基本的理解”。正如本文所描述的，治理经济学主要是一种双边私人排序的实践活动，这意味着交易的直接参与者积极参与提供良好的秩序和可行的安排。当然，私人排序的需求会因国家提供的游戏规则而有所不同。区分国家提供有限或不可靠保护财产与合同方面的无秩序状态（Dixit, 2004），以及国家以原则性方式保护财产和执行合同的有秩序状态，是相关的。前者主要适用于原始经济和转型经济体。后者通常与西方民主国家联系在一起。在无秩序状态下寻求私人秩序安排是完全可以理解的：鉴于缺乏国家支持，... 沃尔特·A·哈斯商学院，加州大学伯克利分校，CA 94720-1900。本文得益于在加州大学伯克利分校、瓦伦西亚大学、法国高等商学院（枫丹白露）以及2004年国际新制度经济学学会年会上进行的研讨会展示。该论文的简版还作为霍斯特·克劳斯·雷克滕瓦尔德讲座在纽伦堡举行，时间为2004年11月4日。特别感谢Fred Balderston、Ernesto Dalbo、Avinash Dixit、Robert Gibbons、Witold Henisz、Ian Larkin、Steven Tadelis和Dean Williamson提出的意见和建议。1 朗·富勒（1954年，第477页）将“经济秩序”定义为“关于良好秩序和可行安排的科学、理论或研究”，这与我所指的治理理念非常契合。2 不断比较各种可行的替代方案，而所有这些方案都存在缺陷，其直接后果是，那些被归因于未能达到“最优第一”状态的所谓低效现象并非决定性的，而是引发了“与什么相比？”这样的疑问。我将在第四部分重新讨论这个问题。在1998年至2000年期间，与1977年至1979年期间相比，在选定的经济学、商业/管理、社会学/组织以及政治科学期刊中，使用“治理”这一词的文章数量分别为60篇、76篇、79篇和60篇。这些期刊包括：经济学领域的《美国经济评论》、《政治经济学杂志》、《经济学季刊》、《兰德经济学杂志》和《经济展望杂志》；商业/管理领域的《战略管理杂志》、《管理科学》、《管理学会杂志》和《管理学会评论》；社会学/组织领域的《行政科学季刊》、《组织科学》、《美国社会学杂志》、《美国社会学评论》和《社会学年度评论》；以及政治科学领域的《美国政治科学评论》、《政治科学季刊》、《政治杂志》和《政治研究季刊》。将这四个领域的文章合并计算，使用“治理”这一词的文章数量在20年间从48篇增加到了275篇。Dixit（2004年，第149-150页）报告称，在搜索“治理”时，能找到的网页数量非常庞大。

abstract.text: The problems of teen pregnancy, HIV/AIDS and the high rates of other sexually transmitted diseases among youth have lead to widespread concern with the sexual behaviors of teenagers. Alcohol use is one of the most commonly cited correlates of risky sexual behavior. The purpose of this research is to investigate the causal role of alcohol in determining sexual activity and risky sexual behavior among teenagers and young adults. This research also addresses the question of whether there are public policies that can reduce the risky sexual behavior that results in harmful consequences. Individual and aggregate level data are used to investigate these questions. Results show that alcohol use appears to have no causal influence in determining whether or not a teenage has sex. However, alcohol use may lower contraception use among sexually active teens.

10.1257/000282805774669899.abstractZh: 青少年怀孕、艾滋病以及其他性传播疾病的高发病率问题引发了人们对青少年性行为的广泛关注。酒精使用是引发危险性行为的最常见因素之一。本研究的目的是探讨酒精在决定青少年和年轻成年人的性活动及危险性行为中的因果作用。研究还探讨了是否存在能够减少导致有害后果的危险性性行为的公共政策。研究使用了个体和总体层面的数据来探讨这些问题。结果表明，酒精使用似乎对青少年是否发生性行为没有直接影响。然而，酒精使用可能会降低性活跃青少年的避孕使用率。

abstract.text: New medical technologies hold tremendous promise for improving population health, but they also raise concerns about exacerbating al-ready large differences in health by socioeco-nomic status (SES) (Smith, 1999). In prior work, we found that better self-management of disease by the more educated was a critical factor in maintaining the SES health gradient for two distinct diseases: diabetes and HIV (Goldman and Smith, 2002). For these diseases, both of which are characterized by the introduc-tion of new effective treatment technologies, differences by education in patient adherence to prescribed treatment explained a significant component of the health gradient.

10.1257/000282805774669907.abstractZh: 新的医疗技术对于改善人群健康具有巨大的潜力，但同时也引发了关于可能加剧因社会经济地位而产生的健康差异的担忧（Smith, 1999）。在之前的研究中，我们发现，受教育程度较高的人群在疾病自我管理方面的能力更强，这是维持糖尿病和艾滋病这两种疾病的社会经济地位与健康差异的关键因素（Goldman和Smith, 2002）。这两种疾病都得益于新的有效治疗技术的引入，而受教育程度对病人对治疗方案的依从性的影响，解释了健康差异的一个重要组成部分。

abstract.text: The conventional wisdom views high levels of education as a prerequisite for democracy. This paper shows that existing evidence for this view is based on cross-sectional correlations, which disappear once we look at within-country variation. In other words, there is no evidence that countries that increase their education are more likely to become democratic.

10.1257/000282805774669916.abstractZh: 传统观点认为，高教育水平是民主的先决条件。本文指出，现有证据基于横截面相关性分析，而当我们观察国家内部的差异时，这些相关性就消失了。换句话说，没有证据表明那些提高教育水平的国家更有可能实现民主。

abstract.text: For more than one hundred years, economists have discussed the concept of positional goods—that the utility conferred by many, perhaps even most, goods depends not only on the amount the individual consumes, but also on the amount others consume (e.g., Thorstein Veblen, 1899; James Duesenberry, 1949; John K. Galbraith, 1958; Robert Frank, 1985). While economic interest in “positional goods” is increasing (e.g., Mark Pingle and Mike Mitchell, 2002; Kenneth Arrow et al., 2004; Ed Hopkins and Tatiana Kornienko, 2004), the literature remains largely theoretical rather than empirical. If status concerns affect all items in the utility function equally (leisure as well as goods), the positional effect would operate like a lump-sum tax, reducing well-being without changing the allocation of time or money (Arrow et al., 2004). However, if positional concerns are stronger for some things than for others, then in order to understand how people can become better off in well-being, not simply in wealth, we must investigate how interpersonal competition interacts with material gains (Frank, 1997). Evidence about what goods are more positional than others is essential for correct policy recommendations (Gregory Besharov, 2002), but little is actually known about the relative positional rankings of items in the typical consumer’s utility function. 10.1257/000282805774669925.abstractZh: 一百多年来，经济学家一直在讨论“位置性商品”的概念——即许多甚至大多数商品的效用不仅取决于个人消费的数量，还取决于其他人消费的数量（例如，Thorstein Veblen，1899年；James Duesenberry，1949年；John K. Galbraith，1958年；Robert Frank，1985年）。尽管经济学家对“位置性商品”的兴趣日益增加（例如，Mark Pingle和Mike Mitchell，2002年；Kenneth Arrow等人，2004年；Ed Hopkins和Tatiana Kornienko，2004年），但相关文献仍然主要是理论性的，而非实证性的。如果地位问题对所有商品效用函数的影响都是相同的（包括休闲商品），那么位置效应就会像一次性税收一样，减少人们的幸福感，而不改变时间和金钱的分配（Arrow等人，2004年）。然而，如果某些事物的地位问题比其他事物更为严重，那么为了理解人们如何在不只是财富方面而是整体幸福感上获得改善，我们必须研究人际竞争如何与物质收益相互作用（Frank，1997年）。关于哪些商品比其他商品更具位置性，有确凿证据对于正确的政策建议至关重要（Gregory Besharov，2002年），但实际上，关于典型消费者效用函数中各物品的相对位置排名，我们知之甚少。文献中提出了四个假设：

abstract.text: This paper compares the true, ex-ante forecasting performance of a micro-based model against both a standard macro model and a random walk. In contrast to existing literature, which is focused on longer horizon forecasting, we examine forecasting over horizons from one day to one month (the one-month horizon being where micro and macro analysis begin to overlap). Over our 3-year forecasting sample, we find that the micro-based model consistently out-performs both the random walk and the macro model. Micro-based forecasts account for almost 16 per cent of the sample variance in monthly spot rate changes. These results provide a level of empirical validation as yet unattained by other models. Though our micro-based model out-performs the macro model, this does not imply that past macro analysis has overlooked key fundamentals: our structural interpretation using a fundamentals-based model shows that our findings are consistent with exchange rates being driven by standard fundamentals.

10.1257/000282805774669934.abstractZh: 本文比较了基于微观层面的模型在事前预测性能方面的表现，与标准宏观模型和随机游走模型进行了对比。与现有文献主要关注较长时间范围的预测不同，我们研究了从一天到一个月的时间范围内的情况（一个月的时间范围正是微观分析和宏观分析开始重叠的地方）。在为期3年的预测样本中，我们发现基于微观层面的模型始终优于随机游走模型和宏观模型。基于微观层面的预测几乎占月度现货汇率变化样本方差的16%。这些结果提供了其他模型尚未达到的经验验证水平。尽管我们的基于微观层面的模型表现优于宏观模型，但这并不意味着过去的宏观分析忽视了关键的基本面因素：我们的结构解释表明，基于基本面的模型也支持汇率由标准基本面因素驱动的观点。

abstract.text: Since 1950, housing prices have risen regularly by almost two percent per year. Between 1950 and 1970, this increase reflects rising housing quality and construction costs. Since 1970, this increase reflects the increasing difficulty of obtaining regulatory approval for building new homes. In this paper, we present a simple model of regulatory approval that suggests a number of explanations for this change including changing judicial tastes, decreasing ability to bribe regulators, rising incomes and greater tastes for amenities, and improvements in the ability of homeowners to organize and influence local decisions. Our preliminary evidence suggests that there was a significant increase in the ability of local residents to block new projects and a change of cities from urban growth machines to homeowners' cooperatives.

10.1257/000282805774669961.abstractZh: 自1950年以来，房价每年平均上涨约2%。在1950至1970年间，这一增长反映了住房质量和建设成本的上升。自1970年以来，这一增长则反映了获得新建筑许可的困难日益增加。在本文中，我们提出了一个简单的许可审批模型，该模型为这一变化提供了多种解释，包括司法观念的变化、贿赂监管人员的难度降低、收入的增加以及对便利设施的更高需求，以及房主在组织和影响地方决策方面的能力提升。我们的初步证据表明，当地居民阻止新项目的能力显著增强，城市也从单纯的城市扩张模式转变为以房主合作社为主的模式。

abstract.text: Understanding the nature and sources of human identity is an important objective in the study of a variety of social problems. Scholarly and popular writing on the cultural determinants of economic disadvantage underscores this point. Some analysts (e.g., Edward Banfield 1970, Thomas Sowell 1994, John McWhorter 2000, and John Ogbu 2003, to name a varied few) have hypothesized that a causal connection exists between the poor social performance of a group of people and their “culture. ” That disadvantaged people harbor “dysfunctional ” notions about identity has been offered as an explanation of a group’s welfare dependency, or its low academic proficiency. It has been said, for instance, that peo-ple fair poorly because they focus overly much on their own victimization, or because they disassociate themselves from their more successful fellows, etc. At the root of such cultural criticism lies the presumption that the disadvantaged should “reform” themselves: If those people would only see themselves differently, the critics hint, they could be so much better off. This mode of social explanation easily accommodates racial overtones. With the present paper we intend to raise serious doubts about such normative criticisms of the poor when applied to their conceptions of identity. We show that the identities adopted by a group of people can be perfectly consistent with rational individual choices, even though feasible alternative configurations

10.1257/000282805774669998.abstractZh: 理解人类身份的本质和来源是研究各种社会问题的一个重要目标。关于经济劣势的文化决定因素的学术和通俗著作都强调了这一点。一些分析人士（例如爱德华·班菲尔德1970年、托马斯·索维尔1994年、约翰·麦克沃特2000年以及约翰·奥格布2003年等）假设，一群人的社会表现不佳与他们的“文化”之间存在因果关系。有人认为，处于劣势的人持有“功能失调”的身份观念，这可以解释一个群体的福利依赖性或低学术水平。例如，有人认为人们之所以表现不佳，是因为他们过于关注自己的受害经历，或者因为他们与更成功的人疏远等。这种文化批评的基础是假设处于劣势的人应该“自我改革”：批评者暗示，如果这些人能以不同的方式看待自己，他们就能变得更好。这种社会解释方式很容易带有种族色彩。在本文中，我们旨在对将这种规范性的批评应用于穷人的身份观念提出严肃的质疑。我们表明，一群人所采用的身份观念完全可以与理性的个人选择相一致，即使存在可行的替代方案。

abstract.text: In recent financial crises and in recent theoretical studies of them, abrupt declines in capital inflows, or sudden stops, have been linked with large drops in output. Do sudden stops cause output drops? No, according to a standard equilibrium model in which sudden stops are generated by an abrupt tightening of a country’s collateral constraint on foreign borrowing. In this model, in fact, sudden stops lead to output increases, not decreases. An examination of the quantitative effects of a well-known sudden stop, in Mexico in the mid-1990s, confirms that a drop in output accompanying a sudden stop cannot be accounted for by the sudden stop alone. To generate an output drop during a financial crisis, as other studies have done, the model must include other economic frictions which have negative effects on output large enough to overwhelm the positive effect of the sudden stop.

10.1257/000282805774670013.abstractZh: 在最近的金融危机中，以及相关的理论研究中，资本流入的突然下降或突然停止与产出的大幅下降被联系在一起。那么，突然停止会导致产出下降吗？根据一个标准的均衡模型，答案是否定的。该模型认为，突然停止是由于一个国家对外借款的抵押约束突然收紧所导致的。实际上，在这种模型中，突然停止反而会导致产出的增加，而不是减少。对20世纪90年代中期墨西哥发生的著名突然停止事件进行定量分析后证实，伴随突然停止出现的产出下降不能仅由突然停止本身来解释。正如其他研究所指出的，要在金融危机期间产生产出下降，模型必须包含其他对经济产出有负面影响的摩擦因素，这些负面影响的强度足以抵消突然停止带来的正面效果。

abstract.text: A simple intellectual property rights (IPRs) framework is introduced into a dynamic quality ladder model of technological diffusion between innovating firms in one country and imitating firms in another country. The presence of technological spillovers and feedback effects between firms in the two countries demonstrates that, even when steady state growth increases, transition costs sometimes dominate steady state welfare gains. Most existing models of international IPRs find that high intellectual property enforcement in the imitating country leads to welfare gains in the innovating country at the expense of the imitating country. In contrast, we find IPR regimes that, even after accounting for transition costs, positively affect welfare in both countries. Preferred IPR regimes maintain competition from imitative activity but enforce some remuneration to innovators for the spillovers they generate. Well-designed IPR regimes imposed at the time of trade liberalization will be welfare enhancing for both regions relative to trade liberalization without IPR enforcement.

10.1257/000282805774670022.abstractZh: 本文引入了一个简单的知识产权框架，将其应用于一个动态的质量阶梯模型中，该模型描述了在一个国家中的创新企业与另一个国家的模仿企业之间的技术扩散过程。技术溢出效应和反馈效应表明，即使稳态增长有所增加，转型成本有时也会占据稳态福利收益的主导地位。大多数现有的国际知识产权模型发现，在模仿国家中实施严格的知识产权制度会导致创新国家的福利收益增加，而牺牲模仿国家的利益。相比之下，我们发现即使考虑到转型成本，某些知识产权制度仍会对两国福利产生积极影响。理想的知识产权制度能够维持来自模仿活动的竞争，同时为创新者提供一定的补偿，以换取他们带来的溢出效应。与没有知识产权制度的情况相比，在贸易自由化时实施合理的知识产权制度，会提升两个地区的福利水平。

abstract.text: We present a theoretical model of airport searches. The model extends previous work in the area in that detection conditional on search is imperfect. The hit rates tests for racial bias developed in Knowles, Persico, and Todd (2001) is shown to apply even in the presence of imperfections in monitoring. We then study two channels for improving airport security: better targeting and better detection. We show that better targeting does not necessarily decrease the overall crime rate, although it will decrease crime in the group that is targeted. Improved detection rates unambiguously decrease crime. Group-specific improvements in detection do not necessarily increase the number of searches for those groups. The analysis is extended to allow for the possibility that criminal passengers disguise themselves as members of low-crime groups.

10.1257/000282805774670031.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个机场搜索的理论模型。该模型扩展了以往相关研究，因为基于搜索结果的检测并不完美。Knoles、Persico和Todd在2001年提出的针对种族偏见的检测方法，即使在监控存在缺陷的情况下，依然适用。接下来，我们研究了两种提高机场安全性的方法：更精准的目标定位和更有效的检测。我们发现，更精准的目标定位不一定会降低整体犯罪率，但确实会减少目标群体中的犯罪活动。而更有效的检测则能明确降低犯罪率。针对特定群体的改进检测方式，并不一定会增加对该群体的搜索次数。我们的分析还考虑了犯罪乘客可能伪装成低犯罪群体的可能性。

abstract.text: The fraction of doctoral degrees awarded to foreign students rose from 11.3 to 24.4 percent between 1976 and 2000, with nonresident aliens receiving a remarkably high share of the doctoral degrees awarded in the physical sciences (36.5 percent in 2000), engineering (50.7 percent), and the life sciences (25.7 percent).1 Over half of the foreign-born doctorates remain in the United States (Michael Finn, 2003), suggesting they may have a sizable impact on the labor market for high-skill workers. This paper addresses a core question in any evaluation of the costs and benefits of the foreign student program: Have foreign students harmed the economic opportunities of competing native workers?2 The foreign student influx provides a near-ideal research framework for measuring the impact of immigration. Although an exogenous supply increase in a particular field at a particular time may affect the education decisions of future generations of students, there is relatively little that current doctorates can do about the situation except to absorb the supply shock—presumably through lower wages. I. Data The study uses data drawn from the National Science Foundation’s Survey of Earned Doctorates (SED) and Survey of Doctoral Recipients (SDR). The SED provides a population census of all doctorates granted by a U.S. institution, with a response rate of around 92 percent. 10.1257/000282805774670040.abstractZh:
1976年至2000年间，授予外国学生的博士学位比例从11.3%上升到24.4%。其中，非居民外国人获得的物理科学（2000年占36.5%）、工程学（50.7%）和生命科学（25.7%）领域的博士学位比例非常高。超过一半的国外出生博士仍留在美国（Michael Finn，2003年），这表明他们可能对高技能工人的劳动力市场产生显著影响。本文探讨了一个在评估外国学生计划的成本与收益时核心的问题：外国学生是否损害了本土工人的经济机会？外国学生的涌入为衡量移民的影响提供了一个近乎理想的框架。尽管在特定时间和特定领域的外来人才供应增加可能会影响未来一代学生的教育决策，但目前的博士毕业生对此情况几乎无能为力，只能通过降低工资来应对这种供应冲击。

数据：本研究使用了美国国家科学基金会颁发的《 earned Doctorates Survey》（SED）和《Doctoral Recipients Survey》（SDR）的数据。SED提供了美国各机构授予的所有博士学位的人口统计信息，响应率约为92%。我利用SED来计算不同领域和年份的移民供应冲击的幅度。SDR是一个两年一次的纵向数据文件，提供了7%的博士学位样本。

10.1257/000282805774670059.abstractZh: 一些有影响力的评论家最近指出，发展中国家的民主化进程会导致政治不稳定、民族冲突以及糟糕的经济成果。例如，罗伯特·D·卡普兰在2000年指出：“如果一个社会处于不稳定的状态，那么民主不仅具有风险性，还可能带来灾难性的后果。”法里德·扎卡里亚在2003年指出：“虽然民主在许多方面促进了非洲政治的发展，并带来了人民自由，但它也导致了一定程度的混乱和不稳定，这实际上使许多国家的腐败和无法无天现象更加严重。”艾米·蔡亚在2002年指出：“……在世界上许多国家中……”

abstract.text: Infertility is considered by the medical community to be a disease of the reproductive system. It currently affects over 6 million individuals, and one in ten couples cannot conceive without medical assistance. The psychological effects of infertility have been compared to the effects of other diseases such as cancer and heart disease (e.g., Anne T. Fidler and Judith Bernstein, 1999), and the financial costs of treatment can be quite large. However, only 25 percent of all health-plan sponsors provide coverage for infertility services. In response to a perceived need for coverage, legislation was introduced at the federal level in 2003 that would require health plans to provide infertility benefits. As the fraction of the population affected by infertility continues to rise, there are likely to be continued efforts to mandate coverage. Understanding the costs and benefits of these policies thus becomes increasingly important. The first component of a full analysis is to determine whether these mandates will actually have an effect on fertility. By reducing the price of infertility treatment, one might expect to see an increase in utilization of treatments. This could be true if the mandate expands access to individuals who previously could not afford treatment, or if individuals who were previously receiving treatment now choose to consume higher quantities (or a higher quality) of treatment. However, it is also possible that these mandates have no effect on access or on treatment consumed but simply provide windfall gains to those individuals who would have purchased treatment in the absence of insurance coverage. Finally, mandates may also have dynamic effects on the timing of births. Individuals could seek treatment earlier, which is beneficial from a medical perspective. Alternatively, individuals could further delay childbearing, with the knowledge that they will ultimately be covered. In this paper, I ask the first-order question of whether the mandated insurance coverage of infertility treatment has affected birth rates. As of 2003, 15 states have enacted some form of infertility insurance mandate. Using a differencein-differences approach, I exploit variation in the enactment of mandates both across states and over time and identify control groups that should not have been affected by infertility coverage. My results suggest that the mandates increase firstbirth rates for women over age 35 by 32 percent.

10.1257/000282805774670086.abstractZh: 医学界将不孕不育视为一种生殖系统疾病。目前有超过600万人受到其影响，每十对夫妇中就有一对无法在未经医疗协助的情况下怀孕。不孕不育的心理影响被比作癌症和心脏病等其他疾病的影响（例如，Anne T. Fidler和Judith Bernstein，1999年），而其治疗费用也可能相当高昂。然而，只有25%的健康保险计划提供不孕不育服务的覆盖。为了应对这种需求，2003年在联邦层面引入了立法，要求健康保险计划必须提供不孕不育相关的福利。随着受不孕不育影响的人口比例持续上升，强制提供此类服务的努力可能会继续。因此，了解这些政策的成本和收益变得越来越重要。全面分析的第一步是确定这些强制规定是否真的会对生育能力产生影响。通过降低不孕不育治疗的费用，人们可能会期望看到治疗使用的增加。如果这种强制规定能够扩大那些原本无法负担治疗的人的就医机会，或者让原本接受治疗的人选择更高质量或更高数量的治疗，那么这种情况是可能的。然而，也有可能这些强制规定对就医机会或治疗使用量没有任何影响，只是为那些在没有保险覆盖的情况下本来会购买治疗服务的人带来了额外的收益。最后，这些强制规定还可能对出生时间产生动态影响。个体可能会更早寻求治疗，从医学角度来看这是有益的。或者，个人可以进一步推迟生育，因为他们知道最终会得到保险覆盖。在本文中，我首先提出了一个问题：强制要求为不孕不育治疗提供保险是否影响了出生率。截至2003年，已有15个州实施了某种形式的不孕不育保险强制规定。采用差异-差异方法，我分析了各州以及时间上强制规定的实施差异，并确定了不应受到不孕不育保险影响的控制组。我的研究结果表明，这些强制规定使35岁以上女性的初育率增加了32%。

abstract.text: We investigate several possible links between psychological factors and trading performance in a sample of 80 anonymous day-traders. Using daily emotional-state surveys over a five-week period as well as personality inventory surveys, we construct measures of personality traits and emotional states for each subject and correlate these measures with daily normalized profits-and-losses records. We find that subjects whose emotional reaction to monetary gains and losses was more intense on both the positive and negative side exhibited significantly worse trading performance. Psychological traits derived from a standardized personality inventory survey do not reveal any specific "trader personality profile", raising the possibility that trading skills may not necessarily be innate, and that different personality types may be able to perform trading functions equally well after proper instruction and practice.

10.1257/000282805774670095.abstractZh: 我们研究了心理因素与80名匿名日内交易者的交易表现之间可能存在的几种联系。通过为期五周的每日情绪状态调查以及人格特质调查，我们为每个受试者构建了人格特质和情绪状态的测量指标，并将这些指标与每日标准化盈亏记录进行了关联分析。研究发现，那些对金钱收益和损失的情绪反应在正面和负面方面都更为强烈的受试者，其交易表现明显较差。从标准化人格特质调查中得出的心理特征并未显示出任何特定的“交易者人格特征”，这表明交易技能不一定是与生俱来的，不同的人格类型在经过适当的指导与练习后，同样能够胜任交易工作。

abstract.text: The most fundamental solution concepts in Game Theory — Nash equilibrium, backward induction, and iterated elimination of dominated strategies - are based on the assumption that people are capable of predicting others' actions. These concepts require people to be able to view the game from the other players' perspectives, i.e. to understand others' motives and beliefs. Economists still know little about what enables people to put themselves into others' shoes and how this ability interacts with their own preferences and beliefs. Social neuroscience provides insights into the neural mechanism underlying our capacity to represent others' intentions, beliefs, and desires, referred to as 'Theory of Mind' or 'mentalizing', and the capacity to share the feelings of others, referred to as 'empathy'. We summarize the major findings about the neural basis of mentalizing and empathizing and discuss some implications for economics.

10.1257/000282805774670103.abstractZh: 博弈论中最基本的解决概念——纳什均衡、逆向归纳法和迭代消除支配策略法——都基于这样一个假设：人们能够预测他人的行为。这些概念要求人们能够从其他参与者的角度来观察游戏，即理解他人的动机和信念。经济学家对于是什么让人们能够设身处地为他人着想，以及这种能力如何与他们的偏好和信念相互作用，仍然知之甚少。社会神经科学为我们理解我们表达他人意图、信念和愿望的能力提供了见解，这一能力被称为“心智理论”或“心理化”，而分享他人情感的能力则被称为“共情”。我们总结了关于心理化和共情神经基础的主要发现，并讨论了这些发现对经济学的一些启示。

abstract.text: Scholars and librarians have grown increasingly dissatisfied with the market for academic journals. New technologies might be expected to lower journals ’ production and distribution costs, and for these reduced costs to factor into reduced prices; but library subscription prices remain high (Theodore Bergstrom, 2001) and indeed have continued to rise faster than inflation (McCabe, 2002). This dissatisfaction has led to the proposal of a new business model for academic journals, open access. In contrast to a traditional journal, which generates most of its revenue with subscription fees, an open-access journal makes its articles freely available on the Internet, generating revenue with author fees.

10.1257/000282805774670112.abstractZh: 学者和图书馆员对学术期刊市场越来越不满。人们预计新技术会降低学术期刊的出版和发行成本，而这些成本的降低应该会体现在价格上的下降；但实际上，图书馆的订阅价格仍然很高（Theodore Bergstrom，2001年），并且其上涨速度甚至超过了通货膨胀的速度（McCabe，2002年）。这种不满促使人们提出了学术期刊的新商业模式——开放获取。与传统的学术期刊不同，开放获取期刊的文章可以在互联网上免费获取，其收入则来自作者付费。

abstract.text: In the United States, two-thirds of the nonelderly population is covered by employerprovided health insurance (EHI). According to a Kaiser Family Foundation national survey (2003), the cost of EHI has increased by over 59 percent since 2000 with no accompanying increase in the scale or scope of benefits. These increases in health insurance premiums may have significant effects on labor markets, including changes in the number of jobs, hours worked per employee, wages, and compensation packages. Indeed, it is possible that a significant portion of the increase in the uninsured population may be a consequence of employers shedding this benefit as health insurance premiums rise. Understanding how labor-market characteristics affect adjustments to increased health insurance costs is of vital policy importance. Some proposals to cover the uninsured rely on “employer mandates” requiring employers to cover eligible workers. Other proposals provide tax credits for the purchase of non-employer health insurance. The effects of these proposals on employment, wages, and health insurance coverage will be driven by the elasticities of labor supply and demand, institutional constraints on wages and compensation packages, and how much workers value the increase in health insurance costs. Since employers provide such coverage voluntarily, if workers fully value these benefits and are able to sort between firms based on their preferences, then (in the absence of other institutional constraints) they will bear the cost of the increase via reduced wages, with no accompanying change in employment, employment costs, or employee utility. There are many reasons to believe, however, that firms are limited in their ability to offset increases in the price of health insurance premiums through lower compensation, so that increases in the cost of providing health insurance may affect both employment and the structure of work. Identifying the magnitude of these effects empirically is difficult both because of data availability and because of multiple avenues for causality. In this paper we uncover the causal effect of increases in the cost of benefits on labor-market outcomes by exploiting an exogenous source of variation in the cost of providing health insurance: the recent “medical malpractice crisis” in which malpractice costs for physicians grew dramatically in some states but not in others. The growth in malpractice payments affects malpractice insurance premiums and health insurance premiums, but it should not affect other aspects of employment (see Baicker and Chandra, 2005b). Using this source of variation, we examine the effect of increases in health insurance premiums on employment patterns, earnings, and health insurance coverage. We find that the cost of increases in health insurance premiums is borne in large part by workers through increased unemployment and also through decreased hours for those workers moved from full-time jobs with benefits to parttime jobs without. These results have strong implications for the distributional impact of health-care reforms. * Both authors: Economics Department, Dartmouth College, 6106 Rockefeller Hall, Hanover, NH 03755, Dartmouth Medical School, and National Bureau of Economic Research (e-mails: kbaicker@dartmouth.edu, achandra@ dartmouth.edu). We thank Alan Garber, Seth Seabury, Jonathan Skinner, and Douglas Staiger for helpful conversations that have influenced this research program, and Derek Neal, Aaron Yelowitz, and conference participants at the Berger Conference for very insightful comments. We are grateful for funding from NIA-P01 AG19783-02. The opinions in this paper are those of the authors and should not be attributed to the NIA or NBER. 1 Based on tabulations of population under age 65 from the March Current Population Survey for 1988–2003. 2 There is a wide literature estimating the wage–fringe trade-off. A $1 increase in the value of fringes may be offset by a $1 reduction in wages—or a $1/(1 tax rate) reduction for tax-favored benefits. For example, Jonathan Gruber (1994) demonstrates that the passage of the Pregnancy Discrimination Act in 1978 resulted in employers shifting the entire cost of the mandate onto employees.

10.1257/000282805774670121.abstractZh: 在美国，三分之二的非老年人人口享有雇主提供的健康保险。根据凯撒家庭基金会2003年的全国调查，自2000年以来，健康保险的成本增加了59%以上，而福利的规模和范围并未相应增加。健康保险保费的增加可能会对劳动力市场产生重大影响，包括就业机会的数量、每位员工的工作时间、工资以及薪酬待遇的变化。事实上，无保险人口的大幅增加可能是由于雇主在健康保险保费上升的情况下取消了这项福利。了解劳动力市场特征如何影响健康保险成本增加的对策对于政策制定至关重要。一些解决无保险问题的方案依赖于“雇主强制”要求雇主为符合条件的员工提供保险。其他方案则提供税收抵免以鼓励员工购买非雇主提供的健康保险。这些方案对就业、工资和健康保险覆盖的影响将取决于劳动力供需的弹性、对工资和薪酬待遇的制度性限制，以及工人对增加健康保险成本的价值。由于雇主自愿提供此类保险，如果工人完全重视这些福利，并能够根据自己的偏好选择不同的公司，那么在没有其他制度性限制的情况下，他们将通过降低工资来承担成本增加带来的影响，而就业数量、就业成本或员工效用则不会发生变化。然而，有诸多理由认为，企业通过降低薪酬来抵消健康保险保费上涨的能力是有限的，因此，提供健康保险的成本增加可能会影响到就业和工作结构。实证分析这些影响的程度十分困难，一方面是由于数据获取的限制，另一方面则是由于因果关系的复杂性。在本文中，我们通过利用一个外生变量来揭示福利成本增加对劳动力市场结果的影响：即最近发生的“医疗过失危机”，在这一危机中，某些州的医生医疗过失成本急剧上升，而其他州则没有受到影响。医疗过失赔偿费用的增加会影响医疗保险和健康保险的费用，但不应影响就业的其它方面（参见Baicker和Chandra，2005b）。利用这一变量，我们研究了健康保险费用增加对就业模式、收入以及健康保险覆盖程度的影响。我们发现，健康保险费用增加的成本主要由工人承担，他们可能会面临更高的失业率，或者从有福利的全职工作转为没有福利的兼职工作。这些结果对于医疗改革在分配层面的影响具有重要的启示意义。* 两位作者均来自达特茅斯学院经济系，地址为6106 Rockefeller Hall, Hanover, NH 03755；同时也在达特茅斯医学院工作，并隶属于美国国家经济研究局（电子邮箱：kbaicker@dartmouth.edu, achandra@dartmouth.edu）。我们感谢Alan Garber、Seth Seabury、Jonathan Skinner和Douglas Staiger在讨论中提供的宝贵意见，这些意见对本研究项目产生了重要影响。同时，我们也感谢Derek Neal、Aaron Yelowitz以及在Berger会议上参与讨论的各位，他们的见解非常深刻。我们感谢NIA-P01 AG19783-02项目的资助。本文中的观点仅代表作者个人意见，并不代表NIA或NBER的立场。1 数据基于1988年至2003年3月《当前人口调查》中关于65岁以下人口的分类统计。2 已有大量文献研究了工资与福利之间的权衡关系。工资每增加1美元，福利可能会减少1美元，或者对于受税收优惠的福利来说，减少1美元/(1税率)。例如，Jonathan Gruber（1994年）的研究表明，1978年《妊娠歧视法》的通过导致雇主将这一法律要求的全部成本转嫁给了员工。

abstract.text: Using data from the U.S. Decennial Census and the National Longitudinal Surveys, we find little evidence of differences in the return to schooling across racial and ethnic groups, even with attempts to control for ability and measurement error biases. While our point estimates are relatively similar across racial and ethnic groups, our conclusion is driven in part by relatively large standard errors. That said, we find no evidence that returns to schooling are lower for African Americans or Hispanics than for non-minorities. As a result, policies that increase education among the lowskilled have a good possibility of increasing economic well-being and reducing inequality. More generally, our analysis suggests further research is needed to better understand the nature of measurement error and ability bias across subgroups in order to fully understand potential heterogeneity in the return to schooling across the population.

10.1257/000282805774670130.abstractZh: 通过美国十年一次人口普查和国家纵向调查的数据，我们发现尽管尝试控制了能力和测量误差的影响，但不同种族和族裔群体之间的教育回报几乎没有差异。虽然我们的点估计在不同种族和族裔群体之间相对相似，但我们的结论部分受到相对较大的标准误差的影响。尽管如此，我们没有发现非洲裔美国人或西班牙裔人的教育回报低于非少数族裔的情况。因此，针对低技能人群增加教育的政策很有可能会提升经济福祉并减少不平等现象。更普遍地说，我们的分析表明，需要进一步的研究来更好地理解不同亚群体中的测量误差和能力偏差，从而全面理解不同人群在教育回报方面的潜在差异。

abstract.text: Although women have matched or surpassed men in many educational outcomes, female students remain much less likely to major in quantitative, technical, and science-related fields. This under-representation may have serious implications for women's returns to education, occupational segregation, and earnings inequality. To address this problem, some suggest increasing mentoring opportunities for female students by hiring more women faculty members. This paper examines whether the presence of same-gender faculty members affects student interest in a subject using a comprehensive, longitudinal dataset of nearly 54,000 students. To address selection issues, we employ an instrumental variables strategy. The results suggest that female instructors do positively influence course selection and major choice in some disciplines thus supporting a possible role model effect. The findings provide insight into the potential impacts of policies designed to increase female representation on college faculties.

10.1257/000282805774670149.abstractZh: 尽管女性在许多教育成果上已经达到了或超过了男性，但女性学生选择定量、技术以及科学相关领域的可能性仍然要低得多。这种代表性不足可能对女性的教育回报、职业隔离以及收入不平等产生严重影响。为了解决这个问题，一些人建议通过雇佣更多女性教职员工来增加女性学生的指导机会。本文利用包含近54,000名学生的全面纵向数据集，研究同性别教职员工的存在是否会影响学生对某一学科的兴趣。为了解决选择问题，我们采用了工具变量策略。研究结果表明，女性教师确实对某些学科的课程选择和专业选择产生了积极影响，从而支持了可能的榜样效应。这些发现为旨在提高女性在大学教职岗位中代表性的政策提供了有价值的见解。

abstract.text: mechanism to match over 90,000 entering students to public high schools each year. This paper makes a very preliminary report on the design process and the first year of operation, in academic year 2003-04, for students entering high school in Fall 2004. In the first year, only about 3,000 students had to be assigned to a school for which they had not indicated a preference, which is only 10 % of the number of such assignments the previous year. New York City has the largest public school system in the country, with over a million students. In 1969 the system was decentralized into over thirty community school districts. In the 1990s, the city began to take more centralized control, and in 2002, a newly reorganized NYCDOE began to reform many aspects of the school system. In May 2003, Dr. Jeremy Lack, then the NYCDOE Director of Strategic Planning, contacted one of us for advice on designing a new high school matching process. The NYCDOE was aware of the matching process for American physicians, the National Resident Matching Program (Roth 1984; Roth and Peranson 1999). 10.1257/000282805774670167.abstractZh: 该机制每年将超过90,000名进入高中的学生与公立高中进行匹配。本文对2003-04学年开始实施的新高中匹配流程的设计过程及首年运行情况进行了初步报告，这些学生将在2004年秋季进入高中。在第一年，只有大约3,000名学生需要被分配到他们未选择的学校，这仅占前一年此类分配数量的10%。纽约市拥有全国最大的公立学校系统，学生数量超过一百万。1969年，该系统被分散到三十多个社区学区。20世纪90年代，市政府开始实行更集中的管理，2002年，重新组建的NYCDOE开始改革学校系统的许多方面。2003年5月，时任NYCDOE战略规划主任的Jeremy Lack博士联系我们中的一位，就设计新的高中匹配流程提供建议。NYCDOE了解到美国医生使用的匹配系统——国家住院医师匹配计划（Roth 1984；Roth和Peranson 1999）。他们希望了解该系统是否可以适应纽约市的学校需求。本文的三位作者（在几个关键节点上，Tayfun Sönmez也提供了帮助）为Dr. Jeremy Lack提供了建议，并成功说服了他。

abstract.text: The time that parents spend caring for their children is a topic of intense interest among researchers, policymakers, and parents themselves. Parental inputs of time are enormously valuable investments in children’s well-being and development. However, the declining prevalence of two-parent, married-couple families and the steady influx of mothers into the labor market are generally believed to have placed these investments at risk. We use time-diary data from the United Kingdom 2000 Time Use Study (UKTUS) to investigate how parents’ time spent in child care differs with their marital status and other characteristics. Unlike previous economic studies, which have analyzed alternative child-care activities but only among two-parent families (e.g., Peter Kooreman and Arie Kapteyn, 1987; Daniel Hallberg and Anders Klevmarken, 2003), we examine differences among married, cohabiting, and single-parent families. The household production model indicates that single-parent households may differ from married and cohabiting households either because there are fewer time resources or because there are fewer opportunities for economies of scale or specialization in household activities (Gary Becker, 1985). If marital relationships are more stable than cohabiting relationships, the type of union may matter.

10.1257/000282805774670176.abstractZh: 父母花费在照顾孩子上的时间，是研究人员、政策制定者以及父母们都非常关注的话题。父母投入的时间对儿童的福祉和发展具有巨大的价值。然而，双亲家庭以及已婚夫妇家庭的减少，以及母亲进入劳动力市场的数量不断增加，普遍认为这些投资面临着风险。我们利用英国2000年时间使用研究的数据，来研究父母在育儿方面的投入时间与他们的婚姻状况和其他特征之间的关系。与以往的经济研究不同，这些研究通常只分析双亲家庭中的不同育儿活动（例如，Peter Kooreman和Arie Kapteyn，1987年；Daniel Hallberg和Anders Klevmarken，2003年），我们则考察了已婚家庭、同居家庭和单亲家庭之间的差异。家庭生产模型表明，单亲家庭可能与已婚家庭和同居家庭有所不同，原因可能是单亲家庭的时间资源较少，或者家庭活动缺乏规模经济或专业化机会（Gary Becker，1985年）。如果婚姻关系比同居关系更为稳定，那么这种结合方式就可能会产生影响。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates evidence of the impact of outbound foreign direct investment (FDI) on domestic investment rates. OECD countries with high rates of outbound FDI in the 1980s and 1990s exhibited lower domestic investment than other countries, which suggests that FDI and domestic investment are substitutes. U.S. time series data tell a very different story, however: years in which American multinational firms have greater foreign capital expenditures coincide with greater domestic capital spending by the same firms. One dollar of additional foreign capital spending is associated with 3.5 dollars of additional domestic capital spending in the time series, implying that foreign and domestic capital are complements in production by multinational firms. This effect is consistent with cross sectional evidence that firms whose foreign operations expand simultaneously expand their domestic operations, and suggests that interpretation of the OECD cross sectional evidence may be confounded by omitted variables.

10.1257/000282805774670185.abstractZh: 本文评估了对外直接投资对国内投资率影响的证据。在20世纪80年代和90年代，拥有较高对外直接投资率的经合组织国家，其国内投资率低于其他国家，这表明对外直接投资与国内投资是互补的。然而，美国的时序数据则呈现了截然不同的情况：美国跨国公司在外国资本支出较高的年份，其国内资本支出也相应增加。在时序数据中，每增加1美元的外国资本支出，国内资本支出就会增加3.5美元，这意味着跨国公司的外国资本与国内资本在生产中是互补的。这一效应与横截面证据一致，即那些外国业务扩张的公司，其国内业务也会同步扩张。这表明对经合组织横截面数据的解释可能受到了遗漏变量的干扰。

abstract.text: From a macroeconomic perspective, the short-term interest rate is a policy instrument under the direct control of the central bank. From a finance perspective, long rates are risk-adjusted averages of expected future short rates. Thus, as illustrated by much recent research, a joint macro-finance modeling strategy will provide the most comprehensive understanding of the term structure of interest rates. We discuss various questions that arise in this research, and we also present a new examination of the relationship between two prominent dynamic, latent factor models in this literature: the Nelson-Siegel and affine no-arbitrage term structure models. *The views expressed in this paper do not necessarily reflect those of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco. We thank our colleagues and, in particular, our many co-authors. 1 From a macroeconomic perspective, the short-term interest rate is a policy instrument under the direct control of the central bank, which adjusts the rate to achieve its economic stabilization goals. From a finance perspective, the short rate is a fundamental building block for yields of other maturities, which are just risk-adjusted averages of expected future short rates. Thus, as illustrated by much recent research, a joint macro-finance modeling strategy will provide the most comprehensive understanding of the term structure of interest rates. In this paper, we discuss some salient questions that arise in this research, and we also present a new examination of the relationship between two prominent dynamic, latent factor models in this literature: the Nelson-Siegel and affine no-arbitrage term structure models.

10.1257/000282805774670194.abstractZh: 从宏观经济角度来看，短期利率是中央银行直接控制的政策工具，中央银行通过调整利率来实现其经济稳定目标。从金融角度来看，长期利率是预期未来短期利率的风险调整平均值。因此，正如许多最新研究所表明的，采用联合宏观金融建模策略能够最全面地理解利率的期限结构。本文讨论了研究中出现的一些重要问题，并对文献中两种著名的动态潜在因子模型之间的关系进行了新的探讨：Nelson-Siegel模型和仿射无套利期限结构模型。*本文所表达的观点不一定反映旧金山联邦储备银行的立场。我们感谢我们的同事，特别是我们的许多合作者。

abstract.text: Poor women typically use different medical providers than the non poor – resulting in de facto segregation of the poor in separate hospitals. They also have worse birth outcomes. This holds even for poor women with full insurance through Medicaid and controlling for geographic location. In this paper we explore the causes and consequences of using different providers. We exploit an exogenous change in policy that occurred in California in the early 1990s that suddenly increased Medicaid payments to providers. We find that women with Medicaid began delivering in the same hospitals as those with private insurance, suggesting that lack of access was partly responsible for the segregation and the observed differences in health. However we find that individual choice, not just access, also matters. We find that Black mothers responded least to the increase in provider access afforded by the policy change, even though they benefited the most in terms of reduced neonatal mortality and fewer pre-term births.

10.1257/000282805774670248.abstractZh: 贫困女性通常会使用与非贫困人群不同的医疗服务提供者，这导致了贫困群体在独立医院中的实际隔离。即使那些通过医疗补助计划获得全额保险的女性，在控制地理位置因素后，她们的生育结果仍然较差。本文探讨了使用不同医疗服务提供者的原因和后果。我们利用了20世纪90年代初加州发生的政策变化，该变化突然增加了对医疗服务提供者的医疗补助支付。我们发现，拥有医疗补助的女性开始在与拥有私人保险的女性相同的医院分娩，这表明缺乏就医渠道是造成隔离以及健康差异的部分原因。然而，我们发现，不仅仅是就医渠道的问题，个人选择同样重要。我们发现，黑人母亲对政策变化带来的医疗服务提供者增加的反应最为冷淡，尽管她们在降低新生儿死亡率和减少早产方面获得了最大收益。

This sug-gests the importance of both rising food intake and declining physical activity. abstract.text: On October 1, 2002 the State of Alaska increased taxes on malt beverages from $0.35 per gallon to $1.07 per gallon; increased taxes on wine from $0.85 per gallon to $2.50 per gallon; and increased taxes on distilled spirits from $5.60 per gallon to $12.50 per gallon. We use primary data on alcoholic beverage prices in Alaska to study a very basic question: What was the impact of the tax hikes on prices? Economic theory and previous empirical studies, mainly of taxes on goods other than alcoholic beverages, do not provide very much guidance on what to expect. For competitive markets with constant marginal costs of production, taxes are predicted to be fully passed through to prices, but in imperfectly competitive markets a 1-cent increase in taxes may increase taxes by less than or more than 1-cent. To address this very basic empirical question, just before and a year after the tax hike we conducted telephone surveys of on-premise and off-premise alcohol retail establishments across Alaska. The rich data allow us to estimate the impact of the tax hike: across beverage types (beer, wine, spirits); across brands; and across premise type.

10.1257/000282805774670284.abstractZh: 2002年10月1日，阿拉斯加州将麦芽饮料的税收从每加仑0.35美元提高到1.07美元；将葡萄酒的税收从每加仑0.85美元提高到2.50美元；将蒸馏酒的税收从每加仑5.60美元提高到12.50美元。我们利用阿拉斯加州酒精饮料价格的相关数据，来研究一个非常基本的问题：税收增加对价格产生了什么影响？经济理论和以往的经验研究，主要针对非酒精饮料的税收问题，对于这一问题的预期并没有提供太多指导。在边际生产成本恒定的竞争市场中，税收预计会完全体现在价格上；但在不完全竞争市场中，1美分的税收增加可能会导致税收增加不到或超过1美分。为了回答这个非常基本的经验问题，我们在税收增加之前和之后一年，对阿拉斯加各地的酒精饮料零售场所进行了电话调查。丰富的数据使我们能够估算税收增加的影响：包括不同饮料类型（啤酒、葡萄酒、烈酒）、不同品牌以及不同类型的零售场所。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the effect of regulations governing land use and residential construction upon the course of housing prices in California. We explore the linkage between regulation and housing prices using measures of housing prices estimated from the Public Use Microdata Samples (PUMS) of the 1990 and 2000 Census of Population and Housing, together with a detailed cross-sectional land use regulation and growth controls in California cities. We explore mechanisms by which regulatory stringency may affect housing outcomes for consumers. First, we assess whether housing is more expensive in more regulated cities. Second, we assess whether growth in the city-level housing stock over the period of a decade depends on the degree of land-use regulation at the start of the decade. Finally, we estimate the price elasticity of housing supply for regulated and relatively unregulated cities. Our results suggest that current regulations have powerful effects on housing outcomes.

10.1257/000282805774670293.abstractZh: 本文分析了土地使用和住宅建设法规对加利福尼亚州房价走势的影响。我们通过1990年和2000年人口普查的公开使用微观数据样本中的房价数据，结合加利福尼亚城市详细的土地使用法规及增长控制措施，探讨了法规与房价之间的关联。我们研究了监管严格性如何影响消费者的住房结果。首先，我们评估了在监管更严格的城市中，住房是否更昂贵。其次，我们研究了十年间城市级住房库存的增长是否取决于十年初的土地使用法规的严格程度。最后，我们估算了受监管和相对不监管城市住房供应的价格弹性。我们的研究结果表明，当前的法规对住房结果有着显著的影响。

abstract.text: Health and wealth are the two most important components of well-being. Rankings of well-being based on income will differ from more comprehensive rankings depending on the way that income and health are related. There are strong bidirectional causal links between income and health so that we cannot understand either without understanding both. What we call the ?wealthier is healthier? hypothesis asserts both that income is the main determinant of health, and that the international correlation between income and health is sufficiently tight for income rankings to indicate well-being more broadly.

10.1257/000282805774670310.abstractZh: 健康与财富是幸福感的两个最重要组成部分。基于收入的幸福感排名与更全面的排名有所不同，这取决于收入和健康之间的关联方式。收入和健康之间存在强烈的双向因果关系，因此我们无法单独理解其中任何一个，必须同时考虑两者。我们所说的“越富裕的人越健康”这一假设表明，收入是健康的主要决定因素，而且收入与健康之间的国际关联足够紧密，使得收入排名能够更广泛地反映幸福感。

abstract.text: There is a large empirical literature documenting the existence of a positive correlation between the number of times a hospital performs a given surgical procedure and the rate of good health outcomes achieved by patients at that hospital receiving that procedure. Typically, it is found that mortality is lower in hospitals which perform more of a given procedure. This result has been found for a wide variety of different procedures, time periods, and locations (Birkmeyer et al. 2002, Halm 2002, Shahian and Normand 2001). The two leading explanations for this correlation are the “practice makes perfect ” and “selective referral ” effects (Luft, Hunt and Maerki 1987). In the practice makes perfect hy-pothesis, either learning by doing or quality enhancing scale economies cause large hospitals to provide better quality care, improving outcomes. In the selective referral hypothesis, hospitals with higher quality attract greater demand and therefore have a greater volume of patients. The direction of causality matters for policy. If volume causes outcome, then policies supporting centralization of procedures in a few facilities may make sense. Hospitals that specialize in treating one or a few conditions may have the benefit of producing better

10.1257/000282805774670329.abstractZh: 有大量实证研究文献表明，医院执行某项手术的次数与接受该手术的患者获得良好健康结果的概率之间存在正相关关系。通常发现，执行更多某项手术的医院，其死亡率较低。这一结果适用于多种不同的手术、时间段和地点（Birkmeyer等人，2002年；Halm，2002年；Shahian和Normand，2001年）。这种相关性的两个主要解释是“熟能生巧”和“选择性推荐”效应（Luft、Hunt和Maerki，1987年）。在“熟能生巧”假设中，通过实践学习或质量提升的规模经济使得大型医院能够提供更高质量的护理，从而改善治疗效果。在“选择性推荐”假设中，质量更高的医院能够吸引更多的需求，因此拥有更多的患者。因果关系的方向对政策制定具有重要意义。如果数量是导致结果的因素，那么支持将手术集中在少数设施中的政策可能是合理的。专注于治疗一种或几种疾病的医院可能会受益于更好的治疗效果。

abstract.text: The prices of for-profit academic journals have increased rapidly over the past decade (Barbara Albee and Brenda Dingley, 2001). There remains substantial debate as to the explanation for these increases. Among those put forward are the increased concentration of the journal industry (see e.g., McCabe, 2002) and the relatively recent effort by major publishers to bundle print and electronic journals (Aaron S. Edlin and Rubinfeld, 2004). While both explanations are undoubtedly important, what is missing is the significant role of the primary customers of journal publishers—the academic libraries. As agents of college and university faculties, libraries serve the interests of their principals while having only limited information about faculty journal demands. Facing little or no hard budget constraint, faculty are unlikely or unwilling to make difficult allocative choices. As a result, libraries have been making hard choices for years (between journals and books, and among journals), in a world of increasing budgetary pressure. Given that electronic transmission of knowledge is becoming increasingly important, an understanding of the reasons for the increases in journal prices is a vital element in the ongoing discussion of best mechanisms by which scholarly communications can be disseminated. In this paper, we formulate a model of library journal demand and suggest how it can be used to analyze the optimal pricing of journals by publishers. This represents part of a larger project whose long-range goal is to explain the pattern of journal pricing over time, and to

10.1257/000282805774670347.abstractZh: 过去十年中，营利性学术期刊的价格迅速上涨（Barbara Albee和Brenda Dingley，2001年）。关于这些价格上涨的原因，仍然存在大量争论。其中一些解释包括期刊行业的集中度增加（参见McCabe，2002年）以及主要出版商最近尝试将纸质期刊和电子期刊合并的做法（Aaron S. Edlin和Rubinfeld，2004年）。虽然这两种解释无疑很重要，但缺失的是期刊出版商的主要客户——学术图书馆的重要作用。作为大学和学院教员的代理机构，图书馆在服务于其客户利益的同时，对教员对期刊的需求了解有限。由于几乎没有预算限制，教员不太可能或不愿意做出艰难的资源配置选择。因此，多年来图书馆一直在面临预算压力的情况下做出艰难的选择（在期刊与书籍之间，以及在不同期刊之间）。鉴于知识电子传输变得越来越重要，了解期刊价格上涨的原因对于讨论如何最佳传播学术成果至关重要。在本文中，我们建立了一个图书馆期刊需求模型，并提出了如何利用该模型来分析出版商对期刊定价的最佳策略。这只是一个更大项目的一部分，该项目的长远目标是解释期刊定价随时间的变化模式。

abstract.text: Anecdotes are often quite suggestive. A grad-uate student in economics who was serving as a teaching assistant once reported that his major professor came into his office and told him that he was spending too much of his time helping his undergraduate students and not enough time on his research. Was the professor expressing a preference for time spent on teaching over re-search? Or was the professor suggesting to the student that the academic market rewards re-search more than teaching? Regardless, the un-derlying message that gets transferred from such an experience, as early as graduate educa-tion and perhaps throughout a career, is that teaching is not as important or valuable as research. Such strong conclusions, however, should not be based on anecdotal evidence. Whether economics professors are less interested in teaching and more interested in research is an empirical question worthy of study. Although teaching and research choices made by econom-ics faculty members reflect both preferences and choice sets, in this study we focus on prefer-ences and use a national survey to compare the teaching and research views of economists with faculty members in other major disciplines.

10.1257/000282805774670383.abstractZh: 轶事往往具有很大的启示性。一位经济学专业的大学毕业生曾报告说，他的主教授进入他的办公室后告诉他，他花费太多时间帮助本科生，而用于研究的时间却不足。这位教授是在表达更倾向于教学而非研究的态度吗？还是他在向这位学生暗示，学术界对研究的重视程度高于教学？无论如何，从这样的经历中传递出的潜在信息，早在研究生阶段，甚至在整个职业生涯中，都是教学并不像研究那样重要或有价值。然而，如此强烈的结论不应仅基于轶事证据。经济学教授是否更不关注教学而更关注研究，这是一个值得研究的实证问题。尽管经济学教师的教学和研究选择反映了他们的偏好和选择范围，但在本研究中，我们重点关注偏好，并通过全国性的调查来比较经济学家与其他主要学科的教师在教学和研究方面的观点。

abstract.text: In traditional economic models, individual utility depends only on absolute consumption. These models lie at the heart of claims that pursuit of individual self-interest promotes aggregate welfare. Recent years have seen renewed interest in economic models in which individual utility depends not only on absolute consumption, but also on relative consumption. In contrast to traditional models, these models identify a fundamental conflict between individual and social welfare. The conflict stems from the fact that concerns about relative consumption are stronger in some domains than in others. The disparity gives rise to expenditure arms races focused on positional goods—those for which relative position matters most. The result is to divert resources from nonpositional goods, causing welfare losses. Compelling theoretical and empirical evidence confirms the importance of relative consumption in individual valuations. In light of this evidence, we must question the wisdom of economic policy recommendations stemming from models that ignore relative consumption.

10.1257/000282805774670392.abstractZh: 在传统的经济模型中，个人效用仅取决于绝对消费。这些模型的核心观点是，追求个人自身利益能够提升整体福利。然而，近年来人们对那些认为个人效用不仅取决于绝对消费，还取决于相对消费的经济模型产生了新的兴趣。与传统模型不同，这些模型揭示了个人福利与社会福利之间的根本冲突。这种冲突源于某些领域对相对消费的关注程度高于其他领域。这种差异导致了针对“位置性商品”的支出竞赛——即那些相对位置至关重要的商品。结果是将资源从非位置性商品上转移出去，从而导致福利损失。大量的理论和实证证据都证实了相对消费在个人价值评估中的重要性。鉴于这些证据，我们必须质疑那些忽视相对消费的经济模型所提出的经济政策建议的合理性。

abstract.text: This paper examines the empirical relationship between relative educational unemployment rates and monetary policy. Such an examination is warranted because policymakers’ attempts to understand the distributional effects of monetary policy may be confounded by vintages of the theoretical literature that offer contrasting views of how skill-based relative unemployment (with unemployment of the less skilled in the numerator) might behave over the business cycle. A traditional view emphasizes characteristics of labor markets that could induce countercyclical movements in skill-based relative unemployment. For example, Arthur Okun (1973) argues that an important benefit of high levels of aggregate economic activity is that opportunities for employment in the high-quality jobs sector open up to the relatively unskilled. A mechanism for the relative improvement of the employment prospects of the unskilled is changes in hiring standards of high-quality job providers that occur over the cycle. Changes that occur during expansion and boom periods mentioned by Okun include accepting younger and less experienced workers or workers without diplomas and more intensive screening of applicants. A forceful statement of this highpressure economy view is contained in Rebecca Blank (2000). A more recent view of the impact of technological adoption could have quite different implications for movements in skill-based relative unemployment over the cycle. For example, Dale Mortensen and Christopher Pissarides (1999) show that, in their equilibrium search and matching framework, the relationship between skill and unemployment is convex in the presence of labor-market policies such as unemployment compensation. In this environment, skill-biased technology shocks increase overall unemployment rates with a disproportionate share of the unemployment falling on the unskilled. In his popular account of the matter, Krueger (2002) ties cyclical investment in new technologies to the conduct of monetary policy, thereby linking relative educational unemployment to monetary policy. My answer to the title question emerges from quantitative results designed to assess the dynamic effect on relative educational unemployment of a monetary policy surprise, controlling for supply shocks and the introduction of new technical ideas. These findings appear to resolve some of the tension between alternative views on relative unemployment dynamics in favor of the high-pressure economy hypothesis. † Discussants: Seth B. Carpenter, Federal Reserve Board; Jonah B. Gelbach, University of Maryland; Bridget Terry Long, Harvard University.

10.1257/000282805774670428.abstractZh: 本文探讨了相对教育失业率与货币政策之间的实证关系。进行此类研究是有必要的，因为政策制定者在理解货币政策的分配效应时，可能会受到理论文献中不同观点的干扰，这些文献对基于技能的相对失业（以较不熟练的人的失业率为分子）在商业周期中的表现持有不同的看法。传统观点认为，劳动力市场的某些特征可能会引发基于技能的相对失业的逆周期变动。例如，Arthur Okun（1973年）认为，高水平的总体经济活动的一个重要好处是，高质量工作的就业机会向相对不熟练的人开放。不熟练者就业前景相对改善的机制在于，高质量工作提供者在整个商业周期中调整招聘标准。Okun提到的在扩张和繁荣时期发生的改变包括接受更年轻、经验较少的工人，或者接受没有文凭的工人，以及加强对求职者的筛选。Rebecca Blank（2000年）对这种高压经济观点的有力阐述。而关于技术采纳影响的最新观点，可能会对基于技能的相对失业在商业周期中的变动产生完全不同的影响。例如，Dale Mortensen和Christopher Pissarides（1999年）在他们的均衡搜索和匹配框架中表明，在存在失业补偿等劳动力市场政策的情况下，技能与失业之间的关系是凸的。在这种环境下，以技能为导向的技术冲击会增加整体失业率，其中非技术工人的失业率占比尤为突出。Krueger在2002年的研究中将周期性新技术投资与货币政策操作联系起来，从而将相对教育失业与货币政策联系起来。我对标题问题的回答基于定量研究结果，这些研究旨在评估货币政策意外变化对相对教育失业的动态影响，同时控制供应冲击和新技术概念的引入。这些发现似乎解决了关于相对失业动态的不同观点之间的某些矛盾，支持了高压经济假说。讨论者：Seth B. Carpenter，联邦储备委员会；Jonah B. Gelbach，马里兰大学；Bridget Terry Long，哈佛大学。

abstract.text: The market for developing country sovereign debt has become increasingly competitive. Is this necessarily good for welfare? Or, is there scope for benefi-cial government intervention to reduce competition, and promote coordination, among creditors? This paper reviews recent theoretical work on the market for developing country sovereign debt that shows that competition can reduce welfare. Further, it argues that while private sector creditor organizations have been successful at coordinating existing creditors in history, government inter-vention to discourage entry by new creditors may be welfare improving today. In the past three decades, the market for developing economy sovereign lending has grown increasingly competitive. Advances in telecommunications and the removal of capital market regulations have reduced the costs of doing business. At the same

10.1257/000282805774670437.abstractZh: 发展中国家主权债务市场已经变得越来越竞争激烈。这是否对福利有益？或者，是否有空间通过政府干预来减少竞争，并促进债权人之间的协调？本文回顾了关于发展中国家主权债务市场的最新理论研究，这些研究表明竞争可能会降低福利。此外，文章认为，虽然私营部门的债权人组织在过去成功地协调了现有债权人，但政府干预以阻止新债权人的进入可能会改善福利。在过去三十年中，发展中国家主权债务市场的竞争程度日益加剧。电信技术的进步以及资本市场监管的放宽降低了商业成本。

abstract.text: I examine the implications of employer learning and statistical discrimination for initial employment rates, wages, and occupational attainment and for wage growth and occupational change over a career using a model in which the sensitivity of productivity to worker skill is increasing in the skill requirements of the job and in which employers learn about worker skill more rapidly in high skill jobs. I show that statistical discrimination influences initial employment rates, wage levels and job type, and that employers' initial estimate of productivity influences wage growth even in an environment in which access to training is not an issue. The implication is that the market may be slow to learn that a worker is highly skilled if worker's best early job opportunity given the information available to employers is a low skill level job that reveals little about the worker's talent.

10.1257/000282805774670455.abstractZh: 我研究雇主学习行为与统计性歧视对初次就业率、工资、职业成就以及职业生涯中的工资增长和职业变化的影响。我所使用的模型认为，生产力的敏感性随着工作技能要求的提高而增加，而且雇主在高技能岗位中能更快地了解工人的技能水平。研究表明，统计性歧视会影响初次就业率、工资水平和职业类型，而雇主对生产力的初步评估也会影响工资增长，即使培训获取并非问题所在。这意味着，如果根据雇主可获得的信息，工人最好的早期就业机会是低技能的工作，且无法充分反映工人的才能，那么市场可能难以迅速意识到该工人具有高超的技能。

abstract.text: We explore economic model of health behaviors.While the standard economic model of health as an investment is generally supported empirically, the ability of this model to explain heterogeneity across individuals is extremely limited.Most prominently, the correlation of different health behaviors across people is virtually zero, suggest that standard factors such as variation in discount rates or the value of life are not the drivers of behavior.We focus instead on two other factors: genetics; and behavioral-specific situational factors.The first factor is empirically important, and we suspect the second is as well.

10.1257/000282805774670464.abstractZh: 我们探讨了健康行为的经济模型。虽然将健康视为一种投资的标准经济模型在实证上得到了支持，但该模型解释个体间差异的能力非常有限。最显著的是，不同健康行为之间的相关性几乎为零，这表明诸如折现率的变化或生命价值等标准因素并非行为的驱动因素。我们转而关注另外两个因素：遗传因素以及特定行为情境下的因素。第一个因素在实证上具有重要意义，我们怀疑第二个因素也同样重要。

abstract.text: Gasoline taxes are widely perceived as the most efficient instrument for reducing gasoline consumption because they exploit all behavioral responses for reducing fuel use, including reduced driving and improved fuel economy. At present, however, higher fuel taxes are viewed as a political nonstarter. Pay-as-you-drive (PAYD) auto insurance, which involves replacing existing lump-sum premiums with premiums that vary in proportion to miles driven, should be more practical, since they do not raise driving costs for the average motorist. We show that when impacts on a broad range of motor vehicle externalities are considered, PAYD also induces significantly higher welfare gains than comparable gasoline tax increases, for fuel reductions below 9%. The reason is that under PAYD, all of the reduction in fuel use, rather than just a fraction, comes from reduced driving; this produces a substantial additional efficiency gain because mileage-related external costs (especially congestion and accidents) are relatively large in magnitude.

10.1257/000282805774670482.abstractZh: 汽油税被广泛认为是减少汽油消费的最有效手段，因为它们能够利用所有减少燃料使用的行为反应，包括减少驾驶次数和提高燃油经济性。然而，目前较高的燃油税被视为政治上的不可行选择。按行驶里程收费的汽车保险，即用与行驶里程成正比的保费来替代现有的固定保费，应该更为实用，因为它不会增加普通驾驶者的驾驶成本。我们表明，当考虑到对一系列机动车外部性的影响时，按行驶里程收费的保险还能带来比同等汽油税增加更大的福利收益，尤其是在燃油减少超过9%的情况下。原因在于，在按行驶里程收费的保险制度下，减少的燃料使用量并非仅仅来自减少驾驶次数，而是来自减少整体驾驶行为；这会带来显著的效率提升，因为与里程相关的外部成本（尤其是拥堵和事故）的幅度相对较大。

abstract.text: This paper re-examines the returns to computer use using a new matched workplace-employee data from Canada. We control for potential selection using instrumental variables. Results suggest that it is not merely the employee having a computer on his desk, but rather having complementary computer skills, that causes wages to increase.

10.1257/000282805774670509.abstractZh: 本文重新分析了使用计算机所带来的收益，采用了来自加拿大的新的匹配式工作场所-员工数据。我们通过工具变量控制了潜在的选择偏差。研究结果表明，导致工资增加的不仅仅是员工桌上有一台计算机，更重要的是他们具备辅助性的计算机技能。

abstract.text: We examine the strategies of …rms that face an array of organizational choices. Each …rm must acquire intermediate inputs and assemble …nal products. It can perform these activities internally or externally, and at home or abroad. We study the relative prevalence of various organizational structures in industries that di¤er in …xed organizational costs when …rms in each industry di¤er in their productivity levels. We identify conditions under which outsourcing and foreign sourcing are positively correlated across industries. This correlation results from two sources of complementarity between outsourcing and foreign sourcing.

10.1257/000282805774670518.abstractZh: 我们研究了面临各种组织选择的……企业所采用的策略。每个……企业都必须获取中间投入并组装……最终产品。这些活动可以在企业内部或外部进行，既可以在国内也可以在国外进行。我们研究了不同行业在各种固定组织成本下的各种组织结构的相对普遍性，同时考虑到各行业中……企业的生产率水平存在差异。我们确定了外包和海外采购在不同行业中呈正相关的条件。这种相关性源于外包和海外采购之间的两种互补性来源。

abstract.text: Public policy towards low-income families with children in the United States has changed dramatically in the last two decades. The Aid to Families with Dependent Children (AFDC) program, in existence since 1935, was replaced with Temporary Assistance to Needy Families (TANF) as part of the 1996 Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act (PRWORA). PRWORA eliminated the entitlement feature of cash assistance to poor families. Alongside this dismantling of the traditional welfare system has been the increasing reliance on the tax system as a means of providing cash support for needy families. A series of tax acts starting with the 1986 Tax Reform Act have increased assistance to the working poor through expansions of the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC). In 2003, more than 21 million families are estimated to have benefited from the tax credit, at a total cost to the federal government of more than 37 billion dollars (U.S. Treasury 2004).1 It is widely accepted that the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) raised the employment of eligible women with children. Empirical evidence consistent with economic theory suggests that the EITC has been especially successful at promoting employment among eligible unmarried women with children (Eissa and Liebman 1996, Meyer and Rosenbaum 2000). In fact, the labor force participation rate of single mothers increased by an astounding 14 percentage points between 1989 and 2002, a period of substantial

10.1257/000282805774670527.abstractZh: 在过去二十年里，美国针对有孩子的低收入家庭的公共政策发生了巨大变化。自1935年存在的“对有子女家庭的援助计划”被“临时援助贫困家庭计划”所取代，这一变化是1996年《个人责任与工作机会协调法案》的一部分。该法案取消了针对贫困家庭的现金援助的福利性质。随着传统福利体系的瓦解，人们越来越依赖税收体系来为贫困家庭提供现金支持。从1986年的税收改革法案开始，一系列税收措施通过扩大劳动收入税收抵免政策，增加了对贫困劳动群体的援助。据估计，2003年有超过2100万户家庭从中受益，联邦政府因此承担了超过370亿美元的成本（美国财政部2004年数据）。普遍认为，劳动收入税收抵免政策提高了有孩子的符合条件的女性就业率。与经济学理论一致的实证证据表明，劳动收入税收抵免政策在促进有孩子的符合条件的未婚女性就业方面尤为有效（Eissa和Liebman 1996，Meyer和Rosenbaum 2000）。事实上，单亲母亲的劳动力参与率在1989年至2002年间上升了14个百分点，这一时期经济情况十分严峻。

abstract.text: This article examines the gasoline tax option being proposed in the U.S. in 2005, employing an econometrically based multi-market simulation model to explore the policy's efficiency and distributional implications. Because of its potential to improve the environment and enhance national security, reducing automobile-related gasoline consumption has become a major U.S. public policy issue. Policy impacts both in the aggregate and across households distinguished by income, car-ownership, and other characteristics were examined. Simulation results show that whether a gas-tax increase is regressive in its impact depends on the manner in which the tax revenues are recycled to the economy. The results also reveal significant heterogeneity in welfare impacts within household income groups, thus highlighting the importance of accounting for household heterogeneity in tastes and car-ownership in evaluating distributional impacts.

10.1257/000282805774670536.abstractZh: 本文探讨了2005年美国提出的汽油税方案，采用基于计量经济学的多市场模拟模型来研究该政策的效率和分配影响。由于减少与汽车相关的汽油消费有助于改善环境和增强国家安全，因此降低汽车用油量已成为美国重要的公共政策议题。研究考察了政策对整体经济以及不同家庭群体的影响，这些家庭群体在收入、汽车拥有情况等方面存在差异。模拟结果显示，汽油税增税的影响是否具有累退性取决于税收收入如何再分配给经济。研究结果还揭示了不同家庭收入群体之间的福利影响存在显著差异，这凸显了在评估分配影响时考虑家庭在偏好和汽车拥有方面的异质性的重要性。
